0.title: Using this mod
0.body:
The very first thing the HOST will see is a prompt to use the user-interface guided setup process (highly recommended) or not.

UI SETUP
==========================================

During the UI setup, the HOST has full control over the process. All other players will be able to select/draft their own factions, but all other settings will be selected by the HOST.

The UI setup includes options for:
● Which expansions to include (can be fine-tuned to which factions are included).
● Type of draft--what method will be used for players to select their two factions.
● Faction selection--each player will be able to select their own factions from an individually randomized pool, or draft from a randomized draft pool.
● Base settings--choose which bases will be included in the game (the defaults are the standard rules-based settings).

GAMEPLAY
==========================================

Base Basics: There are 6 "base zones" on the table, with a place to play a base card and a scoreboard associated with each. If needed, more base zones will become accessible once all 6 base zones are filled.
If using the UI setup, base cards will automatically be dealt out. When a base card is played into a base zone, the base zone becomes “activate” and the scoreboard turns on. More bases can be dealt by clicking the "Deal New Base" button near the base deck, or simply picking a base card from the deck, and dropping it onto a base zone.
The base’s scoreboard will show the base’s current breakpoint on the gray tile, as well as the combined power of all player’s on the white tile. The power contributed from each player is shown on the tile with the color that matches their seat color.
The tile with the cog icon opens a settings panel for the base (discussed later).
A player’s power at a base can be manually adjusted by left-clicking (to increase) or right-clicking (to decrease) their power there.

-----------------------
Cards and Colors: When playing a minion or an action that plays on a minion or base, it will be played in the base zone. Within each base zone are smaller colored zones. It is within these colored zones that players should play their cards—into the zone matching their chosen color. As a further indicator of where players should play their cards, when a player goes to play a card on a base on their turn, the colored zone will be highlighted and the colored disc associated with each zone will light up. If the colored zone does not highlight, this is an indicator that there is no base in the base zone (and therefore the base zone is not active) or it is not your turn.
The amount of power you have contributed to the base will be automatically calculated and shown on the scoreboard.
Tokens are available to modify a card’s power. These are contained in the green (+1), yellow (+5), and red (-1) pouches on the right side of the table (next to the Smash Up box). Just pull them out of the pouches and place them where desired. If placed on a base card, this will modify the base’s breakpoint (increasing or decreasing the breakpoint by the value on the token).

-----------------------
Turns Tour: The “Turns” panel in the upper left will show a list of current players in turn order. The current turn is shown with the player’s color/name highlighted by a light blue box. To end your turn, click the “End Turn” button in the lower right. This will pass the turn to the next player, and automatically draw 2 cards for you. To pass the turn to another player without clicking “End Turn” (and therefore avoid drawing 2 cards), just click the player’s name in the turn table.

-----------------------
Monster Madness: The madness, monster, and treasure decks will automatically be included in any game that uses “Obligatory Cthulhu” or “Munchkin” cards respectively. When a base that requires monsters is played, monster cards are automatically dealt to that base. The monster card play area is just to the left of the base card play area. NOTE: if a `Web Troll` monster is played on a base, it does not (yet?) automatically play another monster card.
At the end of the game, madness cards will be automatically tallied and apply their penalty to the final scores.

-----------------------
Scoring Stages: To score a base, click the base’s settings button. This will open up the “Base Settings” panel, showing several different things you can do with the base and the base zone. By far and away the most commonly used function here will be “Score Base”. After confirming that you do indeed want to score this base, a “base scoring progress panel” will appear on the top of every player’s screen. This panel shows:
● The name of the base being scored.
● Which stage of base scoring is currently underway (before, when or after a base scores).
● How many points are set to be given when the base scores.
In addition, there are two buttons that will appear to the left of the panel: “Pass” and “Used Special”. These buttons will appear first for the current active player. That player can pass, or if they decide to play/use a special ability, play the special ability and click the “Used Special” button. Either option will pass the opportunity to play/use a special to the next player. Once everyone has passed, the scoring will advance to the next phase.
The player whose turn it is to play or use a special can be monitored in the “Turns” panel: there is a pink star next to that player.
The scoring stages can also be advanced (more quickly) by clicking the navigation buttons on the bottom of the “Base Settings” panel, which will also display information about each phase of base scoring.

-----------------------
Beyond Base-ics: In addition to initiating base scoring, the base settings panel provides several other options. The “Change Breakpoint” button is used to manually set the breakpoint of a base. This allows players to essentially change the “starting breakpoint” of a base. After applying the change, any modifiers of the breakpoint (monsters, tokens) will then be applied to the breakpoint.
Some Smash Up cards, such as “Terraforming” or “Hulk Smash”, have the players remove a base card from play and replace it with another base without scoring the base or discarding the minions played there. This should be accomplished using the “Replace Base” button in the “Base Settings” panel. NOTE: If a base card is picked up and dropped into the discard pile, the whole base zone area will be cleared!

__bundle_register("Smash Up/Global", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local openTime = os.time()

local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp = require("Smash Up/SmashUpSetup")

function onSave()
    local save_state = {}
    local recentTime = os.time()

    -- Handle initial autosave interval detection (first 2 saves)
    if SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.initialAutoSavesCount <= 2 then
        SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.initialAutoSavesCount = SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.initialAutoSavesCount + 1
        SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.initialAutoSavesTimestamps[SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.initialAutoSavesCount] = recentTime

        if SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.initialAutoSavesCount == 2 then
            SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.estimatedAutoSaveInterval =
                SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.initialAutoSavesTimestamps[2] -
                SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.initialAutoSavesTimestamps[1]
            SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.estimatedAutoSaveInterval = math.floor(SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.estimatedAutoSaveInterval) - 0.10
        end
    end

    -- Only save if UI setup is complete and saves aren't paused for rejoin
    if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete and not SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.savesPausedForRejoin then

        -- If a rewind has occured, a new "Timeline" is created
        if SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.justRewound then
            SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.justRewound = false
            SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveTimelineVersion = SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveTimelineVersion + 1
        end

        -- Track every onSave() call
        SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.totalSavesCount = SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.totalSavesCount + 1

        -- Cap totalSavesCount to match saveStateHistory limit
        if SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.totalSavesCount > SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.maxSaveHistoryEntries then
            SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.totalSavesCount = SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.maxSaveHistoryEntries
        end

        -- Determine if this is an autosave or manual save
        local saveCount = SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.totalSavesCount
        local lastAutoSaveTime = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.gameStarted

        for i = saveCount - 1, 1, -1 do
            if not SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveStateHistory[i].isManual then
                lastAutoSaveTime = SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveStateHistory[i].time
                break
            end
        end

        local isAutoSave = (recentTime - lastAutoSaveTime) >= SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.estimatedAutoSaveInterval

        -- Add to save history
        SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveStateHistory[saveCount] = {
            time = recentTime,
            saveTimelineVersion = SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveTimelineVersion,
            isManual = not isAutoSave,
        }

        if #SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveStateHistory > SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.maxSaveHistoryEntries then
            local entriesToRemove = #SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveStateHistory - SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.maxSaveHistoryEntries
            for i = 1, entriesToRemove do
                table.remove(SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveStateHistory, 1)
            end
        end

        -- Save essential data efficiently
        save_state = {
            GameData = {
                SaveSystem = SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem,
                TableSetup = SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup,
                TurnControl = SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl,
                BaseScoring = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring,
                GameStats = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats,
                Customs = {customReadyToDetectNewObj = SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customReadyToDetectNewObj,
                            databaseEntryBackup = SmashUp.GameData.Customs.databaseEntryBackup},
                SystemTrackers = Common.deepCopy(SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers),
                CleanUp = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp,
                FinalScoring = SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring,
                UISetup = {General = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General},
            },
            GameBoard = SmashUp.GameBoard,
            baseBlockStatus = SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus,
            playersWithValidColors = Common.deepCopy(SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlSetup.playersWithValidColors),
        }

        -- Clean up data that shouldn't be saved
        save_state.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[0] = nil
        save_state.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID = {}
    end

    self.script_state = JSON.encode(save_state)
    return self.script_state
end


function onLoad(script_state)
    self.script_state = script_state

    --if no prior save state exists (this is a brand new unsaved game) then...
    if script_state == "" or script_state == "[]" then
        --ensure the in-game turns system is off (prevent passing turns before setup has been completed)
        Turns.enable = false
        Turns.pass_turns = false

        SmashUp.Setup.onLoad()

        --populate in-game custom faction database from GoogleSheet data
        SmashUp.XMLUI.CustomDecks.getCustomFactionsFromDatabase()
    else

        local saveTable = JSON.decode(script_state)

        SmashUp.GameData = saveTable.GameData

        local lastSave = SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveStateHistory[SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.totalSavesCount]
        if lastSave and not lastSave.isManual then
            -- This was a rewind (autosave)
            SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.justRewound = true
        else
            -- This was a manual load
            SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.justRewound = false
        end

        SmashUp.GameBoard = saveTable.GameBoard

        SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus = saveTable.baseBlockStatus
        SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlSetup.playersWithValidColors = saveTable.playersWithValidColors

        SmashUp.Setup.reinitiateGameAfterSaveReload()
    end

-- this function is called whenver an object gets spawned (in this case, pulled out of a container). It is only called on objects after the game has finished loading.
-- this function is used here to identify cards that are drawn/dealt that have errata
function onObjectSpawn(newObj)
    if newObj.type == "Card" and newObj.hasTag("Errata") and SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then
        Wait.condition(function()
            if newObj == nil then return end

            local oldText = SmashUp.Database.erratadCards[newObj.getName()]
            local cardDesc = newObj.getDescription()

            if not cardDesc:find("Errata") then
                cardDesc = cardDesc.."\nErrata: "..oldText
                newObj.setDescription(cardDesc)
            end

            if not SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.errataAnnouncedPerCard[newObj.getName()] then
                local playerColor = "White"
                for _, handZone in ipairs(newObj.getZones()) do
                    if handZone.type == "Hand" then
                        playerColor = handZone.getName():match("(.*) Zone")
                    end
                end
                local msg = "The card \""..newObj.getName().."\" has been errata'd. Please see the card's description for it's original text."
                if playerColor == "White" then
                    broadcastToAll(msg)
                else
                    if Player[playerColor].seated then
                        broadcastToColor(msg, playerColor)
                    end
                end
                SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.errataAnnouncedPerCard[newObj.getName()] = true
            end
        end, || not newObj.isDestroyed() and (not newObj.is_face_down and newObj.resting and not newObj.held_by_color))
    end
end

    end

function onObjectPickUp(player, object)
    -- Track held objects for save/load system
    SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.heldCardsPositions[object.getGUID()] = object.getPosition()

    if object.type == "Card" and object.hasTag("Base") then
        local card = object

        if card.hasTag("SuspendedBase") then
            local baseNum = tonumber(table.concat(card.getTags(), ", "):match("Base(%d+)"))

            local castPoint = Global.getSnapPoints()[baseNum].position
            local castFindings = Physics.cast({
                type = 1,
                origin = castPoint + Vector(0, 0.5, 0),
                direction = {0, -1, 0},
                max_distance = 1,
            })

            for _, castItem in ipairs(castFindings) do
                local foundObj = castItem.hit_object
                if foundObj.type == "Card" and foundObj.hasTag("Base") then
                    card.removeTag("ActivatedBase")
                    card.removeTag("Base"..baseNum)
                    card.removeTag("MonstersPlayed")
                    card.removeTag("SuspendedBase")
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        -- **Picking up a base card that has not yet activated a baseBlock, and all 6 normal base spots are used, this will then show the next extraBaseDock
        if not card.hasTag("ActivatedBase") then  -- 'ActivatedBase' tag marks a base card as having activated a baseBlock. Prevents base card from being able to activate another extraBaseDock.

            for i = 1, 6 do                                                                             -- ... iterate through all baseBlockZones on the gameboard, if any of them are off, then this function will be aborted; no phantomZone will be shown
                if SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[i] == "off" then                           -- ... if any of the six baseBlocks on the gameboard are still available/open/inactive...
                    return                                                                                      -- ... then abort this function; players should continue filling up the gameboard baseBlocks first
                end
            end
            SmashUp.Bases.ExtraBaseDocks.showPhantomZone()                                                  -- ... call this function to show the next phantomZone
        end
    end
end



function onObjectDrop(playerColor, object)
    SmashUp.makeSureMovementStops(object)
    SmashUp.makeSureCardGetsUnlocked(object)


    if object.type == "Deck" then                                                                   -- if the object that triggered this event is a deck...
        local deckCopy = false
        local reverseDeck = false

        if reverseDeck == true then
            local newDeck = object
            local newDeckData = newDeck.getData()

            local resortedCards = {}
            local resortedIDs = {}

            for num = #newDeckData.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do
                table.insert(resortedCards, newDeckData.ContainedObjects[num])
                table.insert(resortedIDs, newDeckData.DeckIDs[num])
            end

            newDeckData.ContainedObjects = resortedCards
            newDeckData.DeckIDs = resortedIDs

            newDeck.destruct()
            newDeck = spawnObjectData({data = newDeckData})
        end


        --*******************************
        if deckCopy == true then
            local newDeck = object                                                                         -- ... set the `newDeck` variable equal to the object (for ease of understanding)
            local newDeckData = newDeck.getData()
            local name = newDeck.getName()
            local isBase = name:find("Base")
            local isTitan = name:find("Titans")

            local box = SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox

            local boxData = box.getData()
            local oldDeckData
            local boxLoc
            local kitLoc

            local titanTable = {
                "Dinosaurs",
                "Ninja",
                "Pirates",
                "Trickers",
                "Wizards",
                "Bear Cavalry",
                "Ghosts",
                "Killer Plants",
                "Innsmouth",
                "Minions of Cthulhu",
                "Super Spies",
                "Tive Travelers",
                "Giant Ants",
                "Mad Scientists",
                "Vampires",
                "Werewolves",
                "Fairies",
                "Sharks",
                "Super Heroes",
                "Tornados",
                "Changerbots",
                "Ignobles",
                "Explorers",
                "Grannies",
                "Itty Critters",
                "Kaiju",
                "Magical Girls",
                "Mega Troopers",
                "Kung Fu Fighters",
                "Ancient Egyptians",
                "Cowboys",
                "Penguins",
            }

            if isTitan then
                local oldTitanCard

                for titanCount, titanName in ipairs(titanTable) do
                    local newTitanCardObj = newDeck.takeObject({position = {-55 + (5 * titanCount), 10, 2}})
                    local newTitanCard = newTitanCardObj.getData()
                    for x, kitData in ipairs(boxData.ContainedObjects) do
                        if kitData.Nickname == titanName.." Kit" then
                            for y, deckData in ipairs(kitData.ContainedObjects) do
                                if deckData.Name == "Card" then
                                    oldTitanCard = deckData
                                end
                            end
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    newTitanCard.Description = oldTitanCard.Description
                    newTitanCard.GMNotes = oldTitanCard.GMNotes
                    newTitanCard.Nickname = oldTitanCard.Nickname
                    newTitanCard.Memo = oldTitanCard.Memo
                    newTitanCard.Tags = oldTitanCard.Tags
                    newTitanCard.Value = oldTitanCard.Value

                    oldTitanCard.CustomDeck = newTitanCard.CustomDeck
                    oldTitanCard.CardID = newTitanCard.CardID
                    newTitanCardObj.destruct()
                end

                box.destruct()

                spawnObjectData({data = boxData})
            else

                for x, kit in ipairs(boxData.ContainedObjects) do
                    if kit.Nickname == ((isBase and "Bases") or name).." Kit" then
                        for y, item in ipairs(kit.ContainedObjects) do
                            if item.Nickname == name then
                                oldDeckData = item
                                boxLoc = x
                                kitLoc = y
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                if oldDeckData ~= nil then
                    newDeckData.GMNotes = oldDeckData.GMNotes
                    newDeckData.Description = oldDeckData.Description
                    newDeckData.Tags = oldDeckData.Tags

                    local cardsInOrder = {}
                    local cardInfo = {}

                    local baseTracker = {}
                    for x = #oldDeckData.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do
                        local singleCard = oldDeckData.ContainedObjects[x]
                        if cardInfo[singleCard.Nickname] == nil then
                            table.insert(cardsInOrder, singleCard.Nickname)
                            cardInfo[singleCard.Nickname] = {
                                count = 1,
                                description = singleCard.Description:gsub("(\nErrata.*)", ""),
                                gmnotes = singleCard.GMNotes,
                                tags = singleCard.Tags,
                                memo = singleCard.Memo,
                                value = singleCard.Value,
                            }

                            if next(cardInfo[singleCard.Nickname].tags) ~= nil then
                                for y = #cardInfo[singleCard.Nickname].tags, 1, -1 do
                                    if cardInfo[singleCard.Nickname].tags[y] == "Errata" then
                                        table.remove(cardInfo[singleCard.Nickname].tags, y)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            cardInfo[singleCard.Nickname].count = cardInfo[singleCard.Nickname].count + 1
                        end
                    end


                    local cardCount = #newDeckData.ContainedObjects
                    for index = 1, #cardsInOrder do
                        local name = cardsInOrder[index]

                        local placeCount = (cardCount + 1) - index
                        local card = newDeckData.ContainedObjects[placeCount]

                        card.Nickname = name
                        card.GMNotes = cardInfo[name].gmnotes
                        card.Description = cardInfo[name].description
                        card.Memo = cardInfo[name].memo
                        card.Value = cardInfo[name].value
                        card.Tags = cardInfo[name].tags

                        if cardInfo[name].count > 1 then
                            for _ = 1, cardInfo[name].count - 1 do
                                table.insert(newDeckData.ContainedObjects, placeCount + 1, card)
                                table.insert(newDeckData.DeckIDs, placeCount + 1, card.CardID)
                            end
                        end

                        if isBase then
                            baseTracker[card.Description] = baseTracker[card.Description] or {}
                            baseTracker[card.Description][card.Nickname] = Common.deepCopy(card)
                        end
                    end

                    newDeck.destruct()
                    -- newDeck = spawnObjectData({data = newDeckData})
                    boxData.ContainedObjects[boxLoc].ContainedObjects[kitLoc] = newDeckData

                    if isBase then
                        local oldBaseDeckData
                        local baseBoxLoc
                        local baseKitLoc

                        for factionName, baseList in pairs(baseTracker) do
                            for x, kit in ipairs(boxData.ContainedObjects) do
                                if kit.Nickname == factionName.." Kit" then
                                    for y, deck in ipairs(kit.ContainedObjects) do
                                        if deck.Nickname == factionName.." Bases" then
                                            for z, card in ipairs(deck.ContainedObjects) do

                                                if baseTracker[factionName][card.Nickname] then
                                                    boxData.ContainedObjects[x].ContainedObjects[y].CustomDeck = newDeckData.CustomDeck
                                                    boxData.ContainedObjects[x].ContainedObjects[y].ContainedObjects[z] = baseList[card.Nickname]
                                                    boxData.ContainedObjects[x].ContainedObjects[y].DeckIDs[z] = baseList[card.Nickname].CardID
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    box.destruct()
                    box = spawnObjectData({data = boxData})

                    SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox = box
                end
            end
        end
    end
    --

    if not SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then return end

    if object.type == "Deck" then                                                                   -- if the object that triggered this event is a deck...
        local deck = object                                                                         -- ... set the `deck` variable equal to the object (for ease of understanding)
        SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.repositionDroppedDecks(nil, deck)

    elseif object.type == "Card" then
        local card = object                                                                         -- ... set the `card` variable equal to the object (for ease of understanding)

        -- **if a card is dropped while inside any BaseBlockZone, just add the "DoNotStack" tag now to prevent risk of ANY stacking.
        for _, zone in ipairs(card.getZones()) do
            if zone.getName():find("BaseBlockZone") then
                card.addTag("DoNotStack")
            end
        end

        if card.hasTag("Base") then

            if card.hasTag("Phantom") then                                                              -- ... if card has the "Phantom" tag (will ONLY be true if the object is inside a phantomZone)...
                SmashUp.Bases.ExtraBaseDocks.solidifyPhantomBase(card)                                      -- ... then run this function to make the phantomZone solidify. This will also delete the phantomZone.
            else                                                                                        -- ... otherwise, if the card is dropped outside of a phantomZone...
                for baseNum = 14, 7, -1 do                                                                  -- ... then iterate through all extraBaseDocks...
                    if SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[baseNum] == "phantom" then                 --  ... and find one that is in phantom status...
                        SmashUp.Bases.ExtraBaseDocks.hidePhantomZone(baseNum)                                       -- ... and re-hide the phantomZone. this function is called here in order to make the phantom zone disappear immediately when the base card is dropped
                        break                                                                                       -- ... break early (found the phantomZone)
                    end
                end

                local baseNum = 0
                for _, tag in ipairs(card.getTags()) do
                    if tag:find("Base%d+") then
                        baseNum = tonumber(tag:match("Base(%d+)"))
                    end
                end

                SmashUp.Bases.returnBaseCard(card, baseNum)                                                 -- ... run this function to return the base card to its proper deck; this in turn will trigger the onObjectEnterZone code of the base deck
            end

        elseif card.hasTag("deckRemainder") then
            local cardReposWaitFunc
            cardReposWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
                if card == nil then return end

                local deckType = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromExistingReference(card)
                local okToReposition = true

                if deckType and (not Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors())) then
                    if SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks[deckType:lower().."Draw"] == card then
                        local zone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones[deckType:lower().."Draw"]
                        local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, card)
                        if isInBounds then okToReposition = false end

                        if okToReposition then SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.repositionDroppedDecks(nil, card) end

                    elseif SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks[deckType:lower().."Discard"] == card then
                        local zone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones[deckType:lower().."Discard"]
                        local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, card)
                        if isInBounds then okToReposition = false end

                        if okToReposition then SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.repositionDroppedDecks(nil, card) end
                    end

                else

                    for _, plyrColor in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
                        if SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[plyrColor:lower().."Draw"] == card or SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[plyrColor:lower().."Discard"] == card then
                            for _, zone in ipairs(card.getZones()) do
                                if zone.getGMNotes():find("CardZone") or (zone.getGMNotes():find("Sort Piles") and Common.isInTable(zone.getGMNotes():match("^(.-) .*"), SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getSeatedColors())) then
                                    local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, card)
                                    if isInBounds then okToReposition = false end
                                end
                            end
                            if okToReposition then SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.repositionDroppedDecks(nil, card) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end, function()
                if card.held_by_color then
                    if cardReposWaitFunc then Wait.stop(cardReposWaitFunc) end
                end
                return not card.isDestroyed() and card.resting
            end)
        end
    end
end


-- this TTS event is used to trigger several events, when objects enter a scripting zone:
    -- when a base enters a baseBlock's CardZone; triggers "activating" a baseBlocks scoreboard
    -- when a card enters a CardZone; triggers turning off the DiscLights
    -- when a minion, action, or titan enters a BaseBlockZone; triggers turning on the DiscLights
    -- when an object that has the "Power" tag enters a specific player's playZone; triggers counting up power around the base
function onObjectEnterZone(zone, enteringObj)
    if SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customReadyToDetectNewObj and zone.getGMNotes():find("custom") then

        if (enteringObj.type ~= "Board" or enteringObj.name == "Custom_Board") and enteringObj.type ~= "Scripting" and enteringObj.type ~= "Hand" then

            local objAlreadyHere = false                                        -- as in, there is already a different object here; don't run this code for a second object entering the zone as well.
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if (obj.type ~= "Board" or enteringObj.name == "Custom_Board") and obj.type ~= "Scripting" and obj.type ~= "Hand" and obj.getName() ~= "Custom Deck Mat" and enteringObj ~= obj then
                    objAlreadyHere = true
                end
            end

            if not objAlreadyHere then
                local tempData, codeStripped = SmashUp.XMLUI.CustomDecks.removeAllObjScriptCode(enteringObj)

                SmashUp.GameData.Customs.scriptWarningWait = Wait.condition(function()
                    if codeStripped then
                        enteringObj.destruct()
                        enteringObj = spawnObjectData({data = tempData})
                    end

                    Wait.frames(function()
                        if not (enteringObj.hasTag("OneCustomObj")) then

                            if enteringObj ~= SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject then
                                local typeList = {Minion = 0, Action = 0, Base = 0, Titan = 0}
                                for cardType in pairs(typeList) do
                                    UI.setAttribute("custom"..cardType.."Quant", "text", "")
                                    SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"] = 0
                                end
                            end

                            enteringObj.addTag("OneCustomObj")

                            local objType = enteringObj.name:gsub("Custom", "")
                            objType = objType:gsub("_", "")

                            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject = enteringObj

                            if enteringObj.type == "Card" or enteringObj.type == "Deck" then
                                SmashUp.XMLUI.CustomDecks.cardTypeScan(enteringObj)
                                UI.show("customCardTypeCountPanel")

                            else
                                UI.setAttribute("customTokenPanelText", "text", "Custom "..objType)
                                UI.setAttribute("customSingleTokenText", "text", "Just a single "..objType:lower()..".")
                                UI.setAttribute("customCreateBagText", "text", "Create a bag of "..objType:lower().."s.")
                                UI.setAttribute("customInfiniteBagText", "text", "Infinite number of "..objType:lower().."s.")
                                UI.setAttribute("customLimitedBagText", "text", "Specified number of "..objType:lower().."s.")

                                UI.setAttribute("customObjectType", "text", objType)
                                UI.show("customObjectPanel")

                                if enteringObj.getName():gsub(" ", "") ~= "" and enteringObj.getName():gsub(" ", "") ~= nil then
                                    UI.setAttribute("customObjectName", "text", enteringObj.getName())
                                    SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["customObjectName"] = enteringObj.getName()
                                else
                                    UI.setAttribute("customObjectName", "text", "")
                                    SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["customObjectName"] = nil
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end, 1)
                end, || SmashUp.GameData.Customs.pauseForScriptWarning == false)
            end
        end
    end

    if not SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then return end

    -- **Looking for cards to enter a hand zone**
    if zone.getDescription() == "Hand Zone" and enteringObj.type == "Card" then
        local card = enteringObj

        -- **If the card is a monster card, send it to the monster discard; no monster cards allowed in hand**
        if card.hasTag("Monster") and not card.hasTag("Base") then
            local returnDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.monsterDiscard
            local returnMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.munchkinMat

            local returnPosition = returnMat.positionToWorld(returnMat.getSnapPoints()[2].position)

            if returnDeck == null then returnDeck = nil end

            local yAdjust = returnPosition.y + 0.1                                                              -- ... initialize this variable that will be used to adjust the y-component of the return position of the baseCard
            if returnDeck then                                                                                  -- ... if there is a returnDeck referenced...
                local deckBounds = returnDeck.getBoundsNormalized()                                                 -- ... identify the size of the returnDeck
                yAdjust = (deckBounds.center.y + deckBounds.offset.y) + (deckBounds.size.y / 2) + 0.1                 -- ... adjust the y-component of the returnPosition to be 0.1 higher than the top of the returnDeck
            end
            returnPosition.y = yAdjust

            Wait.condition(function()                                                                           -- ... setup wait condition: waiting for SystemGates.cardMovementLocked to be OFF/false. Once condition is met...
                if zone == nil or card == nil then return end
                card.setRotationSmooth({0, card.hasTag("Base") and 180 or 90, 0}, false, false)                     -- ... then rotate the card to be same orientation as the returnDeck
                card.setPosition(card.getPosition() + Vector(0, 5, 0))                                              -- ... pop the baseCard up a bit higher than its returnPosition, so that the card will land on the top of the returnDeck
                card.setPositionSmooth(returnPosition, false, false)                                                -- ... finally, move the card to the returnDeck
            end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false and (card.isDestroyed() or card.resting))

        else

            if SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[card.getGUID()] then
                Wait.stop(SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[card.getGUID()])
                SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[card.getGUID()] = nil
            end

            local handZoneWaitFunc
            handZoneWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
                if zone == nil or card == nil then return end

                -- **If a madness card enters a handZone, assign the card to that player's color for purposes of tracking ownership**
                if Common.isInTable(zone, card.getZones()) then
                    if card.hasTag("Madness") then
                        SmashUp.Madness.setColorOwnership(zone, card)
                    end

                    if card.hasTag("deckRemainder") then
                        SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.breakDeckReference(card)
                    end
                end

                SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[card.getGUID()] = nil

            end, || (not card.isDestroyed()) and card.resting and (not card.held_by_color))

            SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[card.getGUID()] = handZoneWaitFunc
        end
    end


    if zone.getDescription() == "Hand Zone" then return end

    -- **What to do for Decks entering table zones**
    if enteringObj.type == "Deck" then                                                       -- if the object is a deck...

        local deck = enteringObj                                                             -- ... set `deck` to reference the object

        -- **When a Deck enters a `Draw` or `Discard` zone**
        if zone.getGMNotes():find("Draw") or zone.getGMNotes():find("Discard") then             -- ... if the zone is a `Draw` zone or a `Discard` zone...
            if deck.hasTag("Clone") then return end                                                 -- ... if the deck was created as part of the `last-card-clone-and-move` function, well then, don't do anything with that deck!

            local deckType, zoneType = zone.getGMNotes():match("(.+) (.+)")                         -- ... set the zoneType to be either `Draw` or `Discard`
            local pileType = zoneType == "Draw" and "Deck" or "Discard"                             -- ... based on `zoneType`, set pileType equal to either `Deck` or `Discard`

            -- **If the name on the deck does NOT match the zone, assign this deck now to the zone**
            if not deck.getGMNotes():find(pileType) or not deck.getGMNotes():find(deckType) then                                -- ... if the deck that triggered this zone is not currently attached to or associated with this zone...
                if not deck.held_by_color then
                    if (zoneType == "Draw" and deck.is_face_down) or (zoneType == "Discard" and not deck.is_face_down) then         -- ... and if the deck is face down and the zone IS a draw zone, or the deck is face up and the zone IS a discard zone...
                        SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.zoneTriggerDeckAssign(zone, deck, nil)                                                        -- ... then call this function to set this deck as attached to this zone
                    elseif (zone.hasTag("Madness") and not zone.hasTag("Player")) and deck.hasTag("Madness") then
                        SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.zoneTriggerDeckAssign(zone, deck, nil)
                    end
                end

            else
                -- **The code here is wrapped inside a local function definition so that it can be run again if needed**
                -- **If a deck triggered its own zone, make sure it is rotated in the direction the deck needs to be**
                local function ensureDeckProperRotation(zone, deck, firstCheck)
                    if firstCheck == nil then firstCheck = true end

                    local waitFunc
                    waitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
                        if zone == nil or deck == nil then return end

                        local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, deck)
                        if isInBounds then
                            if (pileType == "Deck" and zoneType == "Draw" and not deck.is_face_down and not (deckType == "Madness"))
                              or (pileType == "Discard" and zoneType == "Discard" and deck.is_face_down) then
                                deck.setRotationSmooth({0, (deckType == "Monster" and 90) or 180, (zoneType == "Draw" and 180) or 0})
                            end
                        else
                            if firstCheck then
                                Wait.condition(function()
                                    if zone == nil or deck == nil then return end
                                    ensureDeckProperRotation(zone, deck, false)
                                    return
                                end, || not deck.isDestroyed() and not deck.resting, 1.5)
                            end
                        end
                        deck.interactable = true
                        deck.setLock(false)
                    end, function()
                        if deck.held_by_color then
                            if waitFunc then Wait.stop(waitFunc) end
                        end
                        return deck.isDestroyed() or (deck.resting and (not deck.held_by_color))
                    end)
                end

                ensureDeckProperRotation(zone, deck)
            end

            if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin and (not deck.is_face_down) then    -- ... if Munchkin set is included then...
                SmashUp.CleanUp.findTreasuresInDiscardDecks(deck, deckType)                             -- ... run this function to check for any treasure cards in the discard
            end

        -- **If the Deck enters a `sort` area, then erase the reference to that object (don't be drawing or sending discards to piles that aren't in their designated spots)**
        elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("Sort") then
            local sortZoneWaitFunc
            sortZoneWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
                if zone == nil or deck == nil then return end
                local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, deck)

                if zone.getGMNotes():find("Base Sort") and deck.hasTag("Base") and not deck.hasTag("Monster") and not isInBounds then
                    for _, testZone in ipairs(deck.getZones()) do
                        if testZone.getGMNotes():find("Base Sort") then
                            isInBounds = true
                        end
                    end
                end

                if isInBounds then
                    deck.addTag("Sorting")
                    local deckType = zone.getGMNotes():match("^(.-) .*$")
                    local cardCat = (deckType == "Base" and "BaseObjects") or (Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) and "PlayerDecks") or "ExtraDecks"

                    if deck == SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][deckType:lower().."Discard"] then
                        deck.setName("")
                        deck.setGMNotes("")
                        deck.removeTag("Deck")
                        SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][deckType:lower().."Discard"] = nil
                    end

                    if ((not deck.hasTag(deckType)) or deck.hasTag("ColorConflict")) and (deck.getGMNotes() == "" or deck.getGMNotes():find(deckType)) then
                        if Common.isInTable(deckType, SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getSeatedColors()) then
                            if (deck.hasTag("Madness") or deck.hasTag("hasMadness")) then
                                if not deck.hasTag("JustOnce") then
                                    deck.addTag("JustOnce")
                                    SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(deck.getGUID(), deckType, deckType)
                                else
                                    deck.removeTag("JustOnce")
                                end
                            end
                            if deck.hasTag("ColorConflict") or ((not deck.hasTag(deckType)) and (deck.hasTag("hasMadness") or deck.hasTag("hasTreasure"))) then
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deck.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deck.getGUID()] or {}
                                if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deck.getGUID()][deckType] then
                                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deck.getGUID()][deckType] = nil
                                end

                                for _, cardInfo in ipairs(deck.getObjects()) do
                                    local color = nil
                                    local isMadness = false
                                    local isTreasure = false

                                    for _, tag in ipairs(cardInfo.tags) do
                                        if Common.isInTable(tag, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                                            color = tag
                                        elseif tag == "Madness" then
                                            isMadness = true
                                        elseif tag == "Treasure" then
                                            isTreasure = true
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if color and color ~= deckType and not isMadness and not isTreasure then
                                        deck.addTag("ColorConflict")
                                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deck.getGUID()][color] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deck.getGUID()][color] or {}
                                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deck.getGUID()][color][cardInfo.guid] = false
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end, function()
                if deck.held_by_color then
                    if sortZoneWaitFunc then Wait.stop(sortZoneWaitFunc) end
                end
                return deck.isDestroyed() or deck.resting
            end, 3)
        end


    elseif enteringObj.type == "Card" then                                                   -- if the object entering a zone is a card or a token...
        local card = enteringObj

        if zone.getGMNotes():find("CardZone") then                                              -- ... if the zone is a `CardZone`...
            if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then card.addTag("DoNotStack") end                  -- ... add this tag to any card that enters this CardZone; the card is now played and should not stack with anything

            if card.hasTag("deckRemainder") then
                SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.breakDeckReference(card)
            end

            if card.hasTag("Base") then                                                             -- ... if the object is a base card...
                SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.turnOnBaseBlockZone(zone, card)                           -- ... then call this function to turn the base `on` and activate its scoreboard

            elseif not card.hasTag("Monster") then                                                  -- ... otherwise, if the object is NOT a monster (ie: it's a faction card)...
                SmashUp.PlayZones.DiscLights.highlightPlayZone(zone, card, "off", "entering")           -- ... then call this function to turn off the DiscLights and highlighting of the playZone
            end

        elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("BaseBlockZone") then                                     -- ... if the zone is a `BaseBlockZone` (only triggers on minions, actions, and titans)...

            if not card.hasTag("Monster") then
                SmashUp.PlayZones.DiscLights.highlightPlayZone(zone, card, "on", "entering")            -- ... call this function to turn on the DiscLights and highlighting of the playZone
            end

        elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("PhantomZone") then                                       -- ... if the zone is a `PhantomZome` (temporary scripting zone used to trigger when a base card draws near a phantom baseblock)...
            SmashUp.Bases.ExtraBaseDocks.highlightPhantomBaseBlock(zone, "on", card)                               -- ... then call this function to highlight the phantom baseBlock

        elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("MonsterZone") and card.hasTag("Monster") and not card.hasTag("Base") then    -- ... if the zone is a `MonsterZone` and the played card is a Monster (and not a base with a `Monster` tag)...
            if not card.hasTag("CountOnce") then
                SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.monsterCardIsPlayed(zone, card)                           -- ... then call this monsterIsPlayed function
            end

        elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("Draw") and not card.hasTag("Titan") then                     -- ... if the zone is for a deck `Draw` zone...
            if card.is_face_down or (not card.is_face_down and zone.hasTag("Madness") and card.hasTag("Madness")) then
                SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.zoneTriggerDeckAssign(zone, card, nil)                                              -- ... call this function to reform the draw pile
            end

        elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("Discard") and not card.hasTag("Titan") then                   -- ... if the zone is for a deck `Discard` zone...
            if not card.is_face_down then
                SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.zoneTriggerDeckAssign(zone, card, nil)                                              -- ... then call this function to form the discard pile
            end

            if card.hasTag("Treasure") and not zone.getGMNotes():find("Treasure") and not card.is_face_down then
                local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, card)
                if isInBounds then
                    SmashUp.CleanUp.returnTreasureCards(card)
                end
            end



        elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("Base Sort") then
            if card.hasTag("Base") and not card.hasTag("Monster") then
                local baseSortWaitFunc
                baseSortWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
                    if zone == nil or card == nil then return end

                    if card.hasTag("ActivatedBase") then
                        card.addTag("SuspendedBase")
                        local baseNum = tonumber(table.concat(card.getTags(), ", "):match("Base(%d+)"))
                        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].beingReplaced = true
                        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].oldReplacedBaseName = card.getName()
                    end
                end, function()
                    if card.held_by_color then
                        if baseSortWaitFunc then Wait.stop(baseSortWaitFunc) end
                    end
                    return card.isDestroyed() or card.resting
                end)
            end

        elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("Sort Piles") then
            if not card.hasTag("Base") and Common.isInTable(zone.getGMNotes():match("^(.-) .*"), SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getSeatedColors()) then
                local waitFunc
                waitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
                    if zone == nil or card == nil then return end
                    local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, card)

                    if isInBounds then
                        SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.breakDeckReference(card)
                        -- --**The following lines of code gather deckType info from the sort zone that was triggered, therefore only allowing comparison between that sort zone and the card. This results in the persistence of the object reference instead of breaking it
                        -- local deckType, zoneType, cardCat = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromExistingReference(card)
                        -- -- **If an established/referenced discard pile is put into a sort zone (is coded to stay there; won't fly back to discard zone), then break the reference to that discard pile
                        -- if deckType and cardCat then
                        --     if card == SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][deckType:lower().."Discard"] then
                        --         SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][deckType:lower().."Discard"] = nil
                        --         card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
                        --
                        --     elseif deckType == "Madness" and card == SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][deckType:lower().."Draw"] then
                        --         SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][deckType:lower().."Draw"] = nil
                        --         card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
                        --     end
                        -- end
                    end

                    -- **Add the color owner tag to the madness card
                    if card.hasTag("Madness") then
                        local color = zone.getGMNotes():match("^(.-) ")
                        if Common.isInTable(color, SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getSeatedColors()) then
                            SmashUp.Madness.setColorOwnership(zone, card)
                        end
                    end
                end, function()
                    if card.held_by_color then
                        if waitFunc then Wait.stop(waitFunc) end
                    end
                    return card.isDestroyed() or card.resting
                end, 3)
            end

        elseif Common.isInTable(zone.getGMNotes():match("^(.-)Zone"), Player.getAvailableColors()) and zone.getGMNotes():find("Zone") then      -- ... if the zone is something akin to a player's playZone (`color`Zone)...
            if card.hasTag("Power") then                                                                                                            -- ... and if the card has the `Power` tag and the zone does not have a `Base` tag...
                if not card.hasTag("CountOnce") then
                    SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.minionCardIsPlayed(zone, card)                                                                        -- ... call this function to update the power around the base
                end
            end
        end


    elseif enteringObj.hasTag("Token") then
        local token = enteringObj

        if zone.hasTag("Token") then
            if not token.hasTag("CountOnce") then
                SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.tokenIsPlaced(zone, token)
            end
        end
    end
end


-- this TTS event is used to trigger several events, when objects leave a scripting zone
function onObjectLeaveZone(zone, leavingObject)
    if SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customReadyToDetectNewObj and zone.getGMNotes():find("custom") then
        local zoneIsEmpty = true
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
            if obj.type ~= "Board" and obj ~= leavingObject and obj.getName() ~= "Custom Deck Mat" then
                zoneIsEmpty = false
            end
        end

        if zoneIsEmpty then
            leavingObject.removeTag("OneCustomObj")
            UI.hide("customObjectPanel")
            UI.hide("customTokenPanel")
            UI.hide("customCardTypeCountPanel")
        end
    end

    if zone.getDescription() == "Hand Zone" or not SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then return end

    if zone == nil or zone.isDestroyed() then return end

    if leavingObject == nil or leavingObject.isDestroyed() then
        if leavingObject.type == "Card" and zone.getGMNotes():find("BaseBlockZone") then
            local card = leavingObject
            card.removeTag("DoNotStack")
            if not card.hasTag("Monster") then
                SmashUp.PlayZones.DiscLights.highlightPlayZone(zone, card, "off", "leaving")                -- ... call this function to turn off the DiscLights and highlighting of the playZone
            end
        end

        return
    end

    Wait.frames(function()

        if leavingObject.type == "Deck" then
            if zone.getGMNotes():find("Sort") then
                leavingObject.removeTag("Sorting")
            end

        elseif leavingObject.type == "Card" then                                                        -- if the object leaving a zone is a card or a token...
            local card = leavingObject

            -- **Specific instructions for specific types of zones**
            if zone.getGMNotes():find("CardZone") then                                                  -- ... if the zone is the `CardZone`...
                card.removeTag("DoNotStack")

                if card.hasTag("Base") then                                                                 -- ... and the object is a base card...
                    SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.turnOffBaseBlockZone(zone, card)                              -- ... then call this function to turn the base `off` and de-activate its scoreboard

                elseif not card.hasTag("Monster") then                                                      -- ... otherwise, if the object is NOT a token (ie: it's a faction card)...
                    SmashUp.PlayZones.DiscLights.highlightPlayZone(zone, card, "on", "leaving")                 -- ... then call this function to turn on the DiscLights and highlighting of the playZone
                end

            elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("BaseBlockZone") then                                         -- ... if the zone is a `BaseBlockZone` (only triggers on minions, actions, and titans)...
                card.removeTag("DoNotStack")
                if not card.hasTag("Monster") then
                    SmashUp.PlayZones.DiscLights.highlightPlayZone(zone, card, "off", "leaving")                -- ... call this function to turn off the DiscLights and highlighting of the playZone
                end

            elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("PhantomZone") then                                           -- ... if the zone is a `PhantomZome` (temporary scripting zone used to trigger when a base card draws near a phantom baseblock)...
                SmashUp.Bases.ExtraBaseDocks.highlightPhantomBaseBlock(zone, "off", card)                                  -- ... then call this function to turn off the highlight around the phantom baseBlock

            elseif zone.getGMNotes():find("Monster") and card.hasTag("Monster") and not card.hasTag("Base") then        -- ... if the zone is a `MonsterZone` and the played card is a Monster (and not a base with a `Monster` tag)...
                SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.monsterCardIsRemoved(zone, card)                           -- ... then call this monsterIsRemoved function

            elseif not zone.getGMNotes():find("Sort Piles") then                                        -- ... if the zone is something else (nothing left but a player's playZone)...
                if card.hasTag("Power") then                                                                -- ... and if the object (card or token) has the `Power` tag...
                    SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.minionCardIsRemoved(zone, card)                               -- ... call this function to update the power around the base
                end
            end

        elseif leavingObject.hasTag("Token") then
            local token = leavingObject

            if zone.hasTag("Token") then
                SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.tokenIsRemoved(zone, token, "removed")
            end
        end
    end, 1)
end



function onObjectEnterContainer(container, enteringObj)
    if not SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then return end
    if container.isDestroyed() or container == nil then return end
    if enteringObj.isDestroyed() or enteringObj == nil then return end

    enteringObj.interactable = true

    if (container.type == "Deck" or container.type == "Card") and (enteringObj.type == "Deck" or enteringObj.type == "Card") and (not enteringObj.hasTag("Clone")) then

        if enteringObj.type == "Card" then
            if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner["singleCards"][enteringObj.getGUID()] then
                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner["singleCards"][enteringObj.getGUID()] = nil
            end
        end

        local enteringDeckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin
        if enteringObj.type == "Deck" and enteringObj.getName() ~= "" then
            enteringDeckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromDeckName(enteringObj)
        elseif enteringObj.type == "Card" then
            enteringDeckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromExistingReference(enteringObj)
        end

        local containerDeckType, contZoneType, contTableCat = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromDeckName(container)
        if containerDeckType == nil then
            containerDeckType, contZoneType, contTableCat = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromExistingReference(container)
        end
        local startingContainerDeckType = containerDeckType

        local enteringTagType = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getTagType(enteringObj)
        local containerTagType = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getTagType(container)

        -- **Track the entering object if it is a desginated/established deck. Assign the container as the designated deck if needed.
        if enteringDeckType then
            -- **This local function is simply used to get a reference to the specified designated draw or discard piles,
            local function getDeckReference(enteringDeckType, tableCat, zoneType)
                if SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][enteringDeckType:lower()..zoneType] then
                    if SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][enteringDeckType:lower()..zoneType] == null then
                        SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][enteringDeckType:lower()..zoneType] = nil
                    end
                    return SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][enteringDeckType:lower()..zoneType]
                else
                    return nil
                end
            end

            -- **Obtain references to the draw and discard piles to check if the enteringObj IS the draw or discard pile
            local drawDeck = getDeckReference(enteringDeckType, tableCat, "Draw")
            local discardDeck = getDeckReference(enteringDeckType, tableCat, "Discard")

            if enteringObj == drawDeck or enteringObj == discardDeck then
                if enteringObj == drawDeck then    -- code process note: enteringObj will never be nil
                    SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][enteringDeckType:lower().."Draw"] = nil
                end
                if enteringObj == discardDeck then
                    SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][enteringDeckType:lower().."Discard"] = nil
                end

                -- **Check to see if the container is also a draw or discard pile
                if container ~= discardDeck and container ~= drawDeck then
                    if container.getQuantity() == 2 and container.hasTag("deckRemainder") and (not container.hasTag("Clone")) then
                        container.removeTag("deckRemainder")
                        local contData = container.getData()
                        local tagCheck = nil
                        local cardGUID = nil

                        for cardNum = 1, 2 do
                            local cardData = contData.ContainedObjects[cardNum]
                            for tagNum = #cardData.Tags, 1, -1 do
                                if cardData.Tags[tagNum] == "deckRemainder" then
                                    table.remove(cardData.Tags, tagNum)
                                end
                                if tagNum == 2 then
                                    tagCheck = cardData.Tags
                                    cardGUID = cardData.GUID
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        local checkCat = "PlayerDecks"

                        for _ = 1, 3 do
                            if SmashUp.GameObjects[checkCat] then
                                for key, obj in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects[checkCat]) do
                                    if type(obj) ~= "table" then
                                        if key == null then
                                            key = nil
                                        end
                                        if obj.getGUID() == cardGUID then
                                            SmashUp.GameObjects[checkCat][key] = nil
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                if checkCat == "PlayerDecks" then
                                    checkCat = "ExtraDecks"
                                elseif checkCat == "ExtraDecks" then
                                    checkCat = "BaseObjects"
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        container.destruct()
                        container = spawnObjectData({data = contData})

                    else
                        if containerDeckType == nil and (not(enteringDeckType == "Treasure" and (not container.hasTag("Treasure")) or enteringDeckType == "Madness" and (not container.hasTag("Madness")))) then
                            local _
                            _, containerDeckType, contZoneType, contTableCat = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.setDeckObject(container, enteringDeckType, ((enteringObj == drawDeck and "Draw") or "Discard"), tableCat)
                        end

                        if enteringObj.hasTag("deckRemainder") then
                            local contData = container.getData()
                            for cardNum = #contData.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do
                                for tagNum = #contData.ContainedObjects[cardNum].Tags, 1, -1 do
                                    if contData.ContainedObjects[cardNum].Tags[tagNum] == "deckRemainder" then
                                        table.remove(contData.ContainedObjects[cardNum].Tags, tagNum)
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            container.destruct()
                            container = spawnObjectData({data = contData})
                            SmashUp.GameObjects[contTableCat][containerDeckType:lower()..contZoneType] = container
                        end
                    end
                else
                    if container == drawDeck then
                        SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][enteringDeckType:lower().."Draw"] = nil
                    end
                    if container == discardDeck then
                        SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][enteringDeckType:lower().."Discard"] = nil
                    end
                    SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.setDeckObject(container, enteringDeckType, ((container.is_face_down and "Draw") or "Discard"), tableCat)
                end

                SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.repositionDroppedDecks(nil, container)
            end
        end

        -- **If the base card is added directly to a deck, and therefore destroyed, run this code to cleanup its baseBlock**
        if container.hasTag("Base") and enteringObj.hasTag("Base") then
            local joiningObjs = {container, enteringObj}

            if joiningObjs[2].type == "Card" then
                for cardNum = 1, 2 do
                    local card = joiningObjs[cardNum]

                    if card.type == "Deck" then
                        goto skip_this_iteration
                    end

                    if card.hasTag("ActivatedBase") then
                        local baseNum = tonumber(table.concat(card.getTags()):match("Base(%d+)"))

                        card.removeTag("ActivatedBase")
                        card.removeTag("Base"..baseNum)
                        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].beingReplaced = false

                        if card.hasTag("SuspendedBase") then
                            local oldBaseName = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].oldReplacedBaseName

                            if oldBaseName ~= nil and card.getName() ~= oldBaseName then
                                SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].oldReplacedBaseName = nil
                                goto skip_cleanup
                            end
                        end

                        SmashUp.CleanUp.cleanUpBaseZone(card, baseNum, card.hasTag("MonstersPlayed"))

                        ::skip_cleanup::
                    end
                    card.removeTag("SuspendedBase")

                    ::skip_this_iteration::
                end
            end

        elseif enteringObj.type == "Card" and enteringObj.hasTag("cleaningUp") then
            enteringObj.removeTag("cleaningUp")
            SmashUp.CleanUp.cleanUpCardList[enteringObj.getGUID()] = nil
        end


        local okToProceed = true

        for _, check in ipairs({"Base", "Monster", "Treasure"}) do
            if enteringObj.hasTag(check) and container.hasTag(check) then
                okToProceed = false
            end
        end

        if okToProceed then
            for _, color in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
                if enteringObj.hasTag(color) and container.hasTag(color) and not enteringObj.hasTag("ColorConflict") and not container.hasTag("ColorConflict") and not container.getQuantity() == 2
                and not enteringObj.hasTag("hasMadness") and not container.hasTag("hasMadness") and not enteringObj.hasTag("Madness") and not container.hasTag("Madness")
                and not enteringObj.hasTag("hasTreasure") and not container.hasTag("hasTreasure") and not enteringObj.hasTag("Treasure") and not container.hasTag("Treasure") then
                    okToProceed = false
                end
            end
        end

        -- **Track "foreign cards"--treasure or madness cards, or cards that belong to other players that are in the "wrong" deck
        if okToProceed then
            local foundPlayerColor
            local foundMadness
            local foundTreasure
            local foundCustomExtra

            -- **Because using the "group" action in-game only triggers onObjectEnterContainer once (instead of twice),
            --   must have this code to iterate over each card in the deck to evaluate for what is there -- there is no way to predict which card will be the container and which will be the enteringObj

            if container.getQuantity() == 2 then
                for cardNum, cardInfo in ipairs(container.getObjects()) do
                    local hasColor = false
                    local hasMadness = false
                    local hasTreasure = false
                    local hasCustomExtra = false
                    local cardExtraID = nil

                    -- **Check each tag on this card. Does it have a color? Does it have a madness?
                    for _, tag in ipairs(cardInfo.tags) do
                        if Common.isInTable(tag, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                            hasColor = tag
                        elseif tag == "Madness" then
                            hasMadness = true
                        elseif tag == "Treasure" then
                            hasTreasure = true
                        elseif tag:find("CustomExtra_") then
                            cardExtraID = SmashUp.CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(cardInfo)
                            if cardExtraID and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.customExtraCleanUp[cardExtraID].discardMode == "singleUse" then
                                hasCustomExtra = true
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    -- **If the card is a player card (has a color and does NOT have a madness)
                    if hasColor and not hasMadness then                                              -- if the card has a player color tag and is not also a madness card, then...
                        if containerDeckType then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] or {}
                            if hasColor ~= containerDeckType then
                                container.addTag("ColorConflict")
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][hasColor] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][hasColor] or {}
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][hasColor][cardInfo.guid] = false
                                SmashUp.CleanUp.foreignCardCheck(container, containerDeckType)
                            end

                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][containerDeckType] = nil
                            foundPlayerColor = containerDeckType
                        else
                            if foundPlayerColor and foundPlayerColor ~= hasColor then                   -- ... if a player color has already been found in this new deck (of 2 cards), and this card's color is NOT the same...
                                container.addTag("ColorConflict")                                           -- ... then there is a ColorConflict

                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = {[foundPlayerColor] = {[container.getObjects()[1].guid] = false}, [hasColor] = {[container.getObjects()[2].guid] = false}}

                            else                                                                        -- ... otherwise,
                                foundPlayerColor = hasColor                                                 -- ... note that we have found a player color tag
                            end
                        end
                        container.addTag(hasColor)                                                  -- ... add this player color tag to the deck
                        container.addTag("Player")                                                  -- ... with a player color card in the deck, this will be a "Player" deck


                    elseif hasMadness then                                                           -- if the card has a madness tag (even if it also has a player color tag)...
                        if hasColor then                                                            -- ... if a player color has been identified, need to remove it from the madness deck
                            container.removeTag(hasColor)
                        end

                        if foundMadness then                                                        -- ... if a madness card has already been found in this new deck (of 2 cards)...
                            container.addTag("Madness")                                                 -- ... then that means there are 2 madness cards, and this is now a madness deck

                            -- **Now that we have identifed this deck specifically as a madness deck...
                            SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), nil, containerDeckType)   -- ... then call this function to ensure the madness card gets the appropriate color tag

                        else                                                                        -- ... otherwise, this is the first madness card found so...
                            foundMadness = true                                                         -- ... set foundMadness to true
                        end

                    elseif hasTreasure then
                        if foundTreasure then
                            container.addTag("Treasure")

                            if hasColor then
                                container.removeTag(hasColor)
