                            end
                            if foundPlayerColor then
                                container.removeTag(foundPlayerColor)
                            end

                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = nil
                        else
                            foundTreasure = true

                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] or {}
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["Treasure"] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["Treasure"] or {}
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["Treasure"][cardInfo.guid] = true
                        end

                    elseif hasCustomExtra then
                        if foundCustomExtra then
                            container.addTag("CustomExtra")

                            if hasColor then
                                container.removeTag(hasColor)
                            end
                            if foundPlayerColor then
                                container.removeTag(foundPlayerColor)
                            end

                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = nil
                        else
                            foundCustomExtra = true

                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] or {}
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] or {}
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"][cardInfo.guid] = cardExtraID
                        end
                    end
                end

                if foundPlayerColor and foundMadness then
                    container.removeTag("Madness")
                    container.addTag("hasMadness")
                    SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), foundPlayerColor, containerDeckType)
                end

                if foundPlayerColor and foundTreasure then
                    container.removeTag("Treasure")
                    container.addTag("hasTreasure")
                end

                if foundMadness and foundTreasure then
                    container.removeTag("Madness")
                    container.removeTag("Treasure")
                    container.addTag("hasTreasure")
                    container.addTag("hasMadness")
                    SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), nil, containerDeckType)
                end

                if foundPlayerColor and foundCustomExtra then
                    container.removeTag("CustomExtra")
                    container.addTag("hasCustomExtra")
                end

                if foundMadness and foundCustomExtra then
                    container.removeTag("Madness")
                    container.removeTag("CustomExtra")
                    container.addTag("hasCustomExtra")
                    container.addTag("hasMadness")
                    SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), nil, containerDeckType)
                end

                if foundTreasure and foundCustomExtra then
                    container.removeTag("Treasure")
                    container.removeTag("CustomExtra")
                    container.addTag("hasCustomExtra")
                    container.addTag("hasTreasure")
                end


                container.removeTag("Action")                                                 -- ... remove these tags from the container, which can possibly be inherited from the player color card
                container.removeTag("Minion")
                container.removeTag("Power")

            else
                if Common.isInTable(enteringTagType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                    foundPlayerColor = enteringTagType
                end
                if containerDeckType == nil then
                    for _, zone in ipairs(container.getZones()) do
                        if zone.getName():find("Sort") and not zone.getName():find("Base") then
                            containerDeckType = zone.getName():match("^(.-) .*$")
                        end
                    end
                end

                if enteringObj.hasTag("ColorConflict") then
                    if container.hasTag("ColorConflict") then                                                                                       -- if container has "ColorConflict" tag, then an entry for this container already exists in the CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner table
                        for _, cardInfo in ipairs(container.getObjects()) do                                                                        -- for each card in the deck (which has now had new cards entered into it)...
                            local color = nil
                            local isMadness = false
                            for _, tag in ipairs(cardInfo.tags) do                                                                                  -- ... for each tag on this individual card...
                                if Common.isInTable(tag, Player.getAvailableColors()) then                                                              -- ... if the tag is a color tag...
                                    color = tag                                                                                                             -- ... then store this tag in the color variable
                                elseif tag == "Madness" then
                                    isMadness = true
                                end
                            end
                            if not isMadness and color ~= nil and color ~= containerDeckType then                                                                       -- ... as long as the color of this specific card is different than the containerDeckType then, add this card into the CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner table
                                container.addTag(color)
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][color] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][color] or {}
                                if not SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][color][cardInfo.guid] then
                                    if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()][color] and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()][color][cardInfo.guid] then
                                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][color][cardInfo.guid] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()][color][cardInfo.guid]
                                    else
                                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][color][cardInfo.guid] = false
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                    else
                        container.addTag("ColorConflict")
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] or {}
                        for _, cardInfo in ipairs(container.getObjects()) do                                                                        -- for each card in the deck (which has now had new cards entered into it)...
                            local color = nil
                            local isMadness = false
                            for _, tag in ipairs(cardInfo.tags) do                                                                                  -- ... for each tag on this individual card...
                                if Common.isInTable(tag, Player.getAvailableColors()) then                                                              -- ... if the tag is a color tag...
                                    color = tag                                                                                                             -- ... then store this tag in the color variable
                                elseif tag == "Madness" then
                                    isMadness = true
                                end
                            end
                            if not isMadness and color ~= nil and color ~= containerDeckType then                                                                       -- ... as long as the color of this specific card is different than the containerDeckType then, add this card into the CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner table
                                container.addTag(color)
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][color] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][color] or {}
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][color][cardInfo.guid] = false
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    container.addTag("Player")
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] = nil

                elseif foundPlayerColor and container.hasTag("ColorConflict") then                 -- this here means that the enteringObj does NOT have a color conflict, but the existing container does\
                    if enteringTagType ~= containerDeckType then                                   -- ... therefore there will be only one color in the enteringObj
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] or {}
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][enteringTagType] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][enteringTagType] or {}

                        if enteringObj.type == "Card" and enteringObj.getName() ~= "Madness" then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][enteringTagType][enteringObj.getGUID()] = false

                        elseif enteringObj.type == "Deck" then
                            for _, card in ipairs(enteringObj.getObjects()) do
                                if card.name ~= "Madness" then
                                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][enteringTagType][card.guid] = false
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end


                    if containerDeckType and Common.isInTable(containerDeckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][containerDeckType] then
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][containerDeckType] = nil
                    end

                elseif foundPlayerColor and not enteringObj.hasTag("Madness") then
                    container.addTag(enteringTagType)
                    container.addTag("Player")
                    if Common.isInTable(containerTagType, Player.getAvailableColors()) and enteringTagType ~= containerTagType then                -- container will only have one color assigned to it, so this is an appropriate check
                        container.addTag("ColorConflict")
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] or {}

                        if enteringTagType ~= containerDeckType then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][enteringTagType] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][enteringTagType] or {}
                        end

                        if containerTagType ~= containerDeckType then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][containerTagType] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][containerTagType] or {}
                        end

                        for _, cardInfo in ipairs(container.getObjects()) do
                            if Common.isInTable(enteringTagType, cardInfo.tags) and enteringTagType ~= containerDeckType and (not Common.isInTable("Madness", cardInfo.tags)) then
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][enteringTagType][cardInfo.guid] = false
                            elseif Common.isInTable(containerTagType, cardInfo.tags) and containerTagType ~= containerDeckType and (not Common.isInTable("Madness", cardInfo.tags)) then
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()][containerTagType][cardInfo.guid] = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end


                if container.hasTag("Madness") or container.hasTag("hasMadness") or enteringObj.hasTag("Madness") or enteringObj.hasTag("hasMadness") then
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] or {}
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()].Madness = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()].Madness or {}
                    local enteringObjMad = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()].Madness

                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] or {}
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()].Madness = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()].Madness or {}
                    local containerMad = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()].Madness

                    if enteringObj.hasTag("Madness") then
                        if container.hasTag("Madness") then
                            SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), nil, containerDeckType)

                        else
                            if containerDeckType and Common.isInTable(containerDeckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                                SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), nil, containerDeckType)
                            elseif containerTagType and Common.isInTable(containerTagType, Player.getAvailableColors()) and not container.hasTag("ColorConflict") then
                                SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), containerTagType)
                            else
                                SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID())
                            end
                        end

                    elseif container.hasTag("Madness") then
                        if enteringDeckType and Common.isInTable(enteringDeckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                            SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), enteringDeckType, containerDeckType ~= "Madness" and containerDeckType or nil)
                        elseif enteringTagType and Common.isInTable(enteringTagType, Player.getAvailableColors()) and not container.hasTag("ColorConflict") then
                            SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), enteringTagType, containerDeckType ~= "Madness" and containerDeckType or nil)
                        else
                            SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), nil, containerDeckType ~= "Madness" and containerDeckType or nil)
                        end

                    elseif enteringObj.hasTag("hasMadness") then

                        if containerDeckType then
                            if enteringObjMad[next(enteringObjMad)] ~= containerDeckType
                            or container.hasTag("hasMadness") and containerMad[next(containerMad)] ~= containerDeckType then

                                SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), nil, containerDeckType)
                            else
                                for cardGUID in pairs(enteringObjMad) do
                                    containerMad[cardGUID] = containerDeckType
                                end
                            end

                        elseif container.hasTag("ColorConflict") then

                            if enteringObjMad[next(enteringObjMad)] ~= "Madness"
                            or container.hasTag("hasMadness") and containerMad[next(containerMad)] ~= "Madness" then

                                SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID())
                            else
                                for cardGUID in pairs(enteringObjMad) do
                                    containerMad[cardGUID] = "Madness"
                                end
                            end

                        elseif not containerTagType and enteringTagType then
                            SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), enteringTagType)

                        else
                            for cardGUID in pairs(enteringObjMad) do
                                containerMad[cardGUID] = containerTagType
                            end
                        end

                    elseif container.hasTag("hasMadness") then
                        if containerDeckType then
                            if containerMad and next(containerMad) and containerMad[next(containerMad)] ~= containerDeckType then
                                SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), nil, containerDeckType)
                            end

                        elseif container.hasTag("ColorConflict") then --and containerMad and next(containerMad) and containerMad[next(containerMad)] ~= "Madness" then
                            if containerMad and next(containerMad) and containerMad[next(containerMad)] ~= "Madness" then
                                SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID())
                            end

                        elseif not containerTagType and enteringTagType and Common.isInTable(enteringTagType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                            SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(container.getGUID(), enteringTagType)
                        end
                    end

                    if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] then
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] = nil
                    end
                end

                if container.hasTag("Treasure") or container.hasTag("hasTreasure") or enteringObj.hasTag("Treasure") or enteringObj.hasTag("hasTreasure") then
                    if enteringObj.hasTag("Treasure") and container.hasTag("Treasure") then
                        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]["Treasure"] then SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]["Treasure"] = nil end
                        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["Treasure"] then SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["Treasure"] = nil end

                        if next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]) == nil then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] = nil
                        end

                        if next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]) == nil then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = nil
                        end

                    else
                        container.removeTag("Treasure")
                        container.addTag("hasTreasure")

                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] or {}
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["Treasure"] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["Treasure"] or {}

                        for _, cardInfo in ipairs(container.getObjects()) do
                            if Common.isInTable("Treasure", cardInfo.tags) then
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["Treasure"][cardInfo.guid] = true
                            end
                        end

                        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] then
                            if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]["Treasure"] then
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]["Treasure"] = nil
                            end

                            if next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]) == nil then
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] = nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                -- Handle custom extras similar to Treasure cards
                local enteringExtraID = SmashUp.CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(enteringObj)
                local containerHasCustomExtra = false

                -- Check if container has any custom extras
                for _, cardInfo in ipairs(container.getObjects()) do
                    local cardExtraID = SmashUp.CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(cardInfo)
                    if cardExtraID then
                        containerHasCustomExtra = true
                        break
                    end
                end

                if containerHasCustomExtra or enteringExtraID then
                    if enteringExtraID and containerHasCustomExtra then
                        -- Both are custom extras, clean up tracking
                        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] = nil
                        end
                        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] = nil
                        end

                        if next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]) == nil then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] = nil
                        end

                        if next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]) == nil then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = nil
                        end

                    else
                        -- Custom extra entering non-custom extra deck or vice versa
                        container.removeTag("CustomExtra")
                        container.addTag("hasCustomExtra")

                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] or {}
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] or {}

                        for _, cardInfo in ipairs(container.getObjects()) do
                            local cardExtraID = SmashUp.CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(cardInfo)
                            if cardExtraID and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.customExtraCleanUp[cardExtraID].discardMode == "singleUse" then
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"][cardInfo.guid] = cardExtraID
                            end
                        end

                        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] then
                            if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] then
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]["CustomExtra"] = nil
                            end

                            if next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()]) == nil then
                                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[enteringObj.getGUID()] = nil
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            container.removeTag("Action")                                                 -- ... remove these tags from the container, which can possibly be inherited from the player color card
            container.removeTag("Minion")
            container.removeTag("Power")
        end

        if container.hasTag("ColorConflict") then
            if startingContainerDeckType and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] then
                if container == SmashUp.GameObjects[contTableCat][startingContainerDeckType:lower().."Discard"] then
                    SmashUp.CleanUp.foreignCardCheck(container, containerDeckType)
                end
            end
        end
        if container.hasTag("hasTreasure") then
            if startingContainerDeckType and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] then
                if container == SmashUp.GameObjects[contTableCat][startingContainerDeckType:lower().."Discard"] then
                    SmashUp.CleanUp.findTreasuresInDiscardDecks(container, containerDeckType)
                end
            end
        end
        if container.hasTag("hasCustomExtra") then
            if startingContainerDeckType and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[container.getGUID()] then
                if container == SmashUp.GameObjects[contTableCat][startingContainerDeckType:lower().."Discard"] then
                    SmashUp.CleanUp.findCustomExtrasInDiscardDecks(container, containerDeckType)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end



function onObjectLeaveContainer(deck, card)
    if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deck.getGUID()] then
        local deckGUID = deck.getGUID()

        local isPlayerDeck = false
        local cardClass = (card.hasTag("Madness") and "Madness") or (card.hasTag("Treasure") and "Treasure") or (card.hasTag("Custom") and card.hasTag("Extra") and "CustomExtra") or nil
        if cardClass == nil then
            for _, tag in ipairs(card.getTags()) do
                if Common.isInTable(tag, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                    cardClass = tag
                    isPlayerColor = true
                end
            end
        end

        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deckGUID][cardClass] then
            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deckGUID][cardClass][card.getGUID()] = nil

            if next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deckGUID][cardClass]) == nil then
                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deckGUID][cardClass] = nil

                if cardClass == "Madness" then
                    deck.removeTag("hasMadness")
                elseif cardClass == "Treasure" then
                    deck.removeTag("hasTreasure")
                elseif cardClass == "CustomExtra" then
                    deck.removeTag("hasCustomExtra")
                end

                local colorCount = 0
                local onlyColor = nil

                for keyColor in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deckGUID]) do
                    if keyColor ~= "Madness" and keyColor ~= "Treasure" and keyColor ~= "CustomExtra" then
                        colorCount = colorCount + 1
                        if colorCount == 1 then
                            onlyColor = keyColor
                        elseif colorCount > 1 then
                            onlyColor = nil
                        end
                    end
                end

                if colorCount == 1 then
                    local cardDeckType = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromExistingReference(deck)
                    if (cardDeckType and onlyColor == cardDeckType) or (not cardDeckType) then
                        deck.removeTag(cardClass)
                        deck.removeTag("ColorConflict")
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deckGUID][onlyColor] = nil
                    end
                elseif colorCount == 0 then
                    deck.removeTag(cardClass)
                    deck.removeTag("ColorConflict")
                end
            end
        end

        if next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deckGUID]) == nil then
            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deckGUID] = nil
        end
    end

    -- **This sets the last card in a designated deck as the designated "deck object"
    if deck.remainder then
        if deck.getGMNotes():find(".+") then
            local lastCard = deck.remainder
            lastCard.setPosition(lastCard.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.1, 0))

            local deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin = SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromDeckName(deck)

            if deckType ~= nil and deckType ~= "originalFactionDeck" then
                if SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower()..zoneType] == null then
                    SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower()..zoneType] = nil
                end

                if deck == SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower()..zoneType] then
                    SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower()..zoneType] = deck.remainder
                    deck.remainder.addTag("deckRemainder")
                    onObjectDrop(nil, deck.remainder)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if card.hasTag("Sideways") then
        card.setScale({3.74, 1.0, 3.74})
        card.setRotation({0, 90, 0})
    end
    if deck.hasTag("Sideways") then
        deck.setScale({3.74, 1.0, 3.74})
        deck.setRotation({0, 90, 0})
    end
end


-- this TTS event is called whenever one object (enter_object) tries to be placed inside another object (container)
function tryObjectEnterContainer(container, enteringObj)
    if container.isDestroyed() or container == nil then return end
    if enteringObj.isDestroyed() or enteringObj == nil then return end

    if enteringObj.hasTag("Sideways") then
        enteringObj.setScale({2.74, 1.0, 2.74})
        enteringObj.setRotation({0, 180, 0})
    end
    if container.hasTag("Sideways") then
        container.setScale({2.74, 1.0, 2.74})
        container.setRotation({0, 180, 0})
    end

    -- **The following are series of statements preventing objectings from joining with certain objects**
    if container.getGMNotes():find("Kit") and enteringObj.getGMNotes():find("Kit")
      and (not enteringObj.getGMNotes():find("Legacy")) then              -- if a faction box kit tries to be placed inside another faction box kit, it won't be allowed
        return false

    elseif enteringObj.getGMNotes() == "Smash Up Box" then                                           -- if the main smash up box tries to be placed inside any other bag object, it won't be allowed
        return false

    elseif container.hasTag("DoNotStack") or enteringObj.hasTag("DoNotStack") then                   -- all cards played on the table (enter any CardZone) receive this tag, preventing any played card from being able to stack
        return false

    elseif container.hasTag("Titan") or enteringObj.hasTag("Titan") then
        return false

    elseif ((container.hasTag("Monster") and not enteringObj.hasTag("Monster")) or
    (not container.hasTag("Monster") and enteringObj.hasTag("Monster"))) and
    not (container.hasTag("Base") and enteringObj.hasTag("Base")) then
        return false

    elseif (container.hasTag("Base") and not enteringObj.hasTag("Base")) or
        (not container.hasTag("Base") and enteringObj.hasTag("Base")) then

            if SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
                return true
            end

            return false

    elseif container.getGMNotes() == "Smash Up Box" and SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customEditMode and enteringObj == SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit then
        return false

    -- **Don't let the madness draw deck join up with other cards/decks
    elseif (container.getName() == "Madness Deck" and not enteringObj.hasTag("Madness")) or (enteringObj.getName() == "Madness Deck" and not container.hasTag("Madness")) then
        return false

    elseif (container == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.madnessDraw and (not enteringObj.hasTag("Madness") and (not container.type == "Card"))) or (enteringObj == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.madnessDraw and (not container.hasTag("Madness")) and (not enteringObj.type == "Card")) then
        return false

    -- **Don't let the treasure draw or discard decks join up with other cards/decks
    elseif (container == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDraw and (container.type ~= "Card") and (not enteringObj.hasTag("Treasure")))
        or (enteringObj == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDraw and (enteringObj.type ~= "Card") and (not container.hasTag("Treasure"))) then
        return false

    elseif (container == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDiscard and (container.type ~= "Card") and (not enteringObj.hasTag("Treasure")))
        or (enteringObj == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDiscard and (enteringObj.type ~= "Card") and (not container.hasTag("Treasure"))) then
        return false

    elseif (((container == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDraw or container == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDiscard) and container.type == "Card" and (not enteringObj.hasTag("Treasure")))
        or ((enteringObj == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDraw or enteringObj == SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDiscard) and enteringObj.type == "Card" and (not container.hasTag("Treasure"))))
        then
            local isAllowed = true
            for _, zone in ipairs(container.getZones()) do
                if zone.getName():find("Treasure") then
                    isAllowed = false
                end
            end
            if isAllowed then
                for _, zone in ipairs(enteringObj.getZones()) do
                    if zone.getName():find("Treasure") then
                        isAllowed = false
                    end
                end
            end
        return isAllowed

    -- **This is a special script that identifies when cards are joining together to form a deck.
    -- This turns `SystemGates.cardMovementLocked` variable on/true, and therefore prevents other cards from starting their movement while that is happening.
    -- Once cards have finished joining together, then `SystemGates.cardMovementLocked` is off/false again.
    else
        if container.type == "Card" and enteringObj.type == "Card" then
            if enteringObj.hasTag("deckRemainder") and not container.hasTag("deckRemainder") then
                local sendPosition = enteringObj.getPosition()
                container.setLock(true)
                container.interactable = false
                container.setPositionSmooth(sendPosition, false, true)

                Wait.condition(function()
                    if container == nil or enteringObj == nil then return end
                    container.setLock(false)
                    container.interactable = true
                    enteringObj.putObject(container)
                end, || container.isDestroyed() or not container.isSmoothMoving() or container.resting)
                return false
            end
        end


        if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then
            if SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping == false then
                if SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false then                                                              -- ... if this SystemGates.cardMovementLocked flag variable is OFF, it will allow the joining, but first...
                    SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked = true                                                                        -- ... set the SystemGates.cardMovementLocked to true (if a base card is joining the base deck, don't bring in other cards, or join up other cards)...
                    Wait.condition(function()                                                                                   -- ... start a wait condition (for either the container or enteringObj to be destroyed)...
                        SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked = false                                                                           -- ... when wait condition is met, reset the SystemGates.cardMovementLocked flag variable to false
                    end, || enteringObj == nil or container == nil,                                                          -- ... wait for either the container or enteringObj to be destroyed (officially joined into a deck)
                        1,                                                                                                  -- ... time out after 1 second (only allow 1 second between starting the process of joining a card to the deck and when the card is destroyed)
                    function()                                                                                                  -- ... if the wait condition DOES timeout...
                        SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked = false                                                                           -- ... go ahead and reset the SystemGates.cardMovementLocked flag to false
                    end
                    )
                    return true
                else
                    if container.held_by_color and enteringObj.held_by_color then
                        return true
                    end
                    Wait.condition(function()                                                                       -- ... wait condition: going to have to allow the joining, but we need to wait for the SystemGates.cardMovementLocked variable to be false again
                        return true
                    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)                                                                 -- ... wait for the SystemGates.cardMovementLocked variable to become false again
                end
            else
                return true
            end

        else
            return true
        end
    end
end

-- this TTS event is called whenever any player changes their color, including the color assigned when they first join the game
function onPlayerChangeColor(color)
    if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete == false then
        SmashUp.XMLUI.BeginPanel.changeSetUpUIVisibility(color)                 -- run this function, which checks to see if the host has selected a color, and then changes UI element visibility based on color status
    end

    if SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.savesPausedForRejoin and (not SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.playerRejoinComplete) then
        SmashUp.Setup.playerRejoinCompleteCheck()
    end

    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles = true

    if not(color == "Gray" or color == "Grey") then
        for num, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
            if playerInfo.color == color then
                SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[num].isGhostPlayer = false

                UI.setAttribute("TurnLabel"..num, "text", playerName)

                SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[num].isGhostPlayer = true
                UI.setAttribute("TurnLabel"..num, "text", playerInfo.color.." Player")
            end
        end
    end

    if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupInProgress and not SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete and SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor ~= "" then

        for rowNum, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
            SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlFunctions.addRowColorAndName(playerInfo)
        end
    end
end


-- this TTS event is called when a player takes one of several actions
-- this function prevents any player that is not Black or White from deleting or duplicating ingame assets
function onPlayerAction(player, action, targets)
    if action == Player.Action.Group then
        local newGroups = {["Base"] = {}, ["Player"] = {}, ["Monster"] = {}}
        for _, card in ipairs(targets) do
            if (card.type == "Deck" or card.type == "Card") and (not card.hasTag("Titan")) then
                local cardType
                if card.hasTag("Base") then
                    cardType = "Base"
                elseif card.hasTag("Monster") and not card.hasTag("Base") then
                    cardType = "Monster"
                else
                    cardType = "Player"
                end

                table.insert(newGroups[cardType], card)
            end
        end

        SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = true
        for cardType, cardList in pairs(newGroups) do
            group(cardList)
        end

        Wait.frames(function()
            SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = false
        end, 2)

        return false
    end

    -- **allows players to destroy tokens**
    if action == Player.Action.Delete then                                      -- if the action the player is performing is a delete action...
        for _, obj in ipairs(targets) do                                        -- ... then for every object the player is trying to perform the action on...
            if obj.hasTag("Token") then                                             -- ... if the object is a token (has "token" tag)...
                for _, zone in ipairs(obj.getZones()) do                                -- ... look at all the zones the object occupies...
                    if zone.hasTag("Token") then                                            -- ... and if there is a zone that has the "Token" tag...
                        obj.addTag("ToBeDeleted")                                               -- ... then add this tag ("ToBeDeleted") marking the token that it will need to be deleted (after running the next function)
                        SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.tokenIsRemoved(zone, obj)  -- ... run this function to re-calculate the power at the base
                    end
                end
                if not obj.hasTag("ToBeDeleted") then                                   -- ... after running the for loop, if the obj does NOT have the "ToBeDeleted" tag, this means it is NOT in a zone that requires recalculating the bases power, so...
                    destroyObject(obj)                                                      -- ... go ahead and delete the token
                end
            end

            if obj == SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit then
                UI.setAttribute("customSpawnIn", "interactable", "true")
                destroyObject(obj)
            end
        end

    end

    if action == Player.Action.Copy or action == Player.Action.Paste then
        for _, obj in ipairs(targets) do
            if obj.hasTag("Token") then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    -- **this prevents non-black and non-white players from deleting all other items**
    if player.color ~= "Black" and player.color ~= "White"                      -- if the player performing an action is not black or white...
        and (action == Player.Action.Delete                                     -- and the action is a delete action...
        or action == Player.Action.Cut                                          -- or the action is a cut action...
        or action == Player.Action.Paste)                                       -- or the action is a paste action (prevents duplicating objects)...
    then
        return false                                                            -- ... then return false (prevent the player from doing those actions)
    end
end

end)

-- THESE FUNCTIONS ARE GENERAL USE FUNCTIONS USED BY OTHER FILES/CHILDREN OF "SMASHUP" TABLE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function SmashUp.makeSureMovementStops(card, triggerFxn, conditionFxn)
    if triggerFxn == nil then                                                                   -- if no triggerFxn is supplied, need to have a "default" so as not to error
        triggerFxn = function() end                                                             -- ... set triggerFxn to an empty function
    end
    if conditionFxn == nil then                                                                 -- if no conditionFxn is supplied...
        conditionFxn = function()                                                               -- ... set conditionFxn equal to this function
            return card.isDestroyed() or (card.resting and (not card.held_by_color))
        end
    end

    local newPos                                                                                -- declare these variables to be used later
    local newRot
    local justVibrating
    local oldPos = card.getPosition()                                                           -- set oldPos equal to card's current position
    local oldRot = card.getRotation()                                                           -- set oldRot equal to card's current rotation
    local timer = os.clock()                                                                    -- find the time at which this function triggers

    local waitCond1                                                                             -- initialize the variables that will hold the wait conditions
    local waitCond2
    local mainWaitFunc
    local resetWaits

    -- **this first wait condition waits for a card to be dropped and waits for 1 second after the card is nearly rested (but not completely resting because of vibration) but no longer than 3 seconds
    waitCond1 = Wait.condition(function()                                                       -- start this first wait condition
        if card == nil then return end
        timer = os.clock()                                                                      -- ... reset the countdown timer

        -- **once the first wait condition has triggered, we setup another wait function
        -- **this second one waits for at least 0.5 seconds
        waitCond2 = Wait.condition(function()
            if card == nil then return end

            card.setLock(true)
            card.setVelocity({0, 0, 0})
            card.setAngularVelocity({0, 0, 0})

        end, function()                                                                             -- ... this is the condition function that is contiously checked, to trigger the first wait condition
            if card == nil then return true end                                                         -- ... if the card is ever nil, then return true; this will trigger the wait condition function, and then abort because of the top return statement
            newPos = card.getPosition()                                                                 -- ... obtain the new position of the card
            newRot = card.getRotation()                                                                 -- ... obtain the new rotation of the card

            justVibrating = SmashUp.checkIfStoppedButVibrating(newPos, oldPos, newRot, oldRot, 0.01, true)  -- ... check to see if the card is exhibiting micro-movements (vibrating)
            oldPos = newPos                                                                             -- ... reset the oldPos variable to be the card's current position to be compared to next frame's evaluation
            oldRot = newRot                                                                             -- ... reset the oldRot variable to be the card's current rotation to be ompared to next frave's evaluation

            return (not card.isDestroyed()) and (not card.resting) and (not card.held_by_color) and (os.clock() - timer > 0.5) and
                (justVibrating or (os.clock() - timer > 3))
                -- (SmashUp.nearlyStoppedCheck(card, 0.03) or justVibrating or (os.clock() - timer > 3))
        end)

    end, || (not card.isDestroyed()) and (not card.resting) and (not card.held_by_color) and ((SmashUp.nearlyStoppedCheck(card, 0.03) and os.clock() - timer > 1) or (os.clock() - timer > 3)))

    -- **this is the main wait condition that is waiting for the card to be resting, and will trigger the function that was passed to this function
    mainWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
        if card == nil then return end

        -- **there is a "race of wait functions" occuring: once the card is dropped, it either comes to a complete stop (or is possibly destroyed) and this wait triggers (canceling the other waits),
        -- ... or the card slows down (appears to be stopped), but continues to "vibrate" and the above waits trigger (which ultimately leads to the card being forced to stop moving/vibrating)
        if resetWaits then Wait.stop(resetWaits) end                                                -- ... stop any of the pending wait statements
        if waitCond1 then Wait.stop(waitCond1) end
        if waitCond2 then Wait.stop(waitCond2) end

            card.setLock(false)                                                                         -- ... unlock the card
    card.interactable = true                                                                    -- ... make sure the card is interactable

    -- **Clean up tracking tables when object stops moving**
    if SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.heldCardsPositions[card.getGUID()] then
        SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.heldCardsPositions[card.getGUID()] = nil
    end

    triggerFxn()                                                                                -- ... call the function that needs to be triggered; the function passed into this function
    end, conditionFxn)                                                                          -- ... the condition function that will be contiuously evaluated; can be passed to this function as a parameter


    -- **if the dropped card is picked up before the card is fully at rest and therefore the above wait conditions have triggered but not resolved, then stop those waits
    Wait.frames(function()
        resetWaits = Wait.condition(function()
            if card == nil then return end

            if mainWaitFunc then Wait.stop(mainWaitFunc) end
            if waitCond1 then Wait.stop(waitCond1) end
            if waitCond2 then Wait.stop(waitCond2) end
        end, || card.held_by_color and true or false)
    end, 5)
end



function SmashUp.makeSureCardGetsUnlocked(card)
    local timer = os.clock()

    local unlockWaitFunc
    unlockWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
        if card == nil then return end

        if SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customReadyToDetectNewObj and card.hasTag("OneCustomObj") then
            return
        end

        if card.interactable == false then
            card.interactable = true
        end
        if card.locked == true then
            card.setLock(false)
        end
    end, function()
            if card.held_by_color then
                if unlockWaitFunc then Wait.stop(unlockWaitFunc) end
            end
            return card.isDestroyed() or (card.resting and (os.clock() - timer > 4))
        end)
end



function SmashUp.cloneLastCardOfDeck(lastCard, deckLocation)
    SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked = false

    lastCard.addTag("Clone")

    local cardClone = lastCard.clone({position = deckLocation})             -- ... make a clone of this last card
    cardClone.addTag("Clone")
    local tempDeck = cardClone.putObject(lastCard)                          -- ... and add the cloned card to the last card to reform a temporary deck
    tempDeck.addTag("Clone")
    tempDeck.setPosition(deckLocation)

    lastCard = tempDeck.takeObject({                                        -- ... now, take a base card from this temp baseDeck...
        flip = true,                                                            -- ... make sure the card is flipped face up
    })

    lastCard.removeTag("Clone")

    local remainingCard = tempDeck.remainder                                -- ... obtain a reference to this last remaining (cloned) card

    Wait.frames(function()                                                  -- ... wait for 0.1 seconds (to make sure the card is fully spawned)...
        if remainingCard ~= nil then                                            -- ... as long as there is a remaining card (it isn't nil) then...
            remainingCard.destruct()                                                -- ... destroy the remaining card (leave no trace of this tomfoolery!)
        end
    end, 1)

    return lastCard
end


-- this function is called from various functions to check if a card is fully inside a scripting zone
function SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, card, useY_Axis)
    if useY_Axis == nil then useY_Axis = false end


    if card.type == "Deck" and SmashUp.Database.factionTable[card.getName():gsub(" Bases", "")] then
        return
    end

    local xLeft, yBottom, zFront = (zone.getPosition() - zone.getScale():scale(0.5)):get()
    local xRight, yTop, zBack = (zone.getPosition() + zone.getScale():scale(0.5)):get()
    xLeft = Common.round(xLeft, 5)
    xRight = Common.round(xRight, 5)
    zFront = Common.round(zFront, 5)
    zBack = Common.round(zBack, 5)

    if useY_Axis then
        yBottom = Common.round(yBottom, 5)
        yTop = Common.round(yTop, 5)
    end

    local rotated = false
    if Common.round(card.getRotation().y, 0) == 90 then
        rotated = true
    end

    local cardCenterX, cardCenterY, cardCenterZ = (card.getBoundsNormalized().center + card.getBoundsNormalized().offset):get()
    local cardWidth, cardThickness, cardLength = card.getBoundsNormalized().size:get()
    local cardLeft = cardCenterX - ((rotated and cardLength or cardWidth) / 2)
    local cardRight = cardCenterX + ((rotated and cardLength or cardWidth) / 2)
    local cardTop = cardCenterZ + ((rotated and cardWidth or cardLength) / 2)
    local cardBottom = cardCenterZ - ((rotated and cardWidth or cardLength) / 2)


    if cardRight < xRight and cardLeft > xLeft and cardTop < zBack and cardBottom > zFront then
        if useY_Axis then
            if cardCenterY < yTop and (cardCenterY - cardThickness) > yBottom then
                return true
            else
                return false
            end
        else
            return true
        end
    else
        return false
    end
end


-- the function is called when playing a smash up card to the board, to see how fast the card is moving. Used when determining whether or not the DiscLights should turn on or off
function SmashUp.movingFastCheck(obj, speedLimit)
    for vect, speed in pairs(obj.getVelocity()) do
        if vect == "x" or vect == "z" then
            if math.abs(speed) > speedLimit then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end



function SmashUp.nearlyStoppedCheck(obj, speedLimit)
    if speedLimit == nil then speedLimit = 0.1 end
    for vect, speed in pairs(obj.getVelocity()) do
        if math.abs(Common.round(speed, 3)) > speedLimit then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end



function SmashUp.checkIfStoppedButVibrating(newPos, oldPos, newRot, oldRot, mvmtAllow, checkRot)
    if checkRot == nil then checkRot = false end

    local posDifX = newPos.x - oldPos.x
    local posDifY = newPos.y - oldPos.y
    local posDifZ = newPos.z - oldPos.z

    local doneRotating = not checkRot

    if checkRot then
        local rotDifX = newRot.x - oldRot.x
        local rotDifY = newRot.y - oldRot.y
        local rotDifZ = newRot.z - oldRot.z
        doneRotating = (math.abs(rotDifX) < mvmtAllow) and (math.abs(rotDifY) < mvmtAllow) and (math.abs(rotDifZ) < mvmtAllow)
    end

    local doneMoving = (math.abs(posDifX) < mvmtAllow) and (math.abs(posDifY) < mvmtAllow) and (math.abs(posDifZ) < mvmtAllow)

    return doneMoving and doneRotating
end

-- this function randomly picks a seated player to go first, and then generates a turn sequence starting with that player and including only the colors that have players seated at them in the sequence
-- it also creates the `playersInfo` table that is used to store information related to each player entry, and used frequently throughout the faction picking UI
function SmashUp.Setup.initializePlayerSetupProfilesAndTurnNumberByColorTables(firstColor)
    local seatedColors = SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getSeatedColors()          -- obtain a table of all players currently seated at valid colors

    if SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSystemEnabled then
        for _, color in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) do
            table.insert(seatedColors, color)
        end
    end

    local firstPlayer = firstColor or SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor        -- the color who will be playing/taking their turn first

    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles = {}                                   -- establish an array-like table that will keep track of various pieces of information specific to that player/color including color, ID, factions dealt, factions selected, redraws left, etc.
    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor = {}                                           -- establish this variable as an empty table; will be used to store the turn order for each color, accessed/keyed by the color

    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[0] = {["color"] = "white"}

    local foundStartPos = false                                             -- initialize this monitoring variable as false

    local turnCount = 1                                                     -- this variable will simply track which turn number the color will be as the below `for loop` iterates through the colors in the turnOrder

    for i = 1, 2 do                                                         -- run the following process twice, in order to iterate through the color turn order twice, allowing iterating back through the turn order once more after reaching the end of the turn order
        for _, turnColor in ipairs(Turns.order) do                          -- ... for every color available in `Turns.order`...

            if turnColor == firstPlayer then                                    -- ... if the iterated color matches the player color randomly picked to go first...
                if foundStartPos == false then                                  -- ... and if the foundStartPos monitoring variable is false...
                    foundStartPos = true                                        -- ... then set the variable to true, indicating that we have found the position in the turn order that will go first...
                else                                                            -- ... otherwise, if the monitoring variable is true...
                    foundStartPos = false                                       -- ... then set the monitoring variable to false, indicating we have circled back around to the same firstPlayer's color again, and should therefore stop obtaining new player colors (to not obtain repeats)
                end
            end

            if foundStartPos then                                               -- ... if we have found the start position in the turn order...
                for _, seatColor in ipairs(seatedColors) do                         -- for every color picked by seated players...
                    if seatColor == turnColor then                                  -- ... if the seat color matches the iterated turn color...
                        SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnCount] = {
                            ["color"] = turnColor,                                  -- ... then insert the turn color into the players info tracking table...
                            ["ID"] = "player"..turnCount,                           -- ... and add the player# to the table
                            ["factionsDealt"] = {},                                 -- ... create entries for factionsDealt, factionsPicked, factionsDrafted, factionsBanned, selectedDraft, oldFactions, and redrawsLeft
                            ["factionsPicked"] = {},
                            ["factionsDrafted"] = {},
                            ["factionsBanned"] = {},
                            ["basesPicked"] = {},
                            ["selectedDraft"] = nil,
                            ["oldFactions"] = {},
                            ["redrawsLeft"] = 0,
                            ["draftComplete"] = false,
                            ["isGhostPlayer"] = false,
                        }

                        SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[turnColor] = turnCount                 -- ... add an entry to the UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor table, storing the color's turn number

                        turnCount = turnCount + 1                                   -- ... increase the turn order value by 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSystemEnabled then
        for _, color in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) do
            for num, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
                if playerInfo.color == color then
                    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[num].isGhostPlayer = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles = false
    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetRandomSelectionPanel = true
    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetDraftSelectionPanel = true

    SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlFunctions.setNamePlate()
end
