-- this function is called during onLoad to iterate through all in-game objects/assets (.getObjects()), and stores references to those objects in the SmashUp.GameObjects table
local function setUpTableOfObjects()
    SmashUp.GameObjects.tokenBags = {}
    SmashUp.GameObjects.RespawnSources = {}
    SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerScoreTiles = {}                                   -- prepare this sub-table to hold all (6) score tiles
    SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerMats = {}                                         -- prepare this sub-table to hold all (6) draw/discard player mats
    SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks = {}                                        -- prepare this sub-table to hold references to every players' deck
    SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats = {}                                          -- prepare this sub-table to hold the (2) madness and munchkin mats
    SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks = {}                                         -- prepare this sub-table to hold the (3) extra decks: madness, monsters, treasures
    SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects = {}                                      -- prepare this sub-table to hold any spawned custom extra objects
    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects = {}                                        -- prepare this sub-table to hold references to objects related to the base deck and the base mat
    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles = {}                         -- prepare this sub-table to hold all (6 x 9) base score board tiles
    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.scoreboards = {}                            -- prepare this sub-table to hold all (6 x 9) base score board tiles
    SmashUp.GameObjects.discLights = {}                                         -- prepare this sub-table to hold all (6 x variable) disc light objects
    SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones = {                                      -- prepare this sub-table to hold references to all scripting zones
        cardZones = {}, baseBlockZones = {}, baseCardZones = {}, baseSortZones = {},
        phantomZones = {}, playerColorPlayZones = {}, PlayerDeckZones = {}, playerSortZones = {}, monsterZones = {},
        customExtraZones = {},
    }
    SmashUp.GameObjects.HandZones = {}

    SmashUp.GameObjects.needUnlocking = {}
    for x, obj in ipairs(getObjects()) do                                       -- iterate through all objects loaded in the game...
        local num = tonumber(obj.getGMNotes():match("(%d+)%.*")) or 0               -- ... set this variable equal to the number contained in the objects name, which indicates which base zone it belongs to

        if SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.manualReloadInProgress then
            obj.interactable = false
        end

        if obj.type == "Tile" then                                                  -- ... if the object is a "Tile"...
            --*** This Includes: ***
            --      Card mats (player card mats, base card mat, madness card mat, etc)
            --      Player score buttons
            --      Each black scoreboard
            --      All the colored tiles on every scoreboard
            --      PDF rulebooks
            if obj.getDescription() ~= "Rulebook" then
                obj.interactable = false                                                    -- ... set the interactable attribute to false...
            else
                table.insert(SmashUp.GameObjects.needUnlocking, obj)
            end

            if obj.getGMNotes():find("Ring") or obj.getGMNotes():find("Base Power")
            or obj.getGMNotes():find("Breakpoint") or obj.getGMNotes():find("Scoreboard")
            or obj.getGMNotes():find("Base Settings") then                                                                      -- ... then if the "Tile" object's name contains "Ring", "Base Power", or "Breakpoint" (it's a component of the base score board)...
                SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[num] = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[num] or {}     -- ... prepare a sub-table to hold all the score board components for this (num) particular base zone

                if obj.getGMNotes():find("Ring") then                                                                               -- ... if the "Tile" object's name contains "Ring"...
                    local color = obj.getGMNotes():match("^(.*) Ring")                                                                  -- ... identify the color from the object's name
                    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[num][color] = obj                                                    -- ... and store this object in the table, keyed by the color (and in turn, indexed by base zone number)
                elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Base Power") then                                                                     -- ... or if the "Tile" object's name contains "Base Power"...
                    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[num]["Base Power"] = obj                                             -- ... store this object in the table, keyed under "Base Power" (and in turn, indexed by base zone number)
                elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Breakpoint") then                                                                     -- ... or if the "Tile" object's name contains "Breakpoint"...
                    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[num]["Breakpoint"] = obj                                             -- ... store this object in the table, keyed under "Breakpoint" (and in turn, indexed by base zone number)
                elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Base Settings") then
                    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[num]["Settings"] = obj
                elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Scoreboard") then
                    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.scoreboards[num] = obj
                end
                if num > 6 then
                end

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Player Mat") then                             -- ... or if the "Tile" object's name contains "Player Mat"...
                local color = obj.getGMNotes():match("^(.*) Player Mat")                    -- ... identify the color from the object's name
                SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerMats[color] = obj                                 -- ... and store this "Player Mat" object in the table, keyed by color

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Base") then                                   -- ... or if the "Tile" object's name contains "Base"...
                if obj.getGMNotes() == "Base Mat" then                                      -- ... and the object's name is "Base Mat"...
                    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseMat = obj                               -- ... save the Base Mat object in the table
                elseif obj.getGMNotes() == "Base Mat Button" then                           -- ... or the object's name is "Base Mat Button"...
                    obj.interactable = true                                                     -- ... set it's interactable attribute to true
                    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseMatButton = obj                         -- ... save the Base Mat Button object in the table
                end

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Custom") then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.customMat = obj

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Madness Mat") then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.madnessMat = obj

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Munchkin Mat") then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.munchkinMat = obj

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Score") and not obj.getGMNotes():find("%d+") then -- ... or if the "Tile" object's name contains "Score" and does NOT have a number in it...
                local color = obj.getGMNotes():match("^(.*)Score")                          -- ... identify the color from the object's name
                obj.interactable = true                                                     -- ... set it's interactable attribute to true
                SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerScoreTiles[color] = obj                           -- ... save this playerScoreTile in the table, keyed by color
            end

        elseif obj.type == "Scripting" then                                         -- ... or if the object is a "Scripting Zone"...
            obj.locked = true                                                                -- make sure the zone is locked
            obj.interactable = false                                                         -- make sure the zone is un-interactable

            if obj.getGMNotes():find("CardZone") then                                   -- ... and its name contains "CardZone"...
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.cardZones[num] = obj                     -- ... store this object in this section of the table, indexed by base zone number
            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("BaseBlockZone") then                               -- ... or its name contains "BaseBlockZone"...
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseBlockZones[num] = obj                     -- ... store this object in this section of the table, indexed by base zone number
            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("BaseZone") then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseCardZones[num] = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Base Sort") then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseSortZones[num] = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes() == "Base Draw" then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseDraw = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes() == "Base Discard" then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseDiscard = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes() == "Monster Draw" then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterDraw = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes() == "Monster Discard" then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterDiscard = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes() == "Treasure Draw" then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.treasureDraw = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes() == "Treasure Discard" then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.treasureDiscard = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes() == "Madness Draw" then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.madnessDraw = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Sort Piles") then
                local color = obj.getGMNotes():match("(.*) Sort Piles")
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerSortZones[color] = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Draw") then
                local color = obj.getGMNotes():match("(.*) Draw")
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[color] = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[color] or {}
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[color].draw = obj

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Discard") then
                local color = obj.getGMNotes():match("(.*) Discard")
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[color] = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[color] or {}
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[color].discard = obj

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("MonsterZone") then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterZones[num] = obj
            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("PhantomZone") then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.phantomZones[num] = obj

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("CustomExtra_") then
                local extraID, zoneType = obj.getGMNotes():match("CustomExtra_(.*) (.*)")
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customExtraZones = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customExtraZones or {}
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customExtraZones[extraID] = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customExtraZones[extraID] or {}
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customExtraZones[extraID][zoneType] = obj

            elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("custom") then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customZone = obj

            elseif Common.isInTable(obj.getGMNotes():match("(.*)Zone"), Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                local color = obj.getGMNotes():match("(.*)Zone")
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerColorPlayZones[num] = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerColorPlayZones[num] or {}
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerColorPlayZones[num][color] = obj
            end
            --*** This is EVERY scripting zone that exists on game load. ***

        elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Board") then                                  -- ... if the object is the game board (only one game board)...
            --*** The Smash Up game board ***
            SmashUp.GameObjects.board = obj                                             -- ... store a reference to the board in the table

        elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Smash Up Box") then                           -- ... if the object is the `Smash Up Box`...
            --*** The smash up box object ***
            SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox = obj                                        -- ... store a reference to it in the table

            obj.interactable = false
            table.insert(SmashUp.GameObjects.needUnlocking, obj)

        elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("SoundEffectsCube") then
            --*** The sound effects cube ***
            SmashUp.GameObjects.soundCube = obj
            obj.interactable = false

        elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("CustomsImportCube") then
            --*** The cube object used to track time for purposes of rewinding/fast-forwarding ***
            SmashUp.GameObjects.customsImportCube = obj
            obj.interactable = false

        elseif obj.getGMNotes():find("Extra Base") then                             -- ... if the object is an "Extra Base" object...
            --*** All eight of the extra base objects (which are actually custom models) ***
            obj.interactable = false                                                    -- ... set `interactable` to false

            SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases or {}   -- ... establish this sub-table (BaseObjects.extraBases)
            SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[num] = obj                       -- ... add the extraBaseDock object to the GameObjects table

        elseif obj.type == "Hand" then
            --*** Hand Zones ***
            local color = obj.getGMNotes():match("^(.*) Zone")
            SmashUp.GameObjects.HandZones[color] = obj

        elseif obj.type == "Coin" then
            --*** The Goblin coin ***
            if obj.getGMNotes() == "Goblin Coin" then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.coin = obj
                table.insert(SmashUp.GameObjects.needUnlocking, obj)
            end

        elseif obj.type == "Deck" then
            --*** ANY deck in the game (tries to get a named/tracked deck) ***
            local typeName = obj.getGMNotes():find("Deck") and "Deck" or "Discard Pile"
            local pileType = obj.getGMNotes():find("Deck") and "Draw" or "Discard"
            local deckType = obj.getGMNotes():match("^(.*) "..typeName)
            local tableCat = ((deckType == "Base" or deckType == "base") and "BaseObjects") or (Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) and "PlayerDecks") or "ExtraDecks"

            if SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "Victorian Literature" and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "Victorian Literature Bases" then
                SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower()..pileType] = obj
            end

            table.insert(SmashUp.GameObjects.needUnlocking, obj)

        elseif obj.type == "Card" then
            --*** ANY card in the game ***
            for _, zone in ipairs(obj.getZones()) do
                if zone.getGMNotes():find("Draw") or zone.getGMNotes():find("Discard") then
                    local deckType, pileType = zone.getGMNotes():match("^(.-) (.-)$")
                    local tableCat = ((deckType == "Base" or deckType == "base") and "BaseObjects") or (Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) and "PlayerDecks") or "ExtraDecks"

                    SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower()..pileType] = obj
                end
            end
            table.insert(SmashUp.GameObjects.needUnlocking, obj)

        elseif obj.type == "Generic" and obj.getGMNotes():find("Disc") then
            --*** All the currently spawned discs (none exist at game start, but will exist if loaded from a save) ***
            obj.interactable = false
            obj.locked = true

            local color = obj.getGMNotes():match("(.*)Disc")
            local copyNum = tonumber(obj.getGMNotes():match("%.(%d+)"))
            SmashUp.GameObjects.discLights[num] = SmashUp.GameObjects.discLights[num] or {}
            SmashUp.GameObjects.discLights[num][color] = SmashUp.GameObjects.discLights[num][color] or {}
            obj.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(0)

            SmashUp.GameObjects.discLights[num][color][copyNum] = obj

        elseif obj.type == "Infinite" then
            obj.interactable = false
            local token = obj.getGMNotes()
            SmashUp.GameObjects.tokenBags[token] = obj
            table.insert(SmashUp.GameObjects.needUnlocking, obj)

        elseif (obj.type == "Bag" and obj.getName():find("Kit")) then
            obj.interactable = false
            table.insert(SmashUp.GameObjects.needUnlocking, obj)

        elseif obj.type == "Board" and obj.getGMNotes():find("Drawer") then
        end
    end
end



local function positionGameObjects()
    -- move the pre-existing scripting zones down into position.
    -- they are 1000 points up along the y-axis to hide them when the game is loading.
    -- after the game is loaded, they are moved into place, and thereby avoids the flashing visual appearance of the zones
    for _, obj in ipairs(getObjects()) do
        if obj.type == "Scripting" then
            if not (obj.getName():find("Monster") or obj.getName():find("Treasure") or obj.getName():find("Madness") or obj.getName():find("Custom")) then
                if obj.getName() == "customFactionZone" then return end
                obj.setPosition(obj.getPosition() - Vector(0, 1000, 0))
            end
        end
    end
end

local function miniGhostButtonClicked(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end

    local playerNum = tonumber(buttonID:match("^miniGhostButton(%d+)$"))

    SmashUp.Setup.miniGhostToggles[playerNum] = not SmashUp.Setup.miniGhostToggles[playerNum]

    if SmashUp.Setup.miniGhostToggles[playerNum] then
        UI.setAttribute("miniGhostButton"..playerNum, "colors", "rgb(0.25,0.25,0.25)|rgb(0.6,0.6,0.6)|rgb(0.1,0.1,0.1)|Gray")
        UI.setAttribute("waitingFade"..playerNum, "active", "true")
        SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerNum].isGhostPlayer = true
        SmashUp.Setup.playerRejoinCompleteCheck()
    else
        UI.setAttribute("miniGhostButton"..playerNum, "colors", "White|rgb(0.9,0.9,0.9)|White|Gray")
        UI.setAttribute("waitingFade"..playerNum, "active", "false")
        SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerNum].isGhostPlayer = false
    end

end



local function displayWaitList()
    UI.setAttribute("reloadCover", "active", "true")

    UI.setAttribute("waitingPanel", "height", 143 + (SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount * 75))

    for playerNum, playerData in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
        UI.setAttribute("waitingRow"..playerNum, "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("waitingPlayerColor"..playerNum, "color", playerData.color)
        UI.setAttribute("waitingColorText"..playerNum, "text", playerData.color)

        local factionsPicked = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerNum].factionsPicked
        UI.setAttribute("waitingFactions"..playerNum, "text", factionsPicked[1].." \\ " .. factionsPicked[2])

        if Player[playerData.color].seated then
            UI.setAttribute("waitingFade"..playerNum, "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("miniGhostButton"..playerNum, "active", "false")
        else
            UI.setAttribute("waitingFade"..playerNum, "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("miniGhostButton"..playerNum, "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("miniGhostButton"..playerNum, "color", "white")
        end
    end
end

local function getBoardMeasurements()
    SmashUp.GameBoard.BOARDWIDTH = SmashUp.GameObjects.board.getBoundsNormalized().size.x - (SmashUp.GameObjects.board.getBoundsNormalized().offset.x * 2 * -1)     -- obtain the width (horizontal axis) of the GameBoard by first obtaining its size from `getBounds()`, and then adjusting for the offset.
    SmashUp.GameBoard.BOARDLENGTH = SmashUp.GameObjects.board.getBoundsNormalized().size.z          -- obtain the length (vertical axis) of the GameBoard

    SmashUp.GameBoard.CARDWIDTH = 3.52
    SmashUp.GameBoard.CARDHEIGHT = 5.03

    SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio = Common.round(1980 / SmashUp.GameBoard.BOARDWIDTH, 7)             -- this variable represents how many pixels there are per in-game unit (the original image is 1980 pixels wide (and 1320 pixels long))

    SmashUp.GameBoard.horizBound = -Common.round(SmashUp.GameBoard.BOARDWIDTH / 2, 7)               -- the farthest left (or right) point of the board
    SmashUp.GameBoard.vertBound = -Common.round(SmashUp.GameBoard.BOARDLENGTH / 2, 7)               -- the closest/down-est (or farthest/up-est) point of the board

    SmashUp.GameBoard.zoneWidth = Common.round(650 / SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio, 7)               -- width of a full base zone
    SmashUp.GameBoard.zoneHeight = Common.round(652 / SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio, 7)              -- height of a full base zone

    SmashUp.GameBoard.baseHeight = Common.round(152 / SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio, 7)
    SmashUp.GameBoard.boxHeight =  Common.round(250 / SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio, 7)              -- height of every player's zone
    SmashUp.GameBoard.thirdWidth = Common.round(214 / SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio, 7)              -- the width of a player zone if there are three players in a row
    SmashUp.GameBoard.halfWidth = Common.round(323 / SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio, 7)               -- the width of a player zone if there are two players in a row
    SmashUp.GameBoard.lineWidth = Common.round(4 / SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio, 7)                 -- the width of a player zone if there is one player in the row

    SmashUp.GameBoard.stripeWidth = Common.round(15 / SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio, 7)              -- the width of a base zone dividing line
    SmashUp.GameBoard.stripeHeight = Common.round(16 / SmashUp.GameBoard.pixelRatio, 7)             -- the thickness of a base zone dividing line
end



local function generateUniqueID()
    local charList = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_0123456789"
    local uniqueStrLen = 20

    local gameSessionID = ""

    for charNum = 1, uniqueStrLen do
        local random = math.random(#charList)
        gameSessionID = gameSessionID..charList:sub(random, random)
    end

    SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameSessionID = gameSessionID
end


--This function pulls card object data from the BigBox to create and spawn the Madness, Monster, and Treasure decks
local function setupCthulhuMunchkinDecks(boxData)
    local madnessIndex                                                                                  -- initialize this variable
    local monsterIndex                                                                                  -- initialize this variable
    local treasureIndex                                                                                 -- initialize this variable

    -- **identify the location in the SmashUp Box Object of the madness, monster, or treasure decks**
    for i, kitData in ipairs(boxData) do                                                                -- for every kit in the boxObject's data...
        if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu and kitData.Nickname == "Madness Kit" then           -- ... if the Kit's name is "Madness Kit" then...
            madnessIndex = i                                                                                -- ... save the index of the Madness kit in this variable
        elseif SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin and kitData.Nickname == "Monsters Kit" then     -- ... if the Kit's name is "Monsters Kit" then...
            monsterIndex = i                                                                                -- ... save the index of the Monsters kit in this variable
        elseif SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin and kitData.Nickname == "Treasures Kit" then    -- ... if the Kit's name is "Treasures Kit" then...
            treasureIndex = i                                                                               -- ... save the index of the Treasures kit in this variable
        end
    end


    -- **spawn the madness deck and put it in the correct spot**
    if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu then                                                     -- if Cthulhu bases/decks are being used then...
        local madnessMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.madnessMat                                     -- ... grab a reference to the madness mat object
        local madnessZone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.madnessDraw
        madnessMat.setPosition(madnessMat.getPosition() - Vector(0,1000,0))                             -- ... move the madness mat into visible position
        madnessZone.setPosition(madnessZone.getPosition() - Vector(0,1000,0))                             -- ... move the madness mat into visible position

        local madnessKitData = boxData[madnessIndex].ContainedObjects

        for deckLoc = #madnessKitData, 1, -1 do
            if madnessKitData[deckLoc].Nickname == "Madness Deck" then
                local madnessDeck = table.remove(madnessKitData, deckLoc)

                local newMadnessDeck = spawnObjectData({
                    data = madnessDeck,
                    position = madnessMat.positionToWorld(madnessMat.getSnapPoints()[1].position),
                })
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.madnessDeck = newMadnessDeck

                --TODO: this is part of my turn-by-turn rewind system; on hold for now.
                -- SmashUp.SaveSystem.createRespawnSources(madnessDeck)

                break
            end
        end
    end


    -- **if using the munchkin set, spawn all needed munchkin components**
    if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin then                                                    -- if munchkin bases/decks are being used then...

        -- **draw the monster play area images on the main gameboard**
        local decals = Global.getDecals()                                                               -- ... store the global decals table in this variable
        for z = 1, 6 do                                                                                 -- ... for every normal (on the board) baseBlockZones (total of 6)...
            local newDecal =                                                                                -- ... create a new variable to store the info for that baseBlockZones Monster area decal
                {
                    name = "Monster",
                    url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1825645848891101144/752FA1AFC0C46E1A1B9C2A2FFE40AFD98A613D6E/",
                    position = SmashUp.GameBoard.BaseBlockZonePositions[z] - Vector(12.46189024, -0.005, 0),
                    rotation = {90, 0, 0},
                    scale = {12.23323171, 8.68902439, 1}
                }
            table.insert(decals, newDecal)                                                                  -- ... insert this data into the decals table
        end
        Global.setDecals(decals)                                                                        -- ... set the Global decals

        -- **draw the monster play area images on the extraBaseDocks**
        for z = 7, 14 do                                                                                -- ... for each extraBaseDock Zone (7 to 14)...
            local mat = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[z]                                       -- ... grab a reference to the extraBaseDockZone object
            local decals = mat.getDecals() or {}                                                            -- ... initiate a table storing the extraBaseDockZones decals table
            local newDecal =                                                                                -- ... create a new variable to store the info for this baseBlockZones Monster area decal
                {
                    name = "Monster",
                    url = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1825645848891101144/752FA1AFC0C46E1A1B9C2A2FFE40AFD98A613D6E/",
                    position = {-3.353846154, 0.55, 0},
                    rotation = {90, 0, 0},
                    scale = {3.292307692, 2.331288344, 1}
                }
            table.insert(decals, newDecal)                                                                  -- ... insert this data/info into the decals table
            mat.setDecals(decals)                                                                           -- ... set the extraBaseDockZones decals
        end

        -- **place the munchkin mat and its scripting zones into correct position**
        local munchkinMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.munchkinMat                                       -- ... grab a reference to the munchkin mat
        local monsterDraw = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterDraw
        local monsterDiscard = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterDiscard
        local treasureDraw = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.treasureDraw
        local treasureDiscard = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.treasureDiscard
        munchkinMat.setPosition(munchkinMat.getPosition() - Vector(0,1000,0))                               -- ... move the munchkin mat into visible position

        if monsterDraw == nil or monsterDiscard == nil or treasureDraw == nil or treasureDiscard == nil then return end

        monsterDraw.setPosition(monsterDraw.getPosition() - Vector(0,1000,0))
        monsterDiscard.setPosition(monsterDiscard.getPosition() - Vector(0,1000,0))
        treasureDraw.setPosition(treasureDraw.getPosition() - Vector(0,1000,0))
        treasureDiscard.setPosition(treasureDiscard.getPosition() - Vector(0,1000,0))

        -- **spawn the monster deck in the correct location**
        local monsterKitData = boxData[monsterIndex].ContainedObjects

        for deckLoc = #monsterKitData, 1, -1 do
            if monsterKitData[deckLoc].Nickname == "Monster Deck" then
                local monsterDeck = table.remove(monsterKitData, deckLoc)
                local newMonsterDeck = spawnObjectData({
                    data = monsterDeck,
                    position = munchkinMat.positionToWorld(munchkinMat.getSnapPoints()[1].position),
                    rotation = {0, 90, 180}
                })
                Wait.frames(function()                                                                              -- ... after waiting 1 frame for the monster deck to spawn...
                    newMonsterDeck.shuffle()                                                                            -- ... shuffle the monster deck
                end, 1)
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.monsterDraw = newMonsterDeck

                --TODO: this is part of my turn-by-turn rewind system; on hold for now.
                -- SmashUp.SaveSystem.createRespawnSources(monsterDeck)

                break
            end
        end

        -- **spawn the treasure deck in the correct location**
        local treasureKitData = boxData[treasureIndex].ContainedObjects

        for deckLoc = #treasureKitData, 1, -1 do
            if treasureKitData[deckLoc].Nickname == "Treasure Deck" then
                local treasureDeck = table.remove(treasureKitData, deckLoc)

                local newTreasureDeck = spawnObjectData({                                                           -- ... spawn the Treasures deck
                    data = treasureDeck,
                    position = munchkinMat.positionToWorld(munchkinMat.getSnapPoints()[3].position),
                    rotation = {180, 0, 0}
                })
                Wait.frames(function()                                                                              -- ... after waiting 1 frame for the treasure deck to spawn...
                    newTreasureDeck.shuffle()                                                                           -- ... shuffle the treasure deck
                end, 1)
                SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDraw = newTreasureDeck

                --TODO: this is part of my turn-by-turn rewind system; on hold for now.
                -- SmashUp.SaveSystem.createRespawnSources(treasureDeck)

                break
            end
        end

        -- **add the scriptingZones and snapPoints for monster cards in the monster play area for each baseBlock on the GameBoard**
        for baseNum = 1, 6 do                                                                                     -- ... for every regular baseBlock (on the game board)...
            SmashUp.Monsters.addMonsterScriptZones(baseNum, SmashUp.GameBoard.BaseBlockZonePositions[baseNum])              -- ... run this function to add the scripting zones for the monster play areas
            SmashUp.Monsters.addMonsterSnapPoints(baseNum, SmashUp.GameBoard.BaseBlockZonePositions[baseNum])                           -- ... run this function to add the monster card snap points in the monster play area
        end
    end

    return boxData
end


-- this function is called upon completing the UI-guided setup to run through all the steps needed to fully setup the GameBoard
function SmashUp.Setup.boardSetup(useAllBases)
    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupInProgress = false                                         -- turn off this variable, indicating that the UI-guided setup is now over
    Hands.enable = true

    generateUniqueID()
    getBoardMeasurements()                                                      -- call this function to obtain the board measurement variables used in the remainder of the automatic board setup

    SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("")                                -- call this function to activate a panel called (empty); this in turn calls the function that deactivates all panels, and then won't be able to turn on any panels

    SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.checkLiftHeight(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor)
    SmashUp.PlayZones.createPlayZones()                                         -- this function generates the play zone for each player (depending on how many players there are)

    if useAllBases then                                                         -- if this variable is true (which is passed to this function when it is called by pushing the UI "Finish" button, based on the value of the "Use All Bases" toggle)...
        SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded = {Cthulhu = true, Munchkin = true}     -- ... then make sure this table variable has correct `true` values for each non-regular expansion key
    end

    local boxData = SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox.getData()
    local contObjList = boxData.ContainedObjects

    -- **if Obligatory Cthulhu or Munchkin sets are used, add their components**
    if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu or SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin then
        contObjList = setupCthulhuMunchkinDecks(contObjList)
    end

    local board = SmashUp.GameObjects.board
    local boardXML = board.UI.getXml()
    board.UI.setXml(boardXML)
    for color in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
        board.UI.setAttribute(color.."PlayArea", "active", "true")
    end

    contObjList = SmashUp.DealCards.dealAll(contObjList)                        -- this function obtains the faction decks selected by each player, shuffles them together, places them in front of each player, and deals 5 cards to each player. It also obtains the base cards, shuffles them together, and deals out the needed number.

    SmashUp.PlayerScores.startingScores()

    SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox.destruct()                                   -- destroy the smashUpBoxObj
    SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox = spawnObjectData({data = boxData})          -- and rebuild it using the modified object data now contained in boxData

    for tokenVal, tokenBag in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.tokenBags) do
        tokenBag.interactable = true
    end

    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringActive = false                          -- initialize this variable, which is used to denote ANY base as scoring, and is used to prevent other bases from being scored while one is already scored
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum = 0
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.passCount = 0

    SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete = true                                     -- mark setup as finally completed, game is ready to begin
    SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.gameStarted = os.time()

    SmashUp.TurnsSystem.turnTurnsOn()
end



function SmashUp.Setup.reinitiateGameAfterSaveReload()
    SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates = SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates or {}
    SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked = SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked or false
    SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping or false

    SmashUp.GameData.BugReports = {}
    SmashUp.GameData.BugReports.bugReportString = ""
    SmashUp.GameData.BugReports.bugCharCount = 0
    SmashUp.GameData.BugReports.bugInputLen = 0
    SmashUp.GameData.BugReports.bugInputRows = 1
    SmashUp.GameData.BugReports.oldBugInputVal = ""
    SmashUp.GameData.BugReports.statusOn = false

    SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customEditMode = false

    SmashUp.Database.onLoad()
    for custom, entry in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.Customs.databaseEntryBackup) do
        SmashUp.Database.factionTable[custom] = entry
    end

    if SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.saveStateHistory[SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.totalSavesCount].isManual then
        printToAll("Loading game from save...")
        SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.manualReloadInProgress = true
        SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.savesPausedForRejoin = true

        -- Restore held cards to their original positions
        restoreHeldCards()
    else
        printToAll("Game was rewound.")
    end

    setUpTableOfObjects()

    SmashUp.PlayZones.onLoad(SmashUp)
    SmashUp.DealCards.onLoad(SmashUp)
    SmashUp.CleanUp.onLoad(SmashUp)
    SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.onLoad(SmashUp)
    SmashUp.Monsters.onLoad(SmashUp)
    SmashUp.Madness.onLoad(SmashUp)
    SmashUp.TurnsSystem.onLoad(SmashUp)
    SmashUp.BaseSettings.onLoad(SmashUp)
    SmashUp.GameStats.onLoad(SmashUp)

    _G["SmashUp.Setup.miniGhostButtonClicked"] = miniGhostButtonClicked
    SmashUp.Setup.miniGhostToggles = {
        [1] = false,
        [2] = false,
        [3] = false,
        [4] = false,
        [5] = false,
        [6] = false,
    }

    for playerNum, playerData in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
        playerData.isGhostPlayer = false
    end

    SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.playerRejoinComplete = false
    SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.savesPausedForRejoin = true

    SmashUp.Setup.playerRejoinCompleteCheck()

    Wait.frames(function()
        Wait.condition(function()
            SmashUp.Bases.onLoad(SmashUp)                                       -- Run the Base functions that setup buttons and tables for use throughout the game, but would have been deleted with a reload
            SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.evalForExistingBases()                -- find all baseBlocks that have a base played and turn those base areas "on"
            SmashUp.PlayerScores.onLoad(SmashUp)                                -- draw on all the buttons for every player's score tile

            SmashUp.TurnsSystem.turnTurnsOn()                                   -- get the turns system set back up, and set to the correct player's turn
            SmashUp.BaseSettings.reloadBaseScoring()                            -- if the game was saved in the middle of a base scoring, reload the game back to the correct phase of base scoring

            for _, obj in ipairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.needUnlocking) do          -- after setUpTableOfObjects() function runs, run through the needsUnlocking table to now unlock objects that need to be unlocked
                obj.interactable = true
            end

            UI.setAttribute("reloadCover", "active", "false")                   -- turn this UI element (that grays out everything) off as game should be able to progress when these functions are being run

            for num = 1, 6 do                                                   -- run through all 6 rows (one for each possible player) and turn off all the "waiting for player:" elements for that player/row
                UI.setAttribute("waitingRow"..num, "active", "false")
                UI.setAttribute("waitingFade"..num, "active", "false")
            end

            SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.manualReloadInProgress = false
            SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.playerRejoinComplete = false

            SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[0] = {["color"] = "white"}        -- re-add this element in the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table that had to be removed prior to saving the data (in onSave), but needs to exist for the table to function correctly

        end, || SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.playerRejoinComplete)
    end, 2)
end

local function parseTime(duration)
    local TIME_HOURS = 60*60
    local TIME_MINS = 60

    local hours = math.floor(duration / TIME_HOURS)
    duration = duration - (hours * TIME_HOURS)

local function obtainPlayTimes()

    local draftDuration = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.gameStarted - SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.draftStarted
    GameStats.allStats.startTime = os.date("%X", SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.draftStarted)
    GameStats.allStats.draftDuration = parseTime(draftDuration)

    local gameDuration
    if SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.gameEnd then
        gameDuration = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.gameEnd - SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.gameStarted
    else
        gameDuration = os.time() - SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.gameStarted
    end
    GameStats.allStats.gameDuration = parseTime(gameDuration)

local function obtainDraftType()
    for draftType, status in pairs(SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]) do
        if status == true then
            GameStats.allStats.draftType = draftType:match("^(.*)Option")
            if not GameStats.allStats.draftType and draftType == "smashLeague" then
                GameStats.allStats.draftType = "smashLeague"
            end
            break
        end
    end
    if GameStats.allStats.draftType == "randomSelection" then GameStats.allStats.draftType = "individualPools" end
end


local function obtainDraftPool()
    if GameStats.allStats.draftType == "snakeDraft" or GameStats.allStats.draftType == "straightDraft" or GameStats.allStats.draftType == "smashLeague" then
        GameStats.allStats.draftPool = table.sort(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool)

    elseif GameStats.allStats.draftType == "openDraft" or GameStats.allStats.draftType == "freePick" then
        if SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.selectAll.selectAllExpansions then
            GameStats.allStats.draftPool = "All Factions"
        else
            GameStats.allStats.draftPool = {}
            for expNum, expansion in ipairs(SmashUp.Database.expansionList) do
                if SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["expansion"][expansion] == true then
                    table.insert(GameStats.allStats.draftPool, expansion.." Factions")
                else
                    for faction, factionData in pairs(SmashUp.Database.factionTable) do
                        if factionData.expansion == expansion and factionData.included == true then

                    end
                end
            end
        end

    end

local function obtainBannedList()
    GameStats.allStats.bannedList = {}
    for _, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do

            table.insert(GameStats.allStats.bannedList, bannedFaction)
        end
    end
    if next(GameStats.allStats.bannedList) == nil then
        GameStats.allStats.bannedList = ""
    else
        GameStats.allStats.bannedList = table.sort(GameStats.allStats.bannedList)

    GameStats.allStats.playerStats = {}
    for numPlayer, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
        local color = playerInfo.color
        local thisPlayerSet = GameStats.allStats.playerStats
        thisPlayerSet[numPlayer] = {}
        thisPlayerSet[numPlayer]["name"] = Player[color].steam_name or color.." Player"
        thisPlayerSet[numPlayer]["turnCount"] = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.turnsTaken[color]
        thisPlayerSet[numPlayer]["GameStats.manualTurnsTriggered"] = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.manualTurnsTriggered[color]
        thisPlayerSet[numPlayer]["factionPool"] = (GameStats.allStats.draftType == "individualPools" and table.sort(Common.removeNilsFromDictionary(playerInfo.factionsDealt))) or ""
        thisPlayerSet[numPlayer]["faction1"] = playerInfo.factionsPicked[1]
        thisPlayerSet[numPlayer]["faction2"] = playerInfo.factionsPicked[2]
        thisPlayerSet[numPlayer]["score"] = SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[color]
        thisPlayerSet[numPlayer]["madness"] = SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessCardCount[color]
    end
end


function GameStats.collectResults()
    GameStats.allStats = {}

    GameStats.allStats.gameDate = os.date("%m/%d/%Y")
    GameStats.allStats.gameID = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameSessionID
    GameStats.allStats.program = "RecordStats"

    obtainPlayTimes()
    obtainDraftType()
    obtainDraftPool()
    obtainBannedList()
    GameStats.allStats.numPlayers = SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount
    GameStats.allStats.totalRounds = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.totalRoundsCompleted
    obtainEachPlayersData()
    GameStats.allStats.gameIsComplete = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameIsComplete
    GameStats.allStats.completionStatus = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameCompletionStatus

    sendTheData()

    SmashUp = lib
end

return GameStats

local Common = {}


function Common.enableCollider(obj)
    if obj.getComponent("Rigidbody") then
        obj.getComponent("Rigidbody").set("detectCollisions", true)
    end
    if obj.getComponent("BoxCollider") then
        obj.getComponent("BoxCollider").set("enabled", true)
    end
end



function Common.disableCollider(obj)
    if obj.getComponent("Rigidbody") then
        obj.getComponent("Rigidbody").set("detectCollisions", false)
    end
    if obj.getComponent("BoxCollider") then
        obj.getComponent("BoxCollider").set("enabled", false)
    end
end



function Common.animate(style, target, from, to, steps, time, repetitions, bouncy)
	if style == nil then style = "move" end
	if repetitions == nil then repetitions = 1 end
	if bouncy == nil then bouncy = false end

	local function wait_time(pause)

        local coro = coroutine.running()
        Wait.time(function() coroutine.resume(coro) end, pause)
        coroutine.yield()
	end

	local function move_coroutine()
		for _ = 1, repetitions do
			for x = 1, steps do
				local current = from:lerp(to, x/steps)
				if target ~= nil then
					target.setPosition(current)
                    wait_time(time/steps)
				end
			end
			if bouncy then
				for x = (steps - 1), 0, -1 do
					local current = from:lerp(to, x/steps)
					if target ~= nil then
						target.setPosition(current)
                        wait_time(time/steps)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return 1
	end

	local function rotate_coroutine()
		for _ = 1, repetitions do
			for x = 1, steps do
				local current = from:lerp(to, x/steps)
				if target ~= nil then
					target.setRotation(current)
					wait_time(time/steps)
				end
			end
            if bouncy then
                for x = (steps - 1), 0, -1 do
                    local current = from:lerp(to, x/steps)
                    if target ~= nil then
                        target.setRotation(current)
                        wait_time(time/steps)
                    end
                end
            end
		end
		return 1
	end

    if style == "move" then
		move_coroutine()
	elseif style == "rotate" then
		rotate_coroutine()
	end
end



function Common.splitStringByDelim(longString, delim)
	local done = false
	local stringTable = {}

	while not done do
		local delimStart = longString:find(delim)

		if not delimStart then
			if longString ~= "" and longString ~= delim then
				table.insert(stringTable, longString)
			end
			done = true
		else
			local subString = longString:sub(1, delimStart - 1):match("(.+)\n*$")
            -- if subString:sub(-1) == "\n" then
            --     subString = subString:match("(.+)\n")
            -- end
			if subString ~= "" and subString ~= delim then
				table.insert(stringTable, subString)
			end
			longString = longString:sub(delimStart + delim:len())
		end
	end

    return stringTable
end



function Common.firstToUpper(str)
    return (str:gsub("^%l", string.upper))
end



function Common.round(val, prec)
    prec = math.abs(prec)
    return tonumber(string.format("%."..prec.."f", val))
end

-- retrieves an object based on it's given GM Note. In this way, code is not relying on GUID to retrieve objects (GUIDs are volatile).
function Common.getObjectByGMNote(gmNote)
    for _, myObject in ipairs(getObjects()) do      -- looks at all spawned objects in the game...
        if myObject.getGMNotes() == gmNote then     -- and looks for one with the specified GM Note.
            return myObject
        end
    end
end

-- this function receives an array-like table as a parameter, and then randomizes all the entries in the table
function Common.randomizeTable(arrayTable)
    math.random()
    local shuffledTable = {}
    local copyArrayTable = Common.deepCopy(arrayTable)
    for i = #copyArrayTable, 1, -1 do
        local j = math.random(i)
        table.insert(shuffledTable, copyArrayTable[j])
        table.remove(copyArrayTable, j)
    end
    return shuffledTable
end


function Common.removeNilsFromDictionary(dictTable)
    local newDict = {}
    for key, value in pairs(dictTable) do
        if value ~= nil then
            newDict[key] = value
        end
    end
    return newDict
end

-- this function looks for a value (passed as to this function as lookFor) in a table, and returns true if found, and the value's key (will usually be an array index)
function Common.isInTable(lookFor, table, useKey)
    if useKey == nil then useKey = false end
    for key, value in pairs(table) do
        if useKey then
            if lookFor == key then
                return true, value
            end
        else
            if lookFor == value then
                return true, key
            end
        end
    end
    return false, nil
end

-- this function makes a deep copy of a table, using recursion to iterate through every key/value in the table and it's subtables to duplicate everything, instead of returning a reference to the same subTables
function Common.deepCopy(tbl)
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
        if type(v) == "table" then
           copy[k] = Common.deepCopy(v)
       else
           copy[k] = v
       end
    end
    return copy
end

function Common.shallowCopy(tbl)
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(tbl) do
        copy[k] = v
    end
    return copy
end

-- this function takes 2 tables, and merges the data from the 2nd one into the 1st
function Common.merge(t1, t2)
   for k, v in pairs(t2) do
       t1[k] = v
   end
   return t1
end

-- this function receives a function, and a table, and returns the table after performing the transformation specified in the function passed to this function
function Common.map(tabl, mapFunc)
    local mappedTable = {}
    for k, v in pairs(tabl) do
        mappedTable[k] = mapFunc(v)
    end
    return mappedTable
end

-- this function takes an array-like table and switches (inverts) the key and value pairs, so that the text value becomes the key by which you can then find out the index number
function Common.switchKeyVal(switchArray)
    local newArray = {}
    for k, v in pairs(switchArray) do
        newArray[v] = k
    end
    return newArray
end


function Common.reverseTable(table)
    local tempTable = {}

    for index = 1, #table do
        tempTable[index] = table[#table - (index - 1)]
    end

    return tempTable
end


function Common.tablesAreEqual(t1, t2)
    if t1 == t2 then return true end

    local t1_type = type(t1)
    local t2_type = type(t2)

    if t1_type ~= t2_type then return false end
    if t1_type ~= "table" then return false end

    local keySet = {}
    for key1, value1 in pairs(t1) do
        local value2 = t2[key1]
        if value2 == nil or tablesAreEqual(value1, value2) == false then return false end
        keySet[key1] = true
    end

    for key2 in pairs(t2) do
        if not keySet[key2] then return false end
    end

    return true
end

return Common

__bundle_register("Smash Up/CleanUp", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

local CleanUp = {}


-- this function is run at the end of the game to clean up all cards
function CleanUp.cleanUpTable()
    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cleanupInProgress = true                                                                  -- set this variable to true, marking that the clean up process has begun
    CleanUp.cleanUpCardList = {}

    for color in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do                                                 -- for every color of player in the current game,

        local playerMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerMats[color]                                         -- ... obtain reference to the player's card mat
        local drawDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Draw"]                         -- ... obtain reference to the player's draw deck
        local discardDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Discard"]                   -- ... obtain reference to the player's discard pile
        local discardPoint = playerMat.positionToWorld(playerMat.getSnapPoints()[2].position)           -- ... set the position to which all discarded cards need to go

        -- **Put the drawDeck into the discardPile**
        if drawDeck then                                                                                -- ... if there is a drawDeck...
            if discardDeck then                                                                             -- ... and if there is a discard pile...
                discardDeck.putObject(drawDeck)                                                                 -- ... then put the draw deck into the discard pile
            else                                                                                            -- ... but if there is no discard pile...
                local deckRotation = (Common.isInTable(color, {"Green", "Yellow", "Orange"}) and 0) or 180      -- ... set the rotation of the player's discard pile based on what color they are
                SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Discard"] = drawDeck                            -- ... set the discardDeck reference to the current draw deck
                discardDeck = drawDeck                                                                          -- ... set the discardDeck variable equal to the draw deck
                discardDeck.setRotation({0, deckRotation, 0})                                                   -- ... set the rotation of the deck to the proper rotation
                discardDeck.setPosition(discardPoint)                                                           -- ... move the draw deck (now the discard pile) to the discard deck location
            end
            SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Draw"] = nil                                    -- ... break the reference to the draw deck, which doesn't exist anymore
        end

        -- **Sweep up the discard area "sortPiles"**
        CleanUp.cleanUpPlayerSortPiles(color)                                                                 -- ... call this function to sweep up all cards in the player's discarded card sort zone

        -- **Discard all cards held in the hand**
        SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = true
        for _, card in ipairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.HandZones[color].getObjects()) do                     -- ... for every card in the player's hand...
            if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu then                                         -- ... if Madness cards are being used then... (this sets up a process that assigns a tag to each card, and puts the card into a table. then scoring cannot happen if the table still has cards listed, allowing Madness cards to be returned to the deck for counting before calculating score)
                CleanUp.cleanUpCardList[card.getGUID()] = card                                                  -- ... add card to the table for tracking
                card.addTag("cleaningUp")                                                                       -- ... add the CleanUp.cleanupInProgress tag
            end

            discardDeck.putObject(card)
        end
        SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = false
    end

    -- **iterate through all baseBlock areas and discard all cards there**
    for zoneNum = 1, 14 do                                                                              -- ... for every baseZone/baseBlock...
        if SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] == "on" then                              -- ... if the baseBlock is `on`...
            local zone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.cardZones[zoneNum]                                  -- ... get a reference to the cardZone
            local baseCard = getObjectFromGUID(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].baseCardGUID)                 -- ... get a reference to the baseCard

            SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.turnOffBaseBlockZone(zone, baseCard)                                  -- ... call this function to turn off the baseBlockZone
            SmashUp.Bases.returnBaseCard(baseCard, zoneNum)                                                     -- ... then call this function to return the base card and clean up the whole baseBlock
        else                                                                                                -- ... otherwise, if the baseBlock is `off`...
            if zoneNum <= 6 then
                CleanUp.returnPlayersCards(zoneNum)                                                                 -- ... call this function to look for player cards that might be loosely hanging around the base area anyway
            end
        end
    end

    Wait.condition(function()
        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cleanupInProgress = false
    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false and next(CleanUp.cleanUpCardList) == nil)

-- this function is used by the `cleanUpPlayerSortPiles` function to identify the parameters that will be used to find all objects inside a player's sort zone via a cast
local function getCastParameters(deckType)
    local sortZone
    if deckType:find("Base") then
        sortZone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseSortZones[tonumber(deckType:match("Base(%d+)"))]
        deckType = "Base"
    else
        sortZone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerSortZones[deckType]
    end

    local isBackRow = Common.isInTable(deckType, {"Green", "Yellow", "Orange"})
    local castAxis = (deckType == "Base" and "z") or "x"

    local zoneSize = sortZone.getScale()
    if not deckType:find("Base") then
        local playerMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerMats[deckType]
        zoneSize.x = zoneSize.x + math.abs((sortZone.getPosition().x - ((sortZone.getScale().x / 2) * ((isBackRow and -1) or 1) )) - (playerMat.getPosition().x + ((playerMat.getBoundsNormalized().size.x / 2) * ((isBackRow and -1) or 1) ))) + playerMat.getBoundsNormalized().size.x
    end

    local castStart = sortZone.getPosition():setAt(castAxis, sortZone.getPosition()[castAxis] + ((zoneSize[castAxis] / 2) * ((isBackRow and -1) or 1)))
    local castSize = sortZone.getScale():setAt(castAxis, "1")
    local castOrientation = Vector(0, ((deckType == "Base" and 1.5) or 0), 0)

    return {
        type = 3,
        origin = castStart,
        direction = {((deckType == "Base" and 0) or ((isBackRow and 1) or -1)), 0, ((deckType == "Base" and -1) or 0)},
        orientation = castOrientation,
        size = castSize,
        max_distance = zoneSize[castAxis],
        -- debug = true
    }
end

-- this function is used by the `cleanUpPlayerSortPiles` function to filter out objects from the sort zones that won't be returned to the discard pile
local function filterCastFindings(castFindings, deckType)
    for index = #castFindings, 1, -1 do
        local castObj = castFindings[index].hit_object
        if castObj.type ~= "Card" and castObj.type ~="Deck" then
            table.remove(castFindings, index)
        elseif deckType ~= "Base" and (castObj.hasTag("Monster") or castObj.hasTag("Base") or (castObj.hasTag("Madness") and castObj.type == "Deck")) then
            table.remove(castFindings, index)
        elseif deckType == "Base" and (not castObj.hasTag("Base")) then
            table.remove(castFindings, index)
        else
            if castObj.is_face_down then
                castObj.setRotation(castObj.getRotation():setAt("z", 0))
            end
            castObj.setLock(false)
            castObj.interactable = false
        end

        if deckType ~= "Base" and (castObj == SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[deckType:lower().."Discard"] or castObj == SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[deckType:lower().."Draw"]) then
            table.remove(castFindings, index)
        end
    end
    return castFindings

-- this function finds and calculates the destination position to return discarded cards to
local function adjustDiscardSpot(discardSpot, discardPile)
    if discardPile then
        local deckBounds = discardPile.getBoundsNormalized()
        local ySetting = (deckBounds.center.y - deckBounds.offset.y) + (deckBounds.size.y / 2) + 0.3
        discardSpot.y = ySetting
    else
        discardSpot.y = discardSpot.y + 0.3
    end
    return discardSpot
end

-- this function looks for cards that have been placed in the sort zones in front of a player, collects them, and returns them to the discard pile
function CleanUp.cleanUpPlayerSortPiles(color, shuffleDiscard)
    local castFindings = filterCastFindings(Physics.cast(getCastParameters(color)), color)

    local tempDeck
    local playerDiscardPile = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Discard"]
    local playerMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerMats[color]
    local discardSpot = adjustDiscardSpot(playerMat.positionToWorld(playerMat.getSnapPoints()[2].position), playerDiscardPile)

    if playerDiscardPile then
        playerDiscardPile.interactable = false
    end

    local cardTable = {}
    local titanAlreadyFound = false

    for index, casting in ipairs(castFindings) do
        local foundObj = casting.hit_object
        if not foundObj.hasTag("Titan") then
            table.insert(cardTable, foundObj)
            foundObj.addTag("DoNotStack")
            discardSpot.y = discardSpot.y + ((index - 1) * 0.2)
            foundObj.setPositionSmooth(discardSpot, false, false)
        else
            titanAlreadyFound = SmashUp.CleanUp.returnTitanCards(playerMat, foundObj, titanAlreadyFound)
        end
    end

    if next(cardTable) == nil and playerDiscardPile == nil then
        if Player[color].seated then
            printToColor("Sorry! No discard pile found.", color)
        end
    else
        if next(cardTable) == nil then
            if shuffleDiscard then
                shuffleDiscard(playerDiscardPile, playerMat)
            end
        else
            tempDeck = cardTable[1]

            Wait.condition(function()
                if tempDeck == nil then return end
                cardTable[1].removeTag("DoNotStack")
                SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = true
                for cardNum = 2, #cardTable do
                    cardTable[cardNum].removeTag("DoNotStack")
                    tempDeck = tempDeck.putObject(cardTable[cardNum])
                end

                if playerDiscardPile then
                    playerDiscardPile.putObject(tempDeck)
                else
                    playerDiscardPile = tempDeck
                    playerDiscardPile.setPositionSmooth(discardSpot, false, true)
                end

                if (not playerDiscardPile.hasTag("ColorConflict")) and shuffleDiscard then
                    shuffleDiscard(playerDiscardPile, playerMat)
                end
                SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = false
            end, || tempDeck ~= nil and not tempDeck.isSmoothMoving())
        end
    end
end


function CleanUp.cleanUpBaseSortPiles(shuffleBaseDiscard)
    local castFindings = {}
    for z = 1, 2 do
        local perZoneCast = filterCastFindings(Physics.cast(getCastParameters("Base"..z)), "Base")

        for _, castItem in ipairs(perZoneCast) do
            table.insert(castFindings, castItem)
        end

    if SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseDiscard == null then
        SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseDiscard = nil

    local tempDeck
    local baseDiscardPile = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseDiscard
    local baseMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseMat
    local discardSpot = adjustDiscardSpot(baseMat.positionToWorld(baseMat.getSnapPoints()[2].position), baseDiscardPile)

    if baseDiscardPile then
        baseDiscardPile.interactable = false

    local cardTable = {}

    for index, casting in ipairs(castFindings) do
        local foundObj = casting.hit_object
        discardSpot.y = discardSpot.y + ((index - 1) * 0.2)

        table.insert(cardTable, foundObj)

        foundObj.setPositionSmooth(discardSpot, false, true)
    end

    tempDeck = cardTable[1]

    if tempDeck then
        Wait.condition(function()
            if tempDeck == nil then return end

            SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = true
            for cardNum = 2, #cardTable do
                if cardTable[cardNum] and cardTable[cardNum] ~= null then
                    tempDeck = tempDeck.putObject(cardTable[cardNum])
                end
            end

            if baseDiscardPile then
                baseDiscardPile = baseDiscardPile.putObject(tempDeck)
            else
                baseDiscardPile = tempDeck
                baseDiscardPile.setPositionSmooth(discardSpot, false, true)
            end

                shuffleBaseDiscard(baseDiscardPile, baseMat)
            end
            SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = false
        end, || tempDeck ~= nil and not tempDeck.isSmoothMoving())

    elseif baseDiscardPile then

            shuffleBaseDiscard(baseDiscardPile, baseMat)
        end
    end

function CleanUp.returnCustomExtras(extraID, card, playerColor)
    local discardPosition = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.customExtraCleanUp[extraID].discardPosition

    local ySetting = discardPosition.y + 0.1

    -- Check if there's an existing deck at the discard position
    local existingDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Discard"]
