        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cleanupInProgress then
            CleanUp.cleanUpCardList[card.getGUID()] = card
            card.addTag("cleaningUp")
        end

        card.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, false)
        card.setPosition(card.getPosition() + Vector(0, ySetting + 0.2, 0))
        card.setPositionSmooth(discardPosition, false, false)
    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)
end

-- this function returns players' Titan cards to their correct spots after being identified as being played in a baseBlock
function CleanUp.returnTitanCards(playerMat, titanCard, titanAlreadyFound)
    local titanSpot = playerMat.positionToWorld(playerMat.getSnapPoints()[3].position)

    if not titanAlreadyFound then
        titanAlreadyFound = true
        local boxCast = Physics.cast({
            type = 3,
            origin = titanSpot,
            direction = {0, -1, 0},
            size = {1, 1, 1},
            max_distance = 0,
        })

        for _, foundObj in ipairs(boxCast) do
            if (foundObj.hit_object.type == "Card" and foundObj.hit_object.hasTag("Titan")) then
                if foundObj.hit_object == titanCard then return end
                titanSpot = playerMat.positionToWorld(playerMat.getSnapPoints()[4].position)
                break
            end
        end
    else
        titanSpot = playerMat.positionToWorld(playerMat.getSnapPoints()[4].position)
    end

    local yAdjust = titanSpot.y + 0.1
    titanSpot.y = yAdjust

    Wait.condition(function()                                                                           -- ... setup wait condition: waiting for SystemGates.cardMovementLocked to be OFF/false. Once condition is met...
        if titanCard == nil then return end
        titanCard.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 180}, false, false)                                                   -- ... then rotate the titanCard to be same orientation as the returnDeck
        titanCard.setPosition(titanCard.getPosition() + Vector(0, yAdjust + 0.2, 0))                                  -- ... pop the baseCard up a bit higher than its returnPosition, so that the titanCard will land on the top of the returnDeck
        titanCard.setPositionSmooth(titanSpot, false, false)                                              -- ... finally, move the card to the returnDeck
    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)

    return titanAlreadyFound
end


function CleanUp.findTreasuresInDiscardDecks(deck, deckType)
    local waitFunc
    waitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
        if Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
            local cardTable = deck.getObjects()
            for index = #deck.getObjects(), 1, -1 do
                local card = cardTable[index]

                if Common.isInTable("Treasure", card.tags) then
                    local strayTreasure
                    if deck.type == "Deck" then
                        strayTreasure = deck.takeObject({
                            position = deck.getPosition() + Vector(0, 1, 0),
                            rotation = deck.getRotation() * Vector(1, 1, 0),
                            index = index - 1
                        })
                    elseif deck.type == "Card" then
                        deck.setPosition(deck.getPosition() + Vector(0, 1, 0))
                        deck.setRotation(deck.getRotation() * Vector(1, 1, 0))
                        strayTreasure = deck
                    end

                    if deck.remainder then deck = deck.remainder end

                    strayTreasure.interactable = false

                    CleanUp.returnTreasureCards(strayTreasure)
                end
            end
        end
    end, function()
        if deck.held_by_color then
            if waitFunc then Wait.stop(waitFunc) end
        end
        return deck.isDestroyed() or (deck.resting and (not deck.held_by_color))
    end)
end


function CleanUp.returnTreasureCards(card)
    local treasureMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.munchkinMat
    local treasureDiscardLoc = treasureMat.positionToWorld(treasureMat.getSnapPoints()[4].position)

    local treasureDiscardDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.treasureDiscard
    if treasureDiscardDeck == null then treasureDiscardDeck = nil end

    local yAdjust = treasureDiscardLoc.y + 0.1

    if treasureDiscardDeck then
        local deckBounds = treasureDiscardDeck.getBoundsNormalized()
        yAdjust = (deckBounds.center.y + deckBounds.offset.y) + (deckBounds.size.y / 2) + 0.1
    end
    treasureDiscardLoc.y = yAdjust

    Wait.condition(function()
        if card == nil then return end
        card.interactable = false
        card.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, false)
        card.setPosition(card.getPosition() + Vector(0, yAdjust + 0.2, 0))
        card.setPositionSmooth(treasureDiscardLoc, false, false)
    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)
end


function CleanUp.findCustomExtrasInDiscardDecks(deck, deckType)
    local waitFunc
    waitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
        if Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
            local cardTable = deck.getObjects()
            for index = #deck.getObjects(), 1, -1 do
                local card = cardTable[index]

                local extraID = SmashUp.CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(card)
                if extraID and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.customExtraCleanUp[extraID].discardMode == "singleUse" then
                    local strayCustomExtra
                    if deck.type == "Deck" then
                        strayCustomExtra = deck.takeObject({
                            position = deck.getPosition() + Vector(0, 1, 0),
                            rotation = deck.getRotation() * Vector(1, 1, 0),
                            index = index - 1
                        })
                    elseif deck.type == "Card" then
                        deck.setPosition(deck.getPosition() + Vector(0, 1, 0))
                        deck.setRotation(deck.getRotation() * Vector(1, 1, 0))
                        strayCustomExtra = deck
                    end

                    if deck.remainder then deck = deck.remainder end

                    strayCustomExtra.interactable = false

                    CleanUp.returnCustomExtras(extraID, strayCustomExtra, deckType)
                end
            end
        end
    end, function()
        if deck.held_by_color then
            if waitFunc then Wait.stop(waitFunc) end
        end
        return deck.isDestroyed() or (deck.resting and (not deck.held_by_color))
    end)
end


function CleanUp.foreignCardCheck(deck, deckType)
    if deck.type == "Deck" then
        for colorCat, cardTable in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[deck.getGUID()]) do
            if colorCat ~= deckType and Common.isInTable(colorCat, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                local cardCount = 0
                for cardGUID, value in pairs(cardTable) do
                    if value ~= deckType then
                        cardTable[cardGUID] = deckType
                        cardCount = cardCount + 1
                    end
                end

                if Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                    if cardCount == 1 then
                        broadcastToAll("A card that is owned by ["..SmashUp.ColorTable[colorCat].hex.."]"..colorCat.." [FFFFFF]was placed into ["..SmashUp.ColorTable[deckType].hex.."]"..deckType.."'s [FFFFFF]discard pile.")

                    elseif cardCount > 1 then
                        broadcastToAll(tostring(cardCount).." cards that are owned by ["..SmashUp.ColorTable[colorCat].hex.."]"..colorCat.." [FFFFFF]were placed into ["..SmashUp.ColorTable[deckType].hex.."]"..deckType.."'s [FFFFFF]discard pile.")
                    end
                end
            end
        end

    elseif deck.type == "Card" then
        local ownerColor = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner.singleCards[deck.getGUID()].owner
        local triggeredColor = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner.singleCards[deck.getGUID()].triggeredColor
        if deckType ~= triggeredColor then
            broadcastToAll("A card that is owned by ["..SmashUp.ColorTable[ownerColor].hex.."]"..ownerColor.." [FFFFFF]was placed into ["..SmashUp.ColorTable[deckType].hex.."]"..deckType.."'s [FFFFFF]discard pile.")
            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner.singleCards[deck.getGUID()].triggeredColor = deckType
        end
    end
end

-- this function returns all played cards found in a baseBlockZone to their owners' discard piles
function CleanUp.returnPlayersCards(baseNum)
    local zone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.cardZones[baseNum]

    local titanAlreadyFound = false
    local colorCardCount = {}

    if zone then
        for _, card in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
            if card.type == "Card" and not card.hasTag("Base") and not card.hasTag("Monster") then

                local color = (card.hasTag("Red") and "Red") or ((card.hasTag("Purple") and "Purple") or ((card.hasTag("Blue") and "Blue") or ((card.hasTag("Orange") and "Orange") or ((card.hasTag("Yellow") and "Yellow") or ((card.hasTag("Green") and "Green") or ((card.hasTag("Madness") and "Madness")))))))
                local tableCat = color == "Madness" and "Extra" or "Player"
                local playerMat = SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat.."Mats"][color == "Madness" and "madnessMat" or color]

                if card.hasTag("Titan") then
                    titanAlreadyFound = CleanUp.returnTitanCards(playerMat, card, titanAlreadyFound)

                elseif card.hasTag("Treasure") then
                    CleanUp.returnTreasureCards(card)

                elseif card.hasTag("Custom") and card.hasTag("Extra") then
                      local extraID = SmashUp.CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(card)
                      if extraID and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.customExtraCleanUp[extraID].discardMode == "singleUse" then
                          CleanUp.returnCustomExtras(extraID, card, color)
                      end

                else
                    colorCardCount[color] = colorCardCount[color] or 0
                    local playerDiscardLoc = playerMat.positionToWorld(playerMat.getSnapPoints()[color == "Madness" and 1 or 2].position)
                    local isBackRow = Common.isInTable(color, {"Green", "Yellow", "Orange"})


                    local returnDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat.."Decks"][color:lower()..(color == "Madness" and "Draw" or "Discard")]

                    if returnDeck == null then returnDeck = nil end                                                     -- ... if the returnDeck should ever be `null` then set the reference to `nil` instead

                    local yAdjust = playerDiscardLoc.y + 0.1                                                            -- ... initialize this variable that will be used to adjust the y-component of the return position of the baseCard
                    if returnDeck then                                                                                  -- ... if there is a returnDeck referenced...
                        local deckBounds = returnDeck.getBoundsNormalized()                                                 -- ... identify the size of the returnDeck
                        yAdjust = (deckBounds.center.y + deckBounds.offset.y) + (deckBounds.size.y / 2) + 0.1               -- ... adjust the y-component of the returnPosition to be 0.1 higher than the top of the returnDeck
                        playerDiscardLoc.y = yAdjust
                    end

                    playerDiscardLoc.y = playerDiscardLoc.y + (colorCardCount[color] * 0.2)
                    Wait.condition(function()                                                                           -- ... setup wait condition: waiting for SystemGates.cardMovementLocked to be OFF/false. Once condition is met...
                        if card == nil then return end
                        card.interactable = false

                        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cleanupInProgress then
                            CleanUp.cleanUpCardList[card.getGUID()] = card
                            card.addTag("cleaningUp")
                        end

                        card.setRotationSmooth({0, (isBackRow and 0) or 180, 0}, false, false)                              -- ... then rotate the card to be same orientation as the returnDeck
                        card.setPosition(card.getPosition() + Vector(0, yAdjust + 0.2, 0))                                  -- ... pop the baseCard up a bit higher than its returnPosition, so that the card will land on the top of the returnDeck
                        card.setPositionSmooth(playerDiscardLoc, false, false)                                              -- ... finally, move the card to the returnDeck

                    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)

                    colorCardCount[color] = colorCardCount[color] + 1
                end

            elseif card.type == "Tile" and card.hasTag("Token") then
                card.setPosition(card.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2.5, 0))
                Wait.frames(function()
                    destroyObject(card)
                end, 2)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- this function is run when a baseZone is deactivated to clear away all other cards there
function CleanUp.cleanUpBaseZone(card, baseNum, monstersPlayed)
    if not SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum]["beingReplaced"] then                                             -- if the baseCard was previously at a baseBlockZone (baseNum ~= 0), and as long as the baseCard is NOT going to the returnDeck just to be replaced by another baseCard...
        if monstersPlayed then                                                                                  -- ... if this base card triggered playing of monster cards (has the "MonstersPlayed" tag)...
            SmashUp.Monsters.clearMonsters(baseNum)                                                                 -- ... then run this function to discard those monster cards
        end
        card.removeTag("MonstersPlayed")                                                                        -- ... and of course, remove the `MonstersPlayed` tag from the baseCard

        for color in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do                                                     -- ... for every color being played in this game...
            if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum == baseNum then                              -- ... if this colored player has the base settings panel open for this base...
                UI.setAttribute("BaseSettings_"..color, "active", "false")                                              -- ... then deactivate the base settings panel (the base is now gone and deactivated)
                SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].status = false                                                -- ... mark the status variable for this player's base settings panel as off now
            end
        end

        CleanUp.returnPlayersCards(baseNum)                                                                     -- ... run this function to clear away all player's played cards

        if baseNum >=7 then                                                                                     -- ... if the baseCard was on an extraBaseDock...
            SmashUp.Bases.ExtraBaseDocks.hidePhantomZone(baseNum)                                                                  -- ... run this function to hide the extraBaseDock
        end
    end
end

-- this function is run when the game is first loaded to pass libraries and tables into this file for use by its functions
function CleanUp.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib
end

return CleanUp

end)

function TrackCardDecks.breakDeckReference(card)
    local hasDeckName = card.type == "Deck" and card.getName() ~= ""

    local deckType, zoneType, tableCat
    if hasDeckName then
        deckType, zoneType, tableCat = TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromDeckName(card)
    else
        deckType, zoneType, tableCat = TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromExistingReference(card)
    end

    if deckType then
        if tableCat == "CustomObjects" then
            -- Handle custom extras
            local extraID = deckType:match("CustomExtra_(.*)")
            if extraID then
                -- Check in General custom objects first
                if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General then
                    if card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Draw"] then
                        SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Draw"] = nil
                        card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
                    elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Discard"] then
                        SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Discard"] = nil
                        card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
                    elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Card"] then
                        SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Card"] = nil
                        card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
                    end
                end

                -- Check player-specific custom objects
                for _, color in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
                    if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color] then
                        if card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color][extraID.."Draw"] then
                            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color][extraID.."Draw"] = nil
                            card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
                        elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color][extraID.."Discard"] then
                            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color][extraID.."Discard"] = nil
                            card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
                        elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color][extraID.."Card"] then
                            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color][extraID.."Card"] = nil
                            card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            -- Handle regular decks
            if card == SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower().."Draw"] then                                            -- ... if the picked up card is equal to the `baseDeck`, this means that the `baseDeck` is down to one card (which is now picked up). at this point in the code, a base draw deck no longer exists, so set this reference variable to nil.
                SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower().."Draw"] = nil
                card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
            end
            if card == SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower().."Discard"] then
                SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower().."Discard"] = nil
                card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
            end
        end

        if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner["singleCards"][card.getGUID()] then
            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner["singleCards"][card.getGUID()] = nil
        end

        if card.hasTag("deckRemainder") then
            card.removeTag("deckRemainder")
            for _, plyrColor in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
                if card == SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[plyrColor:lower().."Draw"] then
                    SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[plyrColor:lower().."Draw"] = nil
                end
                if card == SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[plyrColor:lower().."Discard"] then
                    SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[plyrColor:lower().."Discard"] = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function TrackCardDecks.getTagType(deck)
    local tagType
    if deck.hasTag("Base") then tagType = "Base" end
    if deck.hasTag("Monster") and not deck.hasTag("Base") then tagType = "Monster" end
    if deck.hasTag("Treasure") then tagType = "Treasure" end
    if deck.hasTag("Madness") then tagType = "Madness" end
    if tagType ~= "Base" and tagType ~= "Monster" and tagType ~= "Treasure" then
        for _, color in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
            if deck.hasTag(color) then
                tagType = color
            end
        end
    end

    -- Check for custom extras
    if deck.hasTag("Custom") and deck.hasTag("Extra") then
        local extraID = SmashUp.CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(deck)
        if extraID then
            tagType = "CustomExtra_"..extraID
        end
    end

    return tagType
end



function TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromZone(zone, deck)
    -- deckType is the type of cards (in the game) such as Base, Madness, Monster, etc. Obtained from name of zone OR tags if zone not triggered.
    -- zoneType is determined by the name/type of the zone, ie: draw or discard. Obtained from the name of the zone OR extrapolated from pileType if zone not triggered.
    -- tableCat is the table key used to locate an object in the `GameObjects` table. Determined by the deckType.
    -- pileType is the name of the deck in the game, ie: "Deck" or "Discard Pile". Determined by whether or not the deck/card is face up or down. zoneType is used, in most cases, instead of pileType.
    -- isPlayerDeck is true when the deck being dealt with is a player's deck of cards
    -- isMunchkin is true when the deck being dealt with is a monster or treasure deck

    local deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType
    local isPlayerDeck = false
    local isMunchkin = false


    deckType, zoneType = zone.getGMNotes():match("^(.-) (.-)$")
    pileType = (zoneType == "Draw" and "Deck") or "Discard Pile"
    if Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
        isPlayerDeck = true
    elseif deckType == "Monster" or deckType == "Treasure" then
        isMunchkin = true
    end

    if deckType and deckType:find("CustomExtra_") then
        tableCat = "CustomObjects"
    else
        tableCat = (deckType == "Base" and "BaseObjects") or (isPlayerDeck and "PlayerDecks") or ("ExtraDecks")
    end

    return deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin
end



function TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromDeckName(deck)
    -- deckType is the type of cards (in the game) such as Base, Madness, Monster, etc. Obtained from name of zone OR tags if zone not triggered.
    -- zoneType is determined by the name/type of the zone, ie: draw or discard. Obtained from the name of the zone OR extrapolated from pileType if zone not triggered.
    -- tableCat is the table key used to locate an object in the `GameObjects` table. Determined by the deckType.
    -- pileType is the name of the deck in the game, ie: "Deck" or "Discard Pile". Determined by whether or not the deck/card is face up or down. zoneType is used, in most cases, instead of pileType.
    -- isPlayerDeck is true when the deck being dealt with is a player's deck of cards
    -- isMunchkin is true when the deck being dealt with is a monster or treasure deck
    if SmashUp.Database.factionTable[deck.getName():gsub(" Bases", "")] then
        return "originalFactionDeck"
    end

    local deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType = nil
    local isPlayerDeck = false
    local isMunchkin = false

    if deck.type == "Deck" then
        local deckName = deck.getName()

        deckType, pileType = deckName:match("^(.-) (.*)$")

        if Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
            isPlayerDeck = true
        elseif deckType == "Monster" or deckType == "Treasure" then
            isMunchkin = true
        end

        zoneType = (pileType == "Deck" and "Draw") or "Discard"

        if deckType and deckType:find("CustomExtra_") then
            tableCat = "CustomObjects"
        else
            tableCat = (deckType == "Base" and "BaseObjects") or (isPlayerDeck and "PlayerDecks") or ("ExtraDecks")
        end
    end

    return deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin
end



function TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromExistingReference(card)
    -- deckType is the type of cards (in the game) such as Base, Madness, Monster, etc. Obtained from name of zone OR tags if zone not triggered.
    -- zoneType is determined by the name/type of the zone, ie: draw or discard. Obtained from the name of the zone OR extrapolated from pileType if zone not triggered.
    -- tableCat is the table key used to locate an object in the `GameObjects` table. Determined by the deckType.
    -- pileType is the name of the deck in the game, ie: "Deck" or "Discard Pile". Determined by whether or not the deck/card is face up or down. zoneType is used, in most cases, instead of pileType.
    -- isPlayerDeck is true when the deck being dealt with is a player's deck of cards
    -- isMunchkin is true when the deck being dealt with is a monster or treasure deck

    local deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType
    local isPlayerDeck = false
    local isMunchkin = false

    deckType = TrackCardDecks.getTagType(card)

    if deckType then
        local function loopOverColors(card)
            local deck_type = nil
            local zone_type = nil

            for _, color in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
                if card == SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Draw"] then
                    deck_type = color
                    zone_type = "Draw"
                    tableCat = "PlayerDecks"
                    isPlayerDeck = true
                elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Discard"] then
                    deck_type = color
                    zone_type = "Discard"
                    tableCat = "PlayerDecks"
                    isPlayerDeck = true
                end
            end
            return deck_type, zone_type
        end

        if Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) or card.hasTag("ColorConflict") then
            isPlayerDeck = true
        elseif deckType == "Monster" or deckType == "Treasure" then
            isMunchkin = true
        end

        if deckType and deckType:find("CustomExtra_") then
            tableCat = "CustomObjects"
        else
            tableCat = (deckType == "Base" and "BaseObjects") or (isPlayerDeck and "PlayerDecks") or ("ExtraDecks")
        end

        if card.hasTag("ColorConflict") then
            deckType, zoneType = loopOverColors(card)
        else
            if tableCat == "CustomObjects" then
                local extraID = deckType:match("CustomExtra_(.*)")
                if extraID then
                    -- Check in General custom objects first
                    if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General then
                        if card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Draw"] then
                            zoneType = "Draw"
                        elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Discard"] then
                            zoneType = "Discard"
                        elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects.General[extraID.."Card"] then
                            zoneType = "Card"
                        end
                    end

                    -- Check player-specific custom objects
                    for _, color in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
                        if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color] then
                            if card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color][extraID.."Draw"] then
                                zoneType = "Draw"
                            elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color][extraID.."Discard"] then
                                zoneType = "Discard"
                            elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[color][extraID.."Card"] then
                                zoneType = "Card"
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

            else
                if card == SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower().."Draw"] then
                    zoneType = "Draw"
                elseif card == SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][deckType:lower().."Discard"] then
                    zoneType = "Discard"
                end
                if zoneType == nil then
                    deckType, zoneType = loopOverColors(card)
                end
            end
        end

        if zoneType == nil then deckType = nil tableCat = nil end

        pileType = (zoneType == "Draw" and "Deck") or (zoneType == "Discard" and "Discard Pile") or nil
    end

    return deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin
end



function TrackCardDecks.setDeckObject(obj, deckType, zoneType, cardCat)
    local oppositeType = (zoneType == "Draw" and "Discard") or "Draw"

    -- Create the key for custom extras by removing "customextra_" prefix
    local storageKey = (deckType:lower()..zoneType):gsub("customextra_", "")
    local oppositeStorageKey = (deckType:lower()..oppositeType):gsub("customextra_", "")

    if not SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][storageKey] then
        local oldDeckType, oldZoneType, oldCardCat = nil
        if obj.type == "Deck" then
            oldDeckType, oldZoneType, oldCardCat = TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromDeckName(obj)
            obj.setName(Common.firstToUpper(deckType).." "..((zoneType == "Draw" and "Deck") or "Discard Pile"))
            obj.setGMNotes(obj.getName())

            obj.addTag(deckType)
            obj.addTag("Deck")

        elseif obj.type == "Card" then
            obj.removeTag("InPlay")                                                                    -- ... the obj is no longer in play; remove the `InPlay` tag
            obj.addTag("deckRemainder")
            oldDeckType, oldZoneType, oldCardCat = TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromExistingReference(obj)
        end

        if oldDeckType then
            local oldStorageKey = (oldDeckType:lower()..oldZoneType):gsub("customextra_", "")
            SmashUp.GameObjects[oldCardCat][oldStorageKey] = nil
        end

        if SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][storageKey] == null then
            SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][storageKey] = nil
        end

        SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][storageKey] = obj                                                                          -- ... store a reference to this deck in the GameObjects table

        if SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][storageKey] == SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][oppositeStorageKey] then        -- ... if the draw deck and the discard pile variables reference the same object...
            SmashUp.GameObjects[cardCat][oppositeStorageKey] = nil                                                                      -- ... then remove the duplicate reference from the oppositePile (set it to nil)
        end
    end

    obj.interactable = true
    obj.setLock(false)

    return oldDeckType, deckType, zoneType, cardCat
end



function TrackCardDecks.zoneTriggerDeckAssign(zone, obj, firstCheck, calledFrom)
    if firstCheck == nil then firstCheck = true end

    if SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[obj.getGUID()] then
        Wait.stop(SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[obj.getGUID()])
        SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[obj.getGUID()] = nil
    end

    local waitFunc
    waitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
        if zone == nil or obj == nil then return end

        local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, obj)

        if isInBounds then
            local deckType, zoneType, cardCat, pileType = TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromZone(zone, obj)
            local isPlayerDeck = Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors())
            local isForeignColor = isPlayerDeck and (not obj.hasTag(deckType)) and (not obj.hasTag("Madness"))
            local enteringTagType
            if isForeignColor then
                enteringTagType = TrackCardDecks.getTagType(obj)
            end

            local oldDeckType = TrackCardDecks.setDeckObject(obj, deckType, zoneType, cardCat)

            if obj.type == "Deck" then
                if obj.hasTag("ColorConflict") then
                    if SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()] and SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()][deckType] then
                        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()][deckType] = nil
                    end

                    for _, cardInfo in ipairs(obj.getObjects()) do                                                                        -- for each card in the deck (which has now had new cards entered into it)...
                        local color = nil
                        local isMadness = false
                        for _, tag in ipairs(cardInfo.tags) do                                                                                  -- ... for each tag on this individual card...
                            if Common.isInTable(tag, Player.getAvailableColors()) then                                                              -- ... if the tag is a color tag...
                                color = tag                                                                                                             -- ... then store this tag in the color variable
                            elseif tag == "Madness" then
                                isMadness = true
                            end
                        end
                        if color and color ~= deckType and not isMadness then                                                                                       -- ... as long as the color of this specific card is different than the containerDeckType then, add this card into the CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner table
                            obj.addTag(color)
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()][color] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()][color] or {}
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()][color][cardInfo.guid] = false
                        end
                    end

                    if pileType == "Discard Pile" then
                        SmashUp.CleanUp.foreignCardCheck(obj, deckType)
                    end

                elseif isForeignColor and enteringTagType then
                    obj.addTag("ColorConflict")
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()] or {}
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()][enteringTagType] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()][enteringTagType] or {}

                    for _, cardInfo in ipairs(obj.getObjects()) do
                        if Common.isInTable(enteringTagType, cardInfo.tags) and (not Common.isInTable("Madness", cardInfo.tags)) then
                            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[obj.getGUID()][enteringTagType][cardInfo.guid] = false
                        end
                    end
                end

            elseif obj.type == "Card" then
                if isForeignColor and enteringTagType then
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner["singleCards"][obj.getGUID()] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner["singleCards"][obj.getGUID()] or {}
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner["singleCards"][obj.getGUID()].owner = enteringTagType
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner["singleCards"][obj.getGUID()].triggeredColor = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner["singleCards"][obj.getGUID()].triggeredColor or ""
                    SmashUp.CleanUp.foreignCardCheck(obj, deckType)
                end
            end

            if obj.hasTag("Madness") or obj.hasTag("hasMadness") then
                -- **Add the color owner to the madness card (or remove it if going back into madness draw pile)
                if obj.type == "Card" then
                    if deckType == "Madness" then
                        SmashUp.Madness.resetTags(obj)
                    elseif isPlayerDeck then
                        SmashUp.Madness.setColorOwnership(zone, obj)
                    end

                elseif obj.type == "Deck" then
                    if isPlayerDeck then
                        if deckType ~= oldDeckType then
                            SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(obj.getGUID(), nil, deckType)
                        end
                    elseif deckType == "Madness" then
                        TrackCardDecks.breakDeckReference(obj)
                        SmashUp.Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(obj.getGUID(), nil, nil)
                    end
                end
            end

        else
            if firstCheck then
                local stillInZone = false                                           -- ... need to check that the zone wasn't simply triggered because the card was moving through it; check to see if the card is still in the zone when it comes to a rest.
                for _, occZone in ipairs(obj.getZones()) do
                    if occZone == zone then
                        stillInZone = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if stillInZone then
                    obj.addTag("Repositioning")
                    Wait.condition(function()
                        if obj == nil then return end
                        TrackCardDecks.zoneTriggerDeckAssign(zone, obj, false)
                        return
                    end, || not obj.isDestroyed() and not obj.resting, 1.5)

                    TrackCardDecks.repositionDroppedDecks(zone, obj)
                end
            end
        end

    end, function()
        if obj.held_by_color then
            if waitFunc then Wait.stop(waitFunc) end
        end
        return obj.isDestroyed() or (obj.resting and (not obj.held_by_color))
    end)

    SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[obj.getGUID()] = waitFunc
end



function TrackCardDecks.repositionDroppedDecks(zone, deck)
    local reposWaitFunc
    reposWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()                                                                               -- make sure to wait until the base card is resting at the baseBlock (start wait condition here)...
        Wait.frames(function()
            if deck == nil then return end

            if deck.hasTag("Custom") and deck.hasTag("Extra") then return end

            if deck.hasTag("Repositioning") then
                deck.removeTag("Repositioning")
                return
            end

            local deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin

            if zone then
                deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin = TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromZone(zone, deck)
            elseif deck.type == "Deck" and deck.getName() ~= "" then
                deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin = TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromDeckName(deck)
            elseif deck.type == "Card" then
                deckType, zoneType, tableCat, pileType, isPlayerDeck, isMunchkin = TrackCardDecks.getDeckTypeFromExistingReference(deck)
            end

            if deckType == "originalFactionDeck" then return end

            if deckType then
                local mat = SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat:gsub("Deck", "Mat")][(isPlayerDeck and deckType) or (((isMunchkin and "munchkin") or deckType:lower()).."Mat")]

                if pileType then
                    -- **If the deck is in a sorting zone, don't move it (unless it's a player's deck in another player's sorting zone)**
                    if deck.hasTag("Sorting") then
                        if deckType == "Base" then
                            return
                        elseif Common.isInTable(deckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                            for _, zone in ipairs(deck.getZones()) do
                                if zone.getName():find(deckType) then
                                    return
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    local targetZone = zone or ((isPlayerDeck and SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[deckType][zoneType:lower()]) or
                        (deckType:find("CustomExtra_") and SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customExtraZones[deckType:match("CustomExtra_(.*)")][zoneType:lower()]) or
                        (SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones[deckType:lower()..zoneType]))

                    local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(targetZone, deck)

                    local returnIndex = (pileType == "Deck" and 1) or 2
                    if deckType == "Treasure" then returnIndex = returnIndex + 2 end

                    local returnPosition = mat.positionToWorld(mat.getSnapPoints()[returnIndex].position)

                    local storageKey = (deckType:lower()..zoneType):gsub("customextra_", "")

                    if SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][storageKey] == null then
                        SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][storageKey] = nil
                    end

                    local returnDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][storageKey]

                    local returnDeckSize
                    local yAdjust = 0.25

                    if returnDeck then
                        returnDeckSize = returnDeck.getBoundsNormalized()
                        yAdjust = yAdjust + returnDeckSize.size.y
                    end

                    local deckSize = deck.getBoundsNormalized()
                    yAdjust = yAdjust + deckSize.size.y


                    Wait.condition(function()
                        if deck == nil then return end
                        if not isInBounds then
                            Wait.condition(function()
                                if deck == nil then return end
                                deck.interactable = false

                                deck.setPosition(deck.getPosition() + Vector(0, yAdjust + 0.2, 0))                                                                                                          -- ... set the deck immediately to a higher position
                                deck.setPositionSmooth(returnPosition + Vector(0, yAdjust, 0), false, false)                                                                                                                        -- ... move the deck to the appropriate position; this in turn will trigger the onObjectEnterZone code
                                deck.setRotation({0, (deckType == "Monster" and 90) or 180, ((pileType == "Deck" and not (deckType == "Madness")) and 180) or 0})
                            end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)
                        end
                    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)
                end
            end
        end, 1)
    end, function()                                                             -- ... trigger the wait.condition once the deck is at rest, or the deck is destroyed. This will timeout after 4 seconds.
            if deck.held_by_color then
                if reposWaitFunc then Wait.stop(reposWaitFunc) end
            end
            return deck.isDestroyed() or deck.resting
        end, 4)
end




function TrackCardDecks.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib                                                                                       -- give access to the SmashUp library to this file
end

return TrackCardDecks

end)
__bundle_register("Smash Up/BaseSettings", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local SmashUp

local BaseSettings = {}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SCORING A BASE PHASES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function is called `when a base scores` to give VP out to the players
local function giveVP(baseNum)
    UI.setAttribute("scoreBoard", "active", "false")
    SmashUp.GameObjects.soundCube.AssetBundle.playTriggerEffect(0)
    for place = 1, 3 do
        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[place] then
            local color = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[place].color
            local points = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[place].vp
            SmashUp.PlayerScores.addToScore(color, points, SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerScoreTiles[color])

            printToAll("["..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."]"..SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[place].steamName.." [FFFFFF]was awarded ["..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."]"..points.." [FFFFFF]victory points.")
        end
    end

    for plyrColor, vp in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints) do
        if vp >= 15 then
            SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameCompletionStatus = "Win Conditions Met"
            break
        else
            SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameCompletionStatus = "In Progress"
        end
    end

    SmashUp.GameStats.collectResults(SmashUp.GameData)
end


-- this function is called to decide which players come in first, second, and third in order to award them the appropriate VPs
local function calculateAndDisplayVP(baseNum)
    local baseCard = getObjectFromGUID(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseCardGUID)
    local scoreTable = JSON.decode(baseCard.memo)                                                        -- find the scoring/vp info stored on the base card, convert string to table

    local vpTable = {}                                                                                                              -- set this local table that will store the VPs for each rank/place

    for place, vp in pairs(scoreTable) do                                                                                           -- for each entry in the scoreTable (obtained from the base card)...
        if place == "first" then                                                                                                    -- ... if the key is "first"...
            table.insert(vpTable, 1, vp)                                                                                                -- ... then insert the vp into the 1st row of vpTable
        elseif place == "second" then                                                                                               -- ... if the key is "second"...
            table.insert(vpTable, 2, vp)                                                                                                -- ... then insert the vp into the 2nd row of vpTable
        elseif place == "third" then                                                                                                -- ... if the key is "third"...
            table.insert(vpTable, 3, vp)                                                                                                -- ... then insert the vp into the 3rd row of vpTable
        end
    end

    for rank = 1, 3 do                                                                                                              -- for each possible final rank/place (1st to 3rd)...
        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank] then                                                                          -- ... if there is a player that achieved this rank...
            if rank > 1 and SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank].power == SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank - 1].power then   -- ... and if the rank is 2nd or 3rd and the power contributed by this player is equal to the amount of power contributed by the previously ranked player...
                SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank].vp = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank - 1].vp                               -- ... then this player receives the same amount of VP as the previously ranked player
                SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank].rank = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank - 1].rank
            else                                                                                                                            -- ... if the rank is 1st or the power contributed by this ranked player is NOT equal to the power of the previously ranked player...
                SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank].vp = tonumber(vpTable[rank])                                                         -- ... then this player receives VP equal to the appropriate rank points from the base card
                SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank].rank = rank
            end
            UI.setAttribute("score"..rank.."PlaceVP", "text", SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank].vp.."vp:")
            UI.setAttribute("score"..rank.."PlaceVP", "color", SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank].color)
            UI.setAttribute("score"..rank.."PlaceName", "text", SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank].steamName)
            UI.setAttribute("score"..rank.."PlaceName", "color", SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo[rank].color)
        else
            UI.setAttribute("score"..rank.."PlaceVP", "text", "")
            UI.setAttribute("score"..rank.."PlaceVP", "color", "Black")
            UI.setAttribute("score"..rank.."PlaceName", "text", "")
            UI.setAttribute("score"..rank.."PlaceName", "color", "Black")
        end
    end
end



local function activateScoreControlButtons(color)
    UI.setAttribute("scorePass_"..color, "interactable", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("scorePass_"..color, "textColor", "white")
    UI.setAttribute("scoreUseSpecial_"..color, "interactable", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("scoreUseSpecial_"..color, "textColor", color)
end



local function deactivateScoreControlButtons(color)
    UI.setAttribute("scorePass_"..color, "interactable", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("scorePass_"..color, "textColor", "gray")
    UI.setAttribute("scoreUseSpecial_"..color, "interactable", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("scoreUseSpecial_"..color, "textColor", "gray")
end



local function turnOnScoringProgressBar()
    local baseNum = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum
    local scoringProgress = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseScoringProgress

    UI.setAttribute("BaseSettings_ProgressBar", "active", "true")

    if scoringProgress == 1 then
        calculateAndDisplayVP(baseNum)
        UI.setAttribute("scoreBoard", "active", "true")
    end

    UI.setAttribute("BaseScoreProgressTitle", "text", "Scoring:  "..SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseName)
    UI.setAttribute("BaseScoreHighlightFade"..scoringProgress, "active", "true")

    for plyrColor in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[plyrColor].activeBaseNum == baseNum then
            UI.setAttribute("MainButtonPanel_"..plyrColor, "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("BaseScoringPhasesParent_"..plyrColor, "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("BaseScoringPhase"..scoringProgress.."_"..plyrColor, "active", "true")
        end
    end

    activateScoreControlButtons(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner)
    SmashUp.TurnsSystem.scoringBaseTurnsOn(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner)

    printToAll("")
    printToAll(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum].baseName.." base is being scored.", {0, 1, 1})
    printToAll("●● Phase 1: Before a Base Scores.", {249/255, 220/255, 60/255})
end


-- this function is run when a player clicks "Yes" to initiate scoring of the base
local function initiateScoringPhase(baseNum, color)
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringActive = true
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.passCount = 0
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringPhaseTurns = 0
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum = baseNum

    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].nowScoring = true
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseScoringProgress = 1

    local baseCard = getObjectFromGUID(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseCardGUID)
    baseCard.setLock(true)

    turnOnScoringProgressBar()
end



function BaseSettings.reloadBaseScoring()
    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringActive then
        local baseNum = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum

        local baseCard = getObjectFromGUID(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseCardGUID)
        baseCard.setLock(true)

        local scoringPhase = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseScoringProgress

        turnOnScoringProgressBar()

        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringPhaseTurns > 0 then
            local turnNum = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner]
            deactivateScoreControlButtons(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner)
            UI.setClass("TurnRowSpecial"..(turnNum), "BaseTurnTabFalse")

            for turnSkip = 1, SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringPhaseTurns do
                turnNum = turnNum + 1
                if turnNum > SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount then
                    turnNum = 1
                end
            end

            SmashUp.TurnsSystem.setNextScoreTurn(turnNum)

            local nextColor = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].color
            activateScoreControlButtons(nextColor)
        end
    end
end





--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- INITIALIZE AND SETUP THE BASESETTINGS PANEL PER PLAYER
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function populates the `scoreInfo` table with each players' color, steam name, and total power at that base
local function sortPlayerScorePanelsByPower(baseNum)
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo = {}

    for plyrColor, power in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].playersPower) do
        local playerName = Player[plyrColor].steam_name or plyrColor.." Player"
        table.insert(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo, {["color"] = plyrColor, ["power"] = power, ["steamName"] = playerName})
    end

    table.sort(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo, function(player1, player2) return player1.power > player2.power end)
end


-- this function compares power from each player and sorts the individual power panels on the left edge of the base settings panel accordingly
local function activatePlayerScorePanels(baseNum, color, skipForVPSave)
    if not skipForVPSave then
        sortPlayerScorePanelsByPower(baseNum)

    local scoreInfo = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].scoreInfo

    for z = 1, 6 do

            UI.setAttribute("ScoreText"..z.."_"..color, "text", scoreInfo[z].power)

    UI.setAttribute("BaseCurrentPower_"..color, "text", SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].totalPower)

-- the function populates all the info specific for the base into the panel

function BaseSettings.transferBaseSettingsPanelState(fromColor, toColor)
    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[fromColor] then
        local baseNum = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[fromColor].activeBaseNum
        local wasOpen = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[fromColor].status

        -- Clear the old color's state
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[fromColor] = {
            status = false,
            activeBaseNum = 0
        }
        UI.setAttribute("BaseSettings_"..fromColor, "active", "false")

        -- Copy the state to the new color
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[toColor] = {
            status = wasOpen,
            activeBaseNum = baseNum
        }

        initializeBaseScoringPanelForPlayer(baseNum, toColor, true)

    end
end

-- this function is called each time a monster, token, or minion is played on a base to update the power and sort order of power panels in the base settings panel (or base scoring progress bar)
function BaseSettings.updateScoreOrderAndBreakPoint(baseNum)
    for color in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].status == true and SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum == baseNum then
            activatePlayerScorePanels(baseNum, color)
            UI.setAttribute("BaseBreakPoint_"..color, "text", SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].breakPoint)
        end
    end
    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringActive then
        calculateAndDisplayVP(baseNum)
    end
end



function BaseSettings.resetAllOpenBaseScoringPanels(baseNum)
    for color in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].status == true and SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum == baseNum then
            initializeBaseScoringPanelForPlayer(baseNum, color)
        end
    end
end



function BaseSettings.baseSettingsClicked(button, color, altClick)

    local hover_object = Player[color].getHoverObject()
    if hover_object ~= button then return end
    if altClick then return end

    local baseNum = tonumber(button.getName():match("%d+"))

    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].status == true and SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum ~= baseNum then           -- if a player's baseSettings UI panel is ALREADY open, but the base info displayed in the UI (tracked via `activeBaseNum`) is not the same base as the baseSettingsButton just clicked...
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum = baseNum                                                                                                          -- ... then don't close the panel, just update the activeBaseNum to the currently clicked base (so the UI panel will update appropriately)
    else
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].status = not SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].status
        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].status == false then
            SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum = 0
        else
            SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum = baseNum
        end
    end

    initializeBaseScoringPanelForPlayer(baseNum, color)
end

local function baseCloseClick(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)

local function changeBreakPoint(baseNum)

local function bpInputChanged(playerInst, inputNum, inputID)
    local color = playerInst.color
    local baseNum = tonumber(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum)           -- using the color of the player that activated the button, check the SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer table for that color to see which baseNum is currently populating the player's settings UI

    if inputNum == "-" then

        UI.setAttribute(inputID, "text", "0")
        broadcastToColor("BreakPoint can never be negative.", playerInst.color)
    end

    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].printedBreakPoint = tonumber(inputNum)

local function baseReplaceOrDiscard(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID, baseNum)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end

    local color = playerInst.color                                                      -- identify the color of the player that triggered this button
    local source = buttonID:match("^(.*)_")
    source = source:match("Base(.*)") or source:match("Yes(.*)") or source:match("(Scoring).*")

    baseNum = baseNum or tonumber(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum)           -- using the color of the player that activated the button, check the SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer table for that color to see which baseNum is currently populating the player's settings UI

    local baseCard = getObjectFromGUID(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseCardGUID)

    if baseCard ~= nil then                                                                     -- as long as there is baseCard stored in THIS base's baseData...
        baseCard.setLock(false)
        local zone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.cardZones[baseNum]                      -- ... obtain a reference to the baseZone's cardZone

        if source == "Replace" then
            SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum]["beingReplaced"] = true                          -- ... this variable can exist in the `baseData` table for each baseZone, and marks that the baseZone's base is being replaced, and that played cards shouldn't be removed, monster cards shouldn't be removed, and extraBaseZone tiles should remain where they are
            SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum]["oldReplacedBaseName"] = baseCard.getName()
            for _, token in ipairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseCardZones[baseNum].getObjects()) do
                if token.hasTag("Token") then
                    destroyObject(token)
                end
            end
        -- else
        --     baseCloseClick(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
        end
        baseCloseClick(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)

        SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.turnOffBaseBlockZone(zone, baseCard)                  -- ... call this function to run through the steps of deactivating this baseBlock (which would otherwise have been run when manually picking up the baseCard and triggering the `onObjectLeaveZone` code)
        SmashUp.Bases.returnBaseCard(baseCard, baseNum)                                     -- ... call this function to move ("return") the baseCard to the discard pile

        if source == "Scoring" or source == "Replace" then
            Wait.frames(function()
                SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum]["beingReplaced"] = false
                SmashUp.Bases.drawNewBaseClicked(nil, nil, nil, baseNum)
            end, 15)
        end
    else
        if source == "Replace" and SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum]["beingReplaced"] then
            SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum]["beingReplaced"] = false
            SmashUp.Bases.drawNewBaseClicked(nil, nil, nil, baseNum)
        end
    end
end

local function noButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID, color)

    color = color or playerInst.color                                           -- identify the color of the player that triggered this button
    local baseNum = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum

    UI.setAttribute("MainButtonPanel_"..color, "active", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("ScoreBaseConfirmation_"..color, "active", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("BaseScoringPhasesParent_"..color, "active", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("BaseScoringPhase1_"..color, "active", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("BaseScoringPhase2_"..color, "active", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("BaseScoringPhase3_"..color, "active", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("BreakPointChange_"..color, "active", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("ClearBaseConfirmation_"..color, "active", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("DiscardBaseConfirmation_"..color, "active", "false")
end



local function yesButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end

    local button, color = buttonID:match("Yes(.*)_(.*)")                                -- identify the color of the player that triggered this button
    local baseNum = tonumber(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum)           -- using the color of the player that activated the button, check the SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer table for that color to see which baseNum is currently populating the player's settings UI

    if button == "Clear" then
        SmashUp.CleanUp.returnPlayersCards(baseNum)

        if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin then
            SmashUp.Monsters.clearMonsters(baseNum)                                             -- ... then run this function to discard those monster cards
        end
        noButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID, color)

    elseif button == "Discard" then
        baseReplaceOrDiscard(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
        noButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID, color)

    elseif button == "BPChange" then
        changeBreakPoint(baseNum)
        noButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID, color)

    elseif button == "Score" then
        initiateScoringPhase(baseNum, color)
    end
end



local function confirmChoicePanel(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end

    local button, color = buttonID:match("Base(.*)_(.*)")                               -- identify the color of the player that triggered this button
    local baseNum = tonumber(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum)           -- using the color of the player that activated the button, check the SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer table for that color to see which baseNum is currently populating the player's settings UI

    local baseCard = getObjectFromGUID(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseCardGUID)

    if baseCard ~= nil then                                                             -- as long as there is baseCard stored in THIS base's baseData...
        UI.setAttribute("MainButtonPanel_"..color, "active", "false")
        if button == "BPChange" then
            UI.setAttribute("BreakPointChange_"..color, "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("BPInputBox_"..color, "text", SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].printedBreakPoint)
        else
            if button == "Score" then
                if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringActive == true then
                    printToColor("A base is already being scored. Cannot score "..SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseName.." base at this time.", color, {1, 0, 114/255})
                    UI.setAttribute("MainButtonPanel_"..color, "active", "true")
                elseif next(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].playersPower) == nil and SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].breakPoint > 0 then
                    printToColor("There are no cards played on this base; it cannot be scored.", color, {1, 0, 114/255})
                    UI.setAttribute("MainButtonPanel_"..color, "active", "true")
                else
                    UI.setAttribute(button.."BaseConfirmation_"..color, "active", "true")
                end
            else
                UI.setAttribute(button.."BaseConfirmation_"..color, "active", "true")
            end
        end
    end
end



local function baseScoringYesButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end

    local baseNum = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum

    local scoreStage = tonumber(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseScoringProgress)

    for plyrColor in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[plyrColor].activeBaseNum == SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum then
            UI.setAttribute("BaseScoringPhase"..scoreStage.."_"..plyrColor, "active", "false")
        end
    end
    UI.setAttribute("BaseScoreHighlightFade"..scoreStage, "active", "false")

    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseScoringProgress = tonumber(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseScoringProgress) + 1
    scoreStage = tonumber(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseScoringProgress)

    SmashUp.TurnsSystem.setNextScoreTurn(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner])

    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.passCount = 0

    if scoreStage == 2 then
        printToAll("")
        printToAll("●● Phase 2: When a Base Scores.", {182/255, 224/255, 78/255})
        giveVP(baseNum)
    elseif scoreStage == 3 then
        printToAll("")
        printToAll("●● Phase 3: After a Base Scores.", {50/255, 132/255, 233/255})
    end

    if scoreStage <= 3 then
        for plyrColor in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
            if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[plyrColor].activeBaseNum == SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum then
                UI.setAttribute("BaseScoringPhase"..scoreStage.."_"..plyrColor, "active", "true")
            end
        end
        UI.setAttribute("BaseScoreHighlightFade"..scoreStage, "active", "true")

        activateScoreControlButtons(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner)
    else
        UI.setAttribute("BaseSettings_ProgressBar", "active", "false")
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].nowScoring = false
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringActive = false
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum = 0
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseScoringProgress = 0

        for plyrColor in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
            if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[plyrColor].activeBaseNum == SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringBaseNum then
                noButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID, plyrColor)
            end
        end

        printToAll("")

        baseReplaceOrDiscard(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID, baseNum)

        SmashUp.TurnsSystem.scoringBaseTurnsOff()
    end
end



local function baseScoringNoButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end

    local color = playerInst.color
    local baseNum = tonumber(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer[color].activeBaseNum)

    local baseCard = getObjectFromGUID(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseCardGUID)

    for plyrColor in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do

    UI.setAttribute("BaseSettings_ProgressBar", "active", "false")
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].nowScoring = false
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringActive = false

    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].baseScoringProgress = 0

end

local function scoreControlButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end

    local color = playerInst.color
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.lastTurnColor = color
    local buttonType = buttonID:match("score(.*)_")


    if buttonType == "Pass" then
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.passCount = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.passCount + 1
        local playerName = Player[color].steam_name or color.." Player"
        printToAll("["..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."]"..playerName.." [FFFFFF] clicked pass.")
    elseif buttonType == "UseSpecial" then
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.passCount = 0
        local playerName = Player[color].steam_name or color.." Player"
        printToAll("["..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."]"..playerName.."[FFFFFF] has played a Special.")
    end
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringPhaseTurns = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringPhaseTurns + 1
    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringPhaseTurns >= SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount then SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringPhaseTurns = 0 end

    deactivateScoreControlButtons(color)

    local nextTurnNum = ((SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[color] + 1) > SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount and 1) or (SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[color] + 1)
    local nextColor = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[nextTurnNum].color

    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.passCount >= SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount then
        baseScoringYesButton(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    else
        SmashUp.TurnsSystem.setNextScoreTurn(nextTurnNum)
        activateScoreControlButtons(nextColor)
    end
end
