__bundle_register("Smash Up/CustomExtras", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local SmashUp

local CustomExtras = {}


function CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(obj)
    local tags = {}

    if obj == nil then return nil end

    if type(obj) == "table" then
        tags = obj.Tags or obj.tags or {}
    elseif (obj.hasTag("Custom") and obj.hasTag("Extra")) then
        tags = obj.getTags()
    else
        return nil
    end

    for _, tag in ipairs(tags) do
        if tag:find("CustomExtra_") then
            return tag:match("CustomExtra_(.*)")
        end
    end

    return nil
end



local function checkCustomExtraSize(extraObj)
    local cardSize = extraObj.getBoundsNormalized().size
    local cardScale = extraObj.getScale()

    local cardX = cardSize.x / cardScale.x
    local cardZ = cardSize.z / cardScale.z

    local isLandscape = cardX > cardZ

    return isLandscape
end



local function addCustomExtraSnapPoints(extraID, drawPosition, discardPosition)
    local snapTable = Global.getSnapPoints()

    -- Add snap point for draw deck
    local drawSnap = {
        position = {drawPosition.x, 1.72, drawPosition.z},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        rotation_snap = true,
        tags = {"CustomExtra", "CustomExtra_"..extraID, "Draw"}
    }
    table.insert(snapTable, drawSnap)

    -- Add snap point for discard pile
    local discardSnap = {
        position = {discardPosition.x, 1.72, discardPosition.z},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        rotation_snap = true,
        tags = {"CustomExtra", "CustomExtra_"..extraID, "Discard"}
    }
    table.insert(snapTable, discardSnap)

    Global.setSnapPoints(snapTable)
end



local function createCustomExtraZones(extraObj, isLandscape, extraID)
    Wait.condition(function()
        if extraObj == nil then return end

        local zoneSize = isLandscape and {5.39, 0.3, 7.51} or {3.87, 0.3, 5.39}
        local extraPosition = isLandscape and (extraObj.getPosition() + Vector(-4.25, 0, 0)) or extraObj.getPosition()
        local discardPosition = extraPosition + ((isLandscape and Vector(-8, 0, 0)) or Vector(-4.5, 0, 0))

        local extraScriptingZone = spawnObject({
            type="ScriptingTrigger",
            position = extraPosition,
            scale = zoneSize,
            sound = false,
        })

        local tags = {"Custom", "Extra", "CustomExtra_"..extraID}
        if extraObj.type == "Deck" then table.insert(tags, "Deck") end

        extraScriptingZone.setName("CustomExtra_"..extraID.." Draw")
        extraScriptingZone.setGMNotes("CustomExtra_"..extraID.." Draw")
        extraScriptingZone.setTags(tags)
        extraScriptingZone.locked = true
        extraScriptingZone.interactable = false

        local extraDiscardZone = spawnObject({
            type="ScriptingTrigger",
            position = discardPosition,
            scale = zoneSize,
            sound = false,
        })

        extraDiscardZone.setName("CustomExtra_"..extraID.." Draw")
        extraDiscardZone.setGMNotes("CustomExtra_"..extraID.." Draw")
        extraDiscardZone.setTags(tags)
        extraDiscardZone.locked = true
        extraDiscardZone.interactable = false

        SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customExtraZones[extraID] = {draw = extraScriptingZone, discard = extraDiscardZone}

        -- Add snap points for this custom extra
        addCustomExtraSnapPoints(extraID, extraPosition, discardPosition)

    end, || extraObj.isDestroyed() or extraObj.resting, 3)
end


-- Pre-calculate total faction-specific extras per player
function CustomExtras.calculatePlayerFactionSpecificExtraCounts(pickedFactions)
    local totalExtras = 0

    -- Check if the table exists first
    if not SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired or not SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.specific then
        return totalExtras
    end

    -- Count extras for each of the player's factions
    for _, pickedFaction in ipairs(pickedFactions) do
        if pickedFactions and SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.specific[pickedFaction] then
            -- Count how many extras this faction has
            for extraID, extraData in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.specific[pickedFaction]) do
                totalExtras = totalExtras + 1
            end
        end
    end

    return totalExtras
end



function CustomExtras.spawnFactionSpecificCustomExtras(pickedFaction, playerColor, kitData)
    if SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.specific[pickedFaction] then
        local extraCount = #kitData.ContainedObjects
        for extraNum = extraCount, 1, -1 do
            local specificExtraData = table.remove(kitData.ContainedObjects)

            local extraID = SmashUp.CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(specificExtraData)

            local spawnPos

            if SmashUp.GameData.Customs.playerFactionSpecificExtraCounts[playerColor] == 1 then
                local tile = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerScoreTiles[playerColor]
                local objPos = tile.getPosition()
                local nudge = 4.5
                if playerColor == "Red" or playerColor == "Purple" or playerColor == "Blue" then
                    nudge = -nudge
                end

                spawnPos = objPos + Vector(nudge, 1.5, 0)

            else
                spawnPos = SmashUp.GameData.Customs.lastExtraSpawnPosition
            end


            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[playerColor] = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[playerColor] or {}
            local newCustomExtra = spawnObjectData({
                data = specificExtraData,
                position = spawnPos,
            })

            if newCustomExtra.type == "Deck" then
                newCustomExtra.addTag("Deck")
            end
            newCustomExtra.addTag("Custom")
            newCustomExtra.addTag("Extra")

            newCustomExtra.addTag(playerColor)

            local isLandscape = checkCustomExtraSize(newCustomExtra)
            local discardOffset = isLandscape and Vector(-8, 0, 0) or Vector(-4.5, 0, 0)

            if isLandscape then
                newCustomExtra.setPosition(spawnPos + Vector(-4.25, 0, 0))
            end

            --TODO: this is part of my turn-by-turn rewind system; on hold for now.
            -- SmashUp.SaveSystem.createRespawnSources(specificExtraData, true)

            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.customExtraCleanUp[extraID] = {
                startingPosition = newCustomExtra.getPosition(),
                discardMode = SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.specific[pickedFaction][extraID].discardMode,
                discardPosition = newCustomExtra.getPosition() + discardOffset,
            }
            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObjects[playerColor][extraID.."Draw"] = newCustomExtra

            if newCustomExtra.type == "Card" or newCustomExtra.type == "Deck" then
                createCustomExtraZones(newCustomExtra, isLandscape, extraID)
            end

            if SmashUp.GameData.Customs.playerFactionSpecificExtraCounts[playerColor] > 1 then
                if isLandscape then
                    local posKey = SmashUp.GameData.Customs.lastExtraSpawnPosition[1]..","..SmashUp.GameData.Customs.lastExtraSpawnPosition[3]
                    SmashUp.GameData.Customs.landscapePositions[posKey] = true

__bundle_register("Smash Up/Madness", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

local Madness = {}


local function adjustScoresWithMadness()
    for color in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
        SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[color] = SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[color] - (math.floor(SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessCardCount[color] / 2))
        if SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[color] < 0 then SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[color] = 0 end
    end
    printToAll("Scores have been adjusted for Madness cards.", {0, 1, 1})
end


function Madness.madnessCount()
    Wait.condition(function()
        for color in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
            SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessCardCount[color] = 0
            local discardDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Discard"]
            for index, card in ipairs(discardDeck.getObjects()) do
                if card.name == "Madness" then
                    SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessCardCount[color] = SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessCardCount[color] + 1
                end
            end
        end

        adjustScoresWithMadness()

        SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessPenaltiesCompleted = true
    end, || SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cleanupInProgress == false)
end


function Madness.resetTags(card)
    for _, tag in ipairs(card.getTags()) do
        if Common.isInTable(tag, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
            card.removeTag(tag)
        end
    end
end


function Madness.setColorOwnership(zone, card)
    local color = zone.getGMNotes():match("^(.-) ")
    Madness.resetTags(card)
    card.addTag(color)
end


-- **This function is called to retag madness cards with appropriate color tags when the madness cards are in a deck (or remove them altogether)
function Madness.reColorMadnessInDeck(objID, color, containerDeckType)

    -- **This function uses a wait function to ensure all cards have been grouped together before attempting to destroy and recreate the deck
    if SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[objID] then                 -- if a wait function already exists for this deck object then stop the previous wait (because we are starting a new one)
        Wait.stop(SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[objID])
        SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[objID] = nil
    end

    local deckObj = getObjectFromGUID(objID)
    local waitFunc
    waitFunc = Wait.frames(function()
        local deckData = deckObj.getData()
        local onlyMadness = true
        local hasColors = false

        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID] or {}
        SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID]["Madness"] = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID]["Madness"] or {}

        for _, cardData in ipairs(deckData.ContainedObjects) do
            if cardData.Nickname == "Madness" then
                for tagNum = #cardData.Tags, 1, -1 do
                    if Common.isInTable(cardData.Tags[tagNum], Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                        table.remove(cardData.Tags, tagNum)
                    end
                end
                if containerDeckType and Common.isInTable(containerDeckType, Player.getAvailableColors()) then
                    table.insert(cardData.Tags, containerDeckType)
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID]["Madness"][cardData.GUID] = containerDeckType
                elseif color then
                    table.insert(cardData.Tags, color)
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID]["Madness"][cardData.GUID] = color
                else
                    SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID]["Madness"][cardData.GUID] = "Madness"
                end
            else
                onlyMadness = false
                if (not Common.isInTable("Treasure", cardData.Tags)) and (not Common.isInTable("CustomExtra", cardData.Tags)) then
                    hasColors = true
                end
            end
        end

        local tableCat = ((containerDeckType == "Madness" or containerDeckType == "Treasure") and "ExtraDecks") or "PlayerDecks"
        local pileType

        if containerDeckType then
            if SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][containerDeckType:lower().."Draw"] == deckObj then
                pileType = "Draw"
            elseif SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][containerDeckType:lower().."Discard"] == deckObj then
                pileType = "Discard"
            end
        end

        deckObj.destruct()
        deckObj = spawnObjectData({data = deckData})

        if containerDeckType then
            deckObj.addTag(containerDeckType)
        elseif color then
            deckObj.addTag(color)
        end

        SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[objID] = nil                   -- after this wait function triggers, make sure there is no reference to a wait function for this object

        if pileType then
            SmashUp.GameObjects[tableCat][containerDeckType:lower()..pileType] = deckObj
            SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.repositionDroppedDecks(nil, deckObj)
        end

        if onlyMadness and ((not containerDeckType) or containerDeckType == "Madness") then
            SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID]["Madness"] = nil

            if next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID], next(SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID])) == nil then
                SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner[objID] = nil
            end

            deckObj.addTag("Madness")
            deckObj.removeTag("hasMadness")
            deckObj.removeTag("Player")

            for _, color in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
                deckObj.removeTag(color)
            end
        elseif not onlyMadness then
            deckObj.removeTag("Madness")
            deckObj.addTag("hasMadness")
            if hasColors then
                deckObj.addTag("Player")
            end
        end
    end, 5)

    SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID[objID] = waitFunc
end


function Madness.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib
end

return Madness

end)
__bundle_register("Smash Up/Monsters", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local SmashUp

local Monsters = {}


function Monsters.addMonsterScriptZones(baseNum, scriptSpawnLoc)
    scriptSpawnLoc = scriptSpawnLoc + Vector(-(SmashUp.GameBoard.thirdWidth + SmashUp.GameBoard.lineWidth), 0.01, 0)
    local zone = spawnObject(
        {
            type = "ScriptingTrigger",
            position = Vector(0, 1000, 0),
            scale = {SmashUp.GameBoard.thirdWidth, 2.3, SmashUp.GameBoard.baseHeight},
            sound = false
        }
    )

    Wait.frames(function()
        zone.setPosition(scriptSpawnLoc)
    end, 1)

    zone.setName("MonsterZone"..baseNum)
    zone.setGMNotes(zone.getName())
    zone.setTags({"Monster", "Token"})
    zone.interactable = false
    zone.locked = true

    SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterZones[baseNum] = zone
end



function Monsters.addMonsterSnapPoints(baseNum, startingVector)
    local snapTable
    local xPosInit, yPosInit, zPosInit

    local snapConvertX = 1
    local snapConvertZ = 1

    if baseNum >= 7 then
        xPosInit = 0
        yPosInit = 0.2
        zPosInit = 0

        snapConvertX = SmashUp.GameBoard.zoneWidth / 10                                     -- the variable converts measurements that are given in relation to the gameBoard, to be appropriate for the extraBases
        snapConvertZ = SmashUp.GameBoard.zoneHeight / 10

        snapTable = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[baseNum].getSnapPoints()
    else
        snapTable = Global.getSnapPoints()
        xPosInit, yPosInit, zPosInit = startingVector:get()
    end

    local zOffset = 2.172256098 / snapConvertZ

    local xPosStart = xPosInit - (15.682062 / snapConvertX)
    local xPos = xPosStart
    local xPosInc = 1.610085878 / snapConvertX
    local yPos = yPosInit + 0.2111349
    local zPos = zPosInit - zOffset

    for y = 1, 2 do
        for z = 1, 5 do
            local newSnap
            newSnap = {
                position = {xPos, yPos, zPos},
                rotation = {0, 90, 0},
                rotation_snap = true,
                tags = {"Monster"}
            }
            table.insert(snapTable, newSnap)
            xPos = xPos + xPosInc
        end
        xPos = xPosStart
        zPos = zPosInit + zOffset
    end

    if baseNum >= 7 then
        SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[baseNum].setSnapPoints(snapTable)
    else
        Global.setSnapPoints(snapTable)
    end

local function castForMonsterCards(monsterZone, divider)
    local castSize = monsterZone.getScale()
    local castSpot = monsterZone.getPosition() - Vector(castSize.x / 2, 0, castSize.z / divider)

    local castFindings = Physics.cast({
        type = 3,
        origin = castSpot,
        direction = {1, 0, 0},
        size = Vector(1, castSize.y, castSize.z / 2),
        max_distance = castSize.x,
    })
    return castFindings
end



local function discardMonsterCards(foundMonsters)
    local monsterMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.munchkinMat
    local monstX, monstY, monstZ = monsterMat.positionToWorld(monsterMat.getSnapPoints()[2].position):get()
    monstY = monstY + 1

    for _, monster in ipairs(foundMonsters) do
        Wait.condition(function()
            if monster == nil then return end
            monster.interactable = false
            monster.removeTag("InPlay")
            monster.removeTag("DoNotStack")
            monster.setRotationSmooth({0, 90, 0}, false, false)
            monster.setPositionSmooth({monstX, monstY, monstZ}, false, false)

        end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)

end



local function dealMonsters(zoneNum, baseCard, foundMonsters)
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.monsterDraw == null then
        SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.monsterDraw = nil
    end

    if baseCard.hasTag("SuspendedBase") and baseCard.hasTag("MonstersPlayed") then

            baseCard.removeTag("MonstersPlayed")
        end
    end

    if not baseCard.hasTag("MonstersPlayed") then                                           -- if the base card doesn't have "MonstersPlayed" tag then... (this tag prevents this base from triggering dealing of any further monster cards if played elsewhere on the board)

            dealLocTable = extraBaseDock.getSnapPoints()                                       -- ... obtain reference to the extraBaseDock's snap points and save in this table (as opposed to Global snapPoints)
            dealLocIndex = #dealLocTable - 10 + 1                                               -- ... calculate the starting location of the monster area's snap points (will be the same for each extraBaseDock)
        end

        local dealLocStart = dealLocIndex

        local monsterDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.monsterDraw                      -- ... obtain a reference to the monsterDeck
        local monsterCard                                                                   -- ... create this variable which will hold a reference to the monsterCard that will be dealt next
        local monsterCount = tonumber(baseCard.getGMNotes():match("Monsters: (%d+)"))       -- ... obtain the monster count from the base card's GMNotes, and save in this variable

        local munchkinMat = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.munchkinMat

        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].beingReplaced and baseCard.getName() ~= SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].oldReplacedBaseName then   -- ... if this `beingReplaced` variable is true, then the base card here was removed with the intent of replacing it with a new base; this keeps all previously played cards in play.
            for z = 1, #foundMonsters do
                cardCount = cardCount + 1
                dealLocIndex = dealLocIndex + 2                                                     -- ... adjust this array index variable in order to place the next monsterCard at a different location
                if cardCount == 3 then dealLocIndex = dealLocIndex - 1 end                          -- ... if there are 3 monsterCards dealt, then deal to the very next snapPoint instead of skipping 2 snapPoints
                if cardCount == 8 then dealLocIndex = dealLocIndex + 1 end

                    monsterCard.setPositionSmooth(monsterLoc, false, false)                             -- ... move the found monsterCard to the appropriate location
                end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)

                cardCount = cardCount + 1

                SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.monsterDraw = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.monsterDiscard  -- ... set the monsterDeck object equal to the monsterDiscard deck object

                monsterDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.monsterDraw                            -- ... for ease of use, set this variable

                beingShuffled = true
                monsterDeck.shuffle()                                                               -- ... shuffle the discard pile

                Wait.condition(function()
                    if monsterDeck == nil then return end

                    monsterDeck.setPositionSmooth(munchkinMat.positionToWorld(munchkinMat.getSnapPoints()[1].position), false, false)  -- ... move the discard pile to the draw pile
                end, || not SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked)
            end

            if beingShuffled then
                Wait.condition(function()
                    if monsterDeck == nil then return end

                    Wait.condition(function()
                        if monsterDeck == nil then return end
                        beingShuffled = false
                        monsterDeck.interactable = true
                    end, || monsterDeck.isDestroyed() or monsterDeck.resting)

            end

            Wait.condition(function()
                if monsterDeck then
                    if monsterDeck == nil then return end

                    local monsterDeckPos = monsterDeck.getPosition() + Vector(0, 2, 0)

                    if monsterDeck.type == "Deck" then
                        monsterCard = monsterDeck.takeObject()

                        if monsterDeck.remainder then
                            SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraDecks.monsterDraw = monsterDeck.remainder

                        end

                    elseif monsterDeck.type == "Card" then

                        monsterDeck = nil
                    end

                    end

                    monsterCard.setPosition(monsterDeckPos)

                    if dealLocIndex >= dealLocStart + 10 then dealLocIndex = dealLocIndex - 10 end
                end
            end, || not beingShuffled)
        end
    end

function Monsters.evaluateBaseForExistingMonsters(zoneNum, baseCard)
    local monsterZone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterZones[zoneNum]
    local foundMonsters = {}

    local divider = 2

    for _ = 1, 2 do
        local castFindings = castForMonsterCards(monsterZone, divider)

        for _, obj in ipairs(castFindings) do
            local card = obj.hit_object
            if card.type == "Card" and card.hasTag("Monster") and not card.hasTag("Base") then
                table.insert(foundMonsters, card)
            end
        end
        divider = divider * -1
    end

    if baseCard.hasTag("Monster") then
        dealMonsters(zoneNum, baseCard, foundMonsters)

    else
        discardMonsterCards(foundMonsters)
    end
end



function Monsters.clearMonsters(zoneNum)
    local monsterZone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterZones[zoneNum]
    local foundMonsters = {}

    for _, obj in ipairs(monsterZone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.type == "Card" and obj.hasTag("Monster") and not obj.hasTag("Base") then
            table.insert(foundMonsters, obj)
        end
    end

    discardMonsterCards(foundMonsters)
end

    SmashUp = lib
end

__bundle_register("Smash Up/BaseScoreboards", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- THIS FILE CONTAINS FUNCTIONS RELATED TO COUNTING AND MEASURING EACH PLAYER'S POWER AT A BASE, AND TOTAL POWER AT A BASE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local BaseScoreboards = {}


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- HIDE THE EXTRA SCOREBOARDS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function BaseScoreboards.hideExtraScoreboard(baseNum)
    local board = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.scoreboards[baseNum]
    board.setPosition(board.getPosition() + Vector(0, 1000, 0))

    for _, scoreBoardObj in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[baseNum]) do               -- ... iterate through each scoreboard object at this baseBlock...
        scoreBoardObj.setPosition(scoreBoardObj.getPosition() + Vector(0, 1000, 0))
        scoreBoardObj.interactable = false                                                                      -- ... make sure it remains uninteractable
    end
end




--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SPAWN/REVEAL THE EXTRA SCOREBOARDS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function BaseScoreboards.revealExtraScoreboard(baseNum)
    local board = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.scoreboards[baseNum]
    board.setPosition(board.getPosition() - Vector(0, 1000, 0))

    for _, scoreBoardObj in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[baseNum]) do
        scoreBoardObj.setPosition(scoreBoardObj.getPosition() - Vector(0, 1000, 0))
        scoreBoardObj.interactable = false
    end
end

-- SCOREBOARD MANAGEMENT
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function baseCardFlicked(card, zoneNum)
    card.interactable = false
    SmashUp.makeSureCardGetsUnlocked(card)

    Wait.condition(function()
        if card == nil then return end

        Wait.condition(function()
            if card == nil then return end
            card.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, false)                                                   -- ... rotate the card so it is face up and in the correct orientation
            card.setPositionSmooth(Global.getSnapPoints()[zoneNum].position, false, false)                      -- ... move the base card to the center

            Wait.condition(function()
                if card == nil then return end
                Wait.condition(function()
                    if card == nil then return end

                    card.interactable = true
                end, || card.isDestroyed() or card.resting)
            end, || not card.resting)

        end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)

    end, || card.isDestroyed() or card.resting)
end



local function uncoverObjectsInBaseZone(card)
    Wait.frames(function()                                                                          -- need to wait 1 frame here in order to allow the function that calls this one to initiate movement of the baseCard if needed, before this one can trigger
        local waitFunc
        waitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
            if card == nil then return end
            local coveredObjects = Physics.cast({
                type = 3,
                origin = card.getPosition(),
                direction = {0, -1, 0},
                size = {SmashUp.GameBoard.thirdWidth, 1, SmashUp.GameBoard.baseHeight},
                max_distance = 0,
            })

            for _, coveredObject in ipairs(coveredObjects) do
                local obj = coveredObject.hit_object
                if (obj.type ~= "Scripting") and (obj.hasTag("Token") or (obj.type == "Card" and not obj.hasTag("Base"))) then
                    Wait.condition(function()
                        if obj == nil then return end
                        obj.setPosition(obj.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.8, 0))
                    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)
                end
            end
        end, function()
                if card.held_by_color then
                    if waitFunc then Wait.stop(waitFunc) end
                end

                return (not card.isDestroyed()) and card.resting
            end, 5)
    end, 1)
end



function BaseScoreboards.checkForBreakpointElements(baseNum)
    -- **checks for monster cards and tokens played in each baseBlock's monster zone**
    if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin then
        local monsterZone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterZones[baseNum]
        for _, zoneObj in ipairs(monsterZone.getObjects()) do
            if not zoneObj.hasTag("CountOnce") then
                if zoneObj.hasTag("Token") then
                    BaseScoreboards.tokenIsPlaced(monsterZone, zoneObj)
                elseif zoneObj.hasTag("Monster") and not zoneObj.hasTag("Base") then
                    BaseScoreboards.monsterCardIsPlayed(monsterZone, zoneObj)
                end
            else
                zoneObj.removeTag("CountOnce")
            end
        end
    end

    -- **checks for tokens played on a base**
    local baseZone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseCardZones[baseNum]
    for _, zoneObj in ipairs(baseZone.getObjects()) do
        if zoneObj.hasTag("Token") then
            if not zoneObj.hasTag("CountOnce") then
                BaseScoreboards.tokenIsPlaced(baseZone, zoneObj)
            else
                zoneObj.removeTag("CountOnce")
            end
        end
    end
end


-- look through all the zones at this baseBlock and identify objects that will affect the power at this base
local function checkForPlayedElements(baseNum)
    -- **checks for tokens and cards played in each player's playZone**
    for color, playerZone in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerColorPlayZones[baseNum]) do     -- for every playerColor's scripting zone...
        for _, zoneObj in ipairs(playerZone.getObjects()) do                                            -- ... and for every object within the playerColor's zone...
            if zoneObj.hasTag("Power") then                                                                 -- ... if the object has a "Power" tag (meaning it contributes power)...
                if not zoneObj.hasTag("CountOnce") then
                    if zoneObj.hasTag("Token") then                                                                 -- ... and if the object is a token...
                        BaseScoreboards.tokenIsPlaced(playerZone, zoneObj)                                              -- ... then call this function
                    else
                        BaseScoreboards.minionCardIsPlayed(playerZone, zoneObj)
                    end
                else
                    zoneObj.removeTag("CountOnce")
                end
            end
        end
    end

    BaseScoreboards.checkForBreakpointElements(baseNum)
end

        local buttonFunc = "undefined"                                                      -- ... the default function to run when clicked is "undefined" (a non-existing function)

        if tileButton.getName():find("Ring") then                                           -- ... if the name of the tile includes the word 'Ring'...

            else                                                                                -- ... otherwise, if ther is NO player with this color...
                tileButton.value = 0                                                                -- ... set the button's value to 0
                buttonLabel = "--"                                                                  -- ... but set its label to blank lines
                fontColor = {1, 1, 1, 0}                                                            -- ... and the font color is completely translucent

        elseif tileButton.getName():find("Settings") then                                   -- ... or if the tile name contains the word 'Settings'...

        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum]["baseScoringProgress"] = 0                       -- this value tracks which stage of scoring players are in when scoring a base, in order to facilitate proper display of UI elements

        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum]["beingReplaced"] = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum]["beingReplaced"] or false
        if not SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum]["beingReplaced"] then
            SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum]["oldReplacedBaseName"] = nil
        else
            SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum]["beingReplaced"] = false
        end
    end
end



local function resetBaseData(zoneNum)
    local tile = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[zoneNum]["Base Power"]
    tile.setColorTint(Color.White)

    local beingReplaced = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].beingReplaced
    local nowScoring = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].nowScoring
    local oldReplacedBaseName = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].oldReplacedBaseName

    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].arrow then
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].arrow.destruct()
    end

    for baseInfoCat, value in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum]) do
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum][baseInfoCat] = ""
    end
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].playersPower = {}
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].scoreInfo = {}
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].beingReplaced = beingReplaced
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].nowScoring = nowScoring

    if beingReplaced then
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].oldReplacedBaseName = oldReplacedBaseName
    else
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].oldReplacedBaseName = nil
    end
end



function BaseScoreboards.turnOnBaseBlockZone(zone, card)

    if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then
        local mainWaitFunc
        mainWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()                                                                -- make sure to wait until the base card is resting at the baseBlock (start wait condition here)...
            if card.isDestroyed() or card == nil then return end                                                -- ... if the card no longer exists, then abort
            if zone == nil or zone.isDestroyed() then return end                                                -- ... if the zone no longer exists, then abort

            local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, card)                                                -- ... check to see if the base card is inbounds of the baseBlock's card zone
            local zoneNum = tonumber(zone.getName():match("%d+"))                                               -- ... identify the number of the baseBlock
            local alreadyHasBase = (BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] == "on" and true or false)         -- ... if the baseBlock is already turned on, then this baseBlock already has a base (so don't accept another one)

            if isInBounds and not alreadyHasBase then                                                           -- ... if the base card is inbounds and doesn't already have a base card...
                card.removeTag("Phantom")                                                                           -- ... remove this tag (this tag marks the base card as having entered a phantom script zone to trigger appearance of the baseBlock when dropped)

                BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] = "on"                                                     -- ... turn on this baseBlock
                card.addTag("InPlay")                                                                               -- ... this tag marks a baseCard as having entered play (it is on the board, in a baseBlock). with this tag, this base won't be returned erroneously to the decks
                card.addTag("ActivatedBase")                                                                        -- ... this tag marks a baseCard as having activated a baseBlock, and is used to prevent this same base from being able to activate ANOTHER extraBaseDock
                card.addTag("DoNotStack")

                card.setRotationSmooth({0, 180, 0}, false, false)                                                   -- ... rotate the card so it is face up and in the correct orientation

                local baseInCenter = SmashUp.checkInBounds(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseCardZones[zoneNum], card)     -- ... check to see if the base card is already in the center of the baseBlock (using the baseZone and inbounds)...
                if not baseInCenter then                                                                            -- ... if the base card is NOT in the center...
                    Wait.condition(function()
                        if card == nil then return end
                        card.setPositionSmooth(Global.getSnapPoints()[zoneNum].position, false, false)                      -- ... move the base card to the center
                    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)
                end

                -- **If the base was played at a different baseBlock before its current one, identify what baseBlock number it was, and remove that tag.
                -- Also, remove monster cards that were played there.**
                local previousBaseTag = table.concat(card.getTags(), ", "):match("Base%d+")                         -- ... check to see if the base card has a "Base#" tag (indicating it was played at another baseBlock before being moved here)
                if previousBaseTag then                                                                             -- ... if the base card DOES already have a "Base#" tag...
                    local oldZoneNum = tonumber(previousBaseTag:match("Base(%d+)"))                                     -- ... identify the number of the previous baseBlock
                    if oldZoneNum ~= zoneNum then
                        card.removeTag(previousBaseTag)                                                                     -- ... finally, remove the previous base's "Base#" tag

                        if card.hasTag("SuspendedBase") then
                            local oldBaseName = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[oldZoneNum].oldReplacedBaseName

                            if oldBaseName ~= nil and card.getName() ~= oldBaseName then
                                card.removeTag("MonstersPlayed")
                            end
                        end

                        if card.hasTag("MonstersPlayed") then                                                               -- ... and if the base card has the "MonstersPlayed" tag (indicating monster's were played at this base cards PREVIOUS base)...
                            SmashUp.Monsters.clearMonsters(oldZoneNum)                                                          -- ... then run this function to clear the monsters from the previous base
                            card.removeTag("MonstersPlayed")                                                                    -- ... remove the "MonstersPlayed" tag
                        end

                        if  oldZoneNum >= 7 then                                                                            -- ... if the previous baseBlock number is greater than six (indicating it was an extraBaseDock)...
                            SmashUp.Bases.ExtraBaseDocks.hidePhantomZone(oldZoneNum)                                                           -- ... then hide the extraBaseDock
                        end
                    end
                end

                card.addTag("Base"..zoneNum)                                                                        -- ... mark base with current "Base#" tag--this tag marks which baseZone the base card belongs to

                card.interactable = true                                                                            -- ... make sure the base card is interactable
                card.setLock(false)

                setupBaseData(zoneNum, card)                                                                        -- ... call this function to store the variables associated with this base

                uncoverObjectsInBaseZone(card)                                                                      -- ... run this function to uncover any cards or tokens that may have been covered by the base card

                if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin then                                                    -- ... if there are munchkin factions included in this game...
                    SmashUp.Monsters.evaluateBaseForExistingMonsters(zoneNum, card)                                     -- ... then run this function to look for monster cards that might already be in play in the monster zone
                end

                createBaseButtons(zoneNum, card)                                                                    -- ... lastly, run this function to create the buttons on this now-activated baseBlock

                checkForPlayedElements(zoneNum)

                card.removeTag("SuspendedBase")

                SmashUp.BaseSettings.resetAllOpenBaseScoringPanels(zoneNum)
            end

        end, function()
                if card.held_by_color then
                    if mainWaitFunc then Wait.stop(mainWaitFunc) end
                end

                return card.isDestroyed() or card.resting
            end, 5, function() card.setLock(false) card.interactable = true BaseScoreboards.turnOnBaseBlockZone(zone, card) end)
    end
end



function BaseScoreboards.turnOffBaseBlockZone(zone, card)

    local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, card)

    local isInPlay = card.hasTag("InPlay")                                      -- a card marked with this tag is THE base for the baseBlock. if a base card without this tag is removed from the baseBlock, it won't trigger deactivation of the baseBlock.
    local isMoving = not card.resting
    local isHeld = card.held_by_color and true or false
    local zoneNum = tonumber(zone.getName():match("%d+"))
    local hasButtons = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[zoneNum]["Base Power"].getButtons() and true or false

    -- if not isInBounds or not isInPlay or not hasButtons then return end
    if not isInPlay or not hasButtons then return end
    if not isHeld and isMoving then                                             -- in the unusual case where a base card leaves the CardZone and triggers this event by being flicked or thrown (it is not held and is moving), then abort this function
        baseCardFlicked(card, zoneNum)
        return
    end

    card.setGMNotes(card.getGMNotes():gsub("(%-?%d+)", card.value, 1))          -- reset the breakpoint value stored in the GMNotes to the card's value (which is the actual breakpoint)

    card.removeTag("InPlay")

    BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] = "off"

    for _, button in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[zoneNum]) do
        button.memo = 0
        button.value = 0
        if button.getButtons() then
            button.removeButton(0)
        end
    end

    resetBaseData(zoneNum)
    SmashUp.BaseSettings.resetAllOpenBaseScoringPanels(zoneNum)
end

local function readyToScoreIndicate(baseNum, basePowerTile)
    basePowerTile.setColorTint(Color.Pink)

    SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum] = spawnObject({               -- spawn the arrow object
        type = "Custom_Model",                                                  -- ... object is a Custom_Assetbundle
        position = basePowerTile.getPosition() + Vector(0, 5, 0),               -- ... spawn it at these coordinates
        rotation = {0 , 0, 0},                                                  -- ... spawn it with this rotation
        scale = {1.25, 1.25, 1.25},                                             -- ... set the scale to 1.25:1.25:1.25
        sound = false,
    })

    SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum].setCustomObject({
        mesh = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1897721945353769683/D16CBD88410B4E72A9CEC6BC32CC1AE700BCF86F/",
        type = 0,
        material = 2
        })

    local arrow = SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum]
    arrow.setColorTint(Color.Pink)
    arrow.setLock(true)
    arrow.interactable = false
    Common.disableCollider(arrow)

    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].readyToScore = true

    local bounceAnimate = coroutine.create(Common.animate)
    local spinAnimate = coroutine.create(Common.animate)

    coroutine.resume(bounceAnimate, "move", arrow, arrow.getPosition(), arrow.getPosition() + Vector(0, -4, 0), 20, (1/3), 6, true)
    coroutine.resume(spinAnimate, "rotate", arrow, arrow.getRotation(), arrow.getRotation() + Vector(0, 360, 0), 120, 2, 2)

    Wait.time(function()
        Wait.condition(function()
            if SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum] == nil then return end
            SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum].destruct()
            SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum] = nil
        end,
        function()
            if SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum] == nil then
                return true
            elseif SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum] ~= nil and coroutine.status(bounceAnimate) == "dead" then
                return true
            else
                return false
            end
        end, 4, function() SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum].destruct() SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum] = nil end)
    end, 1)
end



function BaseScoreboards.checkForBaseReadyToScore(baseNum)
    local baseTotalTile = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[baseNum]["Base Power"]

    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].totalPower >= SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].breakPoint then
        if not SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].readyToScore then
            readyToScoreIndicate(baseNum, baseTotalTile)
        end
    else
        baseTotalTile.setColorTint(Color.White)
        if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].readyToScore then
            SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].readyToScore = false
            if SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum] then
                SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.arrows[baseNum].destruct()
            end
        end
    end
end

-- this function is called when the player's power/score button is clicked, or when they play a minion at a base to check to see if there are still any objects at this base, even if the power is zero
local function playerZoneEmptyCheck(baseNum, color)
    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].playersPower[color] == 0 then                                                         -- if the total power at this base for this player is zero, then...
        local cardCount = 0                                                                                             -- ... set this counting variable with a starting value of 0
        for _, obj in ipairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerColorPlayZones[baseNum][color].getObjects()) do       -- ... iterate through all objects in this player's play zone at this base...
            if obj.hasTag("Power") then                                                                                     -- ... and if an object with the "Power" tag is found...
                cardCount = cardCount + 1                                                                                       -- ... increment the cardCount var by 1
            end
        end
        if cardCount == 0 then                                                                                          -- ... if the cardCount var is still 0 (no "Power" objects were found...)
            SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].playersPower[color] = nil                                                            -- ... then remove this player's entry in this base's playersPower list (which in turn removes the score panel in the XML UI for this base)
        end
    end
end


-- this function updates the label of a playerColor's tile at the specific baseBlock when the player plays or removes power from that base
local function updateTotalBasePower(baseNum, powerChange)
    local baseTotalTile = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[baseNum]["Base Power"]
    baseTotalTile.value = baseTotalTile.value + powerChange

    if baseTotalTile.value < 0 then baseTotalTile.value = 0 end

    baseTotalTile.editButton({label = baseTotalTile.value})
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum]["totalPower"] = baseTotalTile.value

    BaseScoreboards.checkForBaseReadyToScore(baseNum)
end



local function updatePlayerScoreTile(zoneNum, color, powerChange)
    powerChange = powerChange or 0                                                      -- the default powerChange is 0 (or whatever was passed to this function from the calling function)
    local tileIndex = color or "Breakpoint"                                             -- tileIndex is the color of the player's tile to update, or it will be "Breakpoint"

    local tile = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.baseScoreTiles[zoneNum][tileIndex]     -- reference the requisite tile/button

    local tilesStartingPower = tonumber(tile.memo)
    local tilesNewPower = tilesStartingPower + powerChange

    tile.memo = tilesNewPower

    if tilesStartingPower <= 0 then tilesStartingPower = 0 end
    if tilesNewPower <= 0 then tilesNewPower = 0 end

    powerChange = tilesNewPower - tilesStartingPower

    tile.value = tile.value + powerChange
    if tile.value < 0 then tile.value = 0 end

    tile.editButton({label = tile.value})

    if color then
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].playersPower[color] = tile.value
        playerZoneEmptyCheck(zoneNum, color)
        updateTotalBasePower(zoneNum, powerChange)
    else
        SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[zoneNum].breakPoint = tonumber(tile.value)
    end

    SmashUp.BaseSettings.updateScoreOrderAndBreakPoint(zoneNum)
end


-- this function updates a player's total power at a base when a minion card is played on the base
function BaseScoreboards.minionCardIsPlayed(zone, minionCard)
    minionCard.addTag("CountOnce")

    local minionWaitFunc
    minionWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()                                                                               -- make sure to wait until the minion card is resting at the baseBlock (start wait condition here)...
        if minionCard == nil or zone == nil then return end

        Wait.frames(function()                                                                          -- ... this wait function (waits 1 frame) so that if the minion card is dropped at the same time as the base card, it allows the `turnOnBaseBlockZone` function to trigger first

            local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, minionCard)
            local color, zoneNum = zone.getName():match("^(.*)Zone(%d+)")
            zoneNum = tonumber(zoneNum)

            if isInBounds and BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] == "on" and not minionCard.is_face_down then
                minionCard.addTag("InPlay")
                updatePlayerScoreTile(zoneNum, color, minionCard.value)
            end

            minionCard.removeTag("CountOnce")
        end, 1)

        minionCard.interactable = true
        minionCard.setLock(false)

    end, function()
        if minionCard.held_by_color then
            if minionWaitFunc then
                Wait.stop(minionWaitFunc)
                minionCard.removeTag("CountOnce")
            end
        end
        return (not minionCard.isDestroyed()) and minionCard.resting
    end)
end


-- this function updates a player's total power at a base when a minion card is removed from the base
function BaseScoreboards.minionCardIsRemoved(zone, minionCard)
    local color, zoneNum = zone.getName():match("^(.*)Zone(%d+)")
    zoneNum = tonumber(zoneNum)

    if minionCard == nil then return end

    if minionCard.hasTag("InPlay") and BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] == "on" then
        minionCard.removeTag("InPlay")
        local powerChange = -tonumber(minionCard.value)
        updatePlayerScoreTile(zoneNum, color, powerChange)
    end
end



function BaseScoreboards.monsterCardIsPlayed(zone, monsterCard)
    monsterCard.addTag("CountOnce")

    local monsterWaitFunc
    monsterWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()                                                                               -- make sure to wait until the base card is resting at the baseBlock (start wait condition here)...
        if monsterCard == nil or zone == nil then return end

        Wait.frames(function()                                                                          -- ... this wait function (waits 1 frame) so that if the monster card is dropped at the same time as the base card, it allows the `turnOnBaseBlockZone` function to trigger first

            local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, monsterCard)
            local zoneNum = tonumber(zone.getGMNotes():match("%d+"))

            if isInBounds and BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] == "on" and not monsterCard.is_face_down then
                monsterCard.addTag("InPlay")
                updatePlayerScoreTile(zoneNum, nil, monsterCard.value)
            end

            monsterCard.removeTag("CountOnce")
        end, 1)
        monsterCard.interactable = true
        monsterCard.setLock(false)
    end, function()
        if monsterCard.held_by_color then
            if monsterWaitFunc then
                Wait.stop(monsterWaitFunc)
                monsterCard.removeTag("CountOnce")
            end
        end
        return (not monsterCard.isDestroyed()) and monsterCard.resting
    end)
end



function BaseScoreboards.monsterCardIsRemoved(zone, monsterCard)
    local zoneNum = tonumber(zone.getGMNotes():match("%d+"))

    if monsterCard == nil then return end

    if monsterCard.hasTag("InPlay") and BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] == "on" then
        monsterCard.removeTag("InPlay")
        updatePlayerScoreTile(zoneNum, nil, -monsterCard.value)
    end
end



-- this function is used when a token is played. A cast is performed to identify what card the token was played on.
local function tokenCast(token, distance)
    return Physics.cast({
        type = 1,
        origin = token.getPosition(),
        direction = {0, -1, 0},
        max_distance = distance
    })
end



local function associateTokenWithCard(zoneNum, color, token, direction)
    local powerChange = token.value

    local baseCard
    local minionCard

    if direction == "removed" then                                              -- if the token is being removed (indicated by the direction variable)...
        powerChange = -powerChange                                              -- ... then the powerChange will be a negative value
        if token.script_state then                                              -- ... if there is data saved on the token's script_state (will be the GUID of the card the token is attached to)...
            local card = getObjectFromGUID(token.script_state)                      -- ... obtain a reference to the card using the GUID stored in the token's script_state
            if card.hasTag("Base") then                                             -- ... if the card is a baseCard...
                baseCard = card                                                         -- ... then set the baseCard variable to the card object
            else                                                                    -- ... otherwise (if it is a minionCard)...
                minionCard = card                                                       -- ... then set the minionCard variable to the card object
            end
        end

    elseif direction == "placed" then                                           -- if the token is being placed...
        local objectsUnderToken = tokenCast(token, 1.5)

        for _, cast in ipairs(objectsUnderToken) do
            if cast.hit_object.type == "Card" then
                if cast.hit_object.hasTag("Base") then
                    if baseCard == nil then baseCard = cast.hit_object end
                elseif cast.hit_object.hasTag("Minion") then
                    if minionCard == nil then minionCard = cast.hit_object end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    token.script_state = nil

    if color == "Monster" or color == "Base" then color = nil end

    if baseCard or minionCard then
        local foundCard = baseCard or minionCard
        Wait.condition(function()
            if foundCard == nil or token == nil then return end

            token.script_state = foundCard.guid

            local startingValue = (baseCard and tonumber(baseCard.getGMNotes():match("(%-?%d+)"))) or tonumber(minionCard.memo)
            local newValue = startingValue + ((direction == "placed" and token.value) or -token.value)

            if baseCard then
                local newGMNote = baseCard.getGMNotes():gsub("(%-?%d+)", newValue, 1)
                baseCard.setGMNotes(newGMNote)
            elseif minionCard then
                minionCard.memo = newValue
            end

            if startingValue <= 0 then startingValue = 0 end
            if newValue <= 0 then newValue = 0 end

            powerChange = newValue - startingValue

            updatePlayerScoreTile(zoneNum, color, powerChange)

            if token.hasTag("ToBeDeleted") then
                destroyObject(token)
            end

        end, || ((not foundCard.isDestroyed()) and (not token.isDestroyed())) and (foundCard.hasTag("InPlay") or direction == "removed"))
    else
        updatePlayerScoreTile(zoneNum, color, powerChange)
        if token.hasTag("ToBeDeleted") then
            destroyObject(token)
        end
    end
end



function BaseScoreboards.tokenIsPlaced(zone, token)
    -- **this wait function sets up a forced stop for tokens that continue to `wiggle` after being dropped.
    -- **once the token's velocity in all 3 axes is below 0.03, a 0.5 second timer is triggered, and after the timer, the velocity of the token is set to 0, which will then trigger any `token.resting` conditions
    token.addTag("CountOnce")

    local tokenWaitFunc
    tokenWaitFunc = Wait.condition(function()
        if token == nil or zone == nil then return end

        Wait.frames(function()                                                                      -- ... this wait function (waits 1 frame) so that if the token is dropped at the same time as the base card, it allows the `turnOnBaseBlockZone` function to trigger first

            local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(zone, token)
            local color, zoneNum = zone.getName():match("^(.*)Zone(%d+)")                           -- identify the player's color and the baseBlock number using the scripting zones name
            zoneNum = tonumber(zoneNum)

            if isInBounds and BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] == "on" then
                token.addTag("InPlay")
                associateTokenWithCard(zoneNum, color, token, "placed")
            end

            token.removeTag("CountOnce")
        end, 1)
        token.interactable = true
        token.setLock(false)

    end, function()
        if token.held_by_color then
            if tokenWaitFunc then
                Wait.stop(tokenWaitFunc)
                token.removeTag("CountOnce")
            end
        end
        return token.isDestroyed() or token.resting
    end)
end



function BaseScoreboards.tokenIsRemoved(zone, token)
    local color, zoneNum = zone.getName():match("^(.*)Zone(%d+)")
    zoneNum = tonumber(zoneNum)

    if token == nil then return end

    if token.hasTag("InPlay") and BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[zoneNum] == "on" then
        token.removeTag("InPlay")
        associateTokenWithCard(zoneNum, color, token, "removed")
    end
end

function BaseScoreboards.playersScoreTileClicked(button, color, altClick)
    local hover_object = Player[color].getHoverObject()
    if hover_object ~= button then return end

    local buttonColor = button.getName():match("^(.*) Ring")

    local deltaNum = altClick and -1 or 1
    button.value = button.value + deltaNum
    if button.value < 0 then
        deltaNum = 0
        button.value = 0
    end
    if button.value > 99 then
        deltaNum = 0
        button.value = 99
    end
    button.editButton({
        label = button.value
    })

    local baseNum = tonumber(button.getName():match("%d+"))
    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].playersPower[buttonColor] = button.value
    playerZoneEmptyCheck(baseNum, buttonColor)                                  -- this function checks to see if there are any minions still in play, even if the power on the base is zero
    updateTotalBasePower(baseNum, deltaNum)                                     -- this function then makes appropriate adjustments to the TOTAL power at this base

    SmashUp.BaseSettings.updateScoreOrderAndBreakPoint(baseNum)
end

function BaseScoreboards.evalForExistingBases()
    for i = 1, 14 do
        if SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[i] == "on" then
            local zone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.cardZones[i]
            local baseCard = getObjectFromGUID(SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[i].baseCardGUID)

            if baseCard then
                SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[i] = "off"
                BaseScoreboards.turnOnBaseBlockZone(zone, baseCard)
            end
        end
    end
end



function BaseScoreboards.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib

    _G["BaseScoreboards.playersScoreTileClicked"] = BaseScoreboards.playersScoreTileClicked

    BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus = BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus or {}
    BaseScoreboards.arrows = BaseScoreboards.arrows or {}

    if next(BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus) == nil then
        for i = 1, 14 do
            table.insert(BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus, SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[i] or "off")
        end
    end
end

return BaseScoreboards
