__bundle_register("Smash Up/ExtraBaseDocks", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- THIS FILE CONTAINS THE FUNCTIONS HANDLING THE APPEARANCE AND HIDING OF EXTRA BASE DOCKS, AS WELL AS THEIR "PHANTOM" APPEARANCE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local ExtraBaseDocks = {}


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- THESE FUNCTIONS HANDLE THE ADDING OF AN EXTRA BASE DOCK WHEN NEEDED
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function creates the BaseBlockZone and CardZone scripting zones on the newly spawned extraBaseDock
local function createExtraBaseScriptingZones(newBase, baseNum)
    local newBaseBlockZone = spawnObject({                                                       -- spawn the new BaseBlockZone...
        type="ScriptingTrigger",                                                            -- ... it is a scripting zone
        position = {0, 1000, 0},                                                            -- ... it is spawned too high to be visualized to avoid the brief flash of its appearance
        scale = {37.9, 11.74, 37.9},                                                        -- ... sets the appropriate size for the zone
        sound = false,                                                                      -- ... it does not make a sound when spawned
    })

    Wait.frames(function()                                                                  -- wait 1 frame for the zone to be spawned (flashing into existence and then being hidden)...
        newBaseBlockZone.setPosition(newBase.positionToWorld({0, 0, 0}) + Vector(0, 5.63, 0))    -- ... and then move the zone to its appropriate location
    end, 1)
    newBaseBlockZone.setName("BaseBlockZone"..baseNum)                                                -- set the name for the zone
    newBaseBlockZone.setGMNotes("BaseBlockZone"..baseNum)                                             -- set the GMNotes for the zone
    newBaseBlockZone.setTags({"Minion", "Action", "Titan"})                                      -- set the appropriate tags
    newBaseBlockZone.locked = true                                                               -- make sure the zone is locked
    newBaseBlockZone.interactable = false                                                        -- make sure the zone is un-interactable
    SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseBlockZones[baseNum] = newBaseBlockZone                     -- save a reference of the zone object in the GameObjects table


    local newCardZone = spawnObject({                                                       -- spawn the new CardZone...
        type="ScriptingTrigger",                                                            -- ... it is a scripting zone
        position = {0, 1000, 0},                                                            -- ... it is spawned too high to be visualized to avoid the brief flash of its appearance
        scale = {37.9, 1.3, 37.9},                                                          -- ... sets the appropriate size for the zone
        sound = false,                                                                      -- ... it does not make a sound when spawned
    })

    Wait.frames(function()                                                                  -- wait 1 frame for the zone to be spawned (flashing into existence and then being hidden)...
        newCardZone.setPosition(newBase.positionToWorld({0, 0, 0}) + Vector(0, 0.01, 0))    -- ... and then move the zone to its appropriate location
    end, 1)
    newCardZone.setName("CardZone"..baseNum)                                                -- set the name for the zone
    newCardZone.setGMNotes("CardZone"..baseNum)                                             -- set the GMNotes for the zone
    newCardZone.locked = true                                                               -- make sure the zone is locked
    newCardZone.interactable = false                                                        -- make sure the zone is un-interactable

    SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.cardZones[baseNum] = newCardZone                     -- save a reference of the zone object in the GameObjects table


    local newBaseZone = spawnObject({                                                       -- spawn the new BaseZone...
        type="ScriptingTrigger",                                                            -- ... it is a scripting zone
        position = {0, 1000, 0},                                                            -- ... it is spawned too high to be visualized to avoid the brief flash of its appearance
        scale = {SmashUp.GameBoard.thirdWidth, 1.35, SmashUp.GameBoard.baseHeight},         -- ... sets the appropriate size for the zone
        sound = false,                                                                      -- ... it does not make a sound when spawned
    })

    Wait.frames(function()                                                                  -- wait 1 frame for the zone to be spawned (flashing into existence and then being hidden)...
        newBaseZone.setPosition(newBase.positionToWorld({0, 0, 0}) + Vector(0, 0.01, 0))    -- ... and then move the zone to its appropriate location
    end, 1)
    newBaseZone.setName("BaseZone"..baseNum)                                                -- set the name for the zone
    newBaseZone.setGMNotes("BaseZone"..baseNum)                                             -- set the GMNotes for the zone
    newBaseZone.setTags({"Base", "Token"})
    newBaseZone.locked = true                                                               -- make sure the zone is locked
    newBaseZone.interactable = false                                                        -- make sure the zone is un-interactable

    SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseCardZones[baseNum] = newBaseZone                     -- save a reference of the zone object in the GameObjects table
end


-- this function is called when an extraBaseDock is despawned/hidden, and its corresponding drawer needs to be closed
local function closeDrawer(baseNum)
    local drawerToColorIndex = {                                                    -- this table provides a reference for the code; identifies which extraBaseDock (index) is associated with which drawer (color)
        [9] = "Green",
        [10] = "Yellow",
        [11] = "Orange",
        [12] = "Red",
        [13] = "Purple",
        [14] = "Blue",
    }

    local drawer = Common.getObjectByGMNote(drawerToColorIndex[baseNum].." Drawer Open") -- obtain a reference to the appropriate drawer
    if drawer then
        local closedDrawer = drawer.setState(1)                                           -- "open" the drawer by changing its object state
    end
end


-- this function is called when an extraBaseDock is spawned where the drawers are located, and opens the drawers
local function openDrawer(baseNum)
    local drawerToColorIndex = {                                                    -- this table provides a reference for the code; identifies which extraBaseDock (index) is associated with which drawer (color)
        [9] = "Green",
        [10] = "Yellow",
        [11] = "Orange",
        [12] = "Red",
        [13] = "Purple",
        [14] = "Blue",
    }

    local drawer = Common.getObjectByGMNote(drawerToColorIndex[baseNum].." Drawer") -- obtain a reference to the appropriate drawer
    if drawer then
        local openDrawer = drawer.setState(2)                                           -- "open" the drawer by changing its object state
        Wait.frames(function()                                                          -- wait 1 frame for the object state to spawn (and therefore its default button has been created)...
            openDrawer.removeButton(0)                                                  -- ... and remove the button
        end, 1)
    end
end


-- this function adds the extraBaseDocks when the GameBoard is full of bases (6 bases on the board)
function ExtraBaseDocks.addExtraBase(baseNum)
    local newBase = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[baseNum]             -- obtain a reference to the next extraBaseDock object stored in the GameObjects table
    local numPlayerZones = #SmashUp.GameBoard.playZoneColors.bottomRow * 2          -- identify the number of play zones needed to be drawn

    if not SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[baseNum].beingReplaced then                    -- as long as the base isn't in the process of being replaced (which means that the extraBase block object will already be in the proper position)...
        newBase.setPosition(newBase.getPosition() - Vector(0, 1000, 0))             -- ... set the position of the extraBaseBlock (bringing it down into position)

        newBase.highlightOff()                                                          -- make sure the base's highlight is off

        if baseNum >= 9 then                                                            -- if the extraBaseDock being created is the 9th or higher (means it is "resting" on a drawer)...
            openDrawer(baseNum)                                                         -- ... call the function to open the drawer
        end

        createExtraBaseScriptingZones(newBase, baseNum)                                 -- call this function to add the BaseBlockZone and CardZone scripting zones
        SmashUp.PlayZones.spawnPlayZoneElements(baseNum, newBase.getPosition() + Vector(0, 0.06, 0))    -- call this function to add in the playZone specific elements

        SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.revealExtraScoreboard(baseNum)                    -- call this function to now reveal the base's scoreBoard

        SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[baseNum].UI.setClass("extraBaseDock", "singleBaseBlock "..numPlayerZones.."playerSetup")    -- draw the xml boundaries for playZones by setting the class of the parent XML element, which will have a downstream effect, enabling the appropriate playZones

        local newSnapList = Global.getSnapPoints()
        newSnapList[baseNum].tags = {"Base"}                                            -- find the snap point on the extraBaseDock for the base card, and change its tag from "Disabled" to "Base"
        Global.setSnapPoints(newSnapList)

        if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin then
            SmashUp.Monsters.addMonsterScriptZones(baseNum, newBase.getPosition())
            SmashUp.Monsters.addMonsterSnapPoints(baseNum)
        end
    end
end




--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- THESE FUNCTIONS RELATE TO THE SHOWING OF "PHANTOM" BASE ZONES WHEN HOLDING A BASE CARD
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ExtraBaseDocks.highlightPhantomBaseBlock(zone, status, card)
    local zoneNum = tonumber(zone.getGMNotes():match("%d+"))
    local baseBlock = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[zoneNum]
    if status == "on" then
        baseBlock.highlightOn("White")
        card.addTag("Phantom")
    else
        baseBlock.highlightOff("White")
        card.removeTag("Phantom")
    end
end



local function createPhantomScriptingZone(phantomBase, phantomZoneNum)
    local newPhantomZone = spawnObject({                                                        -- spawn the new BaseBlockZone...
        type="ScriptingTrigger",                                                                -- ... it is a scripting zone
        position = {0, 1000, 0},                                                                -- ... it is spawned too high to be visualized to avoid the brief flash of its appearance
        scale = {38.5, 11.74, 38.5},                                                            -- ... sets the appropriate size for the zone
        sound = false,                                                                          -- ... it does not make a sound when spawned
    })

    Wait.frames(function()                                                                      -- wait 1 frame for the zone to be spawned (flashing into existence and then being hidden)...
        newPhantomZone.setPosition(phantomBase.positionToWorld({0, 0, 0}) + Vector(0, 5.63, 0)) -- ... and then move the zone to its appropriate location
    end, 1)
    newPhantomZone.setName("PhantomZone"..phantomZoneNum)                                       -- set the name for the zone
    newPhantomZone.setGMNotes("PhantomZone"..phantomZoneNum)                                    -- set the GMNotes for the zone
    newPhantomZone.setTags({"Base"})                                                            -- set the appropriate tags
    newPhantomZone.locked = true                                                                -- make sure the zone is locked
    newPhantomZone.interactable = false                                                         -- make sure the zone is un-interactable
    SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.phantomZones[phantomZoneNum] = newPhantomZone            -- save a reference of the zone object in the GameObjects table
end


-- this function makes the phantomBase area appear opaque/solid/permanent
function ExtraBaseDocks.solidifyPhantomBase(card)
    local baseNum = tonumber(card.getZones()[1].getGMNotes():match("%d+"))      -- obtain the number of the baseBlockZone (should be between 7 and 14)
    SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[baseNum] = "off"              -- set the baseBlockStatus to "off", making sure it is ready to be played on

    SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.phantomZones[baseNum].destruct()         -- destroy the phantom scripting zones; no longer needed (phantom scripting zones are used to trigger this function, actually)
    SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.phantomZones[baseNum] = nil

    local extraBase = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[baseNum]       -- obtain a reference to the extraBaseDock object (the pad/block that appears)
    extraBase.setColorTint({1,1,1,1})                                           -- change the tint of the extraBase to fully opaque
    extraBase.setPosition(extraBase.getPosition() + Vector(0, 1000, 0))         -- move the extraBase back up to hidden position (this is ONLY done here because the position is changed by -1000 AGAIN in a subsequent function)

    ExtraBaseDocks.addExtraBase(baseNum)                                                 -- call this function to setup the extraBase, bringing it back down into position, setting up scripting zones, etc
end


-- this function will hide/disable an extraBaseBlock if a base card is dropped before it is played on it, or if the base card is removed from the baseBlock
function ExtraBaseDocks.hidePhantomZone(baseNum)
    local phantomBase = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[baseNum]

    -- **move the extraBaseBlock back up out of sight, and reset its opacity**
    phantomBase.setPosition(phantomBase.getPosition() + Vector(0, 1000, 0))
    phantomBase.setColorTint({1,1,1,1})

    -- **reset the UI appearance on the extraBaseBlock, removing it**
    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[baseNum].UI.setClass("extraBaseBlock", "singleBaseBlock")    -- ... remove the color outlines for the players' play areas by setting the XML UI class

    -- **delete any created scripting zones for this extraBaseBlock**
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.phantomZones[baseNum] then
        destroyObject(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.phantomZones[baseNum])
        SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.phantomZones[baseNum] = nil
    end
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseBlockZones[baseNum] then
        destroyObject(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseBlockZones[baseNum])
        SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseBlockZones[baseNum] = nil
    end
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.cardZones[baseNum] ~= nil then
        destroyObject(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.cardZones[baseNum])
        SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.cardZones[baseNum] = nil
    end
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseCardZones[baseNum] ~= nil then
        destroyObject(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseCardZones[baseNum])
        SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseCardZones[baseNum] = nil
    end

    if SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerColorPlayZones[baseNum] then
        for color, zone in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerColorPlayZones[baseNum]) do
            zone.destruct()
        end
    end
    SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.playerColorPlayZones[baseNum] = nil                                       -- ... set this table equal to an empty table (these objects have all been destroyed; don't want to preserve references to null objects)

    if SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterZones[baseNum] then
        destroyObject(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterZones[baseNum])
        SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.monsterZones[baseNum] = nil
    end

    -- **remove any added discLights**
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.discLights[baseNum] then
        for color, discTable in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.discLights[baseNum]) do                               -- ... iterate through all GlowDiscs in the baseBlock...
            for discNum, disc in ipairs(discTable) do
                disc.destruct()                                                                                         -- ... and destroy them
            end
        end
    end
    SmashUp.GameObjects.discLights[baseNum] = nil                                                            -- ... set this table equal to an empty table (these objects have all been destroyed; don't want to preserve references to null objects)

    -- **remove and reset snapPoints on this extraBaseBlock**
    SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[baseNum].setSnapPoints({})                                   -- ... remove the snapPoints for this extraBaseBlock

    local resetSnapPoints = Global.getSnapPoints()
    resetSnapPoints[baseNum].tags={"Disabled"}                                                       -- ... reset the extraBaseBlocks base snapPoint back to "Disabled"
    Global.setSnapPoints(resetSnapPoints)

    -- **if the extraBaseBlock was solidified (it's status is no longer `phantom`), then reset the position of the scoreboard as well**
    if SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[baseNum] ~= "phantom" then
        SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.hideExtraScoreboard(baseNum)
    end

    -- **deactivate/turn off the extraBaseBlock
    SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[baseNum] = "off"

    -- **close the drawer for an extraBaseBlock that had a drawer
    if baseNum >= 9 then
        closeDrawer(baseNum)
    end
end



function ExtraBaseDocks.showPhantomZone()
    local phantomZoneNum = nil
    for i = 7, 14 do
        if SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[i] == "off" then
            phantomZoneNum = i
            break
        end
    end

    if phantomZoneNum and not SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles[phantomZoneNum].beingReplaced then
        local phantomBase = SmashUp.GameObjects.BaseObjects.extraBases[phantomZoneNum]      -- obtain a reference to the next extraBaseDock object stored in the GameObjects table
        SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus[phantomZoneNum] = "phantom"

        phantomBase.setColorTint({1, 1, 1, 0.5})                                               -- make the extraBaseDock visible, by setting its alpha channel to 1
        phantomBase.setPosition(phantomBase.getPosition() - Vector(0, 1000, 0))

        createPhantomScriptingZone(phantomBase, phantomZoneNum)                             -- call this function to spawn a ScriptingZone for the phantom base, that can be triggered to activate the phantom base
    end
end




--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FUNCTIONS RUN AT STARTUP (VIA ONLOAD)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ExtraBaseDocks.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib
end

return ExtraBaseDocks

end)
__bundle_register("Smash Up/TurnsSystem", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

local TurnsSystem = {}


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- MANAGING PLAYERS TURNS (SWITCHING OF AND ENDING TURNS)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function is called to transfer "the turn" to the next player; unhighlighting the previous players name, and highlighting the new player's name and giving the new player the sound notification
local function ghostPlayerCheck(turnNo, turnColor)
    local prevColor = nil

    if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNo].isGhostPlayer then
        local nonGhostNum = #Player.getPlayers()

        if nonGhostNum == 1 then
            local hostPlayer = SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getHost()
            prevColor = hostPlayer.color
            hostPlayer.changeColor(turnColor)

        else
            if SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount % nonGhostNum == 0 then

                local foundFirstPlayerAt = 0
                local firstGhostAt = 0

                local longestStretch = 0
                local colorsAreInOrder = 0

                for iter = 1, 2 do
                    for playerNum, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
                        if iter == 2 and playerNum == foundFirstPlayerAt then break end

                        if firstGhostAt == 0 then
                            if not Common.isInTable(playerInfo.color, SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) then
                                foundFirstPlayerAt = playerNum
                            end

                            if foundFirstPlayerAt > 0 then
                                if Common.isInTable(playerInfo.color, SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) then
                                    firstGhostAt = playerNum
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if firstGhostAt > 0 then
                            if Common.isInTable(playerInfo.color, SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) then
                                colorsAreInOrder = colorsAreInOrder + 1
                                if colorsAreInOrder > longestStretch then
                                    longestStretch = colorsAreInOrder
                                end
                            else
                                colorsAreInOrder = 0
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                local nextNonGhost = nil

                if longestStretch % nonGhostNum == 0 then
                    for nextNum = turnNo, SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount do
                        if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[nextNum].isGhostPlayer == false then
                            nextNonGhost = nextNum
                            break
                        end
                    end

                    if nextNonGhost == nil then
                        for nextNum = 1, turnNo - 1 do
                            if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[nextNum].isGhostPlayer == false then
                                nextNonGhost = nextNum
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                prevColor = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[nextNonGhost].color
                Player[prevColor].changeColor(turnColor)
            end
        end
    end
    return prevColor
end


local function setNextTurn(turnNo)
    if turnNo == 1 then
        UI.setClass("TurnRowHighlight"..(SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount), "TurnTealBorderFalse")
    else
        UI.setClass("TurnRowHighlight"..(turnNo - 1), "TurnTealBorderFalse")
    end

    UI.setClass("TurnRowHighlight"..turnNo, "TurnTealBorderTrue")

    SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNo].color

    if SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSystemEnabled then
        ghostPlayerCheck(turnNo, SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner)
    end

    UI.setAttribute("EndTurnButton", "visibility", SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner)

    Turns.turn_color = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner                                        -- set the turn to the color of the first player
    Turns.enable = false                                                                                    -- turns TTS turns system back off

    SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.turnNumber = SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.turnNumber + 1

    --TODO: re-institute this for my own save turn-by-turn rewind system
    -- SmashUp.SaveSystem.saveTurnStartState(SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.turnNumber)
end

-- this function is called when a player clicks the name of a player in the turns panel to switch the turn to that player
local function switchToClickedColor(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end
    if not playerInst.seated then return end

    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringActive == true then
        local color = playerInst.color
        broadcastToColor("Cannot pass turn while scoring a base.", color)
    else
        UI.setClass("TurnRowHighlight"..(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner]), "TurnTealBorderFalse")

        local turnNo = tonumber(buttonID:match("TurnLabel(.*)"))

        local color = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNo].color
        SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.manualTurnsTriggered[color] = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.manualTurnsTriggered[color] + 1

        setNextTurn(turnNo)
    end
end

-- this function gets called when a player clicks the "End Turn" button, dealing 2 cards to that player
local function endOfTurnClicked(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end
    if not playerInst.seated then return end

    local color = playerInst.color

    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker.scoringActive == true then
        broadcastToColor("Cannot end turn while scoring a base.", color)

    else
        SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.turnsTaken[color] = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.turnsTaken[color] + 1

        local nextTurnNo = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[color] + 1
        if nextTurnNo > SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount then
            nextTurnNo = 1
            SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.totalRoundsCompleted = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.totalRoundsCompleted + 1
        end
        SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.currentPlayerTurnNumber = nextTurnNo

        SmashUp.PlayerScores.scoreCheck()

        Wait.condition(function()
            if not SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameIsComplete then
                SmashUp.DealCards.draw2Cards(color)

                setNextTurn(nextTurnNo)
            end
        end, || SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.pauseScoringForTieResolution == false)
    end
end

-- this function is called when the gameplay actually begins to activate the homemade turns system, and display the turns panel
function TurnsSystem.turnTurnsOn()
    for turnOrderNo, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
        local color = playerInfo.color
        local colorTable = SmashUp.ColorTable[color]

        SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.turnsTaken[color] = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.turnsTaken[color] or 0
        SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.manualTurnsTriggered[color] = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.manualTurnsTriggered[color] or 0


        local playerName = Player[color].steam_name or color.." Player"

        UI.setAttribute("TurnRow"..turnOrderNo, "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("TurnLabel"..turnOrderNo, "text", playerName)
        UI.setAttribute("TurnLabel"..turnOrderNo, "colors", colorTable.base.."|"..colorTable.highlighted.."|"..colorTable.selected.."|"..colorTable.base)
    end

    setNextTurn(SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.currentPlayerTurnNumber)

    UI.setAttribute("TurnPanel", "active", "true")
end




--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SCORING A BASE PHASES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function is called when a player clicks the `pass` or `use special` buttons during the scoring a base phase
function TurnsSystem.setNextScoreTurn(turnNo)

    local prevTurnNo
    if SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.lastTurnColor and SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.lastTurnColor ~= "" then
        prevTurnNo = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring.lastTurnColor]
    else
        prevTurnNo = (turnNo == 1 and SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount) or (turnNo - 1)
    end

    UI.setClass("TurnRowSpecial"..prevTurnNo, "BaseTurnTabFalse")

    UI.setClass("TurnRowSpecial"..turnNo, "BaseTurnTabTrue")

    if SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSystemEnabled then
        local nextColor = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNo].color
        local prevColor = ghostPlayerCheck(turnNo, nextColor)

        if prevColor then
            SmashUp.BaseSettings.transferBaseSettingsPanelState(prevColor, nextColor)
        end
    end
end

-- this function is called when the base scoring phase starts to activate the scoring-a-base sub-turns system
function TurnsSystem.scoringBaseTurnsOn(color)
    local currentTurnNo = tonumber(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[color])

    for turnNo = 1, SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount do
        UI.setClass("TurnRowSpecial"..turnNo, "BaseTurnTabFalse")
    end

    TurnsSystem.setNextScoreTurn(currentTurnNo)
end

-- this function turns the scoring-a-base sub-turns system off when a base completes scoring
function TurnsSystem.scoringBaseTurnsOff()
    for turnNo = 1, SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount do
        UI.setClass("TurnRowSpecial"..turnNo, "BaseTurnTabOff")
    end
end




--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SCORING A BASE PHASES
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function is only called when the game is first loaded to establish some variables/tables
function TurnsSystem.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib

    _G["TurnsSystem.endOfTurnClicked"] = endOfTurnClicked
    _G["TurnsSystem.switchToClickedColor"] = switchToClickedColor
end

return TurnsSystem

end)
__bundle_register("Smash Up/SaveSystem", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

local SaveSystem = {}



local function captureGameObjects(snapshot)
    for _, object in ipairs(getObjects()) do
        local objType = object.type
        local objName = object.getName()
        local objGUID = object.getGUID()

        -- Filter objects by type and name
        if objType == "Card" or objType == "Deck" then
            -- Capture all cards and decks
           snapshot.objectData[objGUID] = {
               type = objType,
               name = objName,
               data = object.getJSON()
           }

        elseif objType == "Custom_Token" then
            -- Capture tokens numbered 7-14 and unnamed tokens
            if string.match(objName, "%d+") then
                local number = tonumber(string.match(objName, "%d+"))
                if number and number >= 7 then
                    snapshot.objectData[objGUID] = {
                        type = objType,
                        name = objName,
                        position = object.getPosition(),
                        rotation = object.getRotation(),
                    }
                end
            elseif objName == "" or objName == nil then
                -- Capture unnamed tokens (spawned from bags)
                snapshot.objectData[objGUID] = {
                    type = objType,
                    name = objName,
                    data = object.getJSON()
                }
            end

        elseif objType == "Custom_Assetbundle_Bag" then
            -- Capture all faction kits
            snapshot.objectData[objGUID] = {
                type = objType,
                name = objName,
                position = object.getPosition(),
                rotation = object.getRotation()
            }

        elseif objType == "Custom_Assetbundle" then
            -- Capture only Board Cabinets
            if string.find(objName, "Board Cabinet") then
                snapshot.objectData[objGUID] = {
                    type = objType,
                    name = objName,
                    state = object.getStateId()
                }
            end

        elseif objType == "Custom_Model" then
            -- Capture Goblin Coin and Extra Base boards
            if objName == "Goblin Coin" or string.find(objName, "Extra Base") then
                snapshot.objectData[objGUID] = {
                    type = objType,
                    name = objName,
                    position = object.getPosition(),
                    rotation = object.getRotation()
                }
            end

        elseif objType == "Custom_Tile" then
            -- Capture specific tiles (scoreboards 7-14)
            if string.find(objName, "Scoreboard") then
                local number = tonumber(string.match(objName, "%d+"))
                if number and number >= 7 then
                    snapshot.objectData[objGUID] = {
                        type = objType,
                        name = objName,
                        position = object.getPosition(),
                    }
                end
            end

        elseif objType == "ScriptingTrigger" then
            -- Capture only dynamically spawned zones from ExtraBaseBoards
            -- These are named BaseBlockZone7+, CardZone7+, BaseZone7+
            if string.find(objName, "BaseBlockZone") or string.find(objName, "CardZone") or string.find(objName, "BaseZone") then
                local number = tonumber(string.match(objName, "%d+"))
                if number and number >= 7 then
                    snapshot.objectData[objGUID] = {
                        type = objType,
                        name = objName,
                        data = object.getJSON()
                    }
                end
            end
        end
    end

    snapshot.objectData = JSON.encode(snapshot.objectData)
end


local function captureCurrentObjectStates()
    local objectStates = {}

    local function isExcluded(obj)
        local gm = obj.getGMNotes() or ""
        local desc = obj.getDescription() or ""

        if obj.type == "Board" then return true end
        if gm:find("Player Mat") then return true end
        if gm == "Base Mat" or gm == "Base Mat Button" then return true end
        if desc == "Rulebook" then return true end
        if gm:find("Madness Mat") or gm:find("Munchkin Mat") then return true end
        if obj.type == "Generic" and gm:find("Disc") then return true end
        if gm == "Smash Up Box" then return true end
        if obj.type == "Infinite" then return true end

        -- Scripting zones are excluded by default; handled explicitly below
        if obj.type == "Scripting" then return true end

        return false
    end

    local function push(key, entry)
        objectStates[key] = entry
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(getObjects()) do
        local objType = obj.type
        local name = obj.getName() or ""
        local gm = obj.getGMNotes() or ""
        local guid = obj.getGUID()

        -- include only specific dynamic scripting zones (mid-game)
        if objType == "Scripting" then
            local isExtraBaseDynamic =
                 (gm:find("BaseBlockZone") or gm:find("CardZone") or gm:find("BaseZone"))
                and (tonumber(gm:match("%d+") or "") or 0) >= 7

            if isExtraBaseDynamic then
                push(guid, {
                    kind = "DynamicZone",
                    guid = guid,
                    name = name,
                    gmnotes = gm,
                    data = obj.getJSON(),
                })
            end

        elseif not isExcluded(obj) then
            if objType == "Card" then
                push(guid, {
                    kind = "Card",
                    guid = guid,
                    position = obj.getPosition(),
                    rotation = obj.getRotation(),
                    cardId = obj.getCardID(),
                })

            elseif objType == "Deck" then
                local ids = {}
                for _, info in ipairs(obj.getObjects() or {}) do
                    if info.cardid then table.insert(ids, info.cardid) end
                end
                push(guid, {
                    kind = "Deck",
                    guid = guid,
                    position = obj.getPosition(),
                    rotation = obj.getRotation(),
                    cardIds = ids,
                })

            elseif objType == "Custom_Token" then
                local num = tonumber(string.match(name, "%d+"))
                if num and num >= 7 then
                    push(guid, {
                        kind = "TokenNumbered",
                        guid = guid,
                        name = name,
                        position = obj.getPosition(),
                        rotation = obj.getRotation(),
                    })
                elseif name == "" or name == nil then
                    local bagKey = gm
                    if bagKey ~= "" then
                        local synKey = "UnnamedToken|" .. bagKey .. "|" ..
                            string.format("%.3f,%.3f,%.3f", obj.getPosition().x, obj.getPosition().y, obj.getPosition().z)
                        push(synKey, {
                            kind = "UnnamedToken",
                            bagKey = bagKey,
                            position = obj.getPosition(),
                            rotation = obj.getRotation(),
                        })
                    end
                end

            elseif objType == "Custom_Assetbundle_Bag" then
                push(guid, {
                    kind = "AssetbundleBag",
                    guid = guid,
                    name = name,
                    position = obj.getPosition(),
                    rotation = obj.getRotation(),
                })

            elseif objType == "Custom_Assetbundle" and name:find("Board Cabinet") then
                push(guid, {
                    kind = "BoardCabinet",
                    guid = guid,
                    name = name,
                    state = obj.getStateId(),
                })

            elseif objType == "Custom_Model" and (name == "Goblin Coin" or name:find("Extra Base")) then
                push(guid, {
                    kind = "CustomModel",
                    guid = guid,
                    name = name,
                    position = obj.getPosition(),
                    rotation = obj.getRotation(),
                })

            elseif objType == "Custom_Tile" and name:find("Scoreboard") then
                local sn = tonumber(string.match(name, "%d+"))
                if sn and sn >= 7 then
                    push(guid, {
                        kind = "ScoreboardTile",
                        guid = guid,
                        name = name,
                        position = obj.getPosition(),
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return objectStates
end


function SaveSystem.saveTurnStartState(turnNumber)
    SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.newTurnStarted = true

    -- Create the turn snapshot
    local snapshot = {
        turnNumber = turnNumber,
        timestamp = os.time(),
        objectData = {},  -- We'll populate this in the next step
        gameState = {
            GameData = {
                TurnControl = SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl,
                BaseScoring = SmashUp.GameData.BaseScoring,
                GameStats = SmashUp.GameData.GameStats,
                SystemTrackers = Common.deepCopy(SmashUp.GameData.SystemTrackers),
                CleanUp = SmashUp.GameData.CleanUp,
                FinalScoring = SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring,
                UISetup = {General = Common.deepCopy(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General)},
            },
            GameBoard = SmashUp.GameBoard,
            baseBlockStatus = SmashUp.Bases.BaseScoreboards.baseBlockStatus,
            playersWithValidColors = SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlSetup.playersWithValidColors,
        }
    }

    -- Clean up data that shouldn't be saved
    snapshot.gameState.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[0] = nil
    snapshot.gameState.GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID = nil

    -- captureGameObjects(snapshot)

    -- Add to turn snapshots array
    table.insert(SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.turnSnapshots, snapshot)

    -- Implement 10-turn limit: remove oldest if we exceed max
    if #SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.turnSnapshots > SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.maxTurnSnapshots then
        table.remove(SmashUp.GameData.SaveSystem.turnSnapshots, 1)
    end
end


function SaveSystem.createRespawnSources(deckData, isCustom)
    if not deckData then return end

    local isCustom = isCustom or false

    SmashUp.GameObjects.RespawnSources.count = SmashUp.GameObjects.RespawnSources.count or 0
    SmashUp.GameObjects.RespawnSources.count = SmashUp.GameObjects.RespawnSources.count + 1

    local respawnKey
    if isCustom then
        local customID = SmashUp.CustomExtras.getCustomExtraID(deckData)
        respawnKey = "Custom_" .. customID
    else
        respawnKey = deckData.Nickname
    end

    local respawnSource = spawnObjectData({
        data = deckData,
        position = {-50 + (15 * (SmashUp.GameObjects.RespawnSources.count - 1)), 850, 100},
        rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        sound = false,
    })

    respawnSource.interactable = false
    respawnSource.setLock(true)
    respawnSource.addTag("RespawnSource")

    SmashUp.GameObjects.RespawnSources[respawnKey] = respawnSource
end


function SaveSystem.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib
end

return SaveSystem

end)
__bundle_register("Smash Up/PlayerScores", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

local PlayerScores = {}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CHECKING VICTORY POINT TOTALS AT END OF TURN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function displayCongrats()
    UI.setAttribute("TurnPanel", "active", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("EndTurnButton", "active", "false")

    SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameIsComplete = true
    SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameCompletionStatus = "Completed"
    SmashUp.GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.gameEnd = os.time()
    SmashUp.CleanUp.cleanUpTable()


    if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu == true then
        SmashUp.Madness.madnessCount()
    else
        SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessPenaltiesCompleted = true
    end

    local function vpSort(a, b)
        if SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu then
            if a.score == b.score then
                return SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessCardCount[a.color] > SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessCardCount[b.color]
            else
                return a.score > b.score
            end
        else
            return a.score > b.score
        end
    end

    Wait.condition(function()
        SmashUp.GameStats.collectResults(SmashUp.GameData)

        local scoreTable = {}

        for plyrColor, vp in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints) do
            table.insert(scoreTable, {["score"] = vp, ["color"] = plyrColor})
        end

        table.sort(scoreTable, vpSort)

        UI.setAttribute("CongratsWindow", "active", "true")
        Wait.frames(function()
            for place = 1, 3 do
                UI.setAttribute("VP_place"..place, "text", "")
                UI.setAttribute("VP_place"..place, "colors", "white|white|white|white")
                UI.setAttribute("WinnerName_place"..place, "text", "")
                UI.setAttribute("WinnerName_place"..place, "color", "gray")
            end

            SmashUp.GameObjects.soundCube.AssetBundle.playTriggerEffect(1)

            for place = 1, #scoreTable do
                local color = scoreTable[place].color
                local playerName = Player[color].steam_name or color.." Player"
                UI.setAttribute("VP_place"..place, "text", scoreTable[place].score)
                UI.setAttribute("VP_place"..place, "colors", color.."|"..color.."|"..color.."|"..color)
                UI.setAttribute("WinnerName_place"..place, "text", playerName)
                UI.setAttribute("WinnerName_place"..place, "color", color)
            end
        end, 5)
    end, || SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.madnessPenaltiesCompleted == true)
end



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- CHECKING VICTORY POINT TOTALS AT END OF TURN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function PlayerScores.scoreCheck()
    local winningScore = 0
    local isThereTie = false

    for plyrColor, vp in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints) do
        if vp >= 15 then
            if vp > winningScore then
                winningScore = vp
                isThereTie = false
            elseif vp == winningScore then
                isThereTie = true
            end
        end
    end

    if winningScore >= 15 then
        if isThereTie then
            if SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.tieCheckPanelBypass == false then
                SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.pauseScoringForTieResolution = true
                UI.setAttribute("NoSharing", "active", "true")
                printToAll("Player's have more than 15 VP, but there is a tie! Smash Up rules recommend everyone keeps playing until there is no tie.", {0, 1, 1})
                printToAll("Host is selecting to either continue playing, or ending game now.", {0, 1, 1})
            end
        else
            displayCongrats()
        end
    end
end



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FUNCTIONS FOR SETTING A PLAYER'S VICTORY POINTS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function PlayerScores.startingScores()
    for color in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do     -- for every color playing in this game...
        SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[color] = 0                -- ... set the starting VP of the player to 0
    end
end


function PlayerScores.addToScore(color, points, button, manual)
    if manual == nil then manual = false end

    local buttonColor = button.getName():match("^(.*)Score")

    if SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[buttonColor] then
        SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[buttonColor] = SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[buttonColor] + points

        if SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[buttonColor] < 0 then
            SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[buttonColor] = 0
            return
        elseif SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[buttonColor] > 100 then
            SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[buttonColor] = 100
            return
        end

        button.value = SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[buttonColor]
        button.editButton({
            label = button.value
        })

        if manual then
            -- local buttonColor = button.getName():match("^(.*)Score")
            local colorName
            if color == buttonColor then
                colorName = "their"
            else
                colorName = buttonColor.."'s"
            end

            if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then
                local playerName = Player[color].steam_name or color.." Player"
                printToAll("["..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."]"..playerName.." [FFFFFF]has manually adjusted ["..SmashUp.ColorTable[buttonColor].hex.."]"..colorName.." [FFFFFF]score.")
            end
        end
    end
end


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FUNCTIONS FOR EACH PLAYERS' SCORE TILE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function createPlayerScoreButtons()
    for color, scoreTile in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerScoreTiles) do
        scoreTile.value = SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints[color] or 0
        scoreTile.createButton({
            scale={2, 2, 2},
            label = scoreTile.value,
            function_owner = Global,
            click_function="PlayerScores.playerScoreClicked",
            position={0, 0.055, 0.1},
            width=800,
            height=800,
            font_size=600,
            font_color={1, 1, 1, 100},
            color={0,0,0,0}
        })
        scoreTile.tooltip = false
    end
end


function PlayerScores.playerScoreClicked(button, color, altClick)

    local hover_object = Player[color].getHoverObject()
    if hover_object ~= button then return end

    local deltaNum = altClick and -1 or 1

    if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupComplete then
        PlayerScores.addToScore(color, deltaNum, button, true)
    end
end




local function closePanel(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end
    UI.setAttribute("CongratsWindow", "active", "false")
end


local function noSharingButtonClicked(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end

    UI.setAttribute("NoSharing", "active", "false")
    if buttonID == "TieFinishNow" then
        displayCongrats()
    elseif buttonID == "TieKeepPlaying" then
        SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.tieCheckPanelBypass = true
    end

    SmashUp.GameData.FinalScoring.pauseScoringForTieResolution = false
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FUNCTIONS FOR EACH PLAYERS' SCORE TILE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function is only run when the game is first run to establish variables and spawn game assets
function PlayerScores.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib

    _G["PlayerScores.playerScoreClicked"] = PlayerScores.playerScoreClicked
    _G["PlayerScores.closePanel"] = closePanel
    _G["PlayerScores.noSharingButtonClicked"] = noSharingButtonClicked
    createPlayerScoreButtons()
end

return PlayerScores

end)
__bundle_register("Smash Up/DealCards", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

local DealCards = {}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FUNCTIONS USED TO DEAL 2 CARDS AND CHECK HAND COUNT, AND RE-SHUFFLE DISCARD PILE IF NEEDED
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function handCountCheck(color)
    local handZone = SmashUp.GameObjects.HandZones[color]
    if #handZone.getObjects() > 10 then
        local discardNum = #handZone.getObjects() - 10
        local playerName = Player[color].steam_name or color.." Player"
        printToAll("["..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."]"..playerName.." [FFFFFF]now has more than 10 cards in their hand.")
        if Player[color].seated then
            broadcastToColor("You have more than 10 cards. Please discard "..discardNum..((discardNum == 1 and " card.") or " cards."), color)
        end
    end
end


function DealCards.draw2Cards(color)
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Draw"] == null then
        SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Draw"] = nil
    end

    local playerDrawDeck = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Draw"]

    if playerDrawDeck then
        if (not playerDrawDeck.is_face_down) then
            local deckRotation = playerDrawDeck.getRotation()
            deckRotation.z = 180
            playerDrawDeck.setRotation(deckRotation)
        end
        local drawZone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[color].draw
        local isInBounds = SmashUp.checkInBounds(drawZone, playerDrawDeck)

        if not isInBounds then
            playerDrawDeck.removeTag("Sorting")
            SmashUp.TrackCardDecks.repositionDroppedDecks(drawZone, playerDrawDeck)
        end
    end


    local countCheckCountDown = 0.8

    if playerDrawDeck ~= nil and playerDrawDeck.getQuantity() >= 2 then
        playerDrawDeck.deal(2, color)
    else
        countCheckCountDown = 2.5

        local stillNeedToDraw = 2 - ((playerDrawDeck == nil or playerDrawDeck == null) and 0 or 1)
        if playerDrawDeck ~= nil then
            playerDrawDeck.deal(1, color)
            SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Draw"] = nil
        end

        -- **This local function is defined here. It is then passed as a parameter when `cleanUpPlayerSortPiles` is called**
        -- **This function takes the discardPile and shuffles it and moves it into the drawPile**
        -- local function shuffleDiscard(playerDiscardPile, firstCard, lastCard, playerMat)
        local function shuffleDiscard(playerDiscardPile, playerMat)
            Wait.condition(function()
                if playerDiscardPile == nil then return end

                if playerDiscardPile then
                    local dealRotation = (Common.isInTable(color, {"Green", "Yellow", "Orange"}) and 0) or 180

                    Wait.condition(function()
                        if playerDiscardPile == nil then return end
                        playerDiscardPile.shuffle()                                                                                         -- ... shuffle the discard pile
                        playerDiscardPile.shuffle()                                                                                         -- ... shuffle the discard pile
                        playerDiscardPile.setRotation({0, dealRotation, 180})                                                               -- ... rotate the discard pile to be face down
                        playerDiscardPile.setPositionSmooth(playerMat.positionToWorld(playerMat.getSnapPoints()[1].position), false, false) -- ... move the discard pile to the draw pile

                        SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Discard"] = nil
                        SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerDecks[color:lower().."Draw"] = nil
                    end, || SmashUp.GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked == false)

                    Wait.condition(function()
                        if playerDiscardPile == nil then return end

                        playerDiscardPile.interactable = true
                        playerDiscardPile.deal(stillNeedToDraw, color)

                    end, || not playerDiscardPile.isDestroyed() and playerDiscardPile.resting)
                end
            end, || playerDiscardPile.isDestroyed() or playerDiscardPile.resting, 3)
        end

        Wait.time(function()
            SmashUp.CleanUp.cleanUpPlayerSortPiles(color, shuffleDiscard)
        end, 0.25)
    end

    Wait.time(function()
        handCountCheck(color)
    end, countCheckCountDown)
end



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FUNCTIONS THAT ACCESS OBJECT DATA, AND THEN SPAWN AND DEAL OUT CARDS AND CREATE DECKS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function spawns a deck of cards from object data, or adds more cards to an existing deck
local function createDeck(deckObj, deckData, deckPos, deckRot, isCustom)
    local isCustom = isCustom or false

    if deckObj then                                                 -- if the deck object already exists...
        deckObj.putObject(spawnObjectData(                          -- ... then spawn the next deck object, and put it into the existing deck...
            {
                data = deckData                                         -- ... using the table passed here as sourceTable (and removing it from the sourceTable), at the sourceIndex location
            }
        ))
    else                                                            -- otherwise, if the deck object doesn't exist yet...
        deckObj = spawnObjectData(                                  -- ... spawn the deck object...
            {
                data = deckData,                                        -- ... using the table passed here as sourceTable, at the sourceIndex location
                position = deckPos,                                     -- ... spawn it at the position passed here as deckPos
                rotation = deckRot                                      -- ... with the proper rotation, as passed here as deckRot
            }
        )
    end

    --TODO: this is part of my turn-by-turn rewind system; on hold for now.
    -- SmashUp.SaveSystem.createRespawnSources(deckData, isCustom)

    return deckObj                                                  -- return the spawned deck object
end



local function dealTitans(titanRot)
    for color, titanList in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.titanCardsForEachPlayer) do
        local mat = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerMats[color]                       -- ... obtain a reference to the player's Player Mat...
        local titanPos = {
            mat.positionToWorld(mat.getSnapPoints()[3].position) + Vector(0, 0.5, 0),
            mat.positionToWorld(mat.getSnapPoints()[4].position) + Vector(0, 0.5, 0)
        }

        for i, titanData in ipairs(titanList) do

            })
            SmashUp.GameObjects.board.UI.setAttribute(color.."_Titan"..tostring(i), "active", "true")
        end
    end

-- this function is called to spawn each drafted faction deck, and deal them out to the corresponding player
local function dealFactions(boxData)
    if SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["randomSelectionOption"] == false then     -- if any draft-style options were selected (as opposed to the random selection option)...
        for _, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do                                   -- ... then, for every player in the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table...
            playerInfo.factionsPicked = playerInfo.factionsDrafted                                          -- ... set the player's factionsPicked table equal to the factionsDrafted table
        end                                                                                                 -- (this allows this function to only have to deal with one table to find each player's factions)
    end

    local spawnTheseCustomExtras = {}

    local posX = 77.00                                                                              -- set the starting x-position for spawning the faction's kit object
    local posY = 2.3                                                                                -- set the starting y-position for spawning the faction's kit object
    local posZ = 27.00                                                                              -- set the starting z-position for spawning the faction's kit object
    local deckRot                                                                                   -- ... establish this vector variable (used to set the rotation of a deck based on what side of the table a player is on)

    --**************************************************************************
    --** GET INDIVIDUAL BASES FOR DRAFTED BASES
    --**************************************************************************
    if SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftComplete then
        local nudge = 0
        for playerNum, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do

            for factionNum, pickedBases in ipairs(playerInfo.basesPicked) do

                for kitNum = #boxData, 1, -1 do
                    local kitData = boxData[kitNum]

                    if kitData.Nickname == pickedBases.." Kit" then
                        for deckNum = #kitData.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do
                            local deckData = kitData.ContainedObjects[deckNum]
                            if deckData.Nickname == pickedBases.." Bases" then
                                table.insert(SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.eachDraftedFactionsBaseCards, table.remove(kitData.ContainedObjects, deckNum))
                            end
                        end

                        local kitBox = spawnObjectData(
                            {
                                data = table.remove(boxData, kitNum),
                                position = Vector(posX + nudge, posY, posZ),
                                rotation = Vector(0, 180, 0)
                            }
                        )
                        nudge = nudge + 5
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        posZ = posZ - 8
    end

    --**************************************************************************
    --** GET DRAFTED FACTIONS FROM THE BOX

    for playerNum, playerInfo in ipairs(SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do                       -- for each player in the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table...

        if playerColor == "Red" or playerColor == "Purple" or playerColor == "Blue" then            -- ... if the player color is red, purple, or blue then...

        end

        SmashUp.GameData.Customs.playerFactionSpecificExtraCounts[playerColor] = SmashUp.CustomExtras.calculatePlayerFactionSpecificExtraCounts(playerInfo.factionsPicked)

        for factionNum, pickedFaction in ipairs(playerInfo.factionsPicked) do                       -- ... for each faction that has been picked by the player...
            -- check the factionTable database to see if the pickedFaction is a custom one or not
            local customExpansion = nil
            local isCustom = false

            if SmashUp.Database.factionTable[pickedFaction].custom then
                customExpansion = SmashUp.Database.factionTable[pickedFaction].customExpansion
                isCustom = true
            end

            factionName = pickedFaction:match("^(.*) %*%&%^%*") or pickedFaction

            for kitNum = #boxData, 1, -1 do                                                             -- ... look at every factionKit in the SmashUpBigBox...
                local kitData = boxData[kitNum]

                -- **found the faction-specific kit**
                if kitData.Nickname == factionName.." Kit" then                                           -- ... and if the factionKit's nickname equals the picked faction...
                    SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.expansionsIncludedThisGame[kitData.Description] = true                                 -- ... add the name of the expansion of the chosen faction as a unique key to this table (to track which expansions are being played from). This table tracks which expansions are used in the match.

                    -- **now, iterate over every object in the kitBox
                    for deckNum = #kitData.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do                                           -- ... iterating through each "object" contained in the factionKit backwards...
                        local deckData = kitData.ContainedObjects[deckNum]                                          -- ... set this deckData variable equal to the currently iterated object data in the factionKit

                        -- **found the specific faction deck**
                        if deckData.Nickname == factionName then                                                  -- ... if the name of the deck (in the factionKit) equals the picked faction...
                            for _, cardData in ipairs(deckData.ContainedObjects) do                                     -- ... for every card in the faction deck...
                                table.insert(cardData.Tags, playerColor)                                                    -- ... add the player color as a tag to the card
                            end
                            factionDeck = createDeck(factionDeck, table.remove(kitData.ContainedObjects, deckNum), deckPos, deckRot, isCustom)  -- ... call this function to spawn the faction deck from its data

                            if factionName == "Backtimers" then
                                local stasisBag = SmashUp.GameObjects.tokenBags["Stasis Counters"]
                                local tile = SmashUp.GameObjects.PlayerScoreTiles[playerColor]
                                local bagPos = tile.getPosition()
                                local nudge = 4.5
                                if playerColor == "Red" or playerColor == "Purple" or playerColor == "Blue" then
                                    nudge = -4.5
                                end

                                stasisBag.setPosition(bagPos + Vector(nudge, 0, 0))
                            end

                        -- **found the bases for this faction**
                        elseif deckData.Nickname == factionName.." Bases" then                                    -- ... elseif the deck in the factionKit is the faction's base deck...
                            if isCustom then
                                SmashUp.GameData.Customs.draftedCustomFactions[pickedFaction] = true
                                table.remove(kitData.ContainedObjects, deckNum)

                            else
                                table.insert(SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.eachDraftedFactionsBaseCards, table.remove(kitData.ContainedObjects, deckNum))        -- ... add the base deck data to the factionBases table. This table stores object data for each chosen factions' base cards
                            end

                            if customExpansion ~= nil and customExpansion ~= "" then
                                SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customExpansionsUsed[customExpansion] = true
                            end


                        -- **found the titan for this faction**
                        elseif deckData.Description == "Titan" then                                                 -- ... elseif the "deck" in the factionKit is the faction's Titan card...
                            SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.titanCardsForEachPlayer[playerColor] = SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.titanCardsForEachPlayer[playerColor] or {}               -- ... make sure the playerColor key for the TableSetup.titanCardsForEachPlayer table is established
                            table.insert(SmashUp.GameData.TableSetup.titanCardsForEachPlayer[playerColor], table.remove(kitData.ContainedObjects, deckNum))   -- ... add the Titan card data to the TableSetup.titanCardsForEachPlayer table (after removing it first from the full data table)
                        end
                    end

                    if isCustom then
                        SmashUp.CustomExtras.spawnFactionSpecificCustomExtras(pickedFaction, playerColor, kitData)

                        if SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.general[pickedFaction] then
                            for extraID, extraData in pairs(SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.general[pickedFaction]) do
                                spawnTheseCustomExtras[extraData.name.." *&^* "..extraData.creator] = {extraID = extraID, discardMode = extraData.extraDiscarding}
