local function setBanSettingsTable()
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings = {         -- create the banSettings table. Initiate it with these settings...
        ["bansActivated"] = false,              -- ... ban activated is false
        ["toggleOption_A"] = 1,                 -- ... the 1st toggleOptions default is the first toggle
        ["toggleOption_B"] = 1,                 -- ... the 2nd toggleOptions default is the first toggle
        ["toggleOption_C"] = 1,                 -- ... the 3rd toggleOptions default is the first toggle
        ["banPhaseCount"] = 1,                  -- ... one ban phase is chosen at default
        ["firstPhase"] = "",
        ["banTurnOrder"] = {},
    }
end


local function finalizeBanTurnOrder()
    local banTable = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings
    banTable.banTurnOrder = {}

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.bansActivated then

        for banNum = 1, banTable.banPhaseCount do
            table.insert(banTable.banTurnOrder, {})
        end
        if banTable.banPhaseCount == 1 then
            if banTable.toggleOption_B == 2 then
                banTable.banTurnOrder[1].phase = "midDraft"
            else
                banTable.banTurnOrder[1].phase = "preDraft"
            end
            banTable.banTurnOrder[1].start = banTable.toggleOption_A == 1 and "first" or "last"

        elseif banTable.banPhaseCount == 2 then
            if banTable.toggleOption_B == 2 then
                banTable.banTurnOrder[1].phase = "preDraft"
                banTable.banTurnOrder[2].phase = "midDraft"
            else
                banTable.banTurnOrder[1].phase = "preDraft"
                banTable.banTurnOrder[2].phase = "preDraft"
            end
            banTable.banTurnOrder[1].start = banTable.toggleOption_A == 1 and "first" or "last"
            banTable.banTurnOrder[2].start = (banTable.toggleOption_C == 1 and (banTable.toggleOption_A == 1 and "first" or "last")) or (banTable.toggleOption_C == 2 and (banTable.toggleOption_A == 1 and "last" or "first"))
        end
    end
end


-- this function will make interactable, or uninteractable, the ban options panel elements, based on the status of the `bans allowed?` toggle
-- this function also changes what is interactable and not based on what stage of drafting/banning the players are in
function OptionsPanel.updateBanElements(countVal)
    local countVal = countVal or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banPhaseCount                              -- set this local variable equal to the inputField value passed via the parameter, or equal to what is saved in the banPhaseCount variable if nothing is passed

    if GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer == 3 and
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["openDraftOption"] == false and
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"] == false then                       -- if factionsPerPlayer equals 3 and the draftMethod is a straight or snake draft...
        UI.setAttribute("banInputLabel", "text", "How many ban phases? (only enough factions for 1)")       -- ... then change the inputField label text to indicate that only 1 ban phase is available...
        GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.maxBanRounds = 1                                                                            -- ... and set the maximum # of bans available to 1
    else                                                                                                    -- otherwise...
        UI.setAttribute("banInputLabel", "text", "How many ban phases? (between 1 and 2)")                  -- ... ensure (or reset) the inputField lable text to indicate up to 2 ban phases are available...
        GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.maxBanRounds = 2                                                                            -- ... and set the maximum # of bans available to 2
    end

    local firstDrafter = GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstDraftTurnColor]
    local lastDrafter = ((firstDrafter - 1) > 0) and (firstDrafter - 1) or GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount

    local isBanUsable                                                                                       -- initiate this local variable
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["straightDraftOption"] == true and
    GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[firstDrafter].factionsDrafted[2] then                                         -- if the first player in a straight draft has banned a 2nd faction (meaning a 2nd ban phase was initiated)...
        isBanUsable = false                                                                                 -- ... then set the isBanUsable variable to FALSE
    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["snakeDraftOption"] == true and
    GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[lastDrafter].factionsDrafted[2] then                                          -- if the last player in a snake draft has banned a 2nd faction (meaning a 2nd ban phase was initiated)...
        isBanUsable = false                                                                                 -- ... then set the isBanUsable variable to FALSE
    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"] == true then
        isBanUsable = false
    else                                                                                                    -- otherwise, if a 2nd ban phase has NOT been started...
        isBanUsable = true                                                                                  -- ... then set isBanusable to TRUE
    end

    UI.setAttribute("banAllow", "interactable", "true")                                                     -- make sure the "banAllow" toggle at the top of the banOptions panel is usable
    UI.setAttribute("banOK", "interactable", "true")                                                        -- make sure the "OK" button on the banOptions panel is usable
    if countVal == 1 then                                                                                   -- if one ban phase is chosen, then change the text of the toggleOptions appropriately
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3_text", "text", "Ban phase occurs before the first draft phase.")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4_text", "text", "Ban phase occurs between the first and second drafts.")
    elseif countVal == 2 then                                                                               -- if two ban phases are chosen, then change the text of the toggleOptions to reflect it
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3_text", "text", "Both ban phases occur before the first draft phase.")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4_text", "text", "Ban phases occur before each corresponding draft phase.")
    end

    if GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[firstDrafter].factionsBanned[1] then                                       -- if the first player has started the first ban phase (has banned their 1st faction)...
        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banAllow"] == false then                            -- ... and if the host tries to disable ban phases (unclicks the "banAllow" toggle)...
            XMLUI.xmlFunctions.updateToggleStatus("banAllow", "optionToggles")                                        -- ... then call the updateToggleStatus function to change the "banAllow" toggle status back to TRUE...
            PlayerFunctions.getHost().broadcast("Ban phases have already been started; cannot disable them.")   -- ... and broadcast this message to the host
        end
    end

    if isBanUsable and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banAllow"] == true then                  -- if isBanUsable is true and the "banAllow" toggle is clicked to ON...
        UI.setAttribute("banOption1", "interactable", "true")                                                       -- ... set all the elements in the panel to an "active" state
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2", "interactable", "true")                                                       -- ... set all the elements in the panel to an "active" state
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "interactable", "true")                                                       -- ... set all the elements in the panel to an "active" state
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "interactable", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5", "interactable", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6", "interactable", "true")

        UI.setAttribute("banOption1_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6_text", "color", "black")

        UI.setAttribute("banInputLabel", "color", "Black")
        UI.setAttribute("banInput", "interactable", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("banSlider", "interactable", "true")

    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"] == true then
        UI.setAttribute("banOption1", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6", "interactable", "false")

        UI.setAttribute("banOption1_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5_text", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6_text", "color", "black")

        UI.setAttribute("banInputLabel", "color", "Black")
        UI.setAttribute("banInput", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banSlider", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banAllow", "interactable", "false")

    else                                                                                                    -- otherwise (if isBanUsable is false or "banAllow" toggle is unclicked/OFF)...
        UI.setAttribute("banOption1", "interactable", "false")                                              -- ... set all the elements in the panel to an "inactive" state
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2", "interactable", "false")                                              -- ... set all the elements in the panel to an "inactive" state
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "interactable", "false")                                              -- ... set all the elements in the panel to an "inactive" state
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6", "interactable", "false")

        UI.setAttribute("banOption1_text", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2_text", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3_text", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4_text", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5_text", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6_text", "color", "gray")

        UI.setAttribute("banInputLabel", "color", "Gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banInput", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banSlider", "interactable", "false")
        if not isBanUsable then                                                                             -- ... in addition, if isBanUsable is false...
            UI.setAttribute("banAllow", "interactable", "false")                                                -- ... set the "banAllow" toggle to be unusable...
            UI.setAttribute("banOK", "interactable", "false")                                                   -- ... and set the "OK" button to be unusable
        end
    end

    if GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[firstDrafter].factionsBanned[2] or GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[lastDrafter].factionsBanned[2] then
        UI.setAttribute("banOption1", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption1", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5", "isOn", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_C == 1)

    elseif GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[firstDrafter].factionsDrafted[1] then                                      -- ... and the first player has already started drafting (has drafted their first faction)...

                UI.setAttribute("banInputLabel", "text", "How many ban phases? (can only add 1 at this time)")          -- ... set the inputField label text to indicate that only one ban phase is allowed at this time...

                UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "isOn", "true")                                                           -- ... set the bottom toggleButton's status to on...
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption4"] = true                                 -- ... and save its status in the toggleTracker table...
                UI.setAttribute("toggleGroupC", "active", "false")

            elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.firstPhase == "ban" then
                if countVal == 1 then
                    UI.setAttribute("banInput", "text", "1")                                                                -- ... set the inputField text value to "1"...
                    UI.setAttribute("banSlider", "value", "1")                                                              -- ... set the slider value to "1"...
                    UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "isOn", "true")                                                          -- ... and set the topmost toggleButton's status to off...

                    UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "color", "gray")
                    UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "isOn", "false")                                                           -- ... set the bottom toggleButton's status to on...
                    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption4"] = false                                 -- ... and save its status in the toggleTracker table...

                    UI.setAttribute("banSlider", "value", "2")                                                              -- ... set the slider value to "1"...
                    UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "interactable", "false")                                                  -- ... make the topmost toggleButton in the group unusable...

                    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption4"] = true                                 -- ... and save its status in the toggleTracker table...

                end

            UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "isOn", "true")                                                           -- ... set the bottom toggleButton's status to on...
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption4"] = true                                 -- ... and save its status in the toggleTracker table...
            UI.setAttribute("toggleGroupC", "active", "false")
        end

    elseif GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[firstDrafter].factionsBanned[1] then                                       -- ... and if the first player has already started banning (has banned their first faction)...
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.firstPhase = "ban"
        UI.setAttribute("banOption1", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption1", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2", "color", "gray")

        if countVal == 1 then                                                                                   -- ... and if the number of bans selected is "1"...

            UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "color", "gray")                                                          -- ... and set its color to gray...
            UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "isOn", "true")                                                           -- ... set the topmost toggleButtons status to true...
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption3"] = true                                 -- ... save the toggleButton's status in the toggleTracker table...
            UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "isOn", "false")                                                          -- ... set the bottom toggleButton's status to off...

        elseif countVal == 2 then                                                                               -- ... if the number of bans selected is "2"...
            UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "interactable", "true")                                                   -- ... set the bottom toggleButton to be usuable...
            UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "color", "black")                                                         -- ... and set its color to black
        end
    end
end


-- this function is called when the `Cancel` button is clicked, or when the DraftSelectionPanel is being fully reset (via UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetFullFactionSelectionSystem function in the FactionPickingGeneral file)
-- this function resets the banSettings panel to previously set settings, or to defaults when fully reset
function OptionsPanel.banCancel()
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["openBanPanel"] = false                                      -- clicking cancel should close ("toggle off") the ban options panel, so update this variable to false...
    UI.setAttribute("banOptionsFrame", "active", "false")                                                           -- ... and deactivate the ban options panel

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banAllow"] = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.bansActivated      -- change the `ban allow` toggle back to it's saved status (using the banSettings table)
    UI.setAttribute("banAllow", "isOn", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.bansActivated)                                  -- explicitly update the `ban allow` toggle's `isOn` attribute according to the saved status

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_A == 1 then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption1"] = true
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption2"] = false
        UI.setAttribute("banOption1", "isOn", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2", "isOn", "false")
    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_A == 2 then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption1"] = false
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption2"] = true
        UI.setAttribute("banOption1", "isOn", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption2", "isOn", "true")
    end

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_B == 1 then                                                       -- if the first option in the toggle group is selected...
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption3"] = true                                     -- ... update the toggleTracker table accordingly (first toggle is true, second toggle is false)..
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption4"] = false
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "isOn", "true")                                                               -- ... then explicitly update the toggles' `isOn` attributes
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "isOn", "false")
    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_B == 2 then                                                   -- else, if the second option in the toggle group is selected...
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption3"] = false                                    -- ... update the toggleTracker table accordingly (first toggle is false, second toggle is true)..
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption4"] = true
        UI.setAttribute("banOption3", "isOn", "false")                                                              -- ... then explicitly update the toggles' `isOn` attributes
        UI.setAttribute("banOption4", "isOn", "true")
    end

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_C == 1 then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption5"] = true
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption6"] = false
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5", "isOn", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6", "isOn", "false")
    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_C == 2 then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption5"] = false
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption6"] = true
        UI.setAttribute("banOption5", "isOn", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("banOption6", "isOn", "true")
    end

    OptionsPanel.updateBanInput(_, XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banPhaseCount, _)                                -- call this function to visually reset the ban options slider and inputField to their saved values
end

-- this function is called when the `OK` button the ban options panel is clicked
function OptionsPanel.banOK()
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.bansActivated = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banAllow"]                                  -- save the toggle state of the `bans allowed` toggle in this banSettings tracking table

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption1"] == true then XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_A = 1 end         -- save the states of the ban togglegroup's toggles in the banSettings table
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption2"] == true then XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_A = 2 end
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption3"] == true then XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_B = 1 end
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption4"] == true then XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_B = 2 end
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption5"] == true then XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_C = 1 end
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["banOption6"] == true then XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_C = 2 end

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banPhaseCount = tonumber(UI.getAttribute("banSlider", "value"))                                                 -- save the value of the ban inputField/slider in the banSettings table

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["openBanPanel"] = false                                                                      -- clicking OK should close the ban options panel, so track this status (which is now false) in the toggleTracker table...
    UI.setAttribute("banOptionsFrame", "active", "false")                                                                                           -- ... and deactivate the ban options panel

    local firstDrafter = GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstDraftTurnColor]
    local lastDrafter = ((firstDrafter - 1) > 0) and (firstDrafter - 1) or GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount

    finalizeBanTurnOrder()

    if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftInProgress then XMLUI.DraftSelectionPanel.banPhaseCheck() end                                                                     -- and run the banPhaseCheck function to determine if players are in a draft or ban phase based on the adjustments made here, and show the appropriate popup
end

-- this function is called when the ban options panel's slider or inputField are changed
-- it updates the appearance of the ban options panel's appearance based on the input
function OptionsPanel.updateBanInput(playerInst, countVal, inputID)
    local countVal = tonumber(countVal)                                         -- ensure this variable is a number/value

    if countVal ~= nil then                                                     -- as long as the value of the ban option's inputField/slider isn't nil...
        if countVal  < 1 then                                                   -- ... if the inputField box received a number less than 1...
            countVal = 1                                                            -- ... then change the value to 1
        elseif countVal > GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.maxBanRounds then                                     -- ... if the inputField box received a number higher than the maximum number of bans...
            countVal = GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.maxBanRounds                                                 -- ... then change the value to the maximum number of bans allowed
            if GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer == 3 then                                 -- ... if there are only 3 factions per player in the pool then tell the host that only 1 ban phase can be selected
                PlayerFunctions.getHost().broadcast("Not enough factions in the pool to allow for more than 1 ban phase.")
            else                                                                    -- ... otherwise, remind the host that there is a maximum of 2 ban phases allowed

        UI.setAttribute("banInput", "text", countVal)                           -- ... update the inputField's text to be equal to the slider's value

-- this function needs to be called whenever the choice of draft method is changed or the color chosen to go first is changed
function OptionsPanel.initializeBanPanel()
    setBanSettingsTable()

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"] == true then
        for banKey, value in pairs({
            ["bansActivated"] = true,
            ["toggleOption_A"] = 1,
            ["toggleOption_B"] = 1,
            ["toggleOption_C"] = 1,
            ["banPhaseCount"] = 2,
        }) do
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings[banKey] = value
        end
        OptionsPanel.banCancel()

        finalizeBanTurnOrder()
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["openBanPanel"] = true
        UI.setAttribute("banOptionsFrame", "active", "true")
    else
        OptionsPanel.banCancel()
    end

    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetBanPanel = false
end



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ALL OPTION PANEL FUNCTIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function is called when any of the the faction picking/drafting UI Panels are being prepared
-- this function creates tables that will track the settings set in any of the "Options Panels"
function OptionsPanel.prepareOptionSettingsTable()

    setRedrawSettingsTable()
    setBanSettingsTable()
end

-- this function is called whenever the `allowed` toggle is clicked
function OptionsPanel.onOptionAllowToggled(playerInst, toggleID, newToggleStatus)
    if toggleID == "redrawAllow" then updateRedrawElements(newToggleStatus) end     -- call this function using the updated status of the toggle, to activate or deactivate the redraw panel's elements
    if toggleID == "banAllow" then OptionsPanel.updateBanElements() end             -- call this function to activate or deactivate the ban panel's elements
end

-- this function is called when the "Redraws" or "Ban Phase" buttons are clicked, to open their respective panels
function OptionsPanel.openSettingsPanel(playerInst, buttonID)
    local panelType = string.lower(string.match(buttonID, "open(%a+)Panel"))        -- using the ID of the button that was clicked, determine which type of panel to open
    local frameName = panelType.."OptionsFrame"                                     -- using the panelType identified above, identify the name of the panel to open

    local buttonStatus = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"][buttonID]      -- identify the status of the panel's button/toggle: is it opened or closed?

    buttonStatus = not buttonStatus                                                 -- switch the status of the panel's button/toggle to open or closed

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"][buttonID] = buttonStatus            -- update the new status of the panel's button/toggle in the toggleTracker table

    UI.setAttribute(frameName, "active", buttonStatus)                              -- open/activate or close/deactivate the panel depending on the new status of the panel's button/toggle

    if buttonStatus == false then                                                   -- if the panel is now closed, call the cancel function. Closing the panel by clicking the button again, without clicking OK, should function like a cancel
        OptionsPanel[panelType.."Cancel"]()
    end
end

function OptionsPanel.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib
    XMLUI = SmashUp.XMLUI
    GameData = SmashUp.GameData
    PlayerFunctions = SmashUp.PlayerFunctions
end

return OptionsPanel

end)

            function()

                    return true
                elseif SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.arrow ~= nil and coroutine.status(bounceAnimate) == "dead" then

                    return false

local function editsCompleted(webR)
    GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable = JSON.decode(webR.text)

    broadcastToAll("Changes applied successfully!")

    local shortTab = GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable

    --Gather all the new/edited object data into one table
    local editedEntry = {
        shortTab.rowID,
        shortTab.objName,
        shortTab.objExpansion ~= nil and shortTab.objExpansion or "",
        shortTab.objCreator,
        "",
        shortTab.addedByUserID,
        "",
        "",
        shortTab.deckDescription ~= nil and shortTab.deckDescription or "",
        shortTab.imageLink ~= nil and shortTab.imageLink or "",
        shortTab.uploadDate,

        shortTab.objData and shortTab.objData[1] and JSON.decode(shortTab.objData[1]) or "",
        shortTab.objData and shortTab.objData[2] and JSON.decode(shortTab.objData[2]) or "",
        shortTab.objData and shortTab.objData[3] and JSON.decode(shortTab.objData[3]) or "",
    }

    local objClass
    local subTable
    local rowID = shortTab.rowID

    if rowID:sub(1,1) == "A" then
        objClass = "faction"
        subTable = "allFactions"
        editedEntry[5] = shortTab.difficulty
        editedEntry[7] = shortTab.publicSharing
        editedEntry[8] = shortTab.linkedExtras

    else
        objClass = "extra"
        subTable = "allExtras"
        editedEntry[5] = shortTab.explicitFactionNames
        editedEntry[7] = shortTab.objType
        editedEntry[8] = shortTab.allAssociatedFactions
    end

    --Make the necessary changes to the allWorksheetData table based on if an object was edited or deleted
    local editedEntryFound = false

    table.sort(GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData.allFactions,
        function(a, b)
            if a[1] == "ID #" then
                return true
            elseif b[1] == "ID #" then
                return false
            else
                return a[1] < b[1]
            end
        end
    )

    --**Create an order for any changed RowIDs so that when iterated over, it can be done progressively and avoid updating a RowID a second time, making it incorrect
    local keyOrderForRowIDs = {}
    local keyOrderForItemIDs = {}
    if shortTab.returnInfo.changedRowIDs ~= nil and next(shortTab.returnInfo.changedRowIDs) ~= nil then
        for oldRowID in pairs(shortTab.returnInfo.changedRowIDs) do
            table.insert(keyOrderForRowIDs, oldRowID)
        end
        table.sort(keyOrderForRowIDs)
    end

    if shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs ~= nil and next(shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs) ~= nil then
        for oldRowID in pairs(shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs) do
            table.insert(keyOrderForItemIDs, oldRowID)
        end
        table.sort(keyOrderForItemIDs)
    end


    for entryNum = #GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[subTable], 2, -1 do
        local customRow = GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[subTable][entryNum]
        if customRow[1] == rowID then
            if shortTab.returnInfo.status == "deleted" then
                table.remove(GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[subTable], entryNum)
            elseif shortTab.returnInfo.status == "editsSuccessful" then
                GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[subTable][entryNum] = editedEntry
                editedEntryFound = true
            end

        --** While iterating over the target/primary subTable, update the IDs of rows that had their IDs changed because something was deleted
        elseif shortTab.returnInfo.status == "deleted" and shortTab.returnInfo.needsDataUpdate then
            if shortTab.returnInfo.changedRowIDs[customRow[1]] then
                if shortTab.returnInfo.changedRowIDs[customRow[1]] == "" then
                    table.remove(GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[subTable], entryNum)
                else
                    GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[subTable][entryNum][1] = shortTab.returnInfo.changedRowIDs[customRow[1]]
                end
            end

            if subTable == "allExtras" and shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs ~= nil and next(shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs) ~= nil then
                for _, oldFactionID in ipairs(keyOrderForItemIDs) do
                    local newFactionID = shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs[oldFactionID]
                    local commaUsed = newID == "" and "" or ", "

                    customRow[5] = ((customRow[5]:gsub(oldFactionID.."[, ]*", newFactionID..commaUsed)):gsub(", $", "")):gsub(", \n", "\n")
                    customRow[8] = ((customRow[8]:gsub(oldFactionID.."[, ]*", newFactionID..commaUsed)):gsub(", $", "")):gsub(", \n", "\n")
                end
            end
        end
    end

    --If a custom object was edited, and its class was changed from Faction to Extra (or vice versa), then make the necessary changes to the appropriate subTable
    if shortTab.returnInfo.classChanged then
        local oldSubTable = subTable == "allFactions" and "allExtras" or "allFactions"

        if not editedEntryFound then
            table.insert(GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[subTable], editedEntry)
        end

        for entryNum = #GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[oldSubTable], 2, -1 do
            local oldCustomRow = GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[oldSubTable][entryNum]
            if oldCustomRow[1] == shortTab.returnInfo.oldID then
                table.remove(GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[oldSubTable], entryNum)
            end
        end
    end

    --Apply the edited information to the allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array table as well
    if subTable == "allFactions" and shortTab.returnInfo.status == "editsSuccessful" then
        local headers = {"idNum", "factionName", "expansion", "creator", "difficulty", "uploaderID", "sharing", "linkedExtras", "description", "imageURL", "uploadDate", "uploadTime", "baseData", "factionData", "titanData"}
        local newEntry = {}

        for elemNum = 1, #editedEntry do
            newEntry[headers[elemNum]] = editedEntry[elemNum]
        end

        for indexNum, factionData in ipairs(GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array) do
            if factionData.idNum == rowID then
                newEntry.selected = factionData.selected
                GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array[indexNum] = newEntry
            end
        end
    end

    --If a row was deleted, and this caused other objects rowIDs to get updated, then need to apply those same changes to the existing custom tables (without having to reimport)
    if shortTab.returnInfo.status == "deleted" and shortTab.returnInfo.needsDataUpdate then
        local oppositeTable = (subTable == "allFactions" and "allExtras") or "allFactions"

        for customRowNum = #GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[oppositeTable], 2, -1 do
            local customRow = GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[oppositeTable][customRowNum]

            if shortTab.returnInfo.changedRowIDs ~= nil and next(shortTab.returnInfo.changedRowIDs) ~= nil then

                for _, oldRowID in ipairs(keyOrderForRowIDs) do
                    local newRowID = shortTab.returnInfo.changedRowIDs[oldRowID]
                    local commaUsed = newID == "" and "" or ", "

                    customRow[8] = ((customRow[8]:gsub(oldRowID.."[, ]*", newRowID..commaUsed)):gsub(", $", "")):gsub(", \n", "\n")

                    if oppositeTable == "allExtras" then
                        customRow[5] = ((customRow[5]:gsub(oldRowID.."[, ]*", newRowID..commaUsed)):gsub(", $", "")):gsub(", \n", "\n")
                    end
                end
            end

            --**If an extra was deleted, and by so doing left any placeHolder faction rows without any associated factions, those placeHolder rows need to be deleted;
            --**  and the allFactions table needs to be updated with these changed IDs too
            if shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs ~= nil and next(shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs) ~= nil then
                if shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs[customRow[1]] then
                    if shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs[customRow[1]] == "" then
                        table.remove(GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[oppositeTable], customRowNum)
                    else
                        GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[oppositeTable][customRowNum][1] = shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs[customRow[1]]
                    end
                end

                for _, oldRowID in ipairs(keyOrderForItemIDs) do
                    local newRowID = shortTab.returnInfo.changedItemIDs[oldRowID]
                    local commaUsed = newID == "" and "" or ", "

                    customRow[8] = ((customRow[8]:gsub(oldRowID.."[, ]*", newRowID..commaUsed)):gsub(", $", "")):gsub(", \n", "\n")
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit == null then
        SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit = nil
    end
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit then
        SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit.destruct()
        SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit = nil
    end
    UI.setAttribute("customSpawnIn", "interactable", "true")

    UI.setAttribute("customTrash", "interactable", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("customEdit", "interactable", "false")
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.editRowSelected = nil

    GameData.Customs.resetMainCustomList = true
    CustomDecks.fillCustomsListPanel()

    if shortTab.returnInfo.status == "editsSuccessful" then
        CustomDecks.customRegistrationCancel()
    end

    CustomDecks.customPanelOK()

    UI.setAttribute("customParent", "active", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("customMain", "active", "true")

    GameData.Customs.customEditModeWaitingForDeleteConfirm = false
end

        shortTab.objData and shortTab.objData[3] and JSON.decode(shortTab.objData[3]) or "",

        for entryNum = #GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData[subTable], 2, -1 do

local function processInitialCheck(webR)
    local returnInfo = JSON.decode(webR.text)
    GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.returnInfo = returnInfo

    local function makeObjectTypeString(UItext)

        if UItext ~= "Custom Faction" then
            if UItext ~= "Accessory Deck" then
                local subType1, subType2 = UItext:match("^(.*) %((.*)%)")
                if subType1 == subType2 then
                    UItext = subType1
                end

                UItext = UItext.." object"
            end
        end

        UItext = UItext:find("^[AEIOUaeiou]") and "An "..UItext or "A "..UItext

        return UItext
    end

    if returnInfo.status == "sameNameExists" then
        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectDuplicateName", "active", "true")

        local UItext = makeObjectTypeString(GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objType)

        UI.setAttribute("customDuplicateExplanation", "text", UItext)
        UI.setAttribute("customDuplicateName", "text", GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objName)

        local creatorString = ""

        for _, name in ipairs(returnInfo.creatorsList) do
            if creatorString ~= "" then
                creatorString = creatorString..", "
            end
            creatorString = creatorString..name
        end
        creatorString = "Created by: "..creatorString

        UI.setAttribute("customDuplicateCreators", "text", creatorString)

    elseif returnInfo.status == "objAlreadyExists" then
        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectRename", "active", "true")

        local UItext = makeObjectTypeString(GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objType).." with this name"

        UI.setAttribute("customMustRenameExplanation", "text", UItext)
        UI.setAttribute("customMustRenameName", "text", GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objName)
        UI.setAttribute("customMustRenameCreator", "text", "by "..GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objCreator)

    elseif returnInfo.status == "objWillBeOverWritten" then
        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectExactMatchOverWrite", "active", "true")

        local UItext = makeObjectTypeString(GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objType).." with this name"

        UI.setAttribute("customExactMatchExplanation", "text", UItext)
        UI.setAttribute("customExactMatchName", "text", GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objName)
        UI.setAttribute("customExactMatchCreator", "text", "by "..GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objCreator)

    elseif returnInfo.status == "placeHolderEntryExists" then
        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectPartialEntryExists", "active", "true")

        UI.setAttribute("customPartialEntryFactionName", "text", GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objName)
        UI.setAttribute("customPartialEntryCreator", "text", "by "..GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objCreator)
        UI.setAttribute("customPartialEntryExtraName", "text", returnInfo.assocExtras)

    else
        registerComplete(webR)
    end
end

    if buttonID == "registerNewDeckImport" then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customImport = not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customImport

        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customImport then
            UI.setAttribute("customImport", "active", "true")

        else
            UI.setAttribute("customImport", "active", "false")
        end

    elseif buttonID == "importImport" then
        local sheetID = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.importGoogleID

        if sheetID == nil or sheetID:gsub(" ", "") == "" then
            broadcastToAll("No Google Sheet ID entered.")

        else
            if sheetID:find("https") or sheetID:find("://") or sheetID:find("docs.google.com") or sheetID:find("spreadsheets") or sheetID:find("/d/") or sheetID:find("/edit") or sheetID:find("/copy") then
                sheetID = sheetID:match("/d/(.-)/") or sheetID:match("/s/(.-)/")
            end

            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.importGoogleID = sheetID
            UI.setAttribute("importGoogleID", "text", sheetID)

            if sheetID:find("[  `~!@#%$%%%^&%*%(%)=%+%[%]{}\\|;:'\",%./<>%?]") then
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.importGoogleID = nil
                broadcastToAll("Entry contains invalid characters.")

            elseif sheetID:len() < 44 then
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.importGoogleID = nil
                broadcastToAll("Entry too short to be a valid Google Sheet ID.")

            elseif sheetID:len() > 44 then
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.importGoogleID = nil
                broadcastToAll("Entry too long to be a valid Google Sheet ID.")

            else
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customImport = false
                UI.setAttribute("customImport", "active", "false")

                importDataFromGoogleSheet(sheetID)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function processEscapeChars(string)
    return string:gsub("'", "\\'"):gsub("\\\"", "\\\\\""):gsub("\\n", "\\\\n"):gsub("\\b", "\\\\b"):gsub("\\/", "\\\\/"):gsub("\\f", "\\\\f"):gsub("\\r", "\\\\r"):gsub("\\t", "\\\\t")
end


function CustomDecks.removeAllObjScriptCode(enteringObj)
    local objData = enteringObj.getData()
    local codeStripped = false

    local function eraseLuaScript(objData)
        objData.LuaScriptState = ""
        if objData.LuaScript ~= nil and objData.LuaScript ~= "" then
            objData.LuaScript = ""
            codeStripped = true
        end
    end

    local function searchEachTable(objData)
        eraseLuaScript(objData)

        for _, containedTable in ipairs(objData.ContainedObjects or {}) do
            searchEachTable(containedTable)
        end

        for _, statesTable in pairs(objData.States or {}) do
            searchEachTable(statesTable)
        end
    end

    searchEachTable(objData)

    if codeStripped then
        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectScriptWarning", "active", "true")
        GameData.Customs.pauseForScriptWarning = true
    end

    return objData, codeStripped
end

--adjunct function used when iterating over each card in a deck object to ensure it is sized to correct proportions
local function adjustTransform(objData, cardType)
    cardType = cardType or ""
    objData.Transform.posX = 0
    objData.Transform.posY = 2.5
    objData.Transform.posZ = 0
    objData.Transform.rotX = 0
    objData.Transform.rotY = 180
    objData.Transform.rotZ = 0
    objData.Transform.scaleX = cardType == "Base" and 2.74 or 1.64
    objData.Transform.scaleY = 1
    objData.Transform.scaleZ = cardType == "Base" and 2.74 or 1.64

    return objData
end


local function buildDeckObjectData(playerInst, customDeckParentData)
    local newFactionDeckList = {}

    for _, cardData in ipairs(GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData.Action) do
        table.insert(newFactionDeckList, cardData)
    end
    for _, cardData in ipairs(GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData.Minion) do
        table.insert(newFactionDeckList, cardData)
    end

    local newBaseDeckList = {}
    for _, cardData in ipairs(GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData.Base) do
        table.insert(newBaseDeckList, cardData)
    end

    local newTitanList = {}
    for _, cardData in ipairs(GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData.Titan) do
        table.insert(newTitanList, cardData)
    end


    local factionBackURL = [[https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1621848816992099124/35BD38896CED43B951E7AEAC7DEB8FA90AA8CF89/]]
    local baseBackURL = [[https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/1825645848891966690/7FA9A082D966CF3F2935A737C0C86E3B7D0BDAEB/]]


    local function createSubDeck(deckType)
        local newSubDeckList = {}
        local cardBackURL = ""

        if deckType == "Faction" then
            newSubDeckList = newFactionDeckList
            cardBackURL = factionBackURL

        elseif deckType == "Base" then
            newSubDeckList = newBaseDeckList
            cardBackURL = baseBackURL

        elseif deckType == "Titan" then
            newSubDeckList = newTitanList
            cardBackURL = ""
        end

        local newSubDeckParentData = adjustTransform(Common.deepCopy(customDeckParentData), deckType)

        if deckType == "Base" then
            newSubDeckParentData.Tags = newSubDeckParentData.Tags or {}
            table.insert(newSubDeckParentData.Tags, "Base")
        end

        local setInfoTable = {}
        for _, cardData in ipairs(newSubDeckList) do
            local cardID = cardData.CardID
            local setNum = tonumber(tostring(cardID):sub(1, -3))
            setInfoTable[setNum] = newSubDeckParentData.CustomDeck[setNum]
            setInfoTable[setNum].BackURL = ((deckType == "Titan" and setInfoTable[setNum].FaceURL) or cardBackURL)
            setInfoTable[setNum].BackIsHidden = true
            setInfoTable[setNum].UniqueBack = (deckType == "Titan")

            cardData.CustomDeck = {[setNum] = setInfoTable[setNum]}

            if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Deck" then
                table.insert(newSubDeckParentData.DeckIDs, cardData.CardID)
                table.insert(newSubDeckParentData.ContainedObjects, cardData)
            end
        end

        for setIndex, setData in pairs(newSubDeckParentData.CustomDeck) do
            if not setInfoTable[setIndex] then
                newSubDeckParentData.CustomDeck[setIndex] = nil
            end
        end

        return newSubDeckParentData
    end

    local function obtainJSON(objData)
        if objData == nil or type(objData) ~= "table" then return end

        local tempDeck = spawnObjectData({data = objData, position = {0, 1010, 0}})
        local myJSON = tempDeck.getJSON(false)
        tempDeck.destruct()

        return myJSON
    end


    local newCustomFactionDeckData
    if next(newFactionDeckList) ~= nil then
        newCustomFactionDeckData = createSubDeck("Faction")
    end

    local newCustomBaseDeckData
    if next(newBaseDeckList) ~= nil then
        newCustomBaseDeckData = createSubDeck("Base")

        newCustomBaseDeckData.Nickname = newCustomBaseDeckData.Nickname.." Bases"
        newCustomBaseDeckData.GMNotes = newCustomBaseDeckData.GMNotes.." Bases"
    end


    local newCustomFactionDeckJSON = obtainJSON(newCustomFactionDeckData) or ""
    local newCustomBaseDeckJSON = obtainJSON(newCustomBaseDeckData) or ""

    local newCustomTitanDeckData
    local newCustomTitanDeckJSON
    if #newTitanList == 1 then
        newCustomTitanDeckData = newTitanList[1]
        newCustomTitanDeckJSON = obtainJSON(newCustomTitanDeckData) or ""
    elseif #newTitanList > 1 then
        newCustomTitanDeckData = createSubDeck("Titan")
        newCustomTitanDeckData.Nickname = newCustomTitanDeckData.Nickname.." Titans"
        newCustomTitanDeckData.GMNotes = newCustomTitanDeckData.GMNotes.." Titans"
        newCustomTitanDeckJSON = obtainJSON(newCustomTitanDeckData) or ""
    else
        newCustomTitanDeckJSON = ""
    end

    GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objData = {}

    table.insert(GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objData, newCustomBaseDeckJSON or "")
    table.insert(GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objData, newCustomFactionDeckJSON or "")
    table.insert(GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objData, newCustomTitanDeckJSON or "")

    local objectClass

    if GameData.Customs.customDeckType == "Faction" then
        GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objName = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionNameInput
        GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objExpansion = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.expansionNameInput
        GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objCreator = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.creatorNameInput
        GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.difficulty = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customDifficultyInput
        GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.deckDescription = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.descriptionInput
        GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.imageLink = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.imageLinkInput
        GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objType = "Custom Faction"

local function retrieveInfoFromInputFields(playerInst)

    local customDeckParentData = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.getData()

    if GameData.Customs.customDeckType == "Faction" then
        customDeckParentData.Nickname = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionNameInput
        customDeckParentData.GMNotes = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionNameInput
        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.expansionNameInput ~= nil and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.expansionNameInput ~= "" then
            customDeckParentData.Description = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.expansionNameInput.." (Custom by "..XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.creatorNameInput..")"
        else
            customDeckParentData.Description = "(Custom by "..XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.creatorNameInput..")"
        end

    else
        customDeckParentData.Nickname = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckNameInput
        customDeckParentData.GMNotes = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckNameInput
        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckExpansionInput ~= nil and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckExpansionInput ~= "" then
            customDeckParentData.Description = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckExpansionInput.." (Custom by "..XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckCreatorInput..")"
        else
            customDeckParentData.Description = "(Custom by "..XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckCreatorInput..")"
        end
    end

    customDeckParentData.Tags = GameData.Customs.customDeckType == "Extra" and {"Custom", "Extra"} or {"Custom"}
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Deck" then
        table.insert(customDeckParentData.Tags, "Deck")
        if GameData.Customs.customDeckType ~= "Extra" then
            table.insert(customDeckParentData.Tags, "Player")
        end
    end

    GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData = {Minion = {}, Action = {}, Base = {}, Titan = {}}

    for cardType in pairs(GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData) do
        local rowNum = 1
        local cardQuantCount = 0

        for cardNum = 1, tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"]) do

            if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Name"] ~= nil and
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Name"] ~= "" then
                if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Deck" then
                    table.insert(GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData[cardType], table.remove(customDeckParentData.ContainedObjects))
                    table.remove(customDeckParentData.DeckIDs)

                else
                    table.insert(GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData[cardType], Common.deepCopy(customDeckParentData))
                end

                local entry = GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData[cardType][cardNum]

                entry.Tags = {}

                entry = adjustTransform(entry, cardType)

                if cardType == "Minion" or cardType == "Action" then
                    entry.Nickname = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Name"]
                    entry.GMNotes = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Name"]
                    entry.Description = cardType
                    entry.Value = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Power"]) or 0
                    entry.ContainedObjects = nil

                    -- entry.Tags = {cardType}

                    if cardType == "Minion" or (cardType == "Action" and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Power"] ~= nil) then
                        entry.Memo = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Power"])
                        table.insert(entry.Tags, "Power")
                    end

                elseif cardType == "Base" then
                    entry.Nickname = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Name"]
                    entry.GMNotes = "Breakpoint: "..tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_BP"])
                    entry.Description = (GameData.Customs.customDeckType == "Faction" and (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionNameInput.." (Custom by "..XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.creatorNameInput..")")) or (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckNameInput.." (Custom by "..XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckCreatorInput..")")
                    entry.Memo = JSON.encode_pretty({["first"] = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_VP1"]), ["second"] = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_VP2"]), ["third"] = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_VP3"])})
                    entry.Value = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_BP"])
                    entry.ContainedObjects = nil

                    -- entry.Tags = {cardType}

                elseif cardType == "Titan" then
                    entry.Nickname = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Name"]
                    entry.GMNotes = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Name"]
                    entry.Description = cardType
                    entry.Memo = 0
                    entry.Value = 0
                    entry.ContainedObjects = nil

                    -- entry.Tags = {cardType}
                end

                table.insert(entry.Tags, cardType)
                table.insert(entry.Tags, "Custom")
                if GameData.Customs.customDeckType == "Extra" then
                    table.insert(entry.Tags, "Extra")
                end

                cardQuantCount = cardQuantCount + 1
                if cardQuantCount == tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..rowNum.."_Quant"]) then
                    rowNum = rowNum + 1
                    cardQuantCount = 0
                end
            end
        end

        table.sort(GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData[cardType], function(tabA, tabB)
            if cardType == "Minion" then
                if tonumber(tabA.Value) == tonumber(tabB.Value) then
                    return tabA.Nickname > tabB.Nickname
                else
                    return tonumber(tabA.Value) < tonumber(tabB.Value)
                end
            elseif cardType == "Action" or cardType == "Titan" then
                return tabA.Nickname > tabB.Nickname
            elseif cardType == "Base" then
                if tonumber(tabA.Value) == tonumber(tabB.Value) then
                    return tabA.Nickname > tabB.Nickname
                else
                    return tonumber(tabA.Value) > tonumber(tabB.Value)
                end
            end
        end
        )
    end

    buildDeckObjectData(playerInst, customDeckParentData)
end

--run through all the UI elements of each individual card entered, and ensure necessary data is there
local function checkIndividualCardEntryPanelForCompletion()
    local cardTypeTable = {
        Minion = {Fields = {"Name", "Power"}, Quantity = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customMinionQuant) or 0, nilFieldLimit = 2},
        Action = {Fields = {"Name"}, Quantity = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customActionQuant) or 0, nilFieldLimit = 1},
        Base = {Fields = {"Name", "BP", "VP1", "VP2", "VP3"}, Quantity = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customBaseQuant) or 0, nilFieldLimit = 5},
        Titan = {Fields = {"Name"}, Quantity = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customTitanQuant) or 0, nilFieldLimit = 1},
    }

    local nilsFound = false
    local fieldsIncomplete = false
    local missingEntries = false
    local cardIDStillPresent = false

    local missingFields = ""

    for cardType, typeArray in pairs(cardTypeTable) do

        missingFields = ""

        if fieldsIncomplete ~= false then
            break
        end

        local cardTypeQuantCount = 0
        for cardNum = 1, typeArray.Quantity, 1 do
            local quantSum = 0
            local nilCount = 0

            for _, UIField in ipairs(typeArray.Fields) do
                if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..cardNum.."_"..UIField] == nil then
                    nilCount = nilCount + 1
                    if missingFields ~= "" then
                        missingFields = missingFields..", "
                    end
                    missingFields = missingFields..UIField

                elseif UIField == "Name" and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..cardNum.."_"..UIField]:find("^CardID: %d+") then
                    cardIDStillPresent = true
                end
            end

            local nilPassAllowed = true

            if cardType == "Minion" or cardType == "Action" then
                nilPassAllowed = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..cardNum.."_Quant"] == nil or tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..cardNum.."_Quant"]) == 0

                if (nilCount > 0 and nilCount < typeArray.nilFieldLimit) or (nilCount == typeArray.nilFieldLimit and (not nilPassAllowed)) then
                    fieldsIncomplete = cardType

                    break
                end

                if not(nilCount == typeArray.nilFieldLimit and nilPassAllowed) then
                    quantSum = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues[cardType:lower().."Row"..cardNum.."_Quant"]) or 1
                end

            elseif cardType == "Base" or cardType == "Titan" then
                quantSum = 1

                if nilCount > 0 then
                    if nilCount == typeArray.nilFieldLimit then
                        quantSum = 0
                    else
                        fieldsIncomplete = cardType

                        break
                    end
                end

            end

            cardTypeQuantCount = cardTypeQuantCount + quantSum
        end

        if cardTypeQuantCount ~= typeArray.Quantity then
            missingEntries = cardType
            break
        end
    end

    if cardIDStillPresent then
        broadcastToAll("Please add a name for each card. The CardID cannot be used as a name.")
        return false
    elseif fieldsIncomplete ~= false then
        broadcastToAll("Some of the required fields ("..missingFields..") in the "..fieldsIncomplete.." section are missing.")
        return false
    elseif missingEntries ~= false then
        broadcastToAll("The number of "..missingEntries.." cards entered does not match the previously specified quantities.")
        return false
    end

    return true
end


local function baseCardCheck(cardData)
    local checkBaseCard = spawnObjectData({data = cardData, position = {12, 812, 12}})
    checkBaseCard.locked = true
    checkBaseCard.interactable = false

    local baseSize = checkBaseCard.getBoundsNormalized().size
    local baseScale = checkBaseCard.getScale()

    local baseX = baseSize.x / baseScale.x
    local baseZ = baseSize.z / baseScale.z

    if baseX < baseZ then
        GameData.Customs.basesArePortrait = true
    else
        GameData.Customs.basesArePortrait = false
    end

    checkBaseCard.destruct()
end

--iterate through each card in the deck object data and glean out already existing data
local function checkDeckObjectForExistingCardData()
    if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Card" or SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Deck" then

        local deckData = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.getData()
        local cardTotal = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Card" and 1 or #deckData.ContainedObjects

        local cardTypeTable = {"Minion", "Action", "Base", "Titan"}

        local deckIndex = cardTotal
        local cardTrackingTable = {Minion = {}, Action = {}, Base = {}, Titan = {}}
        local idsWithNames = {}
        local idsWithValues = {}

        -- **Loop through all cards in the custom deck and obtain/store each card's name and value**
        for _, cardType in ipairs(cardTypeTable) do
            local typeTotal = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"])

            for typeNum = 1, typeTotal, 1 do
                local cardData
                if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Card" then
                    cardData = deckData
                elseif SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Deck" then
                    cardData = deckData.ContainedObjects[deckIndex]
                end

                -- Spawn each base card to check its bounds, in order to determine if its a landscape card or not
                if cardType == "Base" then
                    baseCardCheck(cardData)
                end

                local hasNickname = false
                if cardData.Nickname ~= nil and cardData.Nickname:gsub(" ", "") ~= "" then
                    hasNickname = true

                    cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname] = cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname] or {}

                    if cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].cardID then
                        cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].cardID = cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].cardID .. ", " ..cardData.CardID
                    else
                        cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].cardID = cardData.CardID
                    end

                    idsWithNames[cardData.CardID] = cardData.Nickname
                else
                    cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID] = cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID] or {}
                    cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID].cardID = cardData.CardID
                end


                if cardType == "Action" and cardData.Value == 0 then
                    cardData.Value = nil
                    cardData.Memo = nil
                end

                if cardData.Value ~= nil and cardData.Value ~= "" then
                    if hasNickname then
                        cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].value = tonumber(cardData.Value)
                    else
                        cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID].value = tonumber(cardData.Value)
                    end

                    idsWithValues[cardData.CardID] = cardData.Value
                end

                deckIndex = deckIndex - 1
            end
        end


        if not GameData.Customs.basesArePortrait then

            deckIndex = cardTotal
            -- **Loop through all cards in the custom deck to add missing Nickname/Values (for cards with the same cardID as ones found in the first loop through)**
            for _, cardType in ipairs(cardTypeTable) do
                local typeTotal = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"])

                for typeNum = 1, typeTotal, 1 do
                    local cardData
                    if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Card" then
                        cardData = deckData
                    elseif SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Deck" then
                        cardData = deckData.ContainedObjects[deckIndex]
                    end

                    if idsWithNames[cardData.CardID] then
                        cardData.Nickname = idsWithNames[cardData.CardID]
                    end

                    if idsWithValues[cardData.CardID] then
                        if cardData.Value then
                            if idsWithValues[cardData.CardID] >= cardData.Value then
                                cardData.Value = idsWithValues[cardData.CardID]
                            else
                                idsWithValues[cardData.CardID] = cardData.Value
                            end
                        else
                            cardData.Value = idsWithValues[cardData.CardID]
                        end
                    end

                    if cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname] then
                        if cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].quantity then
                            cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].quantity = cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].quantity + 1
                        else
                            cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].quantity = 1
                        end

                    elseif cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID] then
                        if cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID].quantity then
                            cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID].quantity = cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID].quantity + 1
                        else
                            cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID].quantity = 1
                        end
                    end

                    deckIndex = deckIndex - 1
                end
            end

            -- **Loop through the cards in the custom deck and sort them so that cards of the same cardID are kept together**
            deckIndex = cardTotal
            for _, cardType in ipairs(cardTypeTable) do
                local typeTotal = tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"])
                local iterCount = 0
                local elementCount = 1
                local endNum = (deckIndex - typeTotal) + 1

                GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType] = {}

                while iterCount < typeTotal do
                    if deckIndex > 0 then
                        local startNum = deckIndex - 1
                        local cardData
                        if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Card" then
                            cardData = deckData
                        elseif SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Deck" then
                            cardData = deckData.ContainedObjects[deckIndex]
                        end

                        local hasNickname = false
                        local nickName
                        if cardData.Nickname ~= nil and cardData.Nickname:gsub(" ", "") ~= "" then
                            nickName = cardData.Nickname
                            hasNickname = true
                        else
                            nickName = "CardID: "..cardData.CardID
                        end

                        local cardQuant
                        if hasNickname then
                            cardQuant = cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.Nickname].quantity
                        else
                            cardQuant = cardTrackingTable[cardType][cardData.CardID].quantity
                        end


                        if cardQuant > 1 then
                            for cardIndex = startNum, endNum, -1 do
                                local nextCard = deckData.ContainedObjects[cardIndex]
                                if (hasNickname and nextCard.Nickname == cardData.Nickname) or (nextCard.CardID == cardData.CardID) then
                                    table.insert(deckData.ContainedObjects, startNum, table.remove(deckData.ContainedObjects, cardIndex))
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount] = GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount] or {}
                        GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].name = nickName
                        GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].value = tonumber(cardData.Value) or nil
                        GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].quant = cardQuant
                        GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].memo = cardData.Memo

                        if cardType == "Base" then
                            GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].vp1 = ""
                            GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].vp2 = ""
                            GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].vp3 = ""

                            if cardData.Memo ~= nil and cardData.Memo ~= "" then
                                local success, VPs = pcall(JSON.decode, cardData.Memo)

                                if success then
                                    if VPs.first then
                                        GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].vp1 = VPs.first
                                    end
                                    if VPs.second then
                                        GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].vp2 = VPs.second
                                    end
                                    if VPs.third then
                                        GameData.Customs.customCardDetails[cardType][elementCount].vp3 = VPs.third
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        deckIndex = deckIndex - cardQuant
                        iterCount = iterCount + cardQuant
                        elementCount = elementCount + 1
                    end
                end
            end

            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.destruct()
            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject = spawnObjectData({data = deckData})
            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.interactable = false

            if GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject
            end

            UI.setAttribute("eachCardEntryPanel", "active", "true")
        else
            UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("customObjectFixBaseOrientation", "active", "true")
        end
    end
end
