--check to make sure the primary info for the new deck is valid before proceeding
local function checkForValidNewDeckPrimaryInfo()
    if GameData.Customs.customDeckType == "Faction" then
        if (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionNameInput == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionNameInput:gsub(" ", "") == "") then
            broadcastToAll("New Custom Faction must be given a name.")
            return false

        elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionNameInput:len() <= 3 then
            broadcastToAll("Custom Faction name must be 4 characters or longer.")
            return false

        elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.creatorNameInput == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.creatorNameInput:gsub(" ", "") == "" then
            broadcastToAll("Please provide the name of the faction's creator.")
            return false

        elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customPrivate == false and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customPublic == false then
            broadcastToAll("Please choose whether the deck will be private or shared publically.")
            return false
        end

    -- elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customType_ExtraDeck then
    elseif GameData.Customs.customDeckType == "Extra" then
        if (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckNameInput == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckNameInput:gsub(" ", "") == "") then
            broadcastToAll("New Custom Extra Deck must be given a name.")
            return false

        elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckNameInput:len() <= 3 then
            broadcastToAll("Extra Deck name must be 4 characters or longer.")
            return false

        elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckCreatorInput == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckCreatorInput:gsub(" ", "") == "" then
            broadcastToAll("Please provide the name of the deck's creator.")
            return false

        elseif (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionListInput == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionListInput:gsub(" ", "") == "") and
         (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckExpansionInput == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckExpansionInput:gsub(" ", "") == "") then
            broadcastToAll("An Extra/Accessory Deck must be associated with either an expansion or at least one faction (even if the factions haven't been uploaded yet).")
            return false

        elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customSingleUse == false and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customPlayerKeeps == false then
            broadcastToAll("Please choose whether the cards from this deck will go to the original discard pile or the player's discard pile.")
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

--analyzes the custom deck for existing data. run after entering card type quantities
local function checkCardCountSum()
    local zone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customZone
    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.hasTag("OneCustomObj") then
            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject = obj
        end
    end

    if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject then
        if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Card" or SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Deck" then

            local deckData = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.getData()
            local cardTotal = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Card" and 1 or #deckData.ContainedObjects

            local cardTypeTable = {"Minion", "Action", "Base", "Titan"}

            -- **Sum up all manually entered card counts**
            local quantTotal = 0
            for _, cardType in ipairs(cardTypeTable) do
                if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"] == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"] == "" then
                    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"] = 0
                end

                quantTotal = quantTotal + tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"])
            end


            if quantTotal == cardTotal then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.interactable = false

                UI.setAttribute("customPrep", "active", "false")
                UI.setAttribute("customCardTypeCountPanel", "active", "false")
                UI.setAttribute("registerNewDeckPanel", "active", "true")

                local desc = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.getDescription():gsub("%s*%(Custom by.*%)", "")

                UI.setAttribute("factionNameInput", "text", SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.getName())
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.factionNameInput = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.getName()

                UI.setAttribute("expansionNameInput", "text", desc)
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.expansionNameInput = desc

                UI.setAttribute("extraDeckNameInput", "text", SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.getName())
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckNameInput = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.getName()

                UI.setAttribute("extraDeckExpansionInput", "text", desc)
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.extraDeckExpansionInput = desc

            else
                broadcastToAll("The custom deck has "..cardTotal.." cards, but the total specified quantities add up to "..quantTotal..".", {1, 0, 114/255})
            end
        end
    end
end


function CustomDecks.cardTypeScan(deckObj)
    local deckData = deckObj.getData()
    local typeCount = {Minion = 0, Action = 0, Base = 0, Titan = 0}

    if deckObj.type == "Deck" then
        for _, cardData in ipairs(deckData.ContainedObjects) do
            if cardData.Tags then
                for _, tag in ipairs(cardData.Tags) do
                    if tag == "Minion" or tag == "Action" then
                        typeCount[tag] = typeCount[tag] + 1
                    end
                end
            end
            if cardData.Description == "Titan" then
                typeCount.Titan = typeCount.Titan + 1
            end
            if cardData.GMNotes:find("^(Breakpoint:)") and cardData.Memo:find("(\"first\")") then
                typeCount.Base = typeCount.Base + 1
            end
        end

    elseif deckObj.type == "Card" then
        if deckData.Tags then
            for _, tag in ipairs(deckData.Tags) do
                if typeCount[tag] then
                    typeCount[tag] = typeCount[tag] + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end


    for cardType, count in pairs(typeCount) do
        if count > 0 then
            UI.setAttribute("custom"..cardType.."Quant", "text", count)
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues["custom"..cardType.."Quant"] = count
        end
    end
end

--******************************************************************************
-- These functions relate to setting up or undoing edit mode
--******************************************************************************
local function spawnInObjectToEdit()
    local editedCustom = GameData.Customs.onlyThisHostsCustomContent_Array[XMLUI.xmlDataTables.editRowSelected]
    SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit = nil

    if editedCustom[1]:sub(1,1) == "A" or editedCustom[7] == "Accessory Deck" then
        local assembleDeck = {}

        local function push_into_deck(card)
            assembleDeck.ContainedObjects = assembleDeck.ContainedObjects or {}
            assembleDeck.DeckIDs = assembleDeck.DeckIDs or {}

            table.insert(assembleDeck.ContainedObjects, 1, card)
            table.insert(assembleDeck.DeckIDs, 1, card.CardID)
        end

        local function resetTags(obj)
            if not obj then return end

            obj.Tags = {}

            if obj.ContainedObjects then
                for _, cardData in ipairs(obj.ContainedObjects) do
                    cardData.Tags = {}
                end
            end
        end

        if editedCustom[14] and editedCustom[14] ~= "" and next(editedCustom[14]) ~= nil then
            assembleDeck = Common.deepCopy(editedCustom[14])
        end


        if editedCustom[13] and editedCustom[13] ~= "" and next(editedCustom[13]) ~= nil then
            local src13 = Common.deepCopy(editedCustom[13])
            resetTags(src13)

            if assembleDeck and assembleDeck.ContainedObjects then
                -- merge atlas
                assembleDeck.CustomDeck = assembleDeck.CustomDeck or {}

                for deckNum, deckData in pairs(src13.CustomDeck or {}) do
                    assembleDeck.CustomDeck[deckNum] = deckData
                end

                if src13.ContainedObjects and next(src13.ContainedObjects) ~= nil then
                    for cardNum = #src13.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do
                        push_into_deck(src13.ContainedObjects[cardNum])
                    end
                else
                    push_into_deck(src13) -- single-card case
                end

            else
                assembleDeck = src13
            end
        end

        if editedCustom[15] and editedCustom[15] ~= "" and next(editedCustom[15]) ~= nil then
            local src15 = Common.deepCopy(editedCustom[15])
            resetTags(src15)

            if assembleDeck and assembleDeck.ContainedObjects then
                -- merge atlas
                assembleDeck.CustomDeck = assembleDeck.CustomDeck or {}

                for deckNum, deckData in pairs(src15.CustomDeck or {}) do
                    assembleDeck.CustomDeck[deckNum] = deckData
                end

                if src15.ContainedObjects and next(src15.ContainedObjects) ~= nil then
                    for cardNum = #src15.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do
                        push_into_deck(src15.ContainedObjects[cardNum])
                    end
                else
                    push_into_deck(src15) -- single-card case
                end

            else
                assembleDeck = src15
            end
        end

        SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit = spawnObjectData({data = assembleDeck, position = {0, 450, 0}})

        local expansion = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.expansionNameInput

        SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit.setName(editedCustom[2])
        SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit.setDescription(editedCustom[3] ~= "" and expansion.." (Custom by "..editedCustom[4]..")" or "(Custom by "..editedCustom[4]..")")
        SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit.setGMNotes(editedCustom[2])
        SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit.addTag("Custom")

    else
        SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit = spawnObjectData({data = editedCustom[13], position = {0, 450, 0}})
    end

    local matPos = SmashUp.GameObjects.ExtraMats.customMat.getPosition()
    local objPos = matPos:add(Vector(0, 1.5, 12))
    SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit.setPosition(objPos)
    arrowIndicate(objPos, "Teal")

    UI.setAttribute("customSpawnIn", "interactable", "false")
end

local function checkForOwnedCustoms()
    GameData.Customs.onlyThisHostsCustomContent_Array = {}
    local hostID = SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getHost().steam_id
    for customType, allCustomTypeInfo in pairs(GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData) do
        for _, customInfo in ipairs(allCustomTypeInfo) do
            if customInfo[6] == hostID and customInfo[7] ~= "zzz_PlaceHolder" then
                table.insert(GameData.Customs.onlyThisHostsCustomContent_Array, customInfo)
            end
        end
    end

    if next(GameData.Customs.onlyThisHostsCustomContent_Array) ~= nil and not GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
        table.sort(GameData.Customs.onlyThisHostsCustomContent_Array,
            function(a, b)
                return a[12] < b[12]
            end
        )

        UI.setAttribute("editCustomEntries", "active", "true")
    else
        UI.setAttribute("editCustomEntries", "active", "false")
    end
end


function CustomDecks.fillCustomsListPanel()
    if GameData.Customs.resetMainCustomList then
        checkForOwnedCustoms()

        UI.setAttribute("customLoadCover", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customRow0", "active", "false")

        GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID = {}
        local extraHeaders = {"idNum", "objectName", "expansion", "creator", "", "uploaderID", "objectType", "assocFactions", "extraDiscarding", "imageURL", "uploadDate", "uploadTime", "objData1", "objData2", "objData3"}



        for rowNum = 2, (#GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData.allExtras or 0), 1 do
            local tableRowData = GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData.allExtras[rowNum]
            GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[tableRowData[1]] = {}

            for elemNum = 2, #tableRowData do
                if elemNum ~= 5 then
                    GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[tableRowData[1]][extraHeaders[elemNum]] = tableRowData[elemNum]
                end
            end
        end

        local hostID = SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getHost().steam_id
        local listCount = 0
        local headers = {"idNum", "factionName", "expansion", "creator", "difficulty", "uploaderID", "sharing", "linkedExtras", "description", "imageURL", "uploadDate", "uploadTime", "baseData", "factionData", "titanData"}

        local tableSource = nil
        local highlightedBackup = {}

        if GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
            tableSource = GameData.Customs.onlyThisHostsCustomContent_Array
        else
            tableSource = GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData.allFactions

            for count = 1, #GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array do
                if GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array[count].selected then
                    highlightedBackup[GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array[count].idNum] = true
                end
            end

            GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array = {}
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected = {}
        end

        table.sort(tableSource,
            function(a, b)
                if a[1] == "ID #" then
                    return true
                elseif b[1] == "ID #" then
                    return false
                else
                    if GameData.Customs.customSortByType == "Date" then
                        if GameData.Customs.customsSortDirectionUp then
                            return a[12] > b[12]
                        else
                            return a[12] < b[12]
                        end

                    elseif GameData.Customs.customSortByType == "Creator" then
                        if GameData.Customs.customsSortDirectionUp then
                            if GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
                                local aType = a[1]:sub(1,1) == "A" and "Faction" or "Accessory"
                                local bType = b[1]:sub(1,1) == "A" and "Faction" or "Accessory"

                                if aType == bType then
                                    return a[2] < b[2]
                                else
                                    return aType > bType
                                end

                            else
                                if a[4] == b[4] then
                                    if a[3] == b[3] then
                                        return a[2] < b[2]
                                    else
                                        return a[3] < b[3]
                                    end
                                else
                                    return a[4] < b[4]
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            if GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
                                local aType = a[1]:sub(1,1) == "A" and "Faction" or "Accessory"
                                local bType = b[1]:sub(1,1) == "A" and "Faction" or "Accessory"

                                if aType == bType then
                                    return a[2] > b[2]
                                else
                                    return aType < bType
                                end
                            else
                                if a[4] == b[4] then
                                    if a[3] == b[3] then
                                        return a[2] > b[2]
                                    else
                                        return a[3] > b[3]
                                    end
                                else
                                    return a[4] > b[4]
                                end
                            end
                        end

                    elseif GameData.Customs.customSortByType == "Faction" then
                        if GameData.Customs.customsSortDirectionUp then
                            if a[2] == b[2] then
                                return a[4] < b[4]
                            else
                                return a[2] < b[2]
                            end
                        else
                            if a[2] == b[2] then
                                return a[4] > b[4]
                            else
                                return a[2] > b[2]
                            end
                        end

                    elseif GameData.Customs.customSortByType == "Expansion" then
                        if GameData.Customs.customsSortDirectionUp then

                            if a[3] == b[3] then
                                return a[2] < b[2]
                            else
                                if a[3] == "" then
                                    return false
                                elseif b[3] == "" then
                                    return true
                                end

                                return a[3] < b[3]
                            end

                        else
                            if a[3] == b[3] then
                                return a[2] > b[2]
                            else
                                if a[3] == "" then
                                    return true
                                elseif b[3] == "" then
                                    return false
                                end

                                return a[3] > b[3]
                            end
                        end

                    elseif GameData.Customs.customSortByType == "Extra" then
                        if GameData.Customs.customsSortDirectionUp then
                            local aExtra = a[8] ~= "" and 1 or 2
                            local bExtra = b[8] ~= "" and 1 or 2

                            if aExtra == bExtra then
                                if a[3] == b[3] then
                                    return a[2] < b[2]
                                else
                                    if a[3] == "" then
                                        return false
                                    elseif b[3] == "" then
                                        return true
                                    end

                                    return a[3] < b[3]
                                end

                                return a[3] < b[3]
                            end
                            return aExtra < bExtra

                        else
                            local aExtra = a[8] ~= "" and 1 or 2
                            local bExtra = b[8] ~= "" and 1 or 2

                            if aExtra == bExtra then
                                if a[3] == b[3] then
                                    return a[2] > b[2]
                                else
                                    if a[3] == "" then
                                        return true
                                    elseif b[3] == "" then
                                        return false
                                    end

                                    return a[3] > b[3]
                                end
                            end
                            return aExtra > bExtra
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        )

        for customCount = 1, (#GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData.allFactions > 23 and #GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData.allFactions or 23) do
            UI.setAttribute("customRow"..customCount, "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("customRow"..customCount.."_Extra_Image", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("customRow"..customCount, "tooltip", "")
        end

        for rowNum = 1, #tableSource, 1 do
            local tableRowData = tableSource[rowNum]

            if tableRowData[1] ~= "ID #" then

                local newEntry = {}
                for elemNum = 1, #tableRowData do
                    newEntry[headers[elemNum]] = tableRowData[elemNum]
                end

                if (GameData.Customs.customEditMode) or (newEntry.sharing == "Public" or (newEntry.sharing == "Private" and hostID == newEntry.uploaderID)) then
                    listCount = listCount + 1

                    if GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
                        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.editRowSelected = nil

                    else
                        if highlightedBackup[newEntry.idNum] then
                            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected[listCount] = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected[listCount] or {}
                            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected[listCount].factionName = newEntry.factionName
                            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected[listCount].expansionName = newEntry.expansion
                            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected[listCount].creatorName = newEntry.creator
                            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected[listCount].date = newEntry.uploadDate
                            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected[listCount].epochTime = newEntry.uploadTime
                            newEntry.selected = true
                        end

                        table.insert(GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array, newEntry)
                    end

                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount, "active", "true")
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount, "tooltip", newEntry.description)
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Faction", "active", "true")
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Faction_Text", "text", newEntry.factionName)
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Expansion", "active", "true")
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Expansion_Text", "text", newEntry.expansion)
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Creator", "active", "true")
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Creator_Text", "text", (GameData.Customs.customEditMode and (newEntry.idNum:sub(1,1) == "A" and "Faction" or "Accessory")) or newEntry.creator)
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Date", "active", "true")
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Date_Text", "text", newEntry.uploadDate)
                    UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Extra", "active", "true")
                    if newEntry.linkedExtras ~= nil and newEntry.linkedExtras ~= "" then
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Extra_Image", "active", "true")
                    end


                    if newEntry.uploaderID == hostID then
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Faction", "color", "#E2D0E0")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Expansion", "color", "#E2D0E0")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Creator", "color", "#E2D0E0")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Date", "color", "#E2D0E0")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Extra", "color", "#E2D0E0")
                        GameData.Customs.UIRowOwnedByHost["customRow"..listCount] = true
                    else
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Faction", "color", "White")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Expansion", "color", "White")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Creator", "color", "White")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Date", "color", "White")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Extra", "color", "White")
                        GameData.Customs.UIRowOwnedByHost["customRow"..listCount] = nil
                    end

                    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected[listCount] and not GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Faction", "color", "Blue")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Expansion", "color", "Blue")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Creator", "color", "Blue")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Date", "color", "Blue")
                        UI.setAttribute("customRow"..listCount.."_Extra", "color", "Blue")

        end

        if listCount > 23 then

            local totalHeight = heightPerRow * listCount
            UI.setAttribute("customListPanel", "height", totalHeight)

        else
            UI.setAttribute("customListPanel", "height", 509.54)
        end

        GameData.Customs.resetMainCustomList = false

-- This function is run when a player clicks the "OK" button on the main/primary Custom Faction selection list.
function CustomDecks.customPanelOK()
    -- Wait 1 frame before turning the "system" off (allow things to complete)
    Wait.frames(function()
        if not GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
            turnCustomSystemOff()                                                                                                  -- close the panels
        end
    end, 1)

    -- Need to reset these tables to ensure no previous entries remain in case someone changes the selections on the Custom Faction selection panel
    GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array = {}                                                                          -- reset this table in order to re-populate it with the newly selected custom factions
    GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName = {}                                                                                   -- reset this table in order to re-populate it with the newly selected custom factions
    GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired = {specific = {}, general = {}}

    if not GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
        for rowNum, factionInfo in pairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected) do                                                      -- for every item in the list of custom factions that has been selected...
            table.insert(GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array, {rowNum = rowNum, factionName = factionInfo.factionName,
            creatorName = factionInfo.creatorName, date = factionInfo.date, time = factionInfo.epochTime})                              -- ... insert the selected custom faction into the game-wide customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array list
        end

    else
        -- this customPanelOK() function gets run after a user finalized edits made to their custom factions
        -- this code then updates the previously retrieved/stored data with any of those changes
        for rowNumber, factionInfo in ipairs(GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array) do
            if factionInfo.selected then
                table.insert(GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array, {rowNum = rowNumber, factionName = factionInfo.factionName,
                creatorName = factionInfo.creator, date = factionInfo.uploadDate, time = factionInfo.uploadTime})
            end
        end
    end

    -- sort the customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array alphabetically
    table.sort(GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array,
        function(a, b)
            if a.factionName == b.factionName then
                if a.creatorName == b.creatorName then
                    return a.time < b.time
                end

                return a.creatorName < b.creatorName
            end

            return a.factionName < b.factionName
        end)

    -- access the object data of the Smash Up Box
    local boxData = SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox.getData()
    local contObjList = boxData.ContainedObjects

    -- sort all the faction kits within the Smash Up Box, so that all previously inserted "Customs" end up on bottom of the list (so they can be removed in a moment...)
    table.sort(contObjList,
        function(a, b)
            if a.Description:match(".*Custom.*") or b.Description:match(".*Custom.*") then
                if a.Description:match(".*Custom.*") and b.Description:match(".*Custom.*") then
                    if a.Nickname >= b.Nickname then
                        return true
                    else
                        return false
                    end
                elseif a.Description:match(".*Custom.*") then
                    return false
                else
                    return true
                end
            else
                if a.Nickname >= b.Nickname then
                    return true
                else
                    return false
                end
            end
        end)

    -- remove all previously inserted Customs; start fresh
    for surplusCount = #contObjList, (GameData.UISetup.ReferenceData.totalOfficialFactionCount + 1), -1 do
        table.remove(contObjList, surplusCount)
    end

    --**************************************************************************
    --** IF ANY CUSTOM FACTIONS WERE SELECTED, THIS IS HOW THEY GET IMPORTED
    --**************************************************************************
    if next(GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array) ~= nil then                                                        -- as long as the customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array list is not empty...

        --**********************************************************************
        --** ADD ALL SELECTED CUSTOM FACTIONS TO THE INITIAL UI EVERYTHING-AVAILBLE LIST
        --**********************************************************************
        local customAssets = UI.getCustomAssets()                                                                               -- ... backup the UI's customAssets list
        local needToSetCustomAssets = false

        -- a function to add each specific selected Custom to the UI available list
        local function addCustomFactionsToList(toggleNum)
            local factionName = GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array[toggleNum].factionName                                   -- ... get the factionName
            local creatorName = GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array[toggleNum].creatorName                                   -- ... get the creatorName
            local factionLabel = factionName.." *&^* "..creatorName
            table.insert(SmashUp.Database.factionsByExpansion.Custom, factionLabel)                                              -- ... insert the factionName into the factionsByExpansion table's "Custom" key

            local customFactionInfo = GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array[GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array[toggleNum].rowNum]

            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel] = {}
            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].uiImageURL = customFactionInfo.imageURL
            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData = Common.deepCopy(GameData.Customs.customKitBoxData)
            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.Nickname = factionName.." Kit"
            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.Description = customFactionInfo.expansion ~= "" and customFactionInfo.expansion.." (Custom by "..creatorName..")" or "(Custom by "..creatorName..")"
            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.GMNotes = factionName.." Kit"
            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.ContainedObjects = {}
            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.Tags = GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.Tags or {}
            table.insert(GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.Tags, "Custom")
            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].expansion = customFactionInfo.expansion
            GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].extrasList = Common.switchKeyVal(Common.splitStringByDelim(customFactionInfo.linkedExtras, ", "))


            if customFactionInfo.baseData ~= "" then
                table.insert(GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.ContainedObjects, customFactionInfo.baseData)
            end
            if customFactionInfo.factionData ~= "" then
                table.insert(GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.ContainedObjects, customFactionInfo.factionData)
            end
            if customFactionInfo.titanData ~= "" then
                table.insert(GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].kitData.ContainedObjects, customFactionInfo.titanData)
            end

            local complexityTable = {"Low", "Low-Medium", "Medium", "Medium-High", "High"}

            SmashUp.Database.factionTable[factionLabel] = {expansion = "Custom", customExpansion = customFactionInfo.expansion, description = customFactionInfo.description, compLevel = complexityTable[tonumber(customFactionInfo.difficulty)], included = true, custom = true, customNum = toggleNum, faction = factionName, creator = creatorName}
            SmashUp.GameData.Customs.databaseEntryBackup[factionLabel] = {expansion = "Custom", customExpansion = customFactionInfo.expansion, description = customFactionInfo.description, compLevel = complexityTable[tonumber(customFactionInfo.difficulty)], included = true, custom = true, customNum = toggleNum, faction = factionName, creator = creatorName}

            local alreadyExists = false
            for assetNum = #customAssets, 1, -1 do
                local asset = customAssets[assetNum]

                if asset.url == GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].uiImageURL then
                    alreadyExists = true
                    if asset.name ~= factionLabel then
                        asset.name = factionLabel
                        needToSetCustomAssets = true
                    end
                elseif asset.name == factionLabel then
                    alreadyExists = true
                    if asset.url ~= GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].uiImageURL then
                        asset.url = GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].uiImageURL
                        needToSetCustomAssets = true
                    end
                end
            end

            if (not alreadyExists) and (GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].uiImageURL ~= nil and GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].uiImageURL ~= "") then
                table.insert(customAssets, {type = 0, name = factionLabel, url = GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[factionLabel].uiImageURL or ""})   -- ... add the representative image to the UI
                needToSetCustomAssets = true
            end

            UI.setAttribute("customToggle"..toggleNum, "active", "true")                                                  -- ... activate the customToggle that will represent this custom faction in the faction UI panel
            UI.setAttribute("customToggle"..toggleNum, "isOn", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("customToggle"..toggleNum, "text", factionName)
            UI.setAttribute("customToggle"..toggleNum, "tooltip", "by "..creatorName)
        end

        if SmashUp.Database.expansionList[#SmashUp.Database.expansionList] ~= "Custom" then
            table.insert(SmashUp.Database.expansionList, "Custom")                                                      -- ... add the "Custom" expansion to the game-wide expansionList
        end
        SmashUp.Database.factionsByExpansion.Custom = {}                                                                -- ... and add an entry for "Custom" factions in the factionsByExpansion table

        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["expansion"]["Custom"] = true                                                 -- ... set the UI expansion toggle for "Custom" expansion to on/true
        UI.setAttribute("Custom", "active", "true")                                                                     -- ... and activate and toggle on the toggles for "Custom" expansion in the expansion and faction list UI panels
        UI.setAttribute("Custom", "isOn", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("set-Custom", "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("set-Custom", "isOn", "true")

        local windowHeight = SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.factionScrollWindowHeight                                                 -- ... note what the current height attribute is for the faction panels scroll window
        windowHeight = windowHeight + 1                                                                                 -- ... add 1 to the height attribute for adding the "Custom" expansion toggle

        local firstColNum = math.ceil(#GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array / 2)                                             -- ... determine how many custom factions can be listed in the first column of the grid of the faction UI panel
        local secondColNum = (#GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array - firstColNum) + 25                                      -- ... determine the number of the toggle that will be the last one activated in the 2nd column of the faction UI panel

        for activateNum = 1, firstColNum do                                                                             -- ... for each customToggle between 1 and the max number of custom factions that will be in the first column...
            addCustomFactionsToList(activateNum)
            windowHeight = windowHeight + 1                                                                                 -- ... add 1 to the windowHeight to adjust for each custom faction that is being added to the first column
        end

        for activateNum = 26, secondColNum do                                                                                                       -- ... for every customToggle in the 2nd column up to the stopping point (the last custom faction that needs to be added)...
            addCustomFactionsToList((activateNum - 25) + firstColNum)
        end

        UI.setAttribute("factionDisplayWindow", "height", (windowHeight * 20) + 5)                                      -- ... adjust the actual height of the faction display panel

        local alreadyExists = false
        for assetNum, customSet in ipairs(customAssets) do
            if customSet.url == [[https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2271567091974207544/6569F2A4B0ADC9B6F30E80E76DDAB5D85191741C/]] then
                alreadyExists = true
                customAssets[assetNum].name = "CustomCard"
            end
        end
        if not alreadyExists then
            table.insert(customAssets, {type = 0, name = "CustomCard", url = [[https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2271567091974207544/6569F2A4B0ADC9B6F30E80E76DDAB5D85191741C/]]})
            needToSetCustomAssets = true
        end

        if needToSetCustomAssets == true then
            broadcastToAll("Adding Custom Data...", {0, 193/255, 255})                                                     -- ... broadcast a message to everybody
            Wait.frames(function()
                UI.setCustomAssets(customAssets)                                                                                -- ... set the UI custom assets to now include the new custom images
                broadcastToAll("Completed!", {0, 193/255, 255})
            end, 5)
        end
        UI.setAttribute("factionSlider","value", GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer)                                            -- because TTS doesn't load the slider's "knob" at the correct position, manually setting it here will cause the knob to move to the correct place)

        GameData.Customs.customsMandatory = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.forceCustomIntoPool

        --**********************************************************************
        --** GET THE CUSTOM FACTIONS AND EXTRA DECKS ADDED TO THE SMASHUP BOX
        --**********************************************************************
        local addToBigBox = {}

        for customLabel, customDataset in pairs(GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName) do
            if next(customDataset.extrasList) ~= nil then
                for extraID in pairs(customDataset.extrasList) do

                    local extraKit = Common.deepCopy(GameData.Customs.customKitBoxData)

                    extraKit.Nickname = GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].objectName.." Kit"
                    local creator = GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].creator
                    extraKit.Description = "Custom Extra (by "..creator..")"
                    extraKit.GMNotes = GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].objectName.." Kit"
                    extraKit.ContainedObjects = {}

                    for subdeckCount = 1, 3 do
                        if type(GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID]["objData"..tostring(subdeckCount)]) == "table" and
                        next(GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID]["objData"..tostring(subdeckCount)]) ~= nil then
                            table.insert(extraKit.ContainedObjects, GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID]["objData"..subdeckCount])
                        end
                    end

                    local assocFactions = Common.splitStringByDelim(Common.splitStringByDelim(GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].assocFactions, "\n")[1], ", ")

                    if next(assocFactions) ~= nil then
                        if #assocFactions == 1 then
                            if #extraKit.ContainedObjects == 1 then
                                table.insert(GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[customLabel].kitData.ContainedObjects, 1, extraKit.ContainedObjects[1])
                            else
                                table.insert(GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[customLabel].kitData.ContainedObjects, 1, extraKit)
                            end
                            GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.specific[customLabel] = GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.specific[customLabel] or {}
                            GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.specific[customLabel][extraID] = {name = GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].objectName, creator = GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].creator, discardMode = GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].extraDiscarding}

                        else
                            table.insert(addToBigBox, extraKit)

                            GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.general[customLabel] = GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.general[customLabel] or {}
                            GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired.general[customLabel][extraID] = {name = GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].objectName, creator = GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].creator, discardMode = GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID[extraID].extraDiscarding}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            table.insert(addToBigBox, customDataset.kitData)
        end

        table.sort(addToBigBox, function(a, b)
            if a.Nickname >= b.Nickname then
                return true
            else
                return false
            end
        end)

        for _, customKit in ipairs(addToBigBox) do
            table.insert(contObjList, customKit)
        end

        if not GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
            broadcastToAll("The selected custom factions have been added to the Smash Up box, and are now available in the UI for drafting.", {0, 193/255, 255})
        end

    else                                                                                                                -- if there is no custom faction selected...
        if SmashUp.Database.expansionList[#SmashUp.Database.expansionList] == "Custom" then
            table.remove(SmashUp.Database.expansionList, #SmashUp.Database.expansionList)                                   -- ... remove the "Custom" expansion from the expansionList
        end
        SmashUp.Database.factionsByExpansion.Custom = nil                                                               -- ... remove the "Custom" faction list from the factionsByExpansion table

        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["expansion"]["Custom"] = false                                                -- ... turn off the "Custom" toggle in the expansion list
        UI.setAttribute("Custom", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("set-Custom", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("factionDisplayWindow", "height", (SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.factionScrollWindowHeight * 20) + 5)        -- ... reset the height of the faction display panel

        for customNum = 1, 50 do                                                                                        -- ... reset every customToggle
            UI.setAttribute("customToggle"..customNum, "active", "false")
        end

        for faction, factionInfo in pairs(SmashUp.Database.factionTable) do                                             -- ... remove every custom faction from the Database.factionTable
            if factionInfo.custom then
                SmashUp.Database.factionTable[faction] = nil
                SmashUp.GameData.Customs.databaseEntryBackup[faction] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox.destruct()
    SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox = spawnObjectData({data = boxData})
    SmashUp.GameObjects.smashUpBox.interactable = false
end

-- This function is called when any of the the buttons on any of the Customs system panels are clicked.
function CustomDecks.customPanelsButtonHandler(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    --PREVENT A NON-HOST FROM CLICKING A BUTTON
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 or playerInst.host == false then
        return                                                                  -- if this button is clicked by a mouse button OTHER than the left click, or if the host didn't click the button, dont' do anything.
    end

    --**************************************************************************
    --** #1 Buttons on the main/primary Custom Faction selection list**
    --**************************************************************************
    if buttonID == "customOK" then
        if GameData.Customs.customDatabaseLoaded then
            CustomDecks.customPanelOK(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
        end

    elseif buttonID == "registerNewDeck" then
            UI.setAttribute("customMain", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("customPrep", "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("customSpawnButtonPanel", "active", "false")

            activateCustomMat()

    elseif buttonID == "customSortByDate" or buttonID == "customSortByCreator" or buttonID == "customSortByFaction" or buttonID == "customSortByExpansion" or buttonID == "customSortByExtra" then
        if GameData.Customs.customDatabaseLoaded and (not GameData.Customs.customEditModeWaitingForDeleteConfirm) then
            local currentSortType = buttonID:match("^customSortBy(.*)")

            if currentSortType == GameData.Customs.customSortByType then
                GameData.Customs.customsSortDirectionUp = not GameData.Customs.customsSortDirectionUp
            else
                GameData.Customs.customsSortDirectionUp = true
            end

            GameData.Customs.customSortByType = currentSortType

            GameData.Customs.resetMainCustomList = true
            CustomDecks.fillCustomsListPanel()
        end

    --**************************************************************************
    --** #1b Editing hosts custom objects/factions**
    --**************************************************************************
    elseif buttonID == "editCustomEntries" then
        activateEditMode()

    elseif buttonID == "customEditBack" then
        if (not GameData.Customs.customEditModeWaitingForDeleteConfirm) then
            CustomDecks.customRegistrationCancel("customCancel")
            GameData.Customs.resetMainCustomList = true
            CustomDecks.customPanelOpen()
        end

    elseif buttonID == "customEdit" then
        if (not GameData.Customs.customEditModeWaitingForDeleteConfirm) then
            editExistingCustom()
        end

    elseif buttonID == "customSpawnIn" then
        spawnInObjectToEdit()

    elseif buttonID == "customTrash" then
        if (not GameData.Customs.customEditModeWaitingForDeleteConfirm) then
            GameData.Customs.customEditModeWaitingForDeleteConfirm = true
            UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("customObjectConfirmDelete", "active", "true")
        end

    elseif buttonID == "customDeleteYes" then
        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectConfirmDelete", "active", "false")
        deleteExistingCustom()

    elseif buttonID == "customDeleteNo" then
        GameData.Customs.customEditModeWaitingForDeleteConfirm = false
        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectConfirmDelete", "active", "false")

    --**************************************************************************
    --** #2 Preparation Notice Panel and Pop-Outs**
    --**************************************************************************
    elseif buttonID == "customObjectOK" then

        if (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customObjectName == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customObjectName:gsub(" ", "") == "") then
            broadcastToAll("New Custom Object must be given a name.")
            return

        elseif (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customObjectCreator == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customObjectCreator:gsub(" ", "") == "") then
            broadcastToAll("Please provide the name of the object's creator.")
            return
        end

        local zone = SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customZone
        for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
            if obj.hasTag("OneCustomObj") then
                SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject = obj
            end
        end

        if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Tile" then
            UI.hide("customObjectPanel")
            UI.show("customTokenPanel")

        else
            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.interactable = false
            UI.setAttribute("customPrep", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("customCardTypeCountPanel", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("customObjectPanel", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("customAccessoryPanel", "active", "true")
        end

    elseif buttonID == "customTokenOK" then
        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customCreateBag == true and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customLimitedBag == true and (tonumber(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customTokenBagCount) == 0 or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customTokenBagCount == nil) then
            broadcastToAll("Must enter a numerical value greater than zero.")

        else
            SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.interactable = false
            UI.setAttribute("customPrep", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("customCardTypeCountPanel", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("customObjectPanel", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("customAccessoryPanel", "active", "true")
        end

    elseif buttonID == "customDeckQuantOK" then
        checkCardCountSum()


    --**************************************************************************
    --** #2b Associated Faction List Panel for New Custom Accessory**
    --**************************************************************************
    elseif buttonID == "registerNewAccessoryNext" then
        if (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.accessoryFactionListInput == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.accessoryFactionListInput == "") and
         (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.accessoryExpansionInput == nil or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.accessoryExpansionInput == "") then
            broadcastToAll("An Accessory must be associated with either an expansion or at least one faction (even if the factions haven't been uploaded yet).")

        else

            local function addCustomTags(objData)
                for _, subData in ipairs(objData.ContainedObjects) do
                    subData.Tags = subData.Tags or {}
                    table.insert(subData.Tags, "Extra")
                    table.insert(subData.Tags, "Custom")

                    if subData.ContainedObjects then
                        addCustomTags(subData)
                    end
                end
            end

            local objData = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.getData()

            objData.Nickname = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customObjectName
            objData.GMNotes = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customObjectName

            objData.Tags = {"Extra", "Custom"}

            addCustomTags(objData)

            for tagNum = #objData.Tags, 1, -1 do
                if objData.Tags[tagNum] == "OneCustomObj" then
                    table.remove(objData.Tags, tagNum)
                end
            end

            local tempDeck = spawnObjectData({data = objData, position = {0, 1010, 0}})
            local deckJSON = tempDeck.getJSON(false)
            tempDeck.destruct()
            GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objData = {}
            table.insert(GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objData, deckJSON)
            table.insert(GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objData, "")
            table.insert(GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objData, "")


            GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objName = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customObjectName
            GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objExpansion = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.accessoryExpansionInput or ""
            GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objCreator = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customObjectCreator
            GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objType = SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.name:gsub("Custom", ""):gsub("_", "").." ("..SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type..")"
            GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.explicitFactionNames = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.accessoryFactionListInput or ""


            GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.addedByUserID = tostring(playerInst.steam_id)

            if SmashUp.GameData.Customs.customEditMode then
                GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.rowID = GameData.Customs.onlyThisHostsCustomContent_Array[XMLUI.xmlDataTables.editRowSelected][1]
                editRegisteredCustomObject("extra", "applyEdits", GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable)
            else
                registerNewCustomObject("extra", "initialLook")
            end

            UI.setAttribute("customAccessoryPanel", "active", "false")
        end


    --**************************************************************************
    --** #3 New Deck Primary Info Panel**
    --**************************************************************************
    elseif buttonID == "registerNewDeckNext" then
        if GameData.Customs.importActive == false then
            if SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Card" or SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject.type == "Deck" then
                local validPrimaryInfo = checkForValidNewDeckPrimaryInfo()

                if validPrimaryInfo then
                    prepareIndividualCardEntryPanel()
                end
            end
        end

    elseif buttonID == "registerNewDeckImport" or buttonID == "importImport" then
        if GameData.Customs.importActive == false then
            customImportClicked(buttonID)
        end


    --**************************************************************************
    --** #3b Import from GoogleSheet Panel**
    --**************************************************************************
    elseif buttonID == "importCancel" then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customImport = false
        UI.setAttribute("customImport", "active", "false")


    --**************************************************************************
    --** #4 Invididual Card Info Huge Panel**
    --**************************************************************************
    elseif buttonID == "customCardInfoSubmit" then
        local panelComplete = checkIndividualCardEntryPanelForCompletion()

        if panelComplete then
            retrieveInfoFromInputFields(playerInst)
            UI.setAttribute("eachCardEntryPanel", "active", "false")
        end

    elseif buttonID == "customCardInfoClear" then
        resetCustomCardInfoBoxes(true)

    elseif buttonID == "customCardInfoCloser" or buttonID == "customCardInfoBack" then
        UI.setAttribute("eachCardEntryPanel", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("registerNewDeckPanel", "active", "true")


    --**************************************************************************
    --** #5a Duplicate Object Found on Database Query**
    --**************************************************************************
    elseif buttonID == "customDuplicateProceed" or buttonID == "customExactMatchProceed" then
        local queryType

        if buttonID == "customDuplicateProceed" then
            queryType = "addDuplicate"

        elseif buttonID == "customExactMatchProceed" then
            queryType = "overwriteMatch"
        end

        local objectClass
        -- if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customType_Faction == true and GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objType == "Custom Faction" then
        if GameData.Customs.customDeckType == "Faction" and GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable.objType == "Custom Faction" then
            objectClass = "faction"
        else
            objectClass = "extra"
        end

        registerNewCustomObject(objectClass, queryType)

        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectDuplicateName", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectExactMatchOverWrite", "active", "false")

    elseif buttonID == "customMustRenameBack" then

        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectRename", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("registerNewDeckPanel", "active", "true")

    elseif buttonID == "customPartialEntryProceed" then
        registerNewCustomObject("faction", "overwriteMatch")

        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectPartialEntryExists", "active", "false")

    elseif buttonID == "customPartialEntryCancel" then
        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectPartialEntryExists", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customPrep", "active", "true")

        onObjectEnterZone(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.customZone, SmashUp.GameObjects.CustomObject)

    --**************************************************************************
    --** #5b Custom Object Scripting Found**
    --**************************************************************************
    elseif buttonID == "customScriptingWarningProceed" then
        GameData.Customs.pauseForScriptWarning = false
        UI.setAttribute("objProcessingPopups", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("customObjectScriptWarning", "active", "false")



    elseif buttonID == "customCancel" or buttonID == "customCloser" or buttonID == "customDeckQuantCancel" or buttonID == "customObjectCancel" or buttonID == "customTokenCancel" or buttonID == "customPrepCloser" or (buttonID == "registerNewDeckCancel" and GameData.Customs.importActive == false)
        or buttonID == "registerNewAccessoryCancel" or buttonID == "customDuplicateCancel" or buttonID == "customMustRenameCancel" or buttonID == "customExactMatchCancel" or buttonID == "customScriptingWarningCancel" or buttonID == "customBaseFixCancel" then

        if SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit ~= nil and SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit ~= null then
            UI.setAttribute("customSpawnIn", "interactable", "true")
            SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit.destruct()
            SmashUp.GameObjects.customSpawnedForEdit = nil
        end

        CustomDecks.customRegistrationCancel(buttonID)
    end
end

-- This is the function that is called when a player clicks the primary UI "Custom Decks" button to open the main list/window
function CustomDecks.customPanelOpen()
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.custom.customSystemOn = true

    local bigBox = Common.getObjectByGMNote("Smash Up Box")
    bigBox.interactable = false

    UI.setAttribute("customParent", "active", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("customMain", "active", "true")

    if not GameData.Customs.customDatabaseLoaded then
        CustomDecks.getCustomFactionsFromDatabase()
    else
        CustomDecks.fillCustomsListPanel()
    end

    UI.setAttribute("customButton", "active", "false")

    SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlFunctions.cancelSetup()
end



--******************************************************************************
function CustomDecks.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib
    XMLUI = SmashUp.XMLUI
    GameData = SmashUp.GameData

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues = {}
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customInputFieldValues.customDifficultyInput = 2
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.customRowSelected = {}                                  -- tracks which custom faction has been selected by the user. these get "finalized" when pressing OK.
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.editRowSelected = nil
end

return CustomDecks

end)
