    UI.setValue("secondPlayerText", "Waiting for first player to choose.")
    UI.setValue("severalPlayersText", "Waiting for first player to choose.")

    resetOtherPlayersBoxesStatus()
end


local function setTurnSettingsTable()
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings = {
        ["toggleOption"] = 0,
        ["otherPlayerColor"] = "",
    }
end


function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.initializeTurnSettingsSystem()
    setTurnSettingsTable()

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.turnOptions.turnSettingsPanelOpen = false
    UI.setAttribute("additonalTurnOptionsFrame", "active", "false")

    UI.setAttribute("draftFirst", "interactable", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("playFirst", "interactable", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("turnsRandom", "interactable", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("turnsOK", "interactable", "true")

    resetDraftVsPlayFirstToggle()

    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetBanPanel = true
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = false
end





local function updatePlayersBoxes(boxColor, isActive)

    if boxColor == nil then boxColor = "" end

    local usedUIElement = "severalPlayersText"

    if GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount == 2 then
        isActive = true
        for color in pairs(GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
            boxColor = color
            usedUIElement = "secondPlayerText"
        end
    elseif GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount == 1 then
        isActive = false
        usedUIElement = "secondPlayerText"
    end

    local toggleID = "player"..boxColor.."TurnBox"
    local turnType = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.turnOptions.draftFirst and "play" or "draft"

    if isActive then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.otherPlayerColors[boxColor] = true
        UI.setValue(usedUIElement, "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[boxColor].hex.."\">"..boxColor.."</textcolor> Player will "..turnType.." first.")
        UI.setClass(toggleID, "playerSelectButtonSmall "..boxColor.."Button chosenButton")

        for colorBox, value in pairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.otherPlayerColors) do
            if value == true then
                if colorBox ~= boxColor then
                    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.otherPlayerColors[colorBox] = false
                    UI.setClass("player"..colorBox.."TurnBox", "playerSelectButtonSmall "..colorBox.."Button")
                end
            end
        end

    else
        if boxColor ~= "" then
            UI.setClass(toggleID, "playerSelectButtonSmall "..boxColor.."Button")
        end
        if GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount == 1 then
            UI.setValue(usedUIElement, "")
        else
            UI.setValue(usedUIElement, "Which player will "..turnType.." first?")
        end
    end
end


function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.disableTurnSettingsUI()
    XMLUI.xmlFunctions.setNamePlate()

    UI.setAttribute("turnOptionButtons", "active", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("draftNameLabel", "active", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("draftStart", "interactable", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("additonalTurnOptionsFrame", "active", "false")
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.turnOptions.turnSettingsPanelOpen = false
end


function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.enableTurnSettingsUI()
    local function showOtherPlayersBoxes()
        for _, color in ipairs(Turns.order) do
            if GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[color] and color ~= GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor then
                UI.setAttribute("player"..color.."TurnBox", "active", "true")
            else
                UI.setAttribute("player"..color.."TurnBox", "active", "false")
            end
        end
    end

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.choosePlayer.choosePlayerOptions.chooseDraftOrPlay
      and (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["straightDraftOption"]
      or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["snakeDraftOption"]
      or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["openDraftOption"]
      or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"]) then

        UI.setAttribute("turnOptionButtons", "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("openTurnSettings", "interactable", "true")
        if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftInProgress then
            UI.setAttribute("viewDraft", "interactable", "false")
        else
            UI.setAttribute("viewDraft", "interactable", "true")
        end
        UI.setAttribute("draftNameLabel", "active", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("draftStart", "interactable", "false")

        local color = GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor

        UI.setValue("turnsFrameText", "Will the <textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."\">"..color.."</textcolor> Player\ndraft first or play first?")

        showOtherPlayersBoxes()

        if GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount <= 2 then
            UI.setAttribute("severalPlayersText", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("secondPlayerText", "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("addtionalTurnsOrText", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("turnsRandom", "active", "false")

        else
            UI.setAttribute("severalPlayersText", "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("secondPlayerText", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("addtionalTurnsOrText", "active", "true")
            UI.setAttribute("turnsRandom", "active", "true")
        end

        if (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption > 0 and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.otherPlayerColor ~= "")
        or (XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption > 0 and GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount == 1) then
            UI.setAttribute("additonalTurnOptionsFrame", "active", "false")
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.turnOptions.turnSettingsPanelOpen = false
            UI.setAttribute("draftStart", "interactable", "true")
        else
            FirstPlayerTurnSettings.openTurnSettingsPanel()
        end
    end
end




function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.toggleClicked(toggleID)
    if toggleID == "firstForAll" or toggleID == "chooseDraftOrPlay" then
        if toggleID == "firstForAll" then
            GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = false

            if GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor ~= "" then
                UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor].hex.."\">"..GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor.."</textcolor> player will\nboth draft and play first.")
            else
                UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "The first player will\nboth draft and play first.")
            end

        elseif toggleID == "chooseDraftOrPlay" then

            GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = true

            if GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor ~= "" then
                UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor].hex.."\">"..GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor.."</textcolor> player will\ndecide to draft or play first.\n(on next screen)")
            else
                UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "The first player will\ndecide to draft or play first.\n(on next screen)")
            end
        end

        GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles = true
        GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = true
        GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetBanPanel = true

    else
        UI.setAttribute("additionalTurnOptionsToggleGroup", "allowSwitchOff", "false")              -- code note: when the toggle group is "on", then the allowSwitchOff attribute must be false

        local boxColor = nil
        local isActive = false

        for colorBox, value in pairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.otherPlayerColors) do
            if value == true then
                boxColor = colorBox
                isActive = true
            else
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["turnSettings"]["otherPlayerColors"][colorBox] = false
                UI.setClass("player"..colorBox.."TurnBox", "playerSelectButtonSmall "..colorBox.."Button")
            end
            if colorBox ~= GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor then
                if GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[colorBox] then
                    UI.setAttribute("player"..colorBox.."TurnBox", "interactable", "true")
                end
            end
        end

        updatePlayersBoxes(boxColor, isActive)
    end
end


function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.clickColorBoxToggle(playerInst, buttonClick, toggleID)
    local boxColor = toggleID:match("player(.*)TurnBox")

    if GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount >=3 then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.otherPlayerColors[boxColor] = not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.otherPlayerColors[boxColor]
        updatePlayersBoxes(boxColor, XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.otherPlayerColors[boxColor])
    end
end


function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.randomlySelectSecondPlayer()
    local shortTable = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings

    if shortTable.turnOptions.draftFirst or shortTable.turnOptions.playFirst then
        local playerList = {}

        for color in pairs(GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor) do
            if color ~= GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor then
                table.insert(playerList, color)
            end
        end

        local otherPlayerColor = playerList[math.random(#playerList)]

        shortTable.otherPlayerColors[otherPlayerColor] = true

        local attribUsed = GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount <= 2 and "secondPlayerText" or "severalPlayersText"
        local turnType = shortTable.turnOptions.draftFirst and "play" or "draft"

        UI.setValue(attribUsed, "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[otherPlayerColor].hex.."\">"..otherPlayerColor.."</textcolor> Player will "..turnType.." first.")
        UI.setClass("player"..otherPlayerColor.."TurnBox", "playerSelectButtonSmall "..otherPlayerColor.."Button chosenButton")


        for color, value in pairs(shortTable.otherPlayerColors) do
            if color ~= GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor and color ~= otherPlayerColor then
                shortTable.otherPlayerColors[color] = false
                UI.setClass("player"..color.."TurnBox", "playerSelectButtonSmall "..color.."Button")
            end
        end
    end
end


function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.turnSettingsCancel()
    local shortTable = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings

    shortTable.turnOptions.turnSettingsPanelOpen = false
    UI.setAttribute("additonalTurnOptionsFrame", "active", "false")

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption == 0 then
        resetDraftVsPlayFirstToggle()

    else
        shortTable.turnOptions.draftFirst = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption == 1
        UI.setAttribute("draftFirst", "isOn", shortTable.turnOptions.draftFirst)

        shortTable.turnOptions.playFirst = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption == 2
        UI.setAttribute("playFirst", "isOn", shortTable.turnOptions.playFirst)

        updatePlayersBoxes(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.otherPlayerColor, XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.otherPlayerColor ~= "")
    end
end


function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.turnSettingsOK()
    local shortTable = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings

    shortTable.turnOptions.turnSettingsPanelOpen = false
    UI.setAttribute("additonalTurnOptionsFrame", "active", "false")

    if shortTable.turnOptions.draftFirst == true then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption = 1
    elseif shortTable.turnOptions.playFirst == true then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption = 2
    else
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption = 0
    end

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.otherPlayerColor = ""
    for color, value in pairs(shortTable.otherPlayerColors) do
        if value == true then
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.otherPlayerColor = color

            if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption == 1 then
                GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstDraftTurnColor = GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor
                GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor = color

            elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption == 2 then
                GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstDraftTurnColor = color
                GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor = GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor
            end
        end
    end

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.otherPlayerColor ~= "" or (GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount == 1 and XMLUI.xmlDataTables.additionalTurnSettings.toggleOption > 0) then
        UI.setAttribute("draftStart", "interactable", "true")
    else
        UI.setAttribute("draftStart", "interactable", "false")
    end
end




function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.openTurnSettingsPanel()
    UI.setAttribute("additonalTurnOptionsFrame", "active", "true")
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.turnOptions.turnSettingsPanelOpen = true
end


function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.turnSettingsButtonClicked()
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.turnOptions.turnSettingsPanelOpen = not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.turnOptions.turnSettingsPanelOpen

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.turnOptions.turnSettingsPanelOpen then
        FirstPlayerTurnSettings.openTurnSettingsPanel()
    else
        FirstPlayerTurnSettings.turnSettingsCancel()
    end
end






function FirstPlayerTurnSettings.onLoad(lib)
    SmashUp = lib
    XMLUI = SmashUp.XMLUI
    GameData = SmashUp.GameData
end

return FirstPlayerTurnSettings

-- this function is called when re-drawing the DraftSelectionPanel to reset each player's row to default

-- this function resets the `draft` confirm button of a draftBox when it becomes inactivated to its hidden/inactive/white state

    for expansion, factionList in pairs(Database.factionsByExpansion) do    -- for every expansion, and its list of factions, in the factionsByExpansion table... (this accounts for ALL expansions and factions, and is set up this way to account for factions/expansions that may be added in the future)

        UI.setAttribute("text_draftBox"..i, "active", "false")          -- ... make the text element inside the draftBox inactive
        UI.setAttribute("text_draftBox"..i, "text", "")                     -- ... and reset the text attribute to blank

        UI.setAttribute("image_draftBox"..i.."_scroll", "active", "false")         -- ... make the image element inside the draftBox inactive
        UI.setAttribute("image_draftBox"..i.."_scroll", "image", "")                   -- ... and reset the image attribute to blank
        UI.setAttribute("image_draftBox"..i.."_scroll", "color", "White")              -- ... and reset the image's color attribute to White
        UI.setAttribute("text_draftBox"..i.."_scroll", "active", "false")          -- ... make the text element inside the draftBox inactive

-- this function is called to reset the entire draftPanel
-- it calls sub functions to complete this process

-- this function resets the drafting process, starting the whole draft over from the beginning
function DraftSelectionPanel.initializeDraftPhaseData()

    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 1                                                   -- establishes this variable that will be used to track which players turn it is, advancing through turn order

function DraftSelectionPanel.ensureProperDraftPoolSize()
    local draftCount = #GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool                                                           -- count how many factions are in the randomized drafting pool
    local numberToDraft = GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount * GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer                                      -- calculate how many factions there are supposed to be in the drafting pool

    if draftCount < numberToDraft then                                                                          -- if there are less factions in the pool than there are supposed to be...
        for i = 1, numberToDraft - draftCount do                                                                -- ... then for every additional faction that needs to be added to the pool...
            local customDealt = false
            local randFactionIndex

            if GameData.Customs.customsMandatory then
                if #GameData.Customs.customListForDrafting > 0 then
                    randFactionIndex = math.random(#GameData.Customs.customListForDrafting)
                    table.insert(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool, table.remove(GameData.Customs.customListForDrafting, randFactionIndex))
                    customDealt = true
                end
            end

            if not customDealt then
                randFactionIndex = math.random(#GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting)                                  -- ... generate a random index number...
                table.insert(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool, GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting[randFactionIndex])              -- ... and store the faction at that index number (from the UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting table) in the UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool table...
                table.remove(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting, randFactionIndex)                                         -- ... and then remove that index number entry from the UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting table so that it can't be used/dealt again
            end
        end
        GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetDraftSelectionPanel = true                                                                           -- ... because the draft pool has changed, allow drafting to start over

    elseif draftCount > numberToDraft then                                                                      -- otherwise, if there are more factions in the pool than there are supposed to be...
        for i = 1, draftCount - numberToDraft do                                                                -- ... for every excess faction in the pool...
            if Database.factionTable[GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool[#GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool]].custom then
                table.insert(GameData.Customs.customListForDrafting, GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool[#GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool])
            end

            table.insert(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting, table.remove(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool))                  -- ... remove the faction from the draft pool and add it back into the available factionList
            table.remove(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes)                                                              -- ... and remove the draftBox element's entry in the draftElements arrayTable
        end
        GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetDraftSelectionPanel = true                                                                       -- ... because the draft pool has changed, allow drafting to start over
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting = Common.randomizeTable(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting)                -- ... re-randomize the factionList
    end
end



-- this function is called when the rightDraftPanel is being drawn
-- this function resets all the attributes of each individual draftBox element if the draft phase is being reset
local function resetDraftElementAttribs(boxNum, faction)
    if GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetDraftSelectionPanel == true then                                                          -- if the draft pool needs to be reset (UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetDraftSelectionPanel = true)...
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum] = {}                                                       -- ... establish this index of the draftelements arrayTable as an empty table...
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].drafted = false                                            -- ... set the `drafted` field to false...
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].banned = false                                             -- ... set the `banned` field to false...
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].basePicked = false                                         -- ... set the `banned` field to false...
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].faction = faction                                          -- ... save the name of the faction assigned to this index...
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].owner = "White"                                            -- ... reset the color of this faction's UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes to 'White'
        if Database.factionTable[faction] then                                                          -- ... if the faction currently being sent to this function via the parameter is found in the factionTable (ie: its not a "blank" faction)...
            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].expansion = Database.factionTable[faction].expansion       -- ... save the expansion of the faction assigned to this index...
            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].sortIndex = Database.factionTable[faction].orderNo         -- ... save the faction's sortOrderNumer to help aid in sorting by expansion...
            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].complexity = Database.factionTable[faction].compLevel      -- ... save the faction's complexity level
        else                                                                                            -- ... otherwise, if the faction variable is blank...
            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].expansion = ""                                             -- ... create the expansion attribute, but set it to blank...
            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].sortIndex = ""                                             -- ... create the sortIndex attribute, but make it blank...
            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].complexity = ""                                            -- ... create the complexity attribute, but make it blank
        end
    end

    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum] = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum] or {}
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].selected = false                       -- set the `selected` field to false (no draftBox should be 'selected' after resetting/redrawing)
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].highlight = "White"                    -- set the `highlight` field to "White" (after resetting, no draftBox will be selected/highlighted)
end

-- this function checks if a draftBox element has been drafted or banned or basePicked, and if so, changes the element colors as appropriate
local function recolorDraftOrBannedElements(draftID, boxNum)
    local boxColor = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].owner                                     -- for ease of use, establish this variable as the player color (or White) saved in the draftBox's UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table

    if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].drafted == true then                                    -- if the current iterated faction's draftBox has been drafted (as noted in the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes `drafted` attribute)...
        UI.setAttribute("image_"..draftID, "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE[boxColor].Solid)       -- ... set the color shade of the image to that of the player that drafted it...
        UI.setAttribute("image_"..draftID.."_scroll", "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE[boxColor].Solid)       -- ... set the color shade of the image to that of the player that drafted it...
        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.highlightFactionUIElement(draftID, boxColor, 4)                                -- ... call this function to establish a highlight outline around this faction's draftBox using the color of the player that drafted it
    end

    if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].banned == true then                                     -- if the current iterated faction's draftBox has been banned (as tracked in the draftElementAttribu `banned` attribute)...
        UI.setAttribute("image_"..draftID, "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Black"].Solid)        -- ... set the color shade of the image to "Black", as it is banned...
        UI.setAttribute("image_"..draftID.."_scroll", "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Black"].Solid)        -- ... set the color shade of the image to "Black", as it is banned...
        local extraAttribs = {color = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Black"].Highlighted}                -- ... define this extraAttribs table to change the elements highlighting to Black...
        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.highlightFactionUIElement(draftID, boxColor, 4, extraAttribs)                  -- ... call this function to create a Black "highlight" around this draftBox
    end

    if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[boxNum].basePicked == true then
        UI.setAttribute("image_"..draftID, "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Teal"].Solid)
        UI.setAttribute("image_"..draftID.."_scroll", "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Teal"].Solid)
        local extraAttribs = {color = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Teal"].Highlighted}
        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.highlightFactionUIElement(draftID, boxColor, 4, extraAttribs)
    end
end

-- this function is called when the draftBoxes are created to add the factions to the elements, obtaining the info from the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table.
-- this function will also reset the draftBox elements and associated attribs to default when appropriate
local function assignDraftElementAttribs(factionCount, faction)
    local draftID = "draftBox"..factionCount                                                        -- create this variable for ease of use/readability...

    UI.setAttribute("image_"..draftID.."_scroll", "active", "true")                                            -- activate the draftBox image element
    UI.setAttribute("image_"..draftID.."_scroll", "image", faction)                                            -- add the faction's image

    for boxNum, faction in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool) do                                                                 -- for every faction randomized into the draft pool (UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool)...

This will identify which column the draftFaction box appears in.

-- this function iterates through the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table (after it has been sorted) and removes all blank entries
local function removeBlankDraftBoxes()
    for i = #GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes, 1, -1 do                             -- counting through the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes, from the last entry to the first ...
        if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[i].faction == "" or GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[i].faction == nil then                   -- ... if the faction attribute is blank...

        end

end

-- this function is called to redraw the rightDraftPane with the factions sorted by complexity
local function drawByComplexity(height)
    -- this local function sorts the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table by complexity
    local function draftSortByComplexity(a, b)
        local factionA = a.faction or ""                                        -- set this variable to the 1st compared entries faction field, or blank if nil
        local factionB = b.faction or ""                                        -- set this variable to the 2nd compared entries faction field, or blank if nil
        local orderA = a.complexity or ""                                       -- set this variable to the 1st compared entries complexity field, or blank if nil
        local orderB = b.complexity or ""                                       -- set this variable to the 2nd compared entries complexity field, or blank if nil

        local complexityTable = {                                                  -- create a table that sets up numerical levels for comparing various complexities
            ["Low"] = 1,
            ["Low-Medium"] = 2,
            ["Medium"] = 3,
            ["Medium-High"] = 4,
            ["High"] = 5,
            [""] = 6
        }
        if orderA == orderB then                                                -- if the complexity of the two compared entries are the same...
            return factionA < factionB                                          -- ... then sort alphabetically
        else
            return complexityTable[orderA] < complexityTable[orderB]                  -- ... otherwise, using the complexityTable, sort them by complexity
        end
    end

    table.sort(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes, draftSortByComplexity)                 -- sort the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table, by complexity
    local factionCount = 0                                                          -- establish this counting variable as 0
    local compLevel = ""                                                            -- establish this variable, used to check if we are iterating through a new complexity category, as blank

    for _, draftAttribs in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes) do                  -- for every entry in the now-sorted UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table...
        factionCount = factionCount + 1                                             -- ... increase the factionCount by 1...

        if draftAttribs.complexity ~= "" and draftAttribs.complexity ~= nil then    -- ... as long as the complexity field isn't blank or nil...
            if draftAttribs.complexity ~= compLevel then                                -- ... if the complexity of the current iteration is DIFFERENT from the one previously iterated (found a new category)...
                local adjustment = 4 - ((factionCount - 1) % 4)                             -- ... calculate this variable which is used to add blank entries for padding purposes, putting the next category on a new line
                if adjustment ~= 4 then                                                     -- ... as long as the adjustment calculation is NOT 4...
                    for i = 1, adjustment do                                                    -- ... counting from 1 to the adjustment...
                        table.insert(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes, factionCount, {})                -- ... add a blank entry into UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes at the index of the current factionCount
                        resetDraftElementAttribs(factionCount, "")                                  -- ... call this function to set the new blank entries attributes
                    end
                end
            end
            compLevel = draftAttribs.complexity                                         -- ... set the compLevel variable equal to the current iterations complexity (will be compared to next iteration to see if they are different)
        end
    end

    local factionCount = 0                                                          -- reset the factionCount variable to 0
    local rowNum = 1                                                                -- establish this variable to track which row in the rightDraftPane is being drawn on
    local compLevel = ""                                                            -- reset this variable to blank

    for _, draftAttribs in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes) do                  -- for every entry in the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table (which now includes white/blank entries for padding)...
        factionCount = factionCount + 1                                             -- ... increase the factionCount by 1...
        local faction = draftAttribs.faction                                        -- ... set this variable for ease of use and readability...

        if draftAttribs.complexity ~= "" and draftAttribs.complexity ~= nil then    -- ... as long as the complexity field isn't blank or nil...
            if draftAttribs.complexity ~= compLevel then                                -- ... if the complexity of the current iteration is DIFFERENT from the one previously iterated (found a new category)...
                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_label", "active", "true")                         -- ... activate the label of this row...
                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_labelText", "text", draftAttribs.complexity)      -- ... and display the complexity level text...

                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_label_scroll", "active", "true")                         -- ... activate the label of this row...
                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_labelText_scroll", "text", draftAttribs.complexity)      -- ... and display the complexity level text...
                height = height + 35                                                                    -- ... add appropriate height to the height measurement variable
            end
            compLevel = draftAttribs.complexity                                         -- ... set the compLevel variable equal to the current iterations complexity (will be compared to next iteration to see if they are different)

            if faction ~= "" then                                                       -- ... if the faction attribute isn't blank (ie: this is not a blank entry)...
                local colIndex = ((factionCount - 1) % 4) + 1                               -- ... calculate a number (called the column index) by subtracting one from the current factionCount, dividing it by 4 to find the remainder, and then adding one to that. This will identify which column the draftFaction box appears in.
                if colIndex == 1 then                                                       -- ... if the column of the draftBox is 1 (then start a new row)...
                    UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum, "active", "true")                       -- ... activate the row with value of rowNum...
                    UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_scroll", "active", "true")                       -- ... activate the row with value of rowNum...
                    height = height + 133                                                           -- ... increase height of panel by one row...
                    rowNum = rowNum + 1                                                             -- ... increase rowNum by 1
                end

                assignDraftElementAttribs(factionCount, faction)                             -- ... call this function to draw each draft option in the rightDraftPane
            end
        end
    end
    return height                                                                   -- return this value to the calling function
end

-- this function is called to redraw the rightDraftPane with the factions sorted alphabetically
local function drawAlphabetically(height)
    -- this local function sorts the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table alphabetically
    local function draftSortAlphabetically(a, b)
        local factionA = a.faction:match("^(.*) %*%&%^%*") or a.faction or ""                                        -- set this variable to the 1st compared entries faction field, or blank if nil
        local factionB = b.faction:match("^(.*) %*%&%^%*") or b.faction or ""                                        -- set this variable to the 2nd compared entries faction field, or blank if nil

        if factionA == "" or factionB == "" then                                -- if either of the faction attributes are blank...
            return factionB < factionA                                          -- ... then sort so that the blank one moves to the end of the list
        end
        return factionA < factionB                                              -- sort alphabetically
    end

    table.sort(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes, draftSortAlphabetically)               --sort the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table alphabetically

    local factionCount = 0                                                          -- establish this counting variable as 0
    local rowNum = 1                                                                -- establish this variable to track which row in the rightDraftPane is being drawn on

    for _, draftAttribs in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes) do
        if draftAttribs.faction ~= nil and draftAttribs.faction ~= "" then
            factionCount =factionCount + 1

            local colIndex = ((factionCount - 1) % 4) + 1
            if colIndex == 1 then
                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum, "active", "true")
                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_scroll", "active", "true")
                height = height + 133
                rowNum = rowNum + 1
            end

            assignDraftElementAttribs(factionCount, draftAttribs.faction)
        end
    end

    return height                                                                   -- return this value to the calling function
end

-- this function is called to redraw the rightDraftPane with the factions sorted by expansion
local function drawByExpansion(height)
    -- this local function sorts the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table by expansion
    local function draftSortByExpansion(a, b)
        local orderA = tonumber(a.sortIndex) or 0                               -- set this variable to the 1st compared entries sortIndex field, or zero if nil
        local orderB = tonumber(b.sortIndex) or 0                               -- set this variable to the 2nd compared entries sortIndex field, or zero if nil

        if a.expansion == "Custom" or b.expansion == "Custom" then
            if a.expansion == "Custom" and b.expansion ~= "Custom" then
                return true
            elseif a.expansion ~= "Custom" and b.expansion == "Custom" then
                return false
            else
                return a.faction < b.faction
            end
        end

        if orderA == 0 or orderB == 0 then                                      -- if either of the sortOrder attributes are zero then...
            return orderB < orderA                                              -- ... then sort so that they move to the end of the table
        else
            return orderA < orderB                                              -- ... otherwise, sort them in ascending sortOrder
        end
    end

    table.sort(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes, draftSortByExpansion)                  -- sort the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table by expansion

    local factionCount = 0                                                          -- establish this counting variable as 0
    local expansion = ""                                                            -- establish this variable as blank; it is used to check if we are iterating through a new expansion

    for _, draftAttribs in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes) do                  -- for every entry in the now-sorted UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table...

                    for i = 1, adjustment do                                                    -- ... counting from 1 to the adjustment...

                    end
                end
            end
            expansion = draftAttribs.expansion                                          -- ... set the expansion variable equal to the current iterations expansion (will be compared to next iteration to see if they are different)
        end
    end

    factionCount = 0                                                                -- reset the factionCount variable to 0
    local rowNum = 1                                                                -- establish this variable to track which row in the rightDraftPane is being drawn on
    local expansion = ""                                                            -- reset this variable to blank

    for _, draftAttribs in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes) do                  -- for every entry in the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table (which now includes white/blank entries for padding)...
        factionCount = factionCount + 1                                             -- ... increase the factionCount by 1...
        local faction = draftAttribs.faction                                        -- ... set this variable for ease of use and readability...

        if draftAttribs.expansion ~= nil and draftAttribs.expansion ~= "" then      -- ... as long as the expansion field isn't blank or nil...
            if draftAttribs.expansion ~= expansion then                                 -- ... if the expansion of the current iteration is DIFFERENT from the one previously iterated (found a new expansion)...
                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_label", "active", "true")                         -- ... activate the label of this row...
                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_labelText", "text", draftAttribs.expansion)       -- ... and display the expansion text...

                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_label_scroll", "active", "true")                         -- ... activate the label of this row...
                UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_labelText_scroll", "text", draftAttribs.expansion)       -- ... and display the expansion text...
                height = height + 35                                                                    -- ... add appropriate height to the height measurement variable
            end
            expansion = draftAttribs.expansion                                          -- ... set the expansion variable equal to the current iterations expansion (will be compared to next iteration to see if they are different)

            if faction ~= nil and faction ~= "" then                                    -- ... if the faction attribute isn't blank (ie: this is not a blank entry)...
                local colIndex = ((factionCount - 1) % 4) + 1                               -- ... calculate a number (called the column index) by subtracting one from the current factionCount, dividing it by 4 to find the remainder, and then adding one to that. This will identify which column the draftFaction box appears in.
                if colIndex == 1 then                                                       -- ... if the column of the draftBox is 1 (then start a new row)...
                    UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum, "active", "true")                       -- ... activate the row with value of rowNum...
                    UI.setAttribute("draftRow"..rowNum.."_scroll", "active", "true")                       -- ... activate the row with value of rowNum...
                    height = height + 133                                                           -- ... increase height of panel by one row...
                    rowNum = rowNum + 1                                                             -- ... increase rowNum by 1
                end

                assignDraftElementAttribs(factionCount, faction)                             -- ... call this function to draw each draft option in the rightDraftPane
            end
        end
    end
    return height                                                                   -- return this value to the calling function
end

-- this function is called to display/draw the rightDraftPanel
local function drawAllFactions()
    local height = 0                                                                            -- set this measuring variable, starting it at zero

    if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode == "byExpansion" then height = drawByExpansion(height) end          -- call these various functions depending on the value of the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode variable.
    if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode == "Alphabetical" then height = drawAlphabetically(height) end

        UI.setAttribute("rightDraftPanePanel", "active", "false")

    else
        UI.setAttribute("rightDraftPanePanel", "active", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("rightDraftPaneScroll", "active", "false")
    end

    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetDraftSelectionPanel = false                                                                 -- turn off the "needs reset" flag (UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetDraftSelectionPanel)
end

-- this function is the first to create/establish the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table
local function createDraftElementAttribsTable()
    local factionCount = 0                                                      -- set this count variable to zero
    for faction, factionInfo in pairs(Database.factionTable) do                 -- for every faction in the factionTable...
        if factionInfo.expansion ~= "Decks" then                                -- ... as long as its expansion is not "Decks"...
            if factionInfo.included == true then                                    -- ... then if it is supposed to be included...
                factionCount = factionCount + 1                                         -- ... increase the factionCount by 1...
                resetDraftElementAttribs(factionCount, faction)                         -- ... call this function to establish an entry for this faction's draftBox at this iterated index, and setup its attributes with defaults
            end
        end
    end
end

-- this function is called when the turn changes to the next player to give that player access to the sortButton
local function sortTurnChange()
    UI.setAttribute("sortButtonActive", "visibility", GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber].color) -- set the visibility of the usable sortButton to the current player

    local visibString = "White"                                                                             -- reset this variable to contain only the white player
    for num = 1, GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount do                                                                       -- for every player in the game...
        if num ~= GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber then                                                                    -- ... if their orderNumber is NOT equal to the current UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber...
            visibString = visibString.."|"..GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[num].color                                  -- ... add the color to the visibility string
        end
    end
    UI.setAttribute("sortButtonInactive", "visibility", visibString)                                        -- set the visibility of the un-usable sortButton to all non-current players
end

-- this function is called when the sortButton is clicked
function DraftSelectionPanel.sortButtonClicked(playerInst, buttonClick, draftID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end                                                          -- if this button is clicked by a mouse button OTHER than the left click, dont' do anything.
    local playerColor = playerInst.color                                                                    -- set this variable to the color of the player that clicked the button

    local turnNum = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnOrderByGameTurnNumber[GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber]
    local turnColor = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].color                                              -- find the color of the current player

    if turnColor == playerColor then                                                                        -- if the current player is the one that clicked the button then...
        if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode == "byExpansion" then                                                       -- ... if the rightDraftPane is currently sorted by expansion...
            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode = "Alphabetical"                                                               -- ... set UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode to sort alphabetically

            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonImageActive", "image", "SortComplexity")                                 -- ... set the image of the usable sortButton for sorting by complexity
            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonImageInactive", "image", "SortComplexity")                               -- ... set the image of the un-usable sortButton for sorting by complexity
            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonActive", "tooltip", "Click to sort factions by complexity.")             -- ... change the tooltip to indicate that next click will sort by complexity

        elseif GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode == "Alphabetical" then                                                  -- ... if the rightDraftPane is currently sorted alphabetically...
            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode = "byComplexity"                                                               -- ... set UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode to sort by complexity

            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonImageActive", "image", "SortExpansion")                                  -- ... set the image of the usable sortButton for sorting by expansion
            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonImageInactive", "image", "SortExpansion")                                -- ... set the image of the un-usable sortButton for sorting by expansion
            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonActive", "tooltip", "Click to sort factions by expansion.")              -- ... change the tooltip to indicate that next click will sort by expansion

        elseif GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode == "byComplexity" then                                                  -- ... if the rightDraftPane is currently sorted by complexity...
            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode = "byExpansion"                                                                -- ... set UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode to sort by expansion

            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonImageActive", "image", "SortAlphabetical")                               -- ... set the image of the usable sortButton for sorting alphabetically
            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonImageInactive", "image", "SortAlphabetical")                             -- ... set the image of the un-usable sortButton for sorting alphabetically
            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonActive", "tooltip", "Click to sort factions alphabetically.")            -- ... change the tooltip to indicate that next click will sort alphabetically
        end
        resetRightDraftPane()
        drawAllFactions()
    end
end

-- this function turns on Turns for the appropriate player/color
local function activateTurn()
    if not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.draftOptions.freePickOption then                   -- as long as the freePick method was not selected...
        if not GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.allPlayersFinishedDrafting or (GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress and not GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftComplete) then                     -- ... and as long as drafting phase is NOT complete...
            local turnNum = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnOrderByGameTurnNumber[GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber]

            Turns.turn_color = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].color                             -- ... set the turn to the color of the player whose turn it is, which also activates turns.
            Turns.enable = false                                                                    -- ... deactivates turns, so players can't use the end turn button before drafting their faction
            UI.setAttribute(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].ID.."_turn", "active", "true")       -- ... set the turn indicator to the appropriate current player
            UI.setAttribute(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].ID.."_turn_scroll", "active", "true")       -- ... set the turn indicator to the appropriate current player
        end
    end
end





-- this function is called when any true "draft" style draftMethod options are chosen, to generate the UI panel
function DraftSelectionPanel.generateDraftUI(drawAll)
    refreshDraftPhaseUI()                                                                            -- call this function to reset all the draftBoxes to white/blank, erasing previously drawn factions

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["openDraftOption"] or
      XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"] then                      -- if openDraft method has been chosen...
        UI.setAttribute("sortButtonInactive", "active", "true")                                     -- ... then show/activate the un-usable sortButton
    else
        UI.setAttribute("sortButtonInactive", "active", "false")                                    -- ... otherwise, hide/deactivate the un-usable sortButton
    end

    XMLUI.xmlFunctions.resizePlayerRowPanels()                                                      -- call this function to resize the leftPlayerPane to accommodate more than 4 players if needed

    if GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer <= 2 then                                                         -- if there are 2 (or less...?) factions per player in the pool...
        UI.setAttribute("openBanPanel", "interactable", "false")                                    -- ... then make the "Ban Phase" button un-interactable, and change it's tooltip to note why
        UI.setAttribute("openBanPanel", "tooltip", "There aren't enough factions in the pool to allow ban phases.")
    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"] then                 -- or if the freePick method has been chosen
        UI.setAttribute("openBanPanel", "interactable", "false")                                    -- ... then make the "Ban Phase" button un-interactable, and change it's tooltip to note why
        UI.setAttribute("openBanPanel", "tooltip", "No ban phases are allowed during free pick.")
    end

    if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftInProgress == true then                                                           -- only if the draft phase has started (the "Start Draft" button has been clicked)...
        activateTurn()                                                                                  -- ... call this function to initiate turns (for the current player)...

        if drawAll then                                                                             -- ... if drawAll is TRUE (either openDraft or freePick methods were selected)...
            drawAllFactions()                                                                           -- ... call this function to draw all the included factions into the rightDraftPane
        else                                                                                        -- ... for all other draft methods...
            drawDraftPoolFactions()                                                                     -- ... call this function to draw in the factions that have been added to the pool to draft from
        end

    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool.draftViewed then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool.draftViewed = false
        UI.setAttribute("draftGrayMask", "active", "true")                                          -- reactivate the overlying "gray mask"
        UI.setAttribute("viewDraft", "text", "View Draft Pool")
    end

    if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.allPlayersFinishedDrafting == true then                                                          -- if the draft phase has been completed then...
        UI.setAttribute("draftPickerNext", "interactable", "true")                                  -- ... activate the next button
    end

    for i, playerInfo in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do                                       -- for every player in UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table...
        playerInfo.selectedDraft = nil                                                              -- ... reset the players `selectedDraft` field to nil (player doesn't have any draft options selected at this moment)

        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.addRowColorAndName(playerInfo)                                           -- ... call this function to label each row with the player's name, and change the row's color to that of the player
        for j, draftedFaction in ipairs(playerInfo.factionsDrafted) do                              -- ... for every faction contained in the player's `factionsDrafted` list...
            UI.setAttribute("image_"..playerInfo.ID.."_draft"..j, "image", draftedFaction)              -- ... set the image of the player's drafted faction box to that of the drafted faction
            UI.setAttribute("text_"..playerInfo.ID.."_draft"..j, "text", draftedFaction)                -- ... set the text of the player's drafted faction box to that of the drafted faction

            UI.setAttribute("image_"..playerInfo.ID.."_draft"..j.."_scroll", "image", draftedFaction)              -- ... set the image of the player's drafted faction box to that of the drafted faction
            UI.setAttribute("text_"..playerInfo.ID.."_draft"..j.."_scroll", "text", draftedFaction)                -- ... set the text of the player's drafted faction box to that of the drafted faction
        end
    end

    XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("draftSelection")                                                  -- activate the draftSelection panel
end


function DraftSelectionPanel.viewDraftPool()
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool.draftViewed = not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool.draftViewed

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool.draftViewed then
        UI.setAttribute("draftGrayMask", "active", "false")         -- deactivate the overlying "gray mask"

    else
        resetRightDraftPane()
