-- this function is called when ban phases have been activated.
-- this function indicates whether players are in a ban or a draft phase.
local function popUpMessage(phase, color)
    if color == nil then color = "Blue" end
    UI.setClass("popUp", "popUp "..phase)           -- set the class of this "popUp" element to the appropriate phase
    UI.setAttribute("popUp", "active", "true")      -- and activate the popUp element
    UI.setAttribute("popUp", "color", color)
end

-- this function is called after the "Start Draft" button is clicked, or after a player confirms a draft.
-- this function checks to see if there should be a ban phase activated or not.
function DraftSelectionPanel.banPhaseCheck()
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.bansActivated then                                       -- if ban phases are activated (via the settings panel)...
        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banTurnOrder[GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound] then
            if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banTurnOrder[GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound].phase == "preDraft"
              and GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound == 1 then
                GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive = true
                popUpMessage("ban")                                                                 -- ... call this function to display the ban phase popUp

            elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banTurnOrder[GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound].phase == "midDraft"
              and GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound == 2 then
                GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive = true
                popUpMessage("ban")                                                                 -- ... call this function to display the ban phase popUp

            else
                GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive = false
                popUpMessage("draft")                                                               -- ... display the draft phase popUp
            end

            if GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive then
                if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banPhaseCount == 1 then
                    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banTurnOrder[GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound].start == "first" then
                        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 1
                        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = 1
                    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banTurnOrder[GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound].start == "last" then
                        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount
                        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = -1
                    end

                elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banPhaseCount == 2 then
                    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_C == 1 then --straight bans
                        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banTurnOrder[GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound].start == "first" then
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 1
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = 1

                        elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banTurnOrder[GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound].start == "last" then
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = -1
                        end

                    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.toggleOption_C == 2 then --snake bans
                        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banTurnOrder[GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound].start == "first" then
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 1
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = 1

                        elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.banSettings.banTurnOrder[GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound].start == "last" then
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = -1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive = false
            popUpMessage("draft")                                                               -- ... display the draft phase popUp
        end

    else                                                                                    -- otherwise (if ban phases have NOT been activated)...
        GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive = false                                                         -- ... set this flag variable to false (preventing ban phases from occuring)...
        UI.setAttribute("popUp", "active", "false")                                         -- ... deactivate the draft/ban phase popUp...
    end

    DraftSelectionPanel.unselectDraft()                                                     -- call this function to clear any selected draftBoxes, preventing players from having a "Ban" button during drafting and vice versa
end

-- this function is called when the host clicks the "Start Draft" button, removing the overlying "gray mask"
function DraftSelectionPanel.startDraftPhase(drawAll)
    UI.setAttribute("draftGrayMask", "active", "false")         -- deactivate the overlying "gray mask"
    UI.setAttribute("draftFirst", "interactable", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("playFirst", "interactable", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("turnsRandom", "interactable", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("turnsOK", "interactable", "false")

    for colorBox, value in pairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.turnSettings.otherPlayerColors) do
        UI.setAttribute("player"..colorBox.."TurnBox", "interactable", "false")
    end

    UI.setAttribute("viewDraft", "interactable", "false")
    UI.setAttribute("viewDraft", "text", "View Draft Pool")
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool.draftViewed = false

    UI.setAttribute("draftStart", "active", "false")            -- deactivate the "Start Draft" button
    UI.setAttribute("draftPickerNext", "active", "true")        -- activate the "Next" button (though it will be un-interactable at this point)

    UI.setAttribute("waitingRow", "active", "false")            -- deactivate the text bar at the top of the rightDraftPane (the one that says "Waiting for host...")

    if GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[1].color ~= GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor then
        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.resetPlayerSetupProfilesPreservingFactionsDealt()
        DraftSelectionPanel.generateDraftUI((XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["openDraftOption"] or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"]))
    end

    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftInProgress = true                                -- set this flag to true to mark that the drafting phase has now started
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound = 1                                     -- make sure this variable is reset to first phase

    if drawAll then                                             -- if openDraft or freePick methods were selected...
        removeBlankDraftBoxes()
        createDraftElementAttribsTable()                        -- ... call this function to initialize the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes table...
        drawAllFactions()                                       -- ... call this function to draw all included factions in the rightDraftPane...
        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["openDraftOption"] then    -- ... if openDraft method was selected...
            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonActive", "active", "true")                       -- ... show/activate the usable sortButton...
            sortTurnChange()                                                            -- ... and call this function to make the sortButton visible to the current (first) player

        elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"] then
            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonActive", "active", "true")                       -- ... show/activate the usable sortButton...

            local visibString = "White"                                                                             -- reset this variable to contain only the white player
            for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
                if player.host == true then
                    UI.setAttribute("sortButtonActive", "visibility", player.color)
                else
                    visibString = visibString.."|"..player.color                                  -- ... add the color to the visibility string
                end
            end
            UI.setAttribute("sortButtonInactive", "visibility", visibString)
        end
    else                                                        -- for all other draft methods...
        drawDraftPoolFactions()                                 -- ... call this function to draw in the factions that have been added to the pool to draft from
    end

    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnOrderByGameTurnNumber = {[0] = 0}
    for turnNum = 1, GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount do
        local newNum = (GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstDraftTurnColor] + turnNum) - 1
        if newNum > GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount then newNum = newNum - GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount end
        table.insert(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnOrderByGameTurnNumber, newNum)
    end

    DraftSelectionPanel.banPhaseCheck()                         -- call this function to check if a ban phase is up next

    activateTurn()                                              -- call this function to initiate turns (for the first player in this instance)...

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"] then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["optionToggles"]["openBanPanel"] = false
        UI.setAttribute("banOptionsFrame", "active", "false")
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["turnSettings"]["turnOptions"]["turnSettingsPanelOpen"] = false
        UI.setAttribute("additonalTurnOptionsFrame", "active", "false")
    end
end





-- this function is called when a player confirms their draft selection to add the faction to their UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles factionsDrafted table, and add the drafted faction to their player row
local function pickFactionForDraftingPlayer(playerInfo, faction, pickNum)
    table.insert(playerInfo.factionsDrafted, faction)                                   -- add the drafted faction into that players factionsDrafted table

    UI.setAttribute("image_"..playerInfo.ID.."_draft"..pickNum, "image", faction)       -- draw-in the drafted faction into the designated spot in the players row (the pickNum parameter guides this)
    UI.setAttribute("text_"..playerInfo.ID.."_draft"..pickNum, "text", faction:match("^(.*) %*%&%^%*") or faction)         -- add the name of the drafted faction into the designated spot in the players row (the pickNum parameter guides this)

    UI.setAttribute("image_"..playerInfo.ID.."_draft"..pickNum.."_scroll", "image", faction)       -- draw-in the drafted faction into the designated spot in the players row (the pickNum parameter guides this)
    UI.setAttribute("text_"..playerInfo.ID.."_draft"..pickNum.."_scroll", "text", faction:match("^(.*) %*%&%^%*") or faction)         -- add the name of the drafted faction into the designated spot in the players row (the pickNum parameter guides this)
end

-- this function is called when a player clicks/selects a draftBox in order to activate the 'draft' confirm button
local function activateDraftButton(buttonID, playerColor)
    local buttonAttributes = {                                                  -- create a new table of attributes to update the `Draft` button of the clicked draftBox, including...
        color = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE[playerColor].Solid,             -- change the color of the button to that of the activating player
        active = "true"                                                         -- show the button
    }
    if GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive == true then buttonAttributes.text = "Ban" end       -- if players are banning (instead of drafting) then change the text of the button to "Ban"
    if GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress == true then buttonAttributes.text = "Select" end
    UI.setAttributes(buttonID, buttonAttributes)                                -- update the `Draft` button attributes to those in the above table
    UI.setAttributes(buttonID.."_scroll", buttonAttributes)                                -- update the `Draft` button attributes to those in the above table
end

-- this function is called whenever a draftBox UI element is unselected to revert its highlighted state back to default/white
function DraftSelectionPanel.unselectDraft(playerNum)
    local playerNum = playerNum or GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnOrderByGameTurnNumber[GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber]        -- if this function is called without a parameter, set this variable to the UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber instead

    if GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerNum].selectedDraft ~= nil then                   -- if the selectedDraft variable of this player is NOT nil (selectedDraft table is used to store the UI ID of any draftBox when it is clicked the first time to store which draftBox is currently selected/highlighted)...
        local revertDraft = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerNum].selectedDraft          -- ... set this variable equal to the draftID stored in this selectedDraft table...
        local revertNum = tonumber(string.match(revertDraft, "(%d+)"))                  -- ... find the number of the draftBox that needs to be unselected

        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[revertNum].selected = false                        -- ... set the value of this draftBox's 'selected' attribute to false (it is no longer selected)
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[revertNum].highlight = "White"                     -- ... set the value of this draftBox's 'highlight' attribute to "White" (it is no longer selected)
        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.resetFactionUIElement(revertDraft)                           -- ... reset the visual appearance of this draftBox UI element to it's white/default state

        resetDraftButton("button_"..revertDraft)                                        -- ... and reset the draftButton to it's inactive/white state
    end
end

-- this function is called whenever a player hovers their mouse cursor over a draftBox in the right draft pane
function DraftSelectionPanel.draftPickHover(playerInst, _, draftID)
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool.draftViewed then return end

    local freePick = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"]            -- identify whether or not the freePick method has been selected

    local draftNum = tonumber(string.match(draftID, "(%d+)"))                                       -- identify the number of the draftBox being clicked
    local draftAttribs = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[draftNum]                                     -- using the draftNum, access the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes arrayTable to reference this draftBox's attributes

    local turnNum = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnOrderByGameTurnNumber[GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber]
    local turnColor = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].color                                      -- store the color of the player whose turn it is

    -- local playerColor = playerInst.color                                                            -- store the color of the player activating this function
    -- local playerNum = freePick and GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[playerColor] or turnNum                     -- store the order number of the player activating this function, which can be any player during a freePick, or the current-turn's player otherwise
    local playerNum = freePick and GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[playerInst.color] or turnNum                -- store the order number of the player activating this function, which can be any player during a freePick, or the current-turn's player otherwise
    local playerInfo = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerNum]                                         -- for ease of use and readability, obtain reference to the playerNum's index of the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table
    local isValidGhost = playerInfo.isGhostPlayer and playerInst.host == true
    local playerColor = isValidGhost and turnColor or playerInst.color

    if playerColor == turnColor or freePick then                                                    -- if the color of player activating this function is the same as the color of the current player's turn, or if this is a freePick...
        if (not playerInfo.draftComplete) and draftAttribs.selected == false and
        draftAttribs.drafted == false and draftAttribs.banned == false and
        draftAttribs.basePicked == false then                                                       -- ... if the activating player hasn't completed their drafting (for freePicks) and if the draftBox has not been currently selected OR drafted OR banned...
            if GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive then                                                                 -- ... if a ban phase is active...
                local extraAttribs = {color = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Black"].Highlighted}         -- ... change the highlighting color to Black...
                XMLUI.xmlFunctions.highlightFactionUIElement(draftID, playerColor, 3, extraAttribs)         -- ... and call this function to create a "highlight" around the draftBox
            elseif GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress then
                local extraAttribs = {color = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Teal"].Highlighted}         -- ... change the highlighting color to Black...
                XMLUI.xmlFunctions.highlightFactionUIElement(draftID, playerColor, 3, extraAttribs)         -- ... and call this function to create a "highlight" around the draftBox
            else                                                                                        -- ... if it is not a ban phase, but rather a draft phase...
                XMLUI.xmlFunctions.highlightFactionUIElement(draftID, playerColor, 3)                       -- ... then just call this function to create a "highlight" around the draftBox
            end
        end
    end
end

-- this function is called whenever a player moves their mouse off of a draftBox in the right draft pane
function DraftSelectionPanel.draftPickLeave(playerInst, _, draftID)
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool.draftViewed then return end

    local freePick = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"]        -- identify whether or not the freePick method has been selected

    local draftNum = tonumber(string.match(draftID, "(%d+)"))                                   -- identify the number of the draftBox being clicked
    local draftAttribs = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[draftNum]                                 -- using the draftNum, access the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes arrayTable to reference this draftBox's attributes

    local turnNum = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnOrderByGameTurnNumber[GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber]
    local turnColor = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].color                                  -- store the color of the player whose turn it is

-- this function is called whenever the `Draft` button is clicked, to confrim the faction draft
function DraftSelectionPanel.confirmDraftClicked(playerInst, buttonClicked, buttonID)
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool.draftViewed then return end

    local freePick = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"]                            -- identify whether or not the freePick method has been selected

    local draftID = string.match(buttonID, "draftBox[%d]+")                                                         -- extract the draftID from the name of the "Draft" button's buttonID passed in as a parameter
    local draftNum = tonumber(string.match(draftID, "%d+"))                                                         -- obtain the draftBox's number (used to obtain index of an arrayTable) from the draftID
    local draftAttribs = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes[draftNum]                                                     -- using the draftNum, access the UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes arrayTable to reference this draftBox's attributes

    local turnNum = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnOrderByGameTurnNumber[GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber]
    local turnColor = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].color                                                      -- store the color of the player whose turn it is

    local playerNum = freePick and GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor[playerInst.color] or turnNum                                -- store the order number of the player activating this function, which can be any player during a freePick, or the current-turn's player otherwise
    local playerInfo = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerNum]                                                         -- for ease of use and readability, obtain reference to the playerNum's index of the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table
    local isValidGhost = playerInfo.isGhostPlayer and playerInst.host == true
    local playerColor = isValidGhost and turnColor or playerInst.color

    if playerColor == turnColor or freePick then                                                                    -- if the color of the player clicking this button matches the color of the current player's turn...
        if playerColor == draftAttribs.highlight then                                                               -- ... if the color of the activating player matches the `highlight` color of the draftBox...
            local imageID = "image_" .. draftID                                                                         -- ... set this variable for easier setting of image attribs
            local textID = "text_" .. draftID                                                                           -- ... set this variable for easier setting of text attribs

            draftAttribs.owner = playerColor                                                                            -- ... set the draftBox's `owner` attribute equal to the clicking player

            if GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive then                                                                                 -- ... if a ban phase is active (when the "Draft"/"Ban" button is clicked)...
                draftAttribs.banned = true                                                                                  -- ... then set the draftBox's `banned` attribute to TRUE
                UI.setAttribute(imageID, "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Black"].Solid)                           -- ... and set the color shade of the image to "Black"
                UI.setAttribute(imageID.."_scroll", "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Black"].Solid)                           -- ... and set the color shade of the image to "Black"
                table.insert(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].factionsBanned, draftAttribs.faction)                       -- ... add the banned faction into that players factionsBanned table

            elseif GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress then    -- this says BASE phase, not ban phase
                draftAttribs.basePicked = true
                UI.setAttribute(imageID, "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Teal"].solid)
                UI.setAttribute(imageID.."_scroll", "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE["Teal"].solid)
                table.insert(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].basesPicked, draftAttribs.faction)

            else                                                                                                        -- ... if a draft phase is active instead...
                draftAttribs.drafted = true                                                                                 -- ... set the faction's draftBox "drafted" attribute to true
                UI.setAttribute(imageID, "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE[playerColor].Solid)                              -- ... set the color shade of the image to that of the clicking player
                UI.setAttribute(imageID.."_scroll", "color", XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE[playerColor].Solid)                              -- ... set the color shade of the image to that of the clicking player
                local pickNum = (freePick and #playerInfo.factionsDrafted + 1) or GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound                       -- ... set this variable to the # of factions drafted by a player (if in freePick), or to the current draft phase

                pickFactionForDraftingPlayer(playerInfo, draftAttribs.faction, pickNum)                                     -- ... call this function to add the drafted faction to the player's `factionsDrafted` table
            end

            resetDraftButton(buttonID)                                                                                  -- ... reset/deactivate the "Draft" button

            GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerNum].selectedDraft = nil                                                    -- ... now that the faction has been drafted/banned, reset the player's `selectedDraft` variable to nil (marking that the player no longer has a faction selected)


            if not freePick then                                                                                        -- ... if players are not using a freePick...
                UI.setAttribute(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].ID.."_turn", "active", "false")                          -- ... deactivate the current player's turn box UI element, marking end of that players turn
                UI.setAttribute(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[turnNum].ID.."_turn_scroll", "active", "false")                   -- ... deactivate the current player's turn box UI element, marking end of that players turn

                GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber + GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection                                      -- ... increase or decrease the UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber by 1 (depending on value of draftDirection)

                if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber > GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount or GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber < 1 then                                -- ... if the UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber is greater than the number of players (indicating each player has taken a turn), or is less than 1 (indicating each player has taken a turn in reverse-turn order)...
                    if GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive == false and GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress == false then                                          -- ... and if a draft phase is active...
                        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound + 1                                                                   -- ... then move on to the next draft phase (increase draftPhase by 1)
                    elseif GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive == true then
                        GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound = GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound + 1
                    elseif GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress == true then
                        GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.currentBaseDraftRound = GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.currentBaseDraftRound + 1
                    end

                    if not GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress then
                        if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound > 2 then                                                                             -- ... if draftPhase is greater than 2, indicating every player has completed their 2nd draft...
                            UI.setAttribute("draftPickerNext", "interactable", "true")                                                  -- ... activate the next button...
                            UI.setAttribute("popUp", "active", "false")                                                                 -- ... deactivate the draft/ban phase popUp...
                            popUpMessage("complete", "#7F51FF")

                            GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftPlayerTurnNumber = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber - GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 0                                                                                     -- ... set the current player index to 0 (equates to no player)...
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.allPlayersFinishedDrafting = true                                                                               -- ... and mark this flag variable as TRUE
                        else                                                                                                        -- ... if draftPhase is 2 or less (players haven't completed both draft phases)...
                            if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["straightDraftOption"] == true
                            or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["openDraftOption"] == true then                                  -- ... if the draftMethod is a straight draft...
                                GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 1                                                                                     -- ... reset the UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber to 1 (restart the next phase with player 1)
                                GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = 1                                                                                 -- ... and continue advancing in straight/regular turn order

                            elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["snakeDraftOption"] == true
                            or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"] == true then                          -- ... or if the draftMethod is a snake draft...
                                if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound == 1 then                                                                            -- ... and player's have not yet drafted their first faction (would end up here if player's have just completed a ban phase before first draft)...
                                    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 1                                                                                     -- ... reset the UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber to 1 (restart the next phase with player 1)
                                    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = 1                                                                                 -- ... and continue advancing in straight/regular turn order

                                elseif GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound == 2 then                                                                        -- ... player's have completed first draft, but not completed second draft...
                                    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount                                                                   -- ... set the UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber to the last player...
                                    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = -1                                                                                -- ... and change turn direction to reverse turn order
                                end
                            end
                            DraftSelectionPanel.banPhaseCheck()                                                                         -- ... call this function to check to see if another ban phase will be activated or not
                        end

                    elseif GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress then
                        if GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.currentBaseDraftRound > 1 then
                            UI.setAttribute("draftPickerNext", "interactable", "true")
                            UI.setAttribute("popUp", "active", "false")
                            popUpMessage("baseComplete", "#7F51FF")

                            SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["baseOptions"]["expansionBases"] = false
                            UI.setAttribute("expansionBases", "isOn", "false")
                            SmashUp.XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["baseOptions"]["factionBases"] = true
                            UI.setAttribute("expansionBases", "isOn", "true")

                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 0
                            GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress = false
                            GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftComplete = true

                            for _, playerInfo in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
                                for _, faction in ipairs(playerInfo.factionsDrafted) do
                                    if Database.factionTable[faction].expansion == "Munchkin" then
                                        GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin = true
                                    elseif Database.factionTable[faction].expansion == "Obligatory Cthulhu" then
                                        GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu = true
                                    end
                                end
                                for _, faction in ipairs(playerInfo.basesPicked) do
                                    if Database.factionTable[faction].expansion == "Munchkin" then
                                        GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin = true
                                    elseif Database.factionTable[faction].expansion == "Obligatory Cthulhu" then
                                        GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu = true
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 1
                        end

                    end
                end

                activateTurn()                                                                                                  -- ... call this function to advance play to the next turn

                XMLUI.OptionsPanel.updateBanElements()                                                                            -- ... call this function to update the elements on the banOptions panel according to stage of drafting
                if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["openDraftOption"] then sortTurnChange() end                  -- ... if players are using an openDraft, call this function to allow the next player to use the sortButton
            else                                                                                                        -- ... if players ARE using a freePick method...
                if #playerInfo.factionsDrafted == 2 then                                                                    -- ... if this player (that just drafted) now has 2 factions drafted...
                    playerInfo.draftComplete = true                                                                             -- ... then this player has completed drafting...
                    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.numPlayersCompletedDraft = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.numPlayersCompletedDraft + 1                                                   -- ... add 1 to the number of players that have completed drafting
                end

                if GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.numPlayersCompletedDraft == GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount then                                                    -- ... if the number of UISetup.DraftSystem.numPlayersCompletedDraft equals the total number of players (that means all of them)...
                    UI.setAttribute("draftPickerNext", "interactable", "true")                                                  -- ... activate the next button...
                    UI.setAttribute("popUp", "active", "false")                                                                 -- ... deactivate the draft/ban phase popUp...
                    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 0                                                                                     -- ... set the current player index to 0 (equates to no player)...
                    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.allPlayersFinishedDrafting = true                                                                               -- ... and mark this flag variable as TRUE
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

__bundle_register("Smash Up/xmlRandomSelectionPanel", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

local XMLUI
local Database
local GameData

local RandomSelectionPanel = {}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- RANDOM SELECTION UI PANEL FUNCTIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- GETTING FACTIONS INTO EACH PLAYERS' POOL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function is called to deal out random factions to a playerRow
-- initially, will deal out as many factionsPerPlayer as was selected.
-- this function is used on subsequent calls to replace factions when a player clicks `redraw`
local function getRandomCustomFaction(playerInfo)
    local customJustDealt = false

    if #GameData.Customs.customListForRandomized > 0 then
        local randCustomIndex
        randCustomIndex = math.random(#GameData.Customs.customListForRandomized)

        local customFaction = table.remove(GameData.Customs.customListForRandomized, randCustomIndex)
        table.insert(playerInfo.factionsDealt, customFaction)
        customJustDealt = true

        Database.allChosenCustomFactions[customFaction] = true

        for index, custom in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection) do
            if custom == customFaction then
                table.remove(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection, index)
            end
        end
    end

    return customJustDealt
end


local function dealCustomsFirst(playerInfo)
    local playerNum = tonumber(playerInfo.ID:match("player(%d+)"))
    local customTotal = #GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array
    local minimumCustomsPerPlayer = math.floor(customTotal / GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount)
    local remainderToDistribute = customTotal % GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount

    local numCustoms = minimumCustomsPerPlayer

    if remainderToDistribute > 0 then
        if playerNum == GameData.Customs.startDealingCustomsAt then
            numCustoms = numCustoms + 1
        elseif playerNum > GameData.Customs.startDealingCustomsAt and playerNum < (GameData.Customs.startDealingCustomsAt + remainderToDistribute) then
            numCustoms = numCustoms + 1
        elseif playerNum < GameData.Customs.startDealingCustomsAt and playerNum < (GameData.Customs.startDealingCustomsAt + remainderToDistribute - GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount) then
            numCustoms = numCustoms + 1
        end
    end

    for num = 1, numCustoms do
        getRandomCustomFaction(playerInfo)
    end
end


local function dealRandomFactions(playerInfo, initialDeal)

    -- generally, when choosing to redraw alotted factions, the previously dealt factions are witheld from the pool to ensure new factions are indeed dealt.
    -- however, if there aren't enough factions left in the pool to provide a full complement of random factions, then the previously dealt factions must be put back into the pool.
    if GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer > #GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection then
        for oldNum = #playerInfo.oldFactions, 1, -1 do
            table.insert(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection, table.remove(playerInfo.oldFactions, oldNum))
        end

        Common.randomizeTable(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection)
        playerInfo.oldFactions = {}
    end


    local initialDeal = initialDeal or false
    local dealtFactions = playerInfo.factionsDealt                                      -- store the player's dealt factions into this variable (initially will be blank)

    for i = 1, GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer - #dealtFactions do                                   -- run this loop for as many times as the factionsPerPlayer selected (minus the number of factions the player has elected to keep in their pool, which is zero initially)
        local customJustDealt = false

        --the 'initialDeal' variable prevents the first player from receiving ALL of the custom factions.
        --the dealCustomsFirst function divies out custom factions equally among all players on the initial deal.
        if GameData.Customs.customsMandatory and not initialDeal then
            customJustDealt = getRandomCustomFaction(playerInfo)
        end

        if not customJustDealt then
            local randFactionIndex
            randFactionIndex = math.random(#GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection)                      -- ... generate a random index number...
            table.insert(dealtFactions, GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection[randFactionIndex])        -- ... and store the faction at that index number (in the UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection table) in the playersFactionsList table for the currently iterated color/player...
            table.remove(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection, randFactionIndex)                       -- ... and then remove that index number entry from the UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection table so that it can't be used/dealt again
        end
    end
end



-- this function is called everytime the randomSelectionPanel is opened in order to make sure each player has the proper number of factions in their pool
function RandomSelectionPanel.factionCountCheck()
    for _, playerInfo in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
        if playerInfo.factionsDealt == nil then
            playerInfo.factionsDealt = {}
        end

        local factionCount = #playerInfo.factionsDealt                                                      -- check how many factions have been dealt to this player...

        if factionCount ~= tonumber(GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer) then                                        -- if the # of factions dealt to this player's pool is NOT equal to the number that is selected to be dealt...
            playerInfo.factionsPicked = {}                                                                  -- ... reset the player's picked factions
            GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetRandomSelectionPanel = true

            if factionCount < tonumber(GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer) then                                     -- ... if there are less factions dealt to a player than the number of factionsPerPlayer picked on previous UI...
                if GameData.Customs.customsMandatory then
                    dealCustomsFirst(playerInfo)
                end

                dealRandomFactions(playerInfo, true)                                                            -- ... then run this function to deal that player random factions until the player has a number equal to factionsPerPlayer

            elseif factionCount > tonumber(GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer) then                                 -- ... otherwise, if the player has more factions dealt than the number of factionsPerPlayer picked...
                for i = 1, (factionCount - tonumber(GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer)) do                             -- ... for every faction dealt to the player over the factionsPerPlayer number...
                    table.insert(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection, table.remove(playerInfo.factionsDealt))         -- ... remove the last entry of the factionsDealt table, and add it back into the UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection table
                end
                GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection = Common.randomizeTable(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection)    -- ... re-randomize the factionList
            end
        end
    end
end

-- this function is called to reset and disable a player's ready toggle/button

-- this function will reset the factionBoxes to be blank white squares
local function resetFactionBoxes(playerID)
    local rowNum = tonumber(string.match(playerID, "player(%d+)"))
    for L = 1, 6 do                                                                 -- as there are 6 possible factions in a playerRow...
        local factionID = playerID.."_faction"..L                                   -- ... set this variable for ease of use and readability
        local imageID = "image_"..factionID                                         -- ... set this variable for ease of use and readability
        local textID = "text_"..factionID                                           -- ... set this variable for ease of use and readability

        }

        UI.setAttribute(imageID.."_scroll", "image", "")                                       -- ... reset the faction image attribute to blank

-- this function establishes the table that is used to track the dealt or chosen status of the faction elements in the UI
local function resetPlayerRowVars(playerNum)
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.randomSelectionFactionBoxUIAttributes[playerNum] = {}                                                      -- ... establish a new subTable for that player, indexed by the player number...
    for factionBoxNum = 1, 6 do                                                                         -- ... and for every potential factionBox belonging to each player...
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.randomSelectionFactionBoxUIAttributes[playerNum]["player"..playerNum.."_faction"..factionBoxNum] = {       -- ... create a subTable for each factionBox element in that player's row, indexed by the name of the factionBox element...
            ["dealt"] = false,                                                                              -- ... and initialize the factionBoxes `dealt` and `chosen` attributes as false
            ["chosen"] = false
        }
    end
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.randomSelectionFactionBoxUIAttributes[playerNum]["redrawActive"] = false                                   -- ... and set the player row's `redrawActive` attribute to false
end


-- this function resets each players row to it's blank/white/default state (including whether or not the row is visible, the players ready button, the players factionBoxes, etc)
local function resetEachPlayersRow()

    for playerNum = 1, 6 do
        local playerID = "player"..playerNum

        resetPlayerRowVars(playerNum)                                           -- ... call this function to setup the table that will track details about each player's factionBoxes
        resetFactionBoxes(playerID)                                             -- ... call this function to erase/reset a player's factionBoxes
        resetReadyButton(playerID)                                              -- ... call this function to reset a player's ready toggle/button

        UI.setAttribute(playerID.."_row", "active", "false")                    -- ... hide the player row
        UI.setAttribute(playerID.."_row_scroll", "active", "false")                    -- ... hide the player row

-- this function resets the entire RandomSelectionPanel UI, including the `mainPickWindow` size, the player rows, each players' factionBoxes, their readyButtons etc

-- this function is called when the RandomSelectionPanel is being generated, after the panel and rows have been reset (called via createPlayerRow)
-- this function is called when setting up a players row to display the factions that have been randomized to that player
local function drawFactionBoxes(rowNum, playerInfo)
    for factionNum, faction in ipairs(playerInfo.factionsDealt) do                                              -- for every faction randomized to a player...
        local factionID = playerInfo.ID.."_faction"..factionNum                                                 -- ... establish this variable for ease of use
        local factionImage = faction
        local factionKey = faction

        if SmashUp.Database.factionTable[faction].custom then
            if GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName[faction].uiImageURL == "" then
                factionImage = "CustomCard"
            end
            faction = faction:match("^(.*) %*%&%^%*")
            -- factionImage = faction
        end

        UI.setAttribute("image_"..factionID, "image", factionImage)                                             -- ... add the faction image to the factionBox...
        UI.setAttribute("text_"..factionID, "text", faction)                                                    -- ... and the faction name
        UI.setAttribute(factionID, "tooltip", faction..": ["..Database.factionTable[factionKey].compLevel.."] - "..Database.factionTable[factionKey].description)        -- ... and set the tooltip of the factionBox element...

        UI.setAttribute("image_"..factionID.."_scroll", "image", factionImage)                                             -- ... add the faction image to the factionBox...
        UI.setAttribute("text_"..factionID.."_scroll", "text", faction)                                                    -- ... and the faction name
        UI.setAttribute(factionID.."_scroll", "tooltip", faction..": ["..Database.factionTable[factionKey].compLevel.."] - "..Database.factionTable[factionKey].description)        -- ... and set the tooltip of the factionBox element...

        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.randomSelectionFactionBoxUIAttributes[rowNum][factionID].dealt = true                                          -- ... set the `dealt` attribute for the factionBoxElement to true (this box has a faction in it, so it has been "dealt")
        GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.randomSelectionFactionBoxUIAttributes[rowNum][factionID].chosen = false                                        -- ... set the `chosen` attribute for this factionBoxElement to false (this faction is not highlighted/selected)
    end
end


-- this function is called when the RandomSelectionPanel UI is created, to draw and activate a row for each active player
local function createPlayerRow(rowNum, playerInfo)
    local playerID = playerInfo.ID                                                  -- establish this variable for ease of use

    XMLUI.xmlFunctions.addRowColorAndName(playerInfo)                               -- call this function to label this player's row with the player's name, and change the row's color to that of the player's
    drawFactionBoxes(rowNum, playerInfo)                                            -- call this function to draw/add the players randomized factions to this player's row

    if playerInfo.redrawsLeft == 0 then                                             -- if the player has no redraws left then...
        UI.setAttribute(playerID.."_redraw", "interactable", "false")               -- ... disable the redraw button (which was previously enabled during the reset `for loop` in calling function)
        UI.setAttribute(playerID.."_redraw_scroll", "interactable", "false")               -- ... disable the redraw button (which was previously enabled during the reset `for loop` in calling function)
    else                                                                            -- otherwise, if the player still has redraws remaining...
        UI.setAttribute(playerID.."_redrawButtonWindow", "active", "true")          -- ... keep the button (and it's panel/window!) active
        UI.setAttribute(playerID.."_redrawButtonWindow_scroll", "active", "true")          -- ... keep the button (and it's panel/window!) active
    end
end


-- this function is called when "Random Selection" draft option is chosen, to generate this UI panel appearance
function RandomSelectionPanel.generateRandomSelectionPanel()
    resetRandomSelectionWindow()                                                 -- run this function to reset the full RandomSelectionPanel UI
    resetEachPlayersRow()

    for rowNum, playerInfo in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do           -- for every player in UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table...
        createPlayerRow(rowNum, playerInfo)                                     -- ... call this function to create/setup/draw the row for that player
    end
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetRandomSelectionPanel = false
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- when a player makes a faction selection, this function is called to add that faction into their UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table
local function pickFactionFromRandomSelection(factionID)
    local playerIndex = tonumber(string.match(factionID, "^[^_]+(%d)"))         -- using the UI ID of the factionBox element that was clicked, determine which player to give the selected faction to (the player that clicked it!)
    local factionIndex = tonumber(string.match(factionID, "[^_]+(%d)$"))        -- using the UI ID of the factionBox element that was clicked, determine which factionBox was clicked
    table.insert(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerIndex].factionsPicked, GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerIndex].factionsDealt[factionIndex])   -- using the two indices identified above, reference the factionsDealt table for the player that clicked, and add the indexed faction to the factionsPicked table
end

-- when a player deselects a faction, this function is called to remove that faction from their UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles.factionsPicked table
local function unPickFactionFromRandomSelection(factionID)
    local playerIndex = tonumber(string.match(factionID, "^[^_]+(%d)"))                     -- using the UI ID of the factionBox element that was deselected, determine which player to remove the deselected faction from (the player that clicked it!)
    local factionIndex = tonumber(string.match(factionID, "[^_]+(%d)$"))                    -- using the UI ID of the factionBox element that was deselected, determine which factionBox was deselected

    local unPickedFaction = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerIndex].factionsDealt[factionIndex]   -- using the two indices identified above, reference the player's factionsDealt table; this faction will be the one that was deselected and should be removed

    for i, faction in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerIndex].factionsPicked) do           -- for every faction contained in the player's factionsPicked list...
        if faction == unPickedFaction then                                                  -- ... if the iterated faction equals the one that was deselected...
            table.remove(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[playerIndex].factionsPicked, i)                   -- ... then remove that faction from the factionsPicked list
        end
    end
end

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.ready[readyID] = "off"
    UI.setAttribute(readyID, "image", "check_blank")

-- this function is called when a player deselects a faction. The player will no longer have 2 selected, so this disables the ready button
local function disableReadyButton(playerID)
    local readyID = playerID.."_ready"                                              -- find the id of the player's ready button based on their player#

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.ready[readyID] = "disabled"                               -- turn off (uncheck) the player's ready button
    UI.setAttribute(readyID, "image", "check_disabled")
    UI.setAttribute(readyID.."_scroll", "image", "check_disabled")

    UI.setAttribute("pickerNext", "interactable", "false")                          -- then deactivate the panel's `Next` button, as now at least one ready button is unchecked
end

-- this function is called when any player activates a ready button, to see if all players have clicked their ready buttons, to activate the `Next` button
local function allReadyCheck()

    local allReady = true                                                               -- set this monitoring flag variable to true
    for _, playerInfo in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do                                -- for every playerID in the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table...
        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["ready"][playerInfo.ID.."_ready"] ~= "on" then   -- ... if that player's corresponding ready button is off...
            allReady = false                                                                -- ... then set the monitoring flag to false, indicating that an unchecked ready button has been found
            break                                                                           -- ... and break the loop early (no need to proceed further)
        end
    end

    if allReady then                                                                    -- if allReady variable is still true...
        UI.setAttribute("pickerNext", "interactable", "true")                           -- ... then activate the next button
    else                                                                                -- otherwise, if allReady variable is false...
        UI.setAttribute("pickerNext", "interactable", "false")                          -- ... then deactivate the next button
    end
end

-- this function is called whenever a player clicks (checks/unchecks) the ready toggleButton
function RandomSelectionPanel.readyClicked(playerInst, buttonClick, toggleID)
    toggleID = toggleID:gsub("_scroll","")

    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end                                          -- if this button is clicked by a mouse button OTHER than the left click, or if the host didn't click the button, dont' do anything.
    local rowNumber = tonumber(string.match(toggleID, "^player(%d+)"))                      -- obtain the row number of the element that was clicked, which in turn is used as the array index to access the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table to look up the color of that row

    local elementColor = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].color                      -- using the rowNumber as an array index to access the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table, identify the color of the element that was clicked

    local playerInfo = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber]
    local isValidGhost = playerInfo.isGhostPlayer and playerInst.host == true
    local playerColor = isValidGhost and elementColor or playerInst.color           -- simplify color referencing by storing the activating player's color in this variable

    local toggleStatus = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["ready"][toggleID]               -- store the current status of the clicked toggleButton as found in the toggleTracker table
    local checkIcon

    if playerColor == elementColor and toggleStatus ~= "disabled" then                      -- if the color of the player that clicked matches the color of the row in which the button was found (if the player clicked his own button)...
        if toggleStatus == "off" then                                                       -- ... then flip the status of the toggleStatus variable (from true -> false; false -> true)
            toggleStatus = "on"
        elseif toggleStatus == "on" then
            toggleStatus = "off"
        end

        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["ready"][toggleID] = toggleStatus                 -- ... update the toggleTracker table with the new toggleStatus
        if toggleStatus == "on" then                                                        -- ... if the toggle is now set to true...
            UI.setAttribute("player"..rowNumber.."_redraw", "interactable", "false")            -- ... deactivate the "redraw" button so it can't be clicked anymore
            UI.setAttribute("player"..rowNumber.."_redraw_scroll", "interactable", "false")            -- ... deactivate the "redraw" button so it can't be clicked anymore
        else                                                                                -- ... otherwise, if the toggle is now set to false...
            if GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].redrawsLeft ~= 0 then                       -- ... and as long as the player still has some redraws left...
                UI.setAttribute("player"..rowNumber.."_redraw", "interactable", "true")             -- ... then reactivate the "redraw" button so it can now be clicked again
                UI.setAttribute("player"..rowNumber.."_redraw_scroll", "interactable", "true")             -- ... then reactivate the "redraw" button so it can now be clicked again
            end
        end

        checkIcon = (toggleStatus == "on" and "check_green") or (toggleStatus == "off" and "check_blank") or (toggleStatus == "disabled" and "check_disabled")

        UI.setAttribute(toggleID, "image", checkIcon)
        UI.setAttribute(toggleID.."_scroll", "image", checkIcon)
        allReadyCheck()                                                                     -- run this function to see if all ready buttons are checked or not
    end
end

    local numFactionsChosen = #GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].factionsPicked       -- set the numFactionsChosen variable equal to the number of factions given in the player's factionsPicked table

    local newAttributes = {}                                                        -- establish this local table variable for use in the following 'if' blocks

    if playerColor == elementColor then                                             -- as long as the color of the activating player is the same as the color (player) of the activated faction element...
        if factionAttribs.dealt == true then                                        -- ... and if this faction element has a faction dealt to it...

            if redrawActive == true then                                                -- ... if the redraw process is active (player is selecting which factions to keep before redrawing)...
                playerColor = "Teal"                                                        -- ... then set the playerColor variable to "Teal"
            end

            local resetAttribs = {                                                      -- ... set this table that will be used in the resetFactionUIElement functions to set the attributes of the unselected factionBox elements
                outline = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.COLOR_TABLE[playerColor].Outline,
                outlineSize = 6,
            }
            if factionAttribs.chosen == false then                                      -- ... if this faction hasn't been selected by the player yet...
                if numFactionsChosen < 2 or redrawActive == true then                       -- ... and if the player hasn't selected 2 factions yet (and is selecting the next faction) or if player is selecting factions during a redrawing process...
                    factionAttribs.chosen = true                                                -- ... set the chosen attribute of this factionBox element to true (it has now been selected, or chosen)
                    XMLUI.xmlFunctions.highlightFactionUIElement(factionID, playerColor, 6)           -- ... call this function to mark/color/highlight the selected faction

                    if redrawActive == false then                                               -- ... if the player is currently NOT redrawing their factions (this ulimately allows the player to be able to select for redrawing more than 2 factions)...
                        numFactionsChosen = numFactionsChosen + 1                                   -- ... increase the value of `numFactionsChosen` attribute by 1 (as, if redrawActive is TRUE, this number won't increase, thereby allowing, technically, unlimited selecting of factions during a redraw)

                        if numFactionsChosen == 2 then                                              -- ... if the player has selected 2 factions at this point...
                            enableReadyButton(string.match(factionID, "[^_]+"))                         -- ... then the player's ready button should be activated
                        end
                    end

                    pickFactionFromRandomSelection(factionID)                                   -- ... call this function to add the selected faction to the players factionsPicked table

                else                                                                        -- ... otherwise, if the player HAS chosen both of their factions (prevent clicking/choosing another faction)...
                    XMLUI.xmlFunctions.resetFactionUIElement(factionID, resetAttribs)                 -- ... call this function to reset its "highlighting" to white/blank, thereby preventing more than 2 factions from being selected (visually)
                end
            else                                                                        -- ... otherwise, if this faction HAS been selected by the player (unselect it)...
                factionAttribs.chosen = false                                               -- ... set the chosen attribute of this factionElement table to false (it is deselected, unchosen)
                XMLUI.xmlFunctions.resetFactionUIElement(factionID, resetAttribs)                 -- ... call this function to reset the factionBox's "highlighting" to white/blank...

                numFactionsChosen = numFactionsChosen - 1                                   -- ... decrease the value of `numFactionsChosen` attribute by 1...

                disableReadyButton(string.match(factionID, "[^_]+"))                        -- ... run the disableReadyButton function, passing just the playerID as the parameter. This will disable the readyButton.
                unPickFactionFromRandomSelection(factionID)                                 -- ... call this function to remove the deselected faction from the player's factionsPicked table

                if GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].redrawsLeft ~= 0 then                    -- ... if the player still has some redraws left...
                    UI.setAttribute("player"..rowNumber.."_redraw", "interactable", "true")     -- ... then make sure the "redraw" button is activated for the player
                    UI.setAttribute("player"..rowNumber.."_redraw_scroll", "interactable", "true")     -- ... then make sure the "redraw" button is activated for the player
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
