-- this function is called when a player clicks their `redraw` button, which removes the undesired factions from their factionsDealt, and adds those factions back into the available pool
local function putFactionsBackIntoPool(playerInfo)

    local dealtFactions = playerInfo.factionsDealt                                  -- save the player's dealt factions in this variable (initially will be blank)
    local pickedFactions = playerInfo.factionsPicked                                -- save the player's picked factions in this variable (initially will be blank)

    -- local factionIndex = 1                                                          -- keeps track of which array index to use when removing/popping out factions from the factionsDealt table

    for factionIndex = #dealtFactions, 1, -1 do                                     -- run this for as many factions that were dealt to player initially...
        local shouldKeep = false                                                    -- ... this variable tracks whether or not the dealt faction is selected to be kept or not
        for _, keptFaction in ipairs(pickedFactions) do                             -- ... for each faction selected to be kept...
            if dealtFactions[factionIndex] == keptFaction then                          -- ... if the iterated dealt faction equals a selected-to-be-kept-faction, then...
                shouldKeep = true                                                           -- ... set the shouldKeep variable to true
                break                                                                       -- ... break early (don't need to keep this iteration going)
            end
        end
        if not shouldKeep then                                                      -- ... if shouldKeep remains false...
            table.insert(playerInfo.oldFactions, table.remove(dealtFactions, factionIndex))           -- ... then put this iterated dealtFaction into the `oldFactions` table in order to put it back into the pool later...
        end
    end
    -- for i = 1, #dealtFactions do                                                    -- run this for as many factions that were dealt to player initially...
    --     local shouldKeep = false                                                    -- ... this variable tracks whether or not the dealt faction is selected to be kept or not
    --     for _, keptFaction in ipairs(pickedFactions) do                             -- ... for each faction selected to be kept...
    --         if dealtFactions[factionIndex] == keptFaction then                          -- ... if the iterated dealt faction equals a selected-to-be-kept-faction, then...
    --             shouldKeep = true                                                           -- ... set the shouldKeep variable to true
    --             break                                                                       -- ... break early (don't need to keep this iteration going)
    --         end
    --     end
    --     if not shouldKeep then                                                      -- ... if shouldKeep remains false...
    --         table.insert(playerInfo.oldFactions, dealtFactions[factionIndex])           -- ... then put this iterated dealtFaction into the `oldFactions` table in order to put it back into the pool later...
    --         table.remove(dealtFactions, factionIndex)                                   -- ... and remove this faction from the dealtFactions
    --     else                                                                        -- ... otherwise, if shouldKeep is true...
    --         factionIndex = factionIndex + 1                                             -- ... increase the factionIndex by 1 to make sure we skip this keptFaction and keep it in the array
    --     end
    -- end

    playerInfo.factionsPicked = {}                                                  -- reset the factionsPicked table (player no longer has any picked factions)

    dealRandomFactions(playerInfo)                                                  -- re-deal out new factions to the player to replace the ones that were discarded

    for _, faction in ipairs(playerInfo.oldFactions) do                             -- for every faction now contained in the `oldFactions` table...
        table.insert(GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection, faction)                    -- ... put it back into the available factions pool
        if Database.factionTable[faction].custom then
            table.insert(GameData.Customs.customListForRandomized, faction)
        end
    end

    playerInfo.oldFactions = {}                                                     -- reset the oldFactions table to blank, in case it needs to be reused again
end

-- this function is called when a player clicks the redraw button to select which factions to keep.
-- If factions were previously selected, the selection highlight will convert to teal for the redraw selection process
local function convertFactionSelections(playerNum)
    for i = 1, 6 do                                                                         -- for every factionBox in a player's row...
        local factionID = "player"..playerNum.."_faction"..i                                -- ... establish this variable to use as the ID of the faction element...
        local factionChosen = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.randomSelectionFactionBoxUIAttributes[playerNum][factionID].chosen   -- ... and identify whether or not the factionBox has been chosen/selected or not...

        if factionChosen == true then                                                       -- ... if the faction HAS been chosen...
            XMLUI.xmlFunctions.highlightFactionUIElement(factionID, "Teal", 5)                        -- ... then call this function to highlight (in Teal) the chosen factionBox element
        end
    end
end

--this function is called when a player clicks their redraw button
function RandomSelectionPanel.redrawButtonClicked(playerInst, buttonClick, buttonID)
    buttonID = buttonID:gsub("_scroll", "")
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 then return end                                  -- if this faction element is clicked by a mouse button OTHER than the left click then dont' do anything.

    local rowNumber = tonumber(string.match(buttonID, "^player(%d+)"))              -- obtain the row number of the element that was clicked, which in turn is used as the array index to access the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table to look up the color of that row

    local redrawActive = GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.randomSelectionFactionBoxUIAttributes[rowNumber].redrawActive     -- store the redrawActive status of this row in this variable

    local elementColor = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].color                      -- using the rowNumber as an array index to access the UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table, identify the color of the element that was clicked

    local playerInfo = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber]
    local isValidGhost = playerInfo.isGhostPlayer and playerInst.host == true
    local playerColor = isValidGhost and elementColor or playerInst.color           -- simplify color referencing by storing the activating player's color in this variable

    if playerColor == elementColor then                                             -- as long as the color of the activating player is the same as the color (player) of the activated faction element...
        if GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].redrawsLeft ~= 0 then               -- ... and as long as the player has redraws left...
            if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.redrawSettings.toggleOption == 1 then                -- ... if the host has selected the first redraw toggle option (allowing players to select which factions to keep)...
                if redrawActive == false then                                               -- ... if the redraw process hasn't been started yet (redraw button being clicked for the first time here to activate the process)...
                    redrawActive = true                                                         -- ... then set the redraw process active to true

                    UI.setAttribute(buttonID, "text", "Select Factions to Keep")                -- ... change the appearance of the redraw button to have different text, color, and tooltip
                    UI.setClass(buttonID, "Teal")
                    UI.setAttribute(buttonID, "tooltip", "Click this button again once you have selected which factions to keep.")

                    UI.setAttribute(buttonID.."_scroll", "text", "Select Factions to Keep")                -- ... change the appearance of the redraw button to have different text, color, and tooltip
                    UI.setClass(buttonID.."_scroll", "Teal")
                    UI.setAttribute(buttonID.."_scroll", "tooltip", "Click this button again once you have selected which factions to keep.")

                    convertFactionSelections(rowNumber)                                         -- ... run this function to find any previously selected factions, and convert their colors to Teal, for redraw selection process

                elseif redrawActive == true then                                            -- ... if the redraw process HAS been started (and the redraw button is clicked -- again)...
                    redrawActive = false                                                        -- ... then on this second click, turn the redraw process variable off (false)

                    UI.setAttribute(buttonID, "text", "Redraw")                                 -- ... change the appearance of the redraw button back to default
                    UI.setClass(buttonID, "")
                    UI.setAttribute(buttonID, "tooltip", "Select which factions you wish to keep, and the rest will be replaced by new factions.")

                    UI.setAttribute(buttonID.."_scroll", "text", "Redraw")                                 -- ... change the appearance of the redraw button back to default
                    UI.setClass(buttonID.."_scroll", "")
                    UI.setAttribute(buttonID.."_scroll", "tooltip", "Select which factions you wish to keep, and the rest will be replaced by new factions.")

                    putFactionsBackIntoPool(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber])      -- ... call this function to remove the discarded factions from the player, and put them back into the available pool

                    GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].redrawsLeft = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].redrawsLeft - 1   -- ... player just used one of their redraws, so decrement this variable by 1

                    resetFactionBoxes("player"..rowNumber)                                      -- ... reset the players factionBoxes back to white/blank/default...
                    drawFactionBoxes(rowNumber, GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber])  -- ... and display the new factions for the player
                end

                GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.randomSelectionFactionBoxUIAttributes[rowNumber].redrawActive = redrawActive       -- ... update the redrawActive attribute for the player's row

            elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.redrawSettings.toggleOption == 2 then            -- ... if the host has selected the "redraw all factions" toggle (the second one)...
                GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].factionsPicked = {}           -- ... clear the factionsPicked table so that no factions are kept during the redraw; they're all cleared
                putFactionsBackIntoPool(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber])      -- ... call this function to remove the discarded factions from the player, and put them back into the available pool

                GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].redrawsLeft = GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].redrawsLeft - 1   -- ... player just used one of their redraws, so decrement this variable by 1

                resetFactionBoxes("player"..rowNumber)                                      -- ... reset the players factionBoxes back to white/blank/default...
                drawFactionBoxes(rowNumber, GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber])  -- ... and display the new factions for the player
            end

            resetReadyButton("player"..rowNumber)                                       -- ... deactivate the player's ready button

            if GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].redrawsLeft == 0 and redrawActive == false then              -- ... once a player has used all of their redraws (and just to be certain, they are no longer in the process of redrawing)...
                UI.setAttribute(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].ID.."_redraw", "interactable", "false")         -- ... make the player's redraw button unclickable
                UI.setAttribute(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[rowNumber].ID.."_redraw_scroll", "interactable", "false")         -- ... make the player's redraw button unclickable
            end
        end
    end
end

__bundle_register("Smash Up/xmlSettingsPanel", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

-- this function is called whenever the `Next` button is pressed on the `Expansion/Faction` selection UI, switching between `Select Expansions` UI and the `Select Factions` UI
function SettingsPanel.switchPanels(_, click, buttonID)
    if buttonID == "right" then      -- if the rightward next button (on the `Select Expansions` UI) is clicked...
        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("factions", true)
    end
    if buttonID == "left" then       -- if the leftward next button (on the `Select Factions` UI) is clicked...
        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("expansions", true)
    end

-- this function is called after hitting 'Submit' on the Expansion/Faction selection UI panel
function SettingsPanel.expansionSubmit(_, click, buttonID)
    UI.setAttribute("CustomButton", "active", "false")
    Database.obtainAllFactionsToBeIncluded()                                        -- run this function in order to generate the Database.allFactionsToBeIncluded list\

    local factionCount = #Database.allFactionsToBeIncluded                          -- identify how many factions are included via the selection panels

    if factionCount < (GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount * GameData.UISetup.General.numberOfFactionsPerDeck) then                            -- if the number of factions included is less than two times the number of players, broadcast this message to the host

" factions ("..tostring(GameData.UISetup.General.numberOfFactionsPerDeck).." factions per player). Add another expansion or include more individual factions.")

-- this function is called to tick/untick the Expansion toggles via code
local function expansionToggleTableUpdate(expansion, newToggleStatus)
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["expansion"][expansion] = newToggleStatus   -- updates the status of the toggle in the expansion tracking table

    UI.setAttribute(expansion, "isOn", newToggleStatus)                    -- updates the status of the Expansion toggle (on the Select Expansions panel) that was passed to this function
    UI.setAttribute("set-"..expansion, "isOn", newToggleStatus)            -- updates the status of the Expansion toggle (on the Select Factions panel) that was passed to this function
end

-- this function is called to tick/untick the Faction toggles via code
local function factionToggleTableUpdate(faction, newToggleStatus)
    Database.factionTable[faction].included = newToggleStatus      -- updates the status of the toggle in the faction tracking table (factionTable.included)

    if Database.factionTable[faction].custom then
        UI.setAttribute("customToggle"..Database.factionTable[faction].customNum, "isOn", newToggleStatus)
    else
        UI.setAttribute(faction, "isOn", newToggleStatus)              -- updates the status of the Faction toggle that was passed to this function
    end
end

-- this function checks to see if all the Expansion toggles are checked/"True" or not, and then updates the selectAll toggles accordingly
local function checkAllExpansionTogglesTrue()
    local allTrueFlag = true                                                            -- sets a flag variable to track if all Expansion toggles are checked or not
    for _, expansion in ipairs(Database.expansionList) do                               -- for every expansion in expansionList...
        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["expansion"][expansion] == false then      -- ... check to see if it's toggle status is "False"...
            allTrueFlag = false                                                         -- ... if it is, mark the flag as false...
            break                                                                       -- ... and break the for loop (one toggle being false is enough)
        end
    end
    UI.setAttribute("selectAllExpansions", "isOn", (allTrueFlag and true) or false)     -- if the flag is still true, then set this selectAll toggle to "True", otherwise set it to "False"
    UI.setAttribute("selectAllFactions", "isOn", (allTrueFlag and true) or false)       -- if the flag is still true, then set this selectAll toggle to "True", otherwise set it to "False"
end

-- this function is called to check if all the Faction toggles in an expansion set are checked/"True" or not, and updates the Expansion toggle accordingly
local function checkAllFactionTogglesTrue(toggleID, toggleStatus)
    local allFactionsTrueFlag = true                                -- sets a flag variable to track if all Faction toggles are checked or not
    local expansion = Database.factionTable[toggleID].expansion     -- obtain the expansion set of the faction toggle just clicked

    local factionList = Database.factionsByExpansion[expansion]     -- obtain a list of factions in the same set
    for _, faction in ipairs(factionList) do                            -- for each faction in this factionList...
        if Database.factionTable[faction].included == false then      -- ... check to see if its toggle status is false...
            allFactionsTrueFlag = false                                 -- ... and if it is, mark the flag as false...
            break                                                       -- ... and break the for loop
        end
    end
    expansionToggleTableUpdate(expansion, (allFactionsTrueFlag and true) or false)       -- if the flag is still true, then call this function to set the expansion toggle to "True", otherwise set it to "False"
end

-- this function is called whenever the `Select All` toggle is clicked, and updates all the Expansion and Faction toggles to the same status as the selectAll toggle
function SettingsPanel.onSelectAllToggled(_, toggleID, newToggleStatus)

    for toggleName, toggleValue in pairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["selectAll"]) do         -- for every toggle entry in the `selectAll` key of the toggle tracker table...
        toggleValue = newToggleStatus                                                                -- ... set the boolean value of the toggle to the value of the `selectAll` toggle that was just clicked...
        UI.setAttribute(toggleName, "isOn", newToggleStatus)                                        -- ... and update the UI toggle
    end

    for _, expansion in ipairs(Database.expansionList) do               -- for every expansion in the expansionList...
        expansionToggleTableUpdate(expansion, newToggleStatus)          -- ... call this function, passing the currently iterated expansion, as well as the toggle status of the selectAll toggle

        local factionList = Database.factionsByExpansion[expansion]     -- ... establish a new table variable for the list of factions of the currently iterated expansion...
        for _, faction in ipairs(factionList) do                        -- ... and for every faction in the factionList...
            factionToggleTableUpdate(faction, newToggleStatus)          -- ... call this function, passing the currently iterated faction and the selectAll toggle status
        end
    end
end

-- this function is called every time an `Expansion` toggle is clicked, and updates the corresponding Faction toggles
function SettingsPanel.onExpansionToggled(_, toggleID, newToggleStatus)
    local expansionID = string.gsub(toggleID, "set%-", "")        -- trims off the `set-` string of the Expansion id to make the ids of the Expansion toggles from `Select Faction` and `Select Expansion` panels uniform

    expansionToggleTableUpdate(expansionID, newToggleStatus)            -- call this function in order to update BOTH types of the Expansion toggles
    local factionList = Database.factionsByExpansion[expansionID]       -- establish a table variable to obtain a list of the factions belonging to this expansion
    for _, faction in ipairs(factionList) do                            -- for every faction in the factionList...

-- this function is called every time a Faction toggle is clicked, and updates the Expansion and selectAll toggles accordingly

function SettingsPanel.updateMaxSupportedFactionsCap(toggleID)

        elseif toggleID == "straightDraftOption" or toggleID == "snakeDraftOption" then

        end

        GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer = math.floor(#Database.allFactionsToBeIncluded / GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount)
        if GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer < GameData.UISetup.General.maxSupportedFactionsPerPlayer then
            GameData.UISetup.General.maxSupportedFactionsPerPlayer = GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer
        end

        UI.setAttribute("factionCount", "interactable", "true")                                                         -- ... make sure the inputField is usuable...
        UI.setAttribute("factionSlider", "interactable", "true")                                                        -- ... make sure the slider is usuable
        UI.setAttribute("factionSlider", "maxValue", GameData.UISetup.General.maxSupportedFactionsPerPlayer)

-- this function gets called after clicking the `Expansion/Faction` selection UI `Next` button
-- it ensures that the `draftMethod` UI uses correct parameters, preventing the host from creating a pool of factions larger than the amount of factions included/available from the `Expansion/Faction` selection panel
function SettingsPanel.calculateAvailableFactionsPerPlayer(factionCount)
    if GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetMaxSupportedFactionsCap then
        for toggleID, isOn in pairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.draftOptions) do
            if isOn then
                SettingsPanel.updateMaxSupportedFactionsCap(toggleID)
            end
        end
    end

    GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer = math.floor(factionCount / GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount)                              -- identifies the maximum number of factions that can be randomized/pooled for each player based on the number of factions that have been included. needs to round down.

    if GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer == 2 then                                                                  -- if the maximum number of factions available per player is only 2, then...
        UI.setAttribute("factionCount", "text", GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer)                                  -- ... set the text string of inputField to 2 (because default is 3)...
        UI.setAttribute("factionSlider", "maxValue", GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer)                             -- ... set the maxValue of the slider to 2 (however, the code in the `SettingsPanel.validateFactionsPerPlayerInput` automatically would prevent going above 2 anyway; this line of code is not needed but included for clarity and completeness)
        SettingsPanel.validateFactionsPerPlayerInput(PlayerFunctions.getHost(), GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer, "factionCount")       -- ... then run the SettingsPanel.validateFactionsPerPlayerInput function which will update all the values/text strings on the draftMethod UI panel
    elseif GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer < GameData.UISetup.General.maxSupportedFactionsPerPlayer then                                     -- if the maximum number of factions available per player is less than or equal to 5 (and above 2) then...
        UI.setAttribute("factionSlider", "maxValue", GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer )                            -- ... set the maxValue of the slider to the max number of factions per player, so cannot accidentally include more factions than are available...
        if tonumber(UI.getAttribute("factionCount", "text")) > GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer then               -- ... and if the number displayed in the inputField is higher than the UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer then...
            UI.setAttribute("factionCount", "text", GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer)                                  -- ... reset the inputField text to the value of UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer...
            SettingsPanel.validateFactionsPerPlayerInput(PlayerFunctions.getHost(), GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer, "factionCount")       -- ... and run the SettingsPanel.validateFactionsPerPlayerInput function to update all the values/text strings on the draftMethod UI panel
        end
    else
        UI.setAttribute("factionSlider", "maxValue", GameData.UISetup.General.maxSupportedFactionsPerPlayer)                               -- otherwise, just make sure to reset the maxValue of the slider to its default of 9
    end

    if GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer < 7 then
        UI.setAttribute("smashLeague", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("smashLeague", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("smashLeague", "tooltip", "Not enough factions have been included in the pool. Please include at least 7 per player.")
        UI.setAttribute("draftOptionF", "tooltip", "Not enough factions have been included in the pool. Please include at least 7 per player.")
        UI.setAttribute("draftOptionF", "color", "gray")
    end
end



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FUNCTIONS THAT HANDLE UI INPUT ON THE DRAFTMETHOD PANEL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function is called whenever the inputField or the Slider on the draftMethod panel is used to change the number of factions randomized per player
function SettingsPanel.validateFactionsPerPlayerInput(playerInst, countVal, inputID)
    local draftElemAttrib
    if countVal == "-" then countVal = 0 end
    countVal = tonumber(countVal)

    if inputID == "factionSlider" then draftElemAttrib = "value" end            -- choose which attribute will need to be changed based on the element type (inputField vs slider) that called this function
    if inputID == "factionCount" then draftElemAttrib = "text" end

    if playerInst.host == false then                                            -- if a player other than the host tries to use the UI...
        UI.setAttribute(inputID, draftElemAttrib, GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer)   -- ... reset the elements value to it's pre-change value, as stored in the factionsPerPlayer variable...
        return                                                                  -- ... and return from the function early
    end

    if countVal ~= nil then
        if countVal < 2 then                                                        -- if the inputField box received a number less than 2...
            countVal = 2                                                            -- ... then change the value to 2
            if inputID == "factionCount" then PlayerFunctions.getHost().broadcast("Must pool enough factions for each player to select 2.") end
        elseif countVal > GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer then                        -- if the inputField box received a number higher than what is possible, given the UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer (and is not-empty to avoid a 'number is compared to nil' error)...
            countVal = GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer                                -- ... then change the value to UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer
            if inputID == "factionCount" then PlayerFunctions.getHost().broadcast("There weren't enough factions included to put that many into the pool.") end
        elseif countVal > GameData.UISetup.General.maxSupportedFactionsPerPlayer then                          -- if the inputField box received a number higher than 6/six (and is not-empty to avoid a 'number is compared to nil' error)...
            countVal = GameData.UISetup.General.maxSupportedFactionsPerPlayer                                  -- ... then change the value to 6/six (the maximum number of factions per player allowed)
            if inputID == "factionCount" then PlayerFunctions.getHost().broadcast("Cannot include more than 6 factions per player.") end
        end

        setFactionsPerPlayerUI(countVal)
    end
end

local function removeGhostPlayer(color)
    for colorNum = #GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors, 1, -1 do
        if GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors[colorNum] == color then
            table.remove(GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors, colorNum)
        end
    end

    if GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors == nil or next(GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) == nil then
        GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSystemEnabled = false
    end

    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles = true
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = true
    GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount = GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount - 1

    if GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount == 1 then
        Hands.disable_unused = true
    end
end



local function resetTextPanel()
    GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor = ""
    UI.setAttribute("chosenPlayerStatus", "outline", "gray")

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["randomSelectionOption"]
    or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"] then
        UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "The first player will\nplay first.")
        GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = false
    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.choosePlayer.choosePlayerOptions.chooseDraftOrPlay then
        UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "The first player will\ndecide to draft or play first.\n(on next screen)")
        GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = true
    else
        UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "The first player will\nboth draft and play first.")
        GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = false
    end

    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles = true
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = true
end



local function updateTextPanel(color)
    UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..color, "playerSelectButton "..color.."Button chosenButton")
    UI.setAttribute("chosenPlayerStatus", "outline", color)

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["randomSelectionOption"]
    or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"] then
        UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."\">"..color.."</textcolor> player will\nplay first.")
        GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = false
    elseif XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.choosePlayer.choosePlayerOptions.chooseDraftOrPlay then
        UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."\">"..color.."</textcolor> player will\ndecide to draft or play first.\n(on next screen)")
        GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = true
    else
        UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."\">"..color.."</textcolor> player will\nboth draft and play first.")
        GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = false
    end
end



local function resetFirstPlayerColorBoxes(color, isGhostPlyr)
    isGhostPlyr = isGhostPlyr or false

    toggleType = isGhostPlyr and "ghostPlayers" or "choosePlayer"

    for colorDot, value in pairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType].colors) do
        if value == true then
            local oldColor = Common.firstToUpper(colorDot:match("(.*)Dot"))
            if oldColor ~= color then
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType]["colors"][colorDot] = false
                if isGhostPlyr then
                    UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..oldColor, "playerSelectButton "..oldColor.."Button disabledButton")
                    UI.setClass("ghostPlayer"..oldColor, "playerSelectButton "..oldColor.."Button")
                    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["choosePlayer"]["colors"][colorDot] = false
                    removeGhostPlayer(oldColor)
                else
                    UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..oldColor, "playerSelectButton "..oldColor.."Button")
                end

                GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles = true
                GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = true
            end
        end
    end
end



function SettingsPanel.setupChooseFirstPlayerPanel()
    UI.setAttribute("ghostButton", "active", "true")
    UI.setAttribute("ghostPanel", "active", "false")
    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.ghostPlayers.panelOpen = false

    if #Database.allFactionsToBeIncluded < (GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount + 1) * GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer then
        UI.setAttribute("ghostButton", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("ghostButton", "tooltip", "There aren't enough factions included in the pool to accommodate more players.")
        UI.setAttribute("ghostButtonImage", "color", "gray")
    else
        UI.setAttribute("ghostButton", "interactable", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("ghostButton", "tooltip", "Add empty seats (ghost players).")
        UI.setAttribute("ghostButtonImage", "color", "white")
    end

    if GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor == "" then
        for _, color in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do
            if Player[color].seated then
                UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..color, "playerSelectButton "..color.."Button")
                UI.setClass("ghostPlayer"..color, "playerSelectButton "..color.."Button disabledButton")
                UI.setAttribute("ghostPlayer"..color, "tooltip", "The "..color.." seat is already occupied by a player.")
            else
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["choosePlayer"]["colors"][color:lower().."Dot"] = false
                UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..color, "playerSelectButton "..color.."Button disabledButton")

                if Common.isInTable(color, GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) then
                    UI.setClass("ghostPlayer"..color, "playerSelectButton "..color.."Button chosenButton")
                    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.ghostPlayers.colors[color:lower().."Dot"] = true
                else
                    UI.setClass("ghostPlayer"..color, "playerSelectButton "..color.."Button")
                    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.ghostPlayers.colors[color:lower().."Dot"] = false
                end
                UI.setAttribute("ghostPlayer"..color, "tooltip", "Add a ghost player at the "..color.." seat.")
            end
        end

        for _, ghostColor in ipairs(GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) do
            UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..ghostColor, "playerSelectButton "..ghostColor.."Button")
        end

        GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = true

    else
        UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor, "playerSelectButton "..GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor.."Button chosenButton")
        UI.setAttribute("chosenPlayerStatus", "outline", GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor)
    end

    local color = GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor

    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["randomSelectionOption"]
    or XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"] then

        UI.setAttribute("choosePlayerOptionsLabel", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("choosePlayerOptions", "allowSwitchOff", "true")

        if color ~= "" then
            UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."\">"..color.."</textcolor> player will\nplay first.")
        else
            UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "The first player will\nplay first.")
        end
        GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = false

        for option, value in pairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.choosePlayer.choosePlayerOptions) do
            UI.setAttribute(option, "interactable", "false")
            UI.setAttribute(option, "isOn", "false")
            UI.setAttribute(option.."Text", "color", "gray")
        end

    else
        UI.setAttribute("choosePlayerOptionsLabel", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("choosePlayerOptions", "allowSwitchOff", "false")


        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"] then
            if GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount - #GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors >= 2 then
                UI.setAttribute("ghostButton", "active", "false")
            end
            for colorNum = #GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors, 1, -1 do
                local color = GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors[colorNum]
                table.remove(GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors, colorNum)
                if GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor == color then
                    resetTextPanel()
                end
                GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount = GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount - 1
                GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles = true
                GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = true

                UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..color, "playerSelectButton "..color.."Button disabledButton")
                UI.setClass("ghostPlayer"..color, "playerSelectButton "..color.."Button")
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["choosePlayer"]["colors"][color:lower().."Dot"] = false
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["ghostPlayers"]["colors"][color:lower().."Dot"] = false
            end
            if GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors == nil or next(GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) == nil then
                GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSystemEnabled = false
            end

            color = GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor

            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.choosePlayer.choosePlayerOptions.chooseDraftOrPlay = true
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.choosePlayer.choosePlayerOptions.firstForAll = false
        end

        for option, value in pairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.choosePlayer.choosePlayerOptions) do
            if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"] then
                UI.setAttribute(option, "interactable", "false")
                UI.setAttribute(option.."Text", "color", "gray")
            else
                UI.setAttribute(option, "interactable", "true")
                UI.setAttribute(option.."Text", "color", "black")
            end
            UI.setAttribute(option, "isOn", value)
        end

        if color ~= "" then
            if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.choosePlayer.choosePlayerOptions.chooseDraftOrPlay then
                UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."\">"..color.."</textcolor> player will\ndecide to draft or play first.\n(on next screen)")
                GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = true
            else
                UI.setValue("chosenPlayerStatusText", "<textcolor color=\"#"..SmashUp.ColorTable[color].hex.."\">"..color.."</textcolor> player will\nboth draft and play first.")
                GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = false
            end
        end
    end

    XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("choosePlayer", true)
end



function SettingsPanel.randomlySelectPlayer()

    local seatedColors = SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getSeatedColors()
    if GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors then
        for _, color in ipairs(GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors) do
            table.insert(seatedColors, color)
        end
    end

    local firstColor = seatedColors[math.random(#seatedColors)]
    GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor = firstColor

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["choosePlayer"]["colors"][firstColor:lower().."Dot"] = true

    updateTextPanel(firstColor)

    resetFirstPlayerColorBoxes(firstColor)
end



function SettingsPanel.clickChoosePlayerToggle(playerInst, buttonClick, toggleID)
    if tonumber(buttonClick) ~= -1 or playerInst.host == false then return end                                                                  -- if this button is clicked by a mouse button OTHER than the left click, or if the host didn't click the button, dont' do anything.

    local buttonType = toggleID:match("(.*)Player")
    local buttonColor = toggleID:match(buttonType.."Player(.*)")

    if buttonType == "choose" then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["choosePlayer"]["colors"][buttonColor:lower().."Dot"] = not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["choosePlayer"]["colors"][buttonColor:lower().."Dot"]

        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["choosePlayer"]["colors"][buttonColor:lower().."Dot"] then
            GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor = buttonColor

            updateTextPanel(buttonColor)

            resetFirstPlayerColorBoxes(buttonColor)

        else
            UI.setClass(toggleID, "playerSelectButton "..buttonColor.."Button")

            resetTextPanel()
        end

    elseif buttonType == "ghost" then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.ghostPlayers.colors[buttonColor:lower().."Dot"] = not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.ghostPlayers.colors[buttonColor:lower().."Dot"]

        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.ghostPlayers.colors[buttonColor:lower().."Dot"] then
            if #Database.allFactionsToBeIncluded < (GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount + 1) * GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer then
                XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker.ghostPlayers.colors[buttonColor:lower().."Dot"] = false
                PlayerFunctions.getHost().broadcast("There aren't enough factions included in the pool to accommodate more players.")
            else
                GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles = true
                GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = true
                GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount = GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount + 1

                UI.setClass(toggleID, "playerSelectButton "..buttonColor.."Button chosenButton")

                UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..buttonColor, "playerSelectButton "..buttonColor.."Button")

                table.insert(GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors, buttonColor)
                GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSystemEnabled = true

                if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"] then
                    resetFirstPlayerColorBoxes(buttonColor, true)
                end

                Hands.disable_unused = false
            end

        else
            UI.setClass(toggleID, "playerSelectButton "..buttonColor.."Button")
            UI.setClass("choosePlayer"..buttonColor, "playerSelectButton "..buttonColor.."Button disabledButton")
            XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["choosePlayer"]["colors"][buttonColor:lower().."Dot"] = false

            removeGhostPlayer(buttonColor)

            if GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor == buttonColor then
                resetTextPanel()
            end
        end
    end
end

function SettingsPanel.setupBaseOptionsPanel()
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["smashLeague"] then
        XMLUI.DraftSelectionPanel.generatebaseSelectionPanelOpen()
        return
    end


    for _, playerInfo in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
        for _, faction in ipairs(XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["randomSelectionOption"] and playerInfo.factionsPicked or playerInfo.factionsDrafted) do
            if Database.factionTable[faction].expansion == "Munchkin" then
                GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin = true
            elseif Database.factionTable[faction].expansion == "Obligatory Cthulhu" then
                GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu = true
            end
        end
    end

    if GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin == true and GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu == true then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["baseOptions"]["mostBases"] = false
        UI.setAttribute("mostBases", "isOn", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("mostBases", "interactable", "false")
        UI.setAttribute("mostBasesText", "color", "gray")
        UI.setAttribute("mostBasesText", "text", "All regular bases (excludes Cthulhu and Munchkin bases).")
    elseif GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Munchkin == true then
        UI.setAttribute("mostBases", "interactable", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("mostBasesText", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("mostBasesText", "text", "All regular bases (excludes Cthulhu bases; Munchkin bases will be included).")
    elseif GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded.Cthulhu == true then
        UI.setAttribute("mostBases", "interactable", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("mostBasesText", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("mostBasesText", "text", "All regular bases (excludes Munchkin bases; Cthulhu bases will be included).")
    else
        UI.setAttribute("mostBases", "interactable", "true")
        UI.setAttribute("mostBasesText", "color", "black")
        UI.setAttribute("mostBasesText", "text", "All regular bases (excludes Cthulhu and Munchkin bases).")
    end

    XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("baseOptions")
end

__bundle_register("Smash Up/xmlBeginPanel", function(require, _LOADED, __bundle_register, __bundle_modules)
local Common = require("Common")

local SmashUp

local XMLUI
local GameData
local PlayerFunctions

local BeginPanel = {}


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- FUNCTION RUNS WHEN ANY BUTTON ON THE BEGINPANEL IS PRESSED
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this is the function that gets called when any of the buttons on the initial `beginSetup` panel are clicked
-- this function determines what happens with the UI setup process/initial UI panels depending on what buttons are clicked
function BeginPanel.useScriptedSetup(buttonID)
    if (next(Player.getSpectators()) == nil and buttonID == "yesButton") or buttonID == "warningConfirm" then     -- if there are no spectators (or if there are spectators and the host clicks the `Yes` button to confirm the warning anyway)...

        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("expansions")                              -- ... activate/show the "expansions" UI

        GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount = PlayerFunctions.getPlayerCount()                      -- ... find the number of seated players

        GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupInProgress = true                                                  -- ... change this monitoring variable to true. this will prevent players from changing their color during setup
        GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps.draftStarted = os.time()

    elseif buttonID == "warningCancel" then                                         -- ... if the `No` button is clicked on the `spectatorWarning` UI ("acknowleding" the warning)...
        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("beginSetup")                                  -- ... then re-show the `beginSetup` UI

    else                                                                            -- ... if there ARE spectators (and the `Yes` button is clicked)...
        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("spectatorWarning")                            -- ... show the `spectatorWarning` UI, warning the host there are connected players that haven't selected a valid seat color
    end
end





--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- INITIAL "USE SCRIPTED UI?" PANEL FUNCTIONS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function is called through the checkPlayerColorAndHostStatus function on startUp and whenever a player changes their color if criteria are met to activate the initial UI panel.
-- this function changes the initial "Use Scripted Setup?" UI panel to be in it's "Active" state
local function activateSetUpUIPanel()
    UI.setClass("beginSetup", "beginPanel active")
    UI.setClass("yesButton", "yesButton")
end


-- this function is called through the checkPlayerColorAndHostStatus function on startUp and whenever a player changes their color if criteria are met to DEactivate the initial UI panel.
-- this function changes the initial "Use Scripted Setup?" UI panel to be in it's "inActive" state
local function deactivateSetUpUIPanel()
    UI.setClass("beginSetup", "beginPanel inactive")
    UI.setClass("yesButton", "yesButton inactive")
end


-- this function is called on startUp (via onLoad function in the xmlUISetup file) and whenever a player changes their color (via changeSetUpUIVisibility function), to determine whether or not to activate the initial UI panel.
-- this function receives a player instance and checks the color and host status of that player.
-- using that info, it determines if the "Use Scripted Setup?" UI panel should be active or inactive and what messages to broadcast to players when they change their color.
local function checkPlayerColorAndHostStatus(playerInst)
    if Common.isInTable(playerInst.color, Player.getAvailableColors()) then             -- if the player's color is a valid seat color (the player is now seated in a valid color)...
        if playerInst.host then                                                         -- ... and the player is THE HOST...
            activateSetUpUIPanel()                                                          -- ... then call this function to update/activate the Set Up UI
        else
            playerInst.broadcast("Waiting for Host to start the Set Up process...")         -- ... if a player other than the host selects a valid color/seat, then broadcast this message.
        end
    else                                                                                -- if a player chose a color that is a non-valid seat color...
        playerInst.broadcast("Please choose a valid seat color to continue.")           -- ... broadcast this message
        if playerInst.host then                                                         -- ... and if the player that selected a non-valid seat color is the host...
            deactivateSetUpUIPanel()                                                        -- ... then call this function to deactivate the Set Up UI
        end
    end
end


-- this function gets called whenever a player changes color (via onPlayerChangeColor event in Global)
-- this function runs different code depending on whether a host or a non-host changed their color to a valid or a non-valid seat color, but prevents players from changing their color once the UI-guided setup has begun.
-- this function calls other functions that will change the appearance of the initial `beginSetup` UI panel that appears at startup, which is 'deactivated' until the host picks a valid seat color.

local SmashUp

local Database

-- FUNCTIONS USED BY ALL FACTION PICKING UI PANELS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- this function obtains the color of the first player by looking at the first entry of the GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table;
-- using the color of the first player, this function then updates the label in the lower left corner of the faction drafting panels with the first player's name and color
function xmlFunctions.setNamePlate()
    -- for RandomSelectionPanel
    local playerName = Player[GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor].steam_name or GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor

    UI.setAttribute("firstPlayer", "text", playerName)                                          -- display the name of the first player in the bottom row label box
    UI.setClass("nameLabel", "nameLabel "..GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor)                          -- change the colors of the firstPlayer label box according to the colors of the first player

    -- for DraftSelectionPanel
    UI.setAttribute("draftFirstPlayer", "text", playerName)                                     -- display the name of the first player in the bottom row label box
    UI.setClass("draftNameLabel", "nameLabel "..GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor)                     -- change the colors of the firstPlayer label box according to the colors of the first player
end


-- this function is called the first time the faction selection UIs are run in order to setup the variables.
-- Running it only a single time prevents the game from resetting the variables and clearing the UI over-and-over, allowing settings to persist between panel changes
local function initializeFactionSelectionPhase()
    -- the purpose of these lists here is to prevent mutual exclusivity: if a faction is randomized to a player in RandomSelectionPanel, it should still be available to be randomized to players in the DraftSelectionPanel
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection = Common.randomizeTable(Common.shallowCopy(Database.allFactionsToBeIncluded))     -- obtain a copy of the included factions, and randomize it (used by the RandomSelectionPanel)
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting = Common.randomizeTable(Common.shallowCopy(Database.allFactionsToBeIncluded))       -- obtain a copy of the included factions, and randomize it (used by the DraftSelectionPanel)

    GameData.Customs.customListForRandomized = {}
    GameData.Customs.customListForDrafting = {}
    for _, factionInfo in ipairs(GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array) do
        local factionLabel = factionInfo.factionName.." *&^* "..factionInfo.creatorName
        if Database.allChosenCustomFactions[factionLabel] then
            table.insert(GameData.Customs.customListForRandomized, factionLabel)
            table.insert(GameData.Customs.customListForDrafting, factionLabel)
        end
    end
    GameData.Customs.customListForRandomized = Common.randomizeTable(GameData.Customs.customListForRandomized)
    GameData.Customs.customListForDrafting = Common.randomizeTable(GameData.Customs.customListForDrafting)
    GameData.Customs.startDealingCustomsAt = math.random(GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount)


    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool = {}                                                                              -- resets/clears the list of factions that have been randomized into the draft pool
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes = {}                                                                               -- resets/clears the table that tracks the "selected", "drafted", "faction", and "color" attributes for each draftBox UI element

    SmashUp.Setup.initializePlayerSetupProfilesAndTurnNumberByColorTables()                                         -- call this function to create/initiate the GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table that tracks information specific to each player, including their color, the factions they've been dealt, factions they draft, etc

    XMLUI.OptionsPanel.prepareOptionSettingsTable()                                                                 -- this function is called in order to create the tables that will track and store the settings chosen in all the option settings panels
    XMLUI.OptionsPanel.redrawCancel()                                                                               -- run this function to ensure the redraw options panel is reset to defaults
    -- XMLUI.OptionsPanel.banCancel()                                                                                  -- run this function to ensure the ban options panel is reset to defaults

    XMLUI.xmlDataTables.viewDraftPool = {
        ["draftViewed"] = false
    }

    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetRandomSelectionPanel = true
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetDraftSelectionPanel = true
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetBanPanel = true
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = true

    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetFullFactionSelectionSystem = false                                                                                 -- turn this variable to false to avoid rerunning this same function needlessly
end


function xmlFunctions.resetPlayerSetupProfilesPreservingFactionsDealt()
    local factionsDealtBackUp = {}

    for num, playerInfo in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
        factionsDealtBackUp[playerInfo.color] = playerInfo.factionsDealt
    end

    SmashUp.Setup.initializePlayerSetupProfilesAndTurnNumberByColorTables(GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor)

    for num, playerInfo in ipairs(GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles) do
        GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles[num].factionsDealt = factionsDealtBackUp[playerInfo.color]
    end
end

-- this function is called when the draftMethod next button is clicked
-- this function acts as a "switchboard" of sorts to determine which functions to run based on the selected draftMethod
function xmlFunctions.prepareAllFactionSelectionPanels()

    if GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor == "" then
        XMLUI.SettingsPanel.randomlySelectPlayer()
    end

    GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstDraftTurnColor = GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor
    GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor = GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor

    if GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetFullFactionSelectionSystem == true then                                                            -- if this variable (which tracks whether or not the UI data needs to be reset) is set to true...
        initializeFactionSelectionPhase()                                                                               -- ... then run this function that resets/re-establishes UI and data variables; it does not reset or redraw any UI elements (really should only be run at the very beginning, and if the host changes the included expansions/factions)
    end

    if GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles == true then
        xmlFunctions.resetPlayerSetupProfilesPreservingFactionsDealt()
    end


    -- **if the host selected "Random Selection" for the draft method**
    if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["randomSelectionOption"] == true then              -- if the first draftOption is selected in the draftMethod UI setup process...

        XMLUI.RandomSelectionPanel.factionCountCheck()

        if GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetRandomSelectionPanel == true then                                                       -- ... if the random selection window needs to be redraw/reset then...
            XMLUI.RandomSelectionPanel.generateRandomSelectionPanel()                                           -- ... call this function to draw the `Random Selection` UI panel
        end

        XMLUI.xmlFunctions.activatePanel("randomSelection")                                                 -- lastly, make sure the randomSelection UI panel is activated

    else
        if XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker["draftOptions"]["freePickOption"] then
            UI.setAttribute("draftTitleText", "text", "Each player must pick 2 factions:")
            UI.setAttribute("draftTitleLayout", "spacing", "760")
        else
            UI.setAttribute("draftTitleText", "text", "Each player will take turns picking their 2 factions:")
            UI.setAttribute("draftTitleLayout", "spacing", "545")

-- this function is called by activatePanel everytime it itself is called
-- this function closes all UI panels
local function deactivateAllPanels(keepParentOpen)
    UI.setAttribute("beginSetup", "active", "false")                    -- closes the initial "Begin Setup?" panel
    UI.setAttribute("spectatorWarning", "active", "false")              -- closes the "There are still spectators" warning panel
    UI.setAttribute("expansions", "active", "false")                    -- closes the Expansions sub-panel
    UI.setAttribute("factions", "active", "false")                      -- closes the Factions sub-panel
    UI.setAttribute("draftMethod", "active", "false")                   -- closes the draftMethod sub-panel
    UI.setAttribute("choosePlayer", "active", "false")                   -- closes the firstPlayer sub-panel
    UI.setAttribute("baseOptions", "active", "false")                   -- closes the draftMethod sub-panel
    UI.setAttribute("randomSelection", "active", "false")               -- closes the randomSelection faction picking sub-panel
    UI.setAttribute("draftSelection", "active", "false")                -- closes the draftSelection faction picking sub-panel

    if not keepParentOpen then                                          -- if this variable is true, then don't close the following panels. But if it is NOT true...
        UI.setAttribute("settingsEnclosure", "active", "false")         -- ... then close the settingsEnclosure parent panel...
        UI.setAttribute("pickFactions", "active", "false")              -- ... and close the pickFactions faction picking parent panel
    end
end

-- this function is called anytime a panel needs to be closed and a new one opened
function xmlFunctions.activatePanel(panel, keepParentOpen)
    -- if keepParentOpen is `true` then don't close the parent element, diminishing needless "flicker"
    local keepParentOpen = keepParentOpen or false                                  -- set this flag variable to a default of false, if it is not passed in as a parameter
    deactivateAllPanels(keepParentOpen)                                             -- call this function to close all open panels

    if panel == "expansions" or panel == "factions" or panel == "draftMethod"
    or panel == "choosePlayer" or panel == "baseOptions" then                           -- if the panel name is "expansions", "factions", or "draftMethod" then...
        UI.setAttribute("settingsEnclosure", "active", "true")                      -- ... make sure to also activate their settingsEnclosure parent panel

    elseif panel == "randomSelection" or panel == "draftSelection" then             -- if the panel name is "randomSelection" or "draftSelection" then...
        UI.setAttribute("pickFactions", "active", "true")                           -- ... make sure to also activate their pickFactions parent panel

    end

    UI.setAttribute(panel, "active", "true")                                        -- activate the specified panel
end

-- this function updates a toggles status using values stored in a table, rather than relying on TTS to update the xml automatically
function xmlFunctions.updateToggleStatus(toggleID, toggleType)
    local newToggleStatus                                                                                           -- instantiate this new variable as local (that will hold true/false boolean values)
    if toggleType == "faction" then                                                                                 -- if the toggle just clicked was a faction toggle...
        Database.factionTable[toggleID].included = not Database.factionTable[toggleID].included                     -- ... then change the boolean value for the faction toggle stored in the table to its opposite value (true -> false; false -> true)...
        newToggleStatus = Database.factionTable[toggleID].included                                                  -- ... store the new boolean value in the newToggleStatus variable...

    elseif toggleType == "choosePlayer" then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType].choosePlayerOptions[toggleID] = not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType].choosePlayerOptions[toggleID]
        newToggleStatus = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType].choosePlayerOptions[toggleID]

    elseif toggleType == "turnSettings" then
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType].turnOptions[toggleID] = not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType].turnOptions[toggleID]
        newToggleStatus = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType].turnOptions[toggleID]

    else                                                                                                            -- if the toggle just clicked was any other type of toggle...
        local toggleID = string.gsub(toggleID, "set%-", "")                                                         -- ... remove the `set-` prefix from the expansion toggle UI element ID (for the expansion toggles on the `Select Factions` panel)...
        XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType][toggleID] = not XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType][toggleID]     -- ... then change the boolean value for the toggle that is stored in the table to its opposite value (true -> false; false -> true)...
        newToggleStatus = XMLUI.xmlDataTables.toggleTracker[toggleType][toggleID]                                          -- ... store the new boolean value in the newToggleStatus variable...
    end

    UI.setAttribute(toggleID, "isOn", newToggleStatus)                                                              -- update the `isOn` attribute for the toggle just clicked
    return newToggleStatus                                                                                          -- return the value of the newToggleStatus variable to be used in subsequent functions as the actual new value for the toggles
end

local SmashUp

local ManualSetup = {}

local function lookForBaseDeck()
    local foundBases = false
    for _, obj in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseDraw.getObjects()) do
        if obj.type == "Card" or obj.type == "Deck" then
            foundBases = true
        end
    end
    if not foundBases then
        for _, obj in pairs(SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.baseDiscard.getObjects()) do
            if obj.type == "Card" or obj.type == "Deck" then
                foundBases = true
            end
        end
    end
    return foundBases
end



local function lookForPlayerDecks()
    local seatedColors = SmashUp.PlayerFunctions.getSeatedColors()

    local deckCount = 0

    for _, color in pairs(seatedColors) do
        local foundDeck = false
        for _, obj in pairs((SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[color].draw).getObjects()) do
            if obj.type == "Card" or obj.type == "Deck" then
                foundDeck = true
            end
        end
        if not foundDeck then
            for _, obj in pairs((SmashUp.GameObjects.ScriptingZones.PlayerDeckZones[color].discard).getObjects()) do
                if obj.type == "Card" or obj.type == "Deck" then
                    foundDeck = true
                end
            end
        end
        if foundDeck then
            deckCount = deckCount + 1
        end
    end
    return deckCount
end



function ManualSetup.manualSetup()
    local foundCardsOnTable = false
    for _, obj in ipairs(getObjects()) do
        if obj.type ~= "Hand" and obj.type ~= "Scripting1" and obj.type ~= "Tile" and obj.type ~= "Infinite" and obj.type ~= "Board" and obj.type ~= "Generic" and obj.type ~= "Bag" then
            foundCardsOnTable = true
        end
    end

    if not foundCardsOnTable then
        broadcastToAll("Cannot start a game without any faction or base decks!", {1, 0, 114/255})
    else

        local foundBases = lookForBaseDeck()

        local playerDeckCount = lookForPlayerDecks()

        if not foundBases and playerDeckCount == 0 then
            broadcastToAll("No player or base decks have been created yet.", {1, 0, 114/255})
        elseif not foundBases then
            broadcastToAll("Cannot locate the base deck. Place it on the base mat.", {1, 0, 114/255})
        elseif playerDeckCount == 0 then
            broadcastToAll("Each player should choose 2 factions to prepare a deck.\nThen, place the deck on your player mat.", {1, 0, 114/255})
        elseif playerDeckCount < SmashUp.GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount then
            broadcastToAll("Not all players have prepared their play deck.\n(place deck onto your player mat)", {1, 0, 114/255})
        else
            UI.setAttribute("StartUIButton", "active", "false")
            UI.setAttribute("StartGameButton", "active", "false")
            -- SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.uiSetupInProgress = false
            --
            -- SmashUp.Setup.initializePlayerSetupProfilesAndTurnNumberByColorTables()              -- call this function to create/initiate the SmashUp.GameData.UISetup.General.playerSetupProfiles table that tracks information specific to each player, including their color, the factions they've been dealt, factions they draft, etc
            --
            -- getBoardMeasurements()
            --

        end
    end

-- this function returns the player instance of the player who is hosting the game
function PlayerFunctions.getHost()

        if player.host == true then                     -- ... if that player is the host...
            return player                               -- ... then return that player
        end
    end

-- this function counts the number of players that are currently seated in valid seat colors
function PlayerFunctions.getPlayerCount()
    local numPlayers = 0                                                    -- reset the numPlayers count variable to 0
    for _, color in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do                  -- for every valid seat color available...
        if Player[color].seated then numPlayers = numPlayers + 1 end        -- ... if there is a player seated at that color, then increase the numPlayers count by 1
    end
    return numPlayers                                                       -- return the numPlayers count
end

-- this function returns a table of all colors with a player seated at it
function PlayerFunctions.getSeatedColors()
    local seatedColors = {}                                     -- establish this variable as an empty table
    for _, color in ipairs(Player.getAvailableColors()) do      -- for every valid seat color available...
        if Player[color].seated == true then                    -- ... if there is a player seated at that color...
            table.insert(seatedColors, color)                       -- ... then insert that color into the seatedColors table
        end
    end
    return seatedColors                                         -- return the seatedColors table
