-- THIS FUNCTION IS ONLY USED WHEN ADDING NEW FACTIONS TO THE GAME
-- this function iterates through the new faction decks (in-game objects) to add names and other attributes to the cards themselves
-- it utilizes two string variables (above this function) to obtain the necessary data
local function prepareNewFactions()
	local quantTable = {}
	for line in string.gmatch(Database.newFactionCardQuant, "([^\n]+)") do              -- for every line in the string...
		local faction = string.match(line, "^([^\t]+)")                                 -- ... identify the name of the faction, given at the beginning of the line...
		quantTable[faction] = {}                                                        -- ... define a new subtable using the faction name as the key...
		for quantVal in string.gmatch(line, "(%d+)") do                                 -- ... for every number (representing minion power) listed in the remainder of the line...
			table.insert(quantTable[faction], tonumber(quantVal))                           -- ... insert the power number into the faction's subtable
		end
	end

	local powerTable = {}                                                               -- define this local (empty) table
	for line in string.gmatch(Database.newPowerList, "([^\n]+)") do                     -- for every line in the newPowerList string...
		local faction = string.match(line, "^([^\t]+)")                                 -- ... identify the name of the faction, given at the beginning of the line...
		powerTable[faction] = {}                                                        -- ... define a new subtable using the faction name as the key...
		for powerVal in string.gmatch(line, "(%d+)") do                                 -- ... for every number (representing minion power) listed in the remainder of the line...
			table.insert(powerTable[faction], tonumber(powerVal))                           -- ... insert the power number into the faction's subtable
		end
	end

	local minionTable = {}                                                              -- define this local (empty) table
	for line in string.gmatch(Database.newMinionList, "([^\n]+)") do                   	-- for every line in the newMinionList string...
		local faction, minionList = string.match(line, "^([^\t]+)\t(.+)")               -- ... identify the name of the faction at the beginning of the line, and store the rest of the line in the minionList variable
		-- local increment = 1                                                             -- ... establish this counting variable
		minionTable[faction] = {}                                                       -- ... define a new subtable using the faction name as the key...
		for minion in string.gmatch(minionList, "([^\t]+)") do                          -- ... for each minion name listed in minionList...
			table.insert(minionTable[faction], minion)
			-- minionTable[faction][minion] = { power = powerTable[faction][increment]}        -- ... define a new subtable in the faction's subtable, with the minion as the key, and then add that minion's power from the powerTable
			-- increment = increment + 1                                                       -- ... increase the counting variable by 1
		end
	end

	local actionTable = {}
	for line in string.gmatch(Database.newActionList, "([^\n]+)") do
		local faction, actionList = string.match(line, "^([^\t]+)\t(.+)")
		actionTable[faction] = {}
		for action in string.gmatch(actionList, "([^\t]+)") do
			table.insert(actionTable[faction], action)
		end
	end

	for faction, minionList in pairs(minionTable) do
		local minionCount = #minionTable[faction]
		local cardCount = 1

		local factionDeck = Common.getObjectByGMNote(faction)                           -- ... obtain a reference to the card deck for that faction...
		local factionDeckData = factionDeck.getData()                                   -- ... and access the object data for the deck

		for sepCardNum, cardQuant in ipairs(quantTable[faction]) do

			if sepCardNum <= minionCount then
				for cardNum = 1, cardQuant do
					local factionCard = factionDeckData.ContainedObjects[21 - cardCount]
					factionCard.Nickname = minionTable[faction][sepCardNum]
					factionCard.GMNotes = factionCard.Nickname
					factionCard.Description = "Minion"
					factionCard.Memo = powerTable[faction][sepCardNum]
					factionCard.Value = powerTable[faction][sepCardNum]
					factionCard.Tags = {}
					table.insert(factionCard.Tags, "Minion")
					table.insert(factionCard.Tags, "Power")
					cardCount = cardCount + 1
				end
			else
				for cardNum = 1, cardQuant do
					local factionCard = factionDeckData.ContainedObjects[21 - cardCount]
					factionCard.Nickname = actionTable[faction][sepCardNum - minionCount]
					factionCard.GMNotes = factionCard.Nickname
					factionCard.Description = "Action"
					factionCard.Value = 0
					factionCard.Tags = {}
					table.insert(factionCard.Tags, "Action")
					cardCount = cardCount + 1
				end
			end
		end

		factionDeck.destruct()                                                          -- need to destroy the object...
		spawnObjectData({data = factionDeckData})                                       -- ... in order to respawn it with the updated dataTable
	end
end


local function prepareNewBases()
	local newBasesTable = Common.splitStringByDelim(Database.newBaseList, "====\n")

	for _, expansionSetBaseList in ipairs(newBasesTable) do
		local expansionName, allExpansionBases = expansionSetBaseList:match("([^\n]+)\n(.+)")
		local targetBaseDeck = nil

		for _, deck in ipairs(getObjects()) do
			if deck.getName() == expansionName.." Bases" then
				targetBaseDeck = deck
				break
			end
		end

		local deckData
		if targetBaseDeck then
			targetBaseDeck.setGMNotes(targetBaseDeck.getName())
			deckData = targetBaseDeck.getData()
			targetBaseDeck.addTag("Base")
		end

		local eachFactionTable = Common.splitStringByDelim(allExpansionBases, "\n\n")
		local cardCount = 1

		for _, factionInfo in ipairs(eachFactionTable) do
			local factionName, factionsBases = factionInfo:match("([^\n]+)\n(.+)")
			local factionBaseDeck = nil
			if not targetBaseDeck then
				for _, deck in ipairs(getObjects()) do
					if deck.getName() == factionName.." Bases" then
						factionBaseDeck = deck
						factionBaseDeck.addTag("Base")
						break
					end
				end
				deckData = factionBaseDeck.getData()
			end

			for baseInfo in string.gmatch(factionsBases, "([^\n]+)") do
				local baseName, breakPoint, vp1, vp2, vp3 = baseInfo:match("^(.-) %- breakpoint (%d*) %- VPs: (%d*) (%d*) (%d*) %-")

				local deckTotal = #deckData.ContainedObjects

				local cardData = deckData.ContainedObjects[(deckTotal + 1) - cardCount]
				cardData.Nickname = baseName
				cardData.Description = factionName
				cardData.GMNotes = "Breakpoint: "..breakPoint
				cardData.Value = tonumber(breakPoint)
				cardData.Memo = JSON.encode_pretty({["first"] = vp1, ["second"] = vp2, ["third"] = vp3})
				cardData.Tags = {"Base"}

				cardCount = cardCount + 1
			end

			if not targetBaseDeck and factionBaseDeck then
				factionBaseDeck.destruct()
				spawnObjectData({data = deckData})
			end
		end
		if targetBaseDeck then
			targetBaseDeck.destruct()
			spawnObjectData({data = deckData})
		end
	end
end


local function packageUpNewFactions()
	local bigBox = Common.getObjectByGMNote("Smash Up Box")

	-- **This function is utilized by sort commands to properly sort the base cards**
	local function baseSort(a, b)
		if a.Description == b.Description then
			if a.Value == b.Value then
				return a.Nickname > b.Nickname
			else
				return a.Value > b.Value
			end
		else
			return a.Description > b.Description
		end
	end

	-- **Create a table of all new expansions and factions being added**
	local arrayOfEachNewExpansionAsString = Common.splitStringByDelim(Database.newBaseList, "====\n")

	local tableOfDeckIndices = {}
	local tableOfNewURLs = {}

	local boxData = bigBox.getData()
	for _, kitData in ipairs(boxData.ContainedObjects) do
		for _, deckData in ipairs(kitData.ContainedObjects) do
			if deckData.Name == "Deck" then
				for someNum, customDeckInfo in pairs(deckData.CustomDeck) do
					tableOfDeckIndices[tonumber(someNum)] = customDeckInfo.FaceURL
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local newDeckIndex = nil																				-- ... this variable is used to define and control what integer will be used to create the CardIDs and DeckIDs of this deck created by code
	local newDeckIndexURL = nil

	-- **Loop through each entry in the table. Each entry represents its own expansion set.**
	for _, allExpansionInfoAsString in ipairs(arrayOfEachNewExpansionAsString) do
		local expansionName, stringOfAllFactions = allExpansionInfoAsString:match("([^\n]+)\n(.+)")			-- Separate out the name of the expansion from the rest of the longString

		local newExpansionBasesDeckObj																		-- Create this new variable that will be used to reference the deck of base cards from this expansion
		for _, deck in ipairs(getObjects()) do																-- iterate over all objects in the game...
			if deck.getName() == expansionName.." Bases" then												-- ... and if the object is the expansions base deck...
				newExpansionBasesDeckObj = deck																	-- ... set this variable equal to the deck object
				break
			end
		end
		local deckData = newExpansionBasesDeckObj.getData()													-- get the object data table from the base card deck object and store in this variable
		local backupDeckData = Common.deepCopy(deckData)
		backupDeckData.DeckIDs = {}
		backupDeckData.CustomDeck = {}
		backupDeckData.ContainedObjects = {}

		-- **Create a table containing each of the expansion's factions in their own entry**
		local arrayOfEachNewExpansionsFactionsAsStrings = Common.splitStringByDelim(stringOfAllFactions, "\n\n")

		-- **Iterate through each entry in this table; each entry represents its own faction in this expansion set.**
		-- **starting to work with individual factions (their bases) here**
		for _, factionsBaseInfoAsString in ipairs(arrayOfEachNewExpansionsFactionsAsStrings) do
			local factionName = factionsBaseInfoAsString:match("([^\n]+)")									-- ... separate out the name of the faction from this longString containing info for the faction

			local factionDeck																	-- ... initialize this variable that will be used to hold a reference to the deck of cards for this faction
			local factionKitBox																	-- ... initialize this variable that will be used to hold a reference to this faction's kit box object

			for _, obj in ipairs(getObjects()) do												-- ... iterate over all objects in the game...
				if obj.getName() == factionName then												-- ...if the object is the faction's card deck...
					factionDeck = obj																	-- ... set this variable equal to the factions deck
				end
				if obj.getName() == factionName.." Kit" then										-- ... if the object is the faction's kitBox...
					factionKitBox = obj																	-- ... set this variable equal to the faction's kitBox
				end
			end

			local baseCardTable = {}															-- ... initialize this empty table that will hold the object data for all individual base cards for this faction
			for _, baseCardData in ipairs(deckData.ContainedObjects) do							-- ... iterate over the object data of the base deck...
				if baseCardData.Description == factionName then										-- ... and if the base card is from this faction (the faction name is given in the card's description)...
					table.insert(baseCardTable, Common.deepCopy(baseCardData))											-- ... then insert this into the table
				end
			end

			local newDeckFromData = nil

			-- **Iterate over each entry in the baseCardTable, and add the object data to the factionsBaseDeck to create a deck via script.**
			for cardNum = 1, #baseCardTable do

				local oldCardID = tostring(baseCardTable[cardNum].CardID)									-- ... identify the original CardID of the card defined by the currently iterated object data
				local oldDeckIndex = tonumber(oldCardID:sub(1, -3))
				local customDeckInfo = baseCardTable[cardNum].CustomDeck[oldDeckIndex]
				local oldCardIndex = tonumber(oldCardID:sub(-2, -1))

				if tableOfDeckIndices[oldDeckIndex] then
					if not tableOfNewURLs[customDeckInfo.FaceURL] then
						repeat
							 newDeckIndex = math.random(1, 999)
						until (not tableOfDeckIndices[newDeckIndex])
						tableOfDeckIndices[newDeckIndex] = customDeckInfo.FaceURL
						tableOfNewURLs[customDeckInfo.FaceURL] = newDeckIndex

					else
						newDeckIndex = tableOfNewURLs[customDeckInfo.FaceURL]
					end
				else
					newDeckIndex = oldDeckIndex
				end

				local newCardID = (newDeckIndex * 100) + oldCardIndex

				baseCardTable[cardNum].CardID = newCardID
				baseCardTable[cardNum].CustomDeck = {[newDeckIndex] = customDeckInfo}

				if cardNum == 1 then
					newDeckFromData = Common.deepCopy(baseCardTable[cardNum])

					-- **Change the specific data and properties of this code-defined deck to make it consistent with a deck.**
					newDeckFromData.Name = "Deck"
					newDeckFromData.Transform.posX = 0
					newDeckFromData.Transform.posY = 3
					newDeckFromData.Transform.posZ = 0
					newDeckFromData.Transform.rotX = 0
					newDeckFromData.Transform.rotY = 180
					newDeckFromData.Transform.rotZ = 0
					newDeckFromData.Nickname = factionName.." Bases"
					newDeckFromData.Description = expansionName
					newDeckFromData.GMNotes = factionName.." Bases"
					newDeckFromData.Hands = false
					newDeckFromData.Memo = nil
					newDeckFromData.CardID = nil
					newDeckFromData.Tags = {"Base"}
					newDeckFromData.Value = 0

					newDeckFromData.DeckIDs = {newCardID}
					newDeckFromData.ContainedObjects = {baseCardTable[cardNum]}
					table.insert(backupDeckData.DeckIDs, newCardID)
					table.insert(backupDeckData.ContainedObjects, baseCardTable[cardNum])

				else
					table.insert(newDeckFromData.DeckIDs, newCardID)
					table.insert(newDeckFromData.ContainedObjects, baseCardTable[cardNum])
					table.insert(backupDeckData.DeckIDs, newCardID)
					table.insert(backupDeckData.ContainedObjects, baseCardTable[cardNum])
				end

				newDeckFromData.CustomDeck[newDeckIndex] = customDeckInfo
				backupDeckData.CustomDeck[newDeckIndex] = customDeckInfo
			end

			table.sort(newDeckFromData.ContainedObjects, baseSort)								-- sort the base card data inside the deck data to be in proper order, prior to spawning
			table.sort(backupDeckData.ContainedObjects, baseSort)								-- sort the base card data inside the deck data to be in proper order, prior to spawning

			local factionKitBoxData = factionKitBox.getData()
			factionKitBoxData.ContainedObjects = {}
			table.insert(factionKitBoxData.ContainedObjects, newDeckFromData)
			table.insert(factionKitBoxData.ContainedObjects, factionDeck.getData())
			table.insert(boxData.ContainedObjects, factionKitBoxData)

			factionKitBox.destruct()
			factionDeck.destruct()
		end

		newExpansionBasesDeckObj.destruct()														-- destroy this expansions base deck (it is no longer needed; have the object data)


		-- **Place this expansions base cards inside the Bases Kit, and add to the `All Bases` deck**
		Wait.frames(function()
			deckData = backupDeckData

			local expansionNumbers = Common.switchKeyVal(Database.expansionList)

			table.sort(boxData.ContainedObjects, function(a, b)
				return a.Nickname > b.Nickname
			end)

			local allBasesDeck
			local existingDeck
			local existingDeckNum
			local addingToExistingExpansion = false

			for kitNum, kitData in ipairs(boxData.ContainedObjects) do
				if kitData.Nickname == "Bases Kit" then

					for deckCount, deckInfo in ipairs(kitData.ContainedObjects) do
						if deckInfo.Nickname == expansionName.." Bases" then
							addingToExistingExpansion = true
							existingDeck = deckInfo
							existingDeckNum = deckCount
						end
						if deckInfo.Nickname == "All Bases" then
							allBasesDeck = deckInfo
						end
					end
					if not addingToExistingExpansion then
						table.insert(boxData.ContainedObjects[kitNum].ContainedObjects, ((#kitData.ContainedObjects + 1) - expansionNumbers[expansionName]) + 1, deckData)
					end
					break
				end
			end

			if addingToExistingExpansion then
				for _, cardData in ipairs(deckData.ContainedObjects) do
					table.insert(existingDeck.ContainedObjects, cardData)
					table.insert(existingDeck.DeckIDs, cardData.CardID)
				end
				for someNum, customInfo in pairs(deckData.CustomDeck) do
					existingDeck.CustomDeck[someNum] = customInfo
				end
				table.sort(existingDeck.ContainedObjects, baseSort)

				local targetFaction = nil
				for baseNum, baseData in ipairs(existingDeck.ContainedObjects) do
					if baseData.Description == deckData.ContainedObjects[1].Description then
						if baseNum > 1 then
							targetFaction = existingDeck.ContainedObjects[baseNum - 1].Description
						end
						break
					end
				end

				local insertSpot = 1

				for baseNum, baseData in ipairs(allBasesDeck.ContainedObjects) do
					if targetFaction then
						if baseData.Description == targetFaction then
							insertSpot = baseNum + 1
						end
					else
						targetFaction = Database.factionsByExpansion[expansionName][1]
						if baseData.Description == targetFaction then
							insertSpot = baseNum
						end
					end
				end

				for baseNum = #deckData.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do
					local baseData = deckData.ContainedObjects[baseNum]

					table.insert(allBasesDeck.ContainedObjects, insertSpot, baseData)
					table.insert(allBasesDeck.DeckIDs, insertSpot, baseData.CardID)
				end

				if expansionName == "Promos" then
					local deepReefNum = nil
					for cardNum, cardInfo in ipairs(existingDeck.ContainedObjects) do
						existingDeck.DeckIDs[cardNum] = cardInfo.CardID
						if cardInfo.Nickname == "Deepreef Crag" then
							deepReefNum = cardNum
						end
					end
					table.insert(existingDeck.ContainedObjects, 1, table.remove(existingDeck.ContainedObjects, deepReefNum))
					table.insert(existingDeck.DeckIDs, 1, table.remove(existingDeck.DeckIDs, deepReefNum))
				end

			else
				local targetExpansion = Database.expansionList[expansionNumbers[expansionName] - 1]
				local targetFaction = nil
				if targetExpansion ~= nil then
					targetFaction = Database.factionsByExpansion[targetExpansion][#Database.factionsByExpansion[targetExpansion]]
				end
				local insertSpot = 1

				for baseNum, baseData in ipairs(allBasesDeck.ContainedObjects) do
					if baseData.Description == targetFaction then
						insertSpot = baseNum
						break
					end
				end

				for baseNum = #deckData.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do
					local baseData = deckData.ContainedObjects[baseNum]

					table.insert(allBasesDeck.ContainedObjects, insertSpot, baseData)
					table.insert(allBasesDeck.DeckIDs, insertSpot, baseData.CardID)
				end
			end

			bigBox.destruct()
			bigBox = spawnObjectData({ data = boxData})
		end, 2)
	end
end

local function resetDeckIDs()
	local box = Common.getObjectByGMNote("Smash Up Box")
	local boxData = box.getData()

	local deckCount = 0

	for _, expansion in ipairs(Database.expansionList) do
		for _, faction in ipairs(Database.factionsByExpansion[expansion]) do
			for _, kitData in ipairs(boxData.ContainedObjects) do
				if kitData.Nickname == faction.." Kit" then
					for deckNum = #kitData.ContainedObjects, 1, -1 do
						local deckData = kitData.ContainedObjects[deckNum]
						if deckData.Name == "Deck" then
							deckCount = deckCount + 1
							for idNum, deckID in ipairs(deckData.DeckIDs) do
								deckData.DeckIDs[idNum] = tonumber(deckCount..tostring(deckID):sub(-2, -1))
							end

							local count = 0
							local storedNum = nil
							for someNum, deckProperties in pairs(deckData.CustomDeck) do
								count = count + 1
								storedNum = someNum
							end

							if count == 1 then
								deckData.CustomDeck[deckCount] = deckData.CustomDeck[storedNum]
								deckData.CustomDeck[storedNum] = nil
							else
								print("error-or-or")
							end

							for _, cardData in ipairs(deckData.ContainedObjects) do
								cardData.CardID = tonumber(deckCount..tostring(cardData.CardID):sub(-2, -1))
							end
						end
					end
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	box.destruct()
	spawnObjectData({data = boxData})
end

-- this function adds the factions that have been selected to be included in the match into a new table called `allFactionsToBeIncluded`
function Database.obtainAllFactionsToBeIncluded()
	Database.allFactionsToBeIncluded = {}                                  			-- establish this variable as a table, which will hold only the included factions
	Database.allChosenCustomFactions = {}
	for faction, factionInfo in pairs(Database.factionTable) do     			-- for every faction in the factionTable...
		if factionInfo.expansion ~= "Decks" then                    			-- ... that doesn't belong to the arbitrary "Decks" expansion...
			if factionInfo.included == true then                    			-- ... if the faction has been selected to be included in the match...
				table.insert(Database.allFactionsToBeIncluded, faction)    			-- ... then add the faction to the `allFactionsToBeIncluded` table
				if factionInfo.custom == true then
					Database.allChosenCustomFactions[faction] = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- this function creates a new table that has factions grouped by expansion set, and ordered alphabetically within their expansion group
-- this table in turn is used to construct the faction UI panel.
local function setFactionsByExpansion()
	local factionsByExpansion = {}                                                  -- initialize the table variable
	local factionCount = 0

	for faction, factionInfo in pairs(Database.factionTable) do                     -- for every entry in the factionTable table...
		local expansion = factionInfo.expansion                                     -- ... obtain the faction's expansion...
		factionsByExpansion[expansion] = factionsByExpansion[expansion] or {}       -- ... and create a key in this new table for the expansion, initializing it as a table if nil (or just keeping it the same if not nil)...
		table.insert(factionsByExpansion[expansion], faction)                       -- ... and add a new entry to this table for the faction, under the expansion key

		factionCount = factionCount + 1
	end

	for expansion, factionList in pairs(factionsByExpansion) do                     -- for every set of factions in an expansion set in this table...
		table.sort(factionList)                                                     -- ... sort the faction list alphabetically
	end

	return factionsByExpansion, factionCount									-- return this local variable to the calling function
end

-- this function uses the correct order of expansions as given in expansionList, then iterates through all the factions for the currently iterated expansion in factionsByExpansion in order to generate the correct "by expansion" order number and stores that order number in the factionTable, keyed by faction name
local function addExpansionSortOrder()
	local orderNo = 1                                                   -- initialize the counting variable
	for expansionNo, expansion in ipairs(Database.expansionList) do     -- for every expansion in expansionList (iterates chronologically)...
		local factionList = Database.factionsByExpansion[expansion]     -- ... obtain the list of factions for that expansion...
		for factionNo, faction in ipairs(factionList) do                -- ... then for every faction in that faction list...
			Database.factionTable[faction].orderNo = orderNo            -- ... add an `orderNo` entry into the factionTable and set it equal to the current counting variable, in order to use this number to sort by expansion
			orderNo = orderNo + 1                                       -- increase the counting variable by 1
		end
	end
end

-- this function iterates through the factionComplexity mega-string to add the information to the Database.factionTable
local function addFactionComplexity()
	for line in string.gmatch(Database.factionComplexity, "\t([^\n]+)\n") do
		local faction, complexity, compLevel = string.match(line, "^([^\t]+)\t(%d+.*%d*)\t(.*)")
		Database.factionTable[faction].compLevel = compLevel
	end
end

-- this function iterates over the erratadCardsByFaction table and creates an errata'd cards list by card name

    GameData.UISetup.General.turnNumberByColor = {}                                             -- stores the turn order number of each player, using the player's color as the key

    GameData.UISetup.General.numberOfFactionsPerDeck = 2                                        -- how many factions are allowed to be used in a deck; default is 2 which is the default Smash Up gameplay
    GameData.UISetup.General.inputFactionsPerPlayer = 3                                         -- initialize this variable to track the value of the faction count on the draft mode UI panel, in order to revert the value of the inputField or slider back to this variable's value when a non-host attempts to change it
    GameData.UISetup.General.maxAvailableFactionsPerPlayer = 2                                  -- calculated by dividing the total number of factions included in the draft pool by the number of players, giving how many factions are available per player
    GameData.UISetup.General.maxSupportedFactionsPerPlayer = 6                                  -- given the chosen method of faction drafting, this is the theoretical maximum number of factions that could be available (as determined by what I have hard-coded to the drafting mechanic)

    GameData.UISetup.General.factionScrollWindowHeight = 0                                      -- the total height of the UI vLayout that holds the list of all factions found during the setup process. Needs to be adjusted when adding custom factions.


    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetMaxSupportedFactionsCap = true                                -- this flag marks when the maxSupportedFactionsPerPlayer variable needs to be recalculated because of other setting changes, such as including or excluding expansions/factions
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetFullFactionSelectionSystem = true                             -- this flag variable marks whether or not the UI data/variables need to be reset in order to fully rebuild the RandomSelectionPanel or DraftSelectionPanel (clicking the reset button)
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetPlayerSetupProfiles = true                                    -- a boolean flag that triggers the internal player state table to be rebuilt
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetRandomSelectionPanel = true                                   -- a boolean flag that indicates that the randomSelectionPanel needs to be redrawn/refreshed
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetDraftSelectionPanel = true                                    -- this flag variable marks whether or not the draft pool has been changed/re-selected, and therefore the draft phase UI needs to start over
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetBanPanel = true                                               -- this flag variable marks whether or not the ban panel needs to be redrawn because either the draft choice method has changed, or the color chosen to go first has changed (or both)
    GameData.UISetup.ResetTriggers.resetTurnSettingsPanel = true                                      -- this flag variable marks when the additional turn settings panel needs to be reset


    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftInProgress = false                                            -- this flag variable tracks whether or not the draft phase has started. first gets set to true when the host clicks the "Start Draft" button
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftRound = 1                                              -- this variable will track which phase of drafting will be next (1st pick vs 2nd pick)

    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnOrderByGameTurnNumber = {}
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.currentDraftTurnNumber = 1                                         -- establishes this variable that will be used to track which players turn it is, advancing through turn order
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftTurnDirection = 1                                             -- the direction in which turns progress. +1 is forward (straight draft), -1 is backward (snake draft)

    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.numPlayersCompletedDraft = 0                                       -- this counting variable will track how many players have completed their draft in a freeDraft
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.allPlayersFinishedDrafting = false                                 -- this flag variable marks when the drafting has been completed by all players

    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForRandomSelection = {}                             -- establish this table which will store all the allowed factions for randomly dealing out to each player for random selection picking
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.fullFactionListForDrafting = {}                                    -- establish this table which will store all the allowed factions that could be used for the draft pool
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.curatedDraftPool = {}                                              -- establish this table which will store the pool of factions players will draft from

    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.randomSelectionFactionBoxUIAttributes = {}                         -- this table will store info used as "attributes" for every factionBox in the RandomSelectionPanel UI
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftFactionBoxUIAttributes = {}                                   -- this table will store info used as "attributes" for every draft factionBox in the DraftSelectionPanel UI
    GameData.UISetup.DraftSystem.draftPanelFactionSortMode = "byExpansion"                          -- this sets the default/starting sorting method when displaying all included factions (in an openDraft or a freePick)


    GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.banRoundActive = false                                             -- this flag variable will track whether or not players are in a ban phase, as they take their turns
    GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.currentBanRound = 1                                                -- this variable tracks which ban phase will be activated at next ban
    GameData.UISetup.BanSystem.maxBanRounds = 2                                                   -- this variable sets how many maximum bans are allowed (at default)


    GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.turnSettingsSystemEnabled = false                                  -- during the drafting of factions, this setting is true if players need to select who will draft first and who will play first
    GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.prelimFirstPlayerColor = ""                                        -- the color that is selected to "go first" on the chooseFirstPlayer panel.
    GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstGameplayTurnColor = ""                                        -- stores the color of the player that will be playing first/taking the first turn; is also used to change the color of the "first player" name plate box in the lower left corner of the faction picking/drafting UIs.
    GameData.UISetup.TurnsSystem.firstDraftTurnColor = ""                                           -- stores the color of the player that will be drafting first, as it may be different from the color that is playing first.


    GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftInProgress = false
    GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.currentBaseDraftRound = 0
    GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftComplete = false
    GameData.UISetup.BaseDraftSystem.baseDraftPlayerTurnNumber = 1


    GameData.UISetup.ReferenceData.totalOfficialFactionCount = 0                                      -- how many factions are in the game?


--**FLAGS/GATES USED TO CONTROL VARIOUS ASPECTS OF GAMEPLAY**
    GameData.SystemGates = {}
    GameData.SystemGates.cardMovementLocked = false                                         -- this flag variable is used to prevent other cards from moving when another card is entering a deck. This prevents the card scheduled to move from being pulled into the previous card's deck.
    GameData.SystemGates.overrideLockForGrouping = false                                    -- if players use the grouping action, this flag is made true, and allows the cards to group, bypassing "SystemGates.cardMovementLocked".


--**TRACKS VARIOUS MISCELLANEOUS IN-GAME DATA**
    GameData.SystemTrackers = {}
    GameData.SystemTrackers.errataAnnouncedPerCard = {}                                    -- this table stores the name of cards that have errata, for which the "this card has errata" announcement has been made
    GameData.SystemTrackers.activeWaitTimersByGUID = {}                                    -- this table holds the waitIDs of wait functions that might be triggered when a deck is created or added into by other cards/decks
    GameData.SystemTrackers.heldCardsPositions = {}                                        -- this table holds the positions of cards that are being held by players

--**PREPARE THE TABLE AFTER SETUP PHASE IS COMPLETED**
    GameData.TableSetup = {}
    GameData.TableSetup.expansionsIncludedThisGame = {}                                    -- this table is used to store a list of all expansions that are being utilized in this current match; this is used to bring in the bases of all expansions that are included during setup
    GameData.TableSetup.eachDraftedFactionsBaseCards = {}                                  -- this table is used when factions are being dealt out; this is used to store the bases for each faction, and is used if player's only want to use the bases for their factions (rather than expansions)
    GameData.TableSetup.titanCardsForEachPlayer = {}                                       -- this table is used when factions are being dealt out; it tracks what titans need to be dealt out
    GameData.TableSetup.nonStandardExpansionsIncluded = {Cthulhu = false, Munchkin = false}-- this table tracks whether or not a Cthulhu or Munchkin faction is used in the game, and therefore is used to make adjustments to the setup process to accommodate


--**TURN CONTROL SYSTEM**
    GameData.TurnControl = {}
    GameData.TurnControl.activePlayerCount = 1                                              -- tracks how many active/seated players are playing. Initially set when the host clicks "Yes" on the "Use Scripted Setup?" beginning panel. Also updated when seated players disconnect.
    GameData.TurnControl.currentPlayerTurnNumber = 1                                        -- the first turn will be player #1 (used to track which player's turn to start on when a save game is loaded).
    GameData.TurnControl.turnNumber = 0

    GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSystemEnabled = false
    GameData.TurnControl.ghostPlayerSeatColors = {}

--**BASE SCORING DATA**
    GameData.BaseScoring = {}
    GameData.BaseScoring.primaryTurnOwner = ""                                              -- tracks the color of the current player.
    GameData.BaseScoring.lastTurnColor = ""                                                 -- tracks the color of the last player to pass or use special.
    GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPhaseTracker = {}                                       -- this table stores the variables needed to monitor the progress of any base scoring; it does not hold data for specific bases, but monitors the progress of scoring in general.
    GameData.BaseScoring.baseCardProfiles = {}                                              -- this table will track all pertinent info related to each individual baseBlock's base, score, etc
    GameData.BaseScoring.baseScoringPanelStateForEachPlayer = {}                            -- this table will track the status of each player's XML UI for baseScoringPanel


--**TRACK AND CALCULATE THE FINAL SCORE**
    GameData.FinalScoring = {}
    GameData.FinalScoring.victoryPoints = {}                                                 -- this table holds the VP scores for each player
    GameData.FinalScoring.madnessCardCount = {}                                              -- this table tracks how many madness cards each player has
    GameData.FinalScoring.madnessPenaltiesCompleted = false                                  -- this flag variable marks when the madness cards have been counted (and will be subsequently be used to calculate final scores)
    GameData.FinalScoring.tieCheckPanelBypass = false                                        -- this flag variable indicates whether or not players have chosen to keep playing when players are tied for the win
    GameData.FinalScoring.pauseScoringForTieResolution = false                               -- this switch variable notes when the turn progression system needs to be paused momentarily to allow the host to choose to end game early, or continue playing in the case of a tie


--**CLEAN UP WHEN THE GAME IS FINISHED**
    GameData.CleanUp = {}
    GameData.CleanUp.cleanupInProgress = false                                          -- this flag variable is used to note when the gameboard is being cleaned up after a game is over
    GameData.CleanUp.cardsToReturnToOwner = {                                           -- this table holds the GUIDs of cards that are not in the correct player's decks
        ["singleCards"] ={}
    }
    GameData.CleanUp.customExtraCleanUp = {}


--**STATS TO REPORT TO SPREADSHEET AT GAME CONCLUSION**
    GameData.GameStats = {}
    GameData.GameStats.turnsTaken = {}                                                    -- this table is used to track how many turns each player took
    GameData.GameStats.manualTurnsTriggered = {}                                          -- this table tracks when players change turns using the turn table, instead of the end turn button
    GameData.GameStats.totalRoundsCompleted = 1                                           -- tracks how many rounds of turns have been taken

    GameData.GameStats.gameCompletionStatus = "In Progress"
    GameData.GameStats.gameIsComplete = false                                             -- this flag variable marks when the game has been completed

    GameData.GameStats.gameTimestamps = {}
    GameData.GameStats.gameSessionID = ""                                                 -- a persistent ID used for tracking game sessions; used for game stats reporting


--**CUSTOM FACTION DATA**
    GameData.Customs = {}
    GameData.Customs.maximumCustomQuant = 200                                           -- controls how many rows in the main Custom List UI panel are pre-added
    GameData.Customs.resetMainCustomList = true                                         -- this flag tells the script when the main custom list UI needs to be redrawn
    GameData.Customs.customDatabaseLoaded = false                                       -- this flag variable marks whether or not the custom database has been pinged yet (to populate the custom list)
    GameData.Customs.customReadyToDetectNewObj = false                                  -- this flag variable marks whether the system is prepared to identify a new custom object during the "register new" custom object process, by placing the object on the mat.
    GameData.Customs.customsMandatory = false                                           -- a flag variable marking whether all custom factions should always be included in the draft pool or not.
    GameData.Customs.customSortByType = "Date"                                          -- a switch variable that directs how to sort the factions in the main custom list panel
    GameData.Customs.customsSortDirectionUp = true                                      -- whether to sort the factions in the main custom list panel in ascending/descending Order
    GameData.Customs.customEditMode = false                                             -- when true, marks that the user is intending to edit their own customs, and directs the code to handle user input on the CustomsPanel for editing, as opposed to drafting
    GameData.Customs.customEditSpawnedIn = false                                        -- if a player spawns in their custom object for editing, this will be true. Used to prevent spawning the object in more than once.
    GameData.Customs.customEditModeWaitingForDeleteConfirm = false                      -- this is true when prompted to delete a custom object, and prevents interactions with other UI objects while waiting for input.
    GameData.Customs.customDeckType = "Faction"                                         -- either "Faction" or "Extra"; directs what code/script to use based on whether a faction deck or an extra deck is being uploaded
    GameData.Customs.basesArePortrait = false                                           -- this flag is true if custom base cards are uploaded in the wrong orientation (which is portrait)

    GameData.Customs.allWorksheetData = {}                                              -- this table holds all the information kept on the Google Spreadsheet, and stored here when it gets requested
    GameData.Customs.allCustomFactionsAvailableToInstance_Array = {}                    -- this table contains a subset of information from customs.allWorksheetData (all the Google Spreadsheet info) that is usable for this user (private items are kept private)
    GameData.Customs.allExtraObjectsByID = {}                                           -- a table of ALL extra objects/accessories, keyed by their unique IDs
    GameData.Customs.onlyThisHostsCustomContent_Array = {}                              -- table of all this host's custom content (obtained upon database query) to setup capability of editing previously submitted custom content
    GameData.Customs.UIRowOwnedByHost = {}                                              -- this table notes which of all the rows in the custom list are specifically owned/created by the host (used for keeping those rows marked with color)
    GameData.Customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array = {}                          -- the list of all custom factions selected to be added to the overall faction pool from the main custom faction list.
    GameData.Customs.customFactionCoreDataByName = {}                                   -- a table that contains all pertinent data and objectData pertaining to each selected custom faction.
    GameData.Customs.customKitBoxData = {}                                              -- keeps a reference to the custom faction kit box for ease of access
    GameData.Customs.customExpansionsUsed = {}                                          -- a table that holds the name of any custom expansions so that the bases from that expansion can be searched for and included in the game
    GameData.Customs.customExtrasRequired = {}
    GameData.Customs.customListForRandomized = {}                                       -- a copy of the customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array table that can be altered for purposes of generating a pool of factions for each individual player.
    GameData.Customs.customListForDrafting = {}                                         -- a copy of the customs.customFactionsToIncludeInDraft_Array table that can be altered for purposes of generating a single draft pool of factions.
    GameData.Customs.draftedCustomFactions = {}                                         -- a list of custom factions that were ultimately selected to be played with
    GameData.Customs.databaseEntryBackup = {}

    GameData.Customs.startDealingCustomsAt = 1                                          -- a number that is randomly chosen based on number of players. That player will be the first to be dealt a custom faction into their pool so as to provide a bit more randomness when dealing/divvying out custom factions into individual pools.

    GameData.Customs.lastExtraSpawnPosition = {-78, 3, 25}
    GameData.Customs.landscapePositions = {}
    GameData.Customs.playerFactionSpecificExtraCounts = {}

    GameData.Customs.importActive = false                                               -- this flag variable marks when custom faction data is currently being imported from Google sheet.
    GameData.Customs.dataImported = false                                               -- this flag marks whether or not card info has been imported from the spreadsheet, and controls whether to use imported data or look at the cards for data
    GameData.Customs.customEntryCardData = {}                                           -- a table thats holds name, quantity, and value info for each card. Generated by iterating over each card in a custom deck to perform initial check for already existing names.
    GameData.Customs.customCardDetails = {}                                             -- collects all info required to setup each custom card, and is what is referenced to populate the individual card entry page
    GameData.Customs.registerNewObjectInfoTable = {}                                    -- a table that holds all pertinent data/info for the object that is being registered to the custom system.
    GameData.Customs.scriptWarningWait = nil                                            -- this variable will hold a reference to the wait condition that is activated if custom object scripting is found. This is needed in order to be able to cancel the wait condition from another function.
    GameData.Customs.pauseForScriptWarning = false                                      -- this is a flag variable that pauses/waits the code until player acknowledges the custom object script message.


--**BUG REPORTING SYSTEM**
    GameData.BugReports = {}
    GameData.BugReports.bugReportString = ""
    GameData.BugReports.bugCharCount = 0
    GameData.BugReports.bugInputLen = 0
    GameData.BugReports.bugInputRows = 1
    GameData.BugReports.oldBugInputVal = ""
    GameData.BugReports.statusOn = false


return GameData

end)
return __bundle_require("__root")
XmlUI:
<!-- include Smash Up/Defaults.xml -->
<Defaults>

    <Color name="Gold" color="#CBB74D"/>

    <Color name="selectedRed" color="#AF1515"/>
    <Color name="disabledRed" color="#DFA7A7"/>
    <!-- <Color name="disabledRed" color="#6D5050"/> -->
    <Color name="highlightedGreen" color="#6EB26B"/>
    <Color name="selectedGreen" color="#288C23"/>
    <Color name="disabledGreen" color="#C7E8C5"/>
    <!-- <Color name="disabledGreen" color="#40563F"/> -->
    <Color name="highlightedYellow" color="#E5E495"/>
    <Color name="selectedYellow" color="#BFBC26"/>
    <Color name="disabledYellow" color="#E8E0A0"/>

    <Color name="selectedOrange" color="#CC5118"/>

    <Color name="highlightedBlue" color="#5EA9FF"/>
    <Color name="selectedBlue" color="#1A73D8"/>
    <Color name="disabledBlue" color="#D6E9FF"/>

    <!--Baseline Defaults-->
    <Panel childForceExpandHeight="false" childForceExpandWidth="false" tooltipPosition="Below" tooltip="" childAlignment="UpperCenter"/>
    <VerticalLayout padding="0 0 0 0" childForceExpandHeight="false" childForceExpandWidth="false" childAlignment="UpperCenter"/>
    <HorizontalLayout padding="0 0 0 0" childForceExpandHeight="false" childForceExpandWidth="false" childAlignment="UpperCenter"/>
    <Toggle isOn="true" childForceExpandHeight="false" childForceExpandWidth="false"/>
    <VerticalScrollView horizontal="false" horizontalScrollbarVisibility="None" horizontalScrollbarHeight="0" rayCastTarget="true"/>

<!--=====================================================================================================================================================================-->
<!--set up/starting buttons-->
    <!--the initial/opening panel for "Use Scripted Setup"-->
    <VerticalLayout class="beginPanel" outline="Black" outlineSize="3 3" width="23.5%" height="16.7%" rectAlignment="UpperCenter" offsetXY="0 -300" padding="0 0 25 0" allowDragging="true" returnToOriginalPositionWhenReleased="false" visibility="Host"/>
    <VerticalLayout class="inactive" color="rgb(0.65, 0.65, 0.65)" tooltip="Must be seated to continue. Please choose a color."/>
    <VerticalLayout class="active" color="White" tooltip="Click 'Yes' button to continue."/>

    <!--the HLayout holds the row of buttons, and helps to properply pad the buttons-->
    <HorizontalLayout class="beginPanel:@HorizontalLayout" childAlignment="MiddleCenter" padding="0 0 20 0" spacing="40"/>

    <!--title-sized text-->
    <Text class="title" fontSize="30" fontStyle="Bold"/>

    <Button class="beginPanel:@Button" preferredWidth="130" preferredHeight="75" textColor="Black" fontStyle="Bold" fontSize="24" outline="Black" outlineSize="2"/>
    <Button class="yesButton" colors="Blue|#9ECBFF|#346CAD|Gray" text="Yes" onClick="xmlUserInput.buttonFunctionSelector"/>
    <Button class="noButton" colors="#F4E946|#F2EEBF|#A09A4B|Gray" text="No" onClick="xmlUserInput.buttonFunctionSelector" interactable="true"/>
    <Button class="inactive" interactable="false"/>

    <!--this panel holds the title text on the `spectatorWarning` UI element to provide padding between title and subText-->
    <Panel class="beginPanel>@VerticalLayout>@Panel" padding="0 0 0 10"/>

    <!--subText (non-title text)-->
    <Text class="subText" fontSize="18" fontStyle="Bold"/>

<!--=====================================================================================================================================================================-->

    <!--Expansion and Faction selection panels-->
    <Panel class="mainParent" width="500" height="788" allowDragging="true" returnToOriginalPositionWhenReleased="false" active="false"/>
    <Panel class="main" color="white" outline="Black" outlineSize="3 3"/>
    <Panel class="closerPanel" preferredWidth="500" minHeight="46" preferredHeight="46" childAlignment="MiddleRight" padding="0 7 8 8"/>
    <Panel class="titlePanel" preferredWidth="500" minHeight="37" preferredHeight="37" childAlignment="MiddleCenter" padding="0 0 4 0"/>
    <Panel class="selectAllPanel" preferredWidth="500" minHeight="34" preferredHeight="34" padding="90 0 13 0" childAlignment="LowerLeft"/>
    <Panel class="blueLinePanel" preferredWidth="500" minHeight="17" preferredHeight="17" padding="0 0 -10 9" childAlignment="LowerCenter"/>

    <!--draw the draftMethod selection UI-->
    <Panel id="draftMethod" class="draftMethod main" tooltip="Choose the method players will use to select their factions." active="false">
        <VerticalLayout>
            <Panel class="closerPanel"><Button id="infoDraft" class="infoButton" type="drafting"/><Panel minWidth="3"/><Button id="closer" class="closeButton"/></Panel>

            </VerticalLayout>
            <Panel class="blueLinePanel"><Text /></Panel>

            <VerticalLayout minHeight="505" preferredHeight="505">
                <ToggleGroup>
                    <VerticalLayout>
                        <Toggle id="randomSelectionOption"><Text id="draftOptionA"><b>Individual Pools:</b><textsize size="18"> 3 </textsize><textsize size="15">factions are randomized to each player from which they choose their 2 factions.</textsize></Text></Toggle>
                        <Toggle id="straightDraftOption" isOn="false"><Text id="draftOptionB"><b>Straight Draft:</b><textsize size="18"> 3 </textsize><textsize size="15">factions per player are randomly selected to form a pool from which each player takes turns selecting their 2 factions.</textsize></Text></Toggle>
                        <Toggle id="snakeDraftOption" isOn="false"><Text id="draftOptionC"><b>Snake Draft:</b><textsize size="18"> 3 </textsize><textsize size="15">factions per player are randomly selected to form a pool from which each player takes a turn selecting their first faction, and selects their second faction in reverse turn order.</textsize></Text></Toggle>
                        <Toggle id="openDraftOption" isOn="false"><Text id="draftOptionD"><b>Open Draft:</b> <textsize size="15"> every player takes turns selecting their factions from all available.</textsize></Text></Toggle>
                        <Toggle id="freePickOption" isOn="false"><Text id="draftOptionE"><b>Free Pick:</b><textsize size="15"> all players can choose from all available factions simultaneously.</textsize></Text></Toggle>

                    <Text fontSize="18" text="randomly selected per player." horizontalOverflow="Wrap"/>
                </VerticalLayout>
            </VerticalLayout>

            <Panel class="blueLinePanel"><Text /></Panel>

                <Button id="draftBack" class="mainButton back"/>
                <Button id="draftNext" class="mainButton next" tooltip="Next step: select which player will go first."/>

        </VerticalLayout>

            <Text fontStyle="Bold" alignment="UpperLeft" text="Select the method, or pattern, players will use to draft their factions."/>
            <Text fontStyle="Bold" alignment="UpperLeft">
                Use the slider to select how many factions per player will be included in the draft pool.
                The minimum number of factions that must be included per player is 2.
            </Text>
            <Text fontStyle="Bold" alignment="UpperLeft">
                When drafting from a collective randomized pool, the maximum number of factions per player is 9.
                When giving each individual player their own pool of random factions, the maximum number per player is 6.
                Because 'Open Draft' and 'Free Pick' use all of the factions in the game, selecting a number for factions per player is unnecessary.
            </Text>
        </VerticalLayout>

--Orange Drawer Open
local ConcealedStorageHeight = 3.0
local ConceiledStorageOffset = 10000.0
local StorageState = 1

local BB = {
	Min = {
		x = -16.0,
		y = 41.99,
		z = -50.0
	},
	Max = {
		x = 16.0,
		y = 41.99,
		z = -32.0
	}
}

function onLoad()
    -- self.interactable = false;

    self.createButton({
		label = "",
		click_function = "onButtonClick",
		function_owner = self,
		width = 1000,
		height = 750,
		color = {1, 0, 0, 0.0},
		position = {0, 40.7, 50.5},
		rotation = {-90, 0, 0},
		font_size = 200
    })

	if self.getStateId() ~= StorageState then
    Timer.create({
        identifier = ("onAfterLoad" .. self.guid),
        function_name = "onAfterLoad",
        delay = 0.2
    })
	end
end

function onAfterLoad()
	local pos = self.getPosition()
	local bounds = self.getBoundsNormalized()
	local rot = self.getRotation()
	local scale = self.getScale()
	local direction = 1.0

	if rot.y == 0 then
		direction = -1.0
	end

	BB.Min.x = (BB.Min.x * scale.x) + pos.x
	BB.Min.y = (BB.Min.y * scale.y) + pos.y - 1.5
	BB.Min.z = ((BB.Min.z * direction) * scale.z) + pos.z

	BB.Max.x = 	(BB.Max.x * scale.x) + pos.x
	BB.Max.y = 	(BB.Max.y * scale.y) + pos.y + ConcealedStorageHeight + 0.5
	BB.Max.z = ((BB.Max.z * direction) * scale.z) + pos.z

	HideObjectsAbove( false )
end

function onButtonClick()
	local currentState = self.getStateId()
	local nextState = 1 + (currentState % 2)

	if currentState ~= StorageState then
		-- HideObjectsAbove( true )
	end

	self.setState( nextState )
end

function HideObjectsAbove( toggle )
    local objectsAbove = {}
	local BBMin = { x = BB.Min.x, y = BB.Min.y, z = BB.Min.z }
	local BBMax = { x = BB.Max.x, y = BB.Max.y, z = BB.Max.z }

	if not toggle then
		BBMin.y = BBMin.y - ConceiledStorageOffset
		BBMax.y = BBMax.y - ConceiledStorageOffset
	end

    for k,v in pairs( getAllObjects() ) do
        if v != self then
            if PointToAABBIntersect( BBMin, BBMax, v.getPosition() ) then
                if toggle then
                    Store( v )
                else
                    Dispense( v )
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Assumes ||min|| < ||max||
function PointToAABBIntersect( min, max, point )
    if IsInRange( point.x, min.x, max.x ) and
       IsInRange( point.y, min.y, max.y ) and
       IsInRange( point.z, min.z, max.z ) then
	   return true
    end

    return false
end

function IsInRange( value, a, b )
	local min = 0
	local max = 0

	if a > b then
		max = a
		min = b
	else
		max = b
		min = a
	end

	if value > min and value < max then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function Store( obj )
	local pos = obj.getPosition()
	local isLocked = obj.getLock()

	obj.setVar( "LockStatus", isLocked )

    obj.interactable = false
    obj.setLock( true )
    obj.setPosition({
        x = pos.x,
        y = pos.y - ConceiledStorageOffset,
        z = pos.z
    })
end

function Dispense( obj )
	local pos = obj.getPosition()
	local originalLockStatus = obj.getVar( "LockStatus" )

    obj.setPosition({
        x = pos.x,
        y = pos.y + ConceiledStorageOffset,
        z = pos.z
    })

    obj.interactable = true

	if originalLockStatus ~= nil and originalLockStatus == true then
		obj.setLock( true )
	else
		obj.setLock( false )
	end
end

--Green Drawer Open
local ConcealedStorageHeight = 3.0
local ConceiledStorageOffset = 10000.0
local StorageState = 1

local BB = {
	Min = {
		x = -16.0,
		y = 41.99,
		z = -50.0
	},
	Max = {
		x = 16.0,
		y = 41.99,
		z = -32.0
	}
}

function onLoad()
    self.interactable = false;

    self.createButton({
		label = "",
		click_function = "onButtonClick",
		function_owner = self,
		width = 1000,
		height = 750,
		color = {1, 0, 0, 0.0},
		position = {0, 40.7, 50.5},
		rotation = {-90, 0, 0},
		font_size = 200
    })

	if self.getStateId() ~= StorageState then
    Timer.create({
        identifier = ("onAfterLoad" .. self.guid),
        function_name = "onAfterLoad",
        delay = 0.2
    })
	end
end

function onAfterLoad()
	local pos = self.getPosition()
	local bounds = self.getBoundsNormalized()
	local rot = self.getRotation()
	local scale = self.getScale()
	local direction = 1.0

	if rot.y == 0 then
		direction = -1.0
	end

	BB.Min.x = (BB.Min.x * scale.x) + pos.x
	BB.Min.y = (BB.Min.y * scale.y) + pos.y - 1.5
	BB.Min.z = ((BB.Min.z * direction) * scale.z) + pos.z

	BB.Max.x = 	(BB.Max.x * scale.x) + pos.x
	BB.Max.y = 	(BB.Max.y * scale.y) + pos.y + ConcealedStorageHeight + 0.5
	BB.Max.z = ((BB.Max.z * direction) * scale.z) + pos.z

	HideObjectsAbove( false )
end

function onButtonClick()
	local currentState = self.getStateId()
	local nextState = 1 + (currentState % 2)

	if currentState ~= StorageState then
		-- HideObjectsAbove( true )
	end

	self.setState( nextState )
end

function HideObjectsAbove( toggle )
    local objectsAbove = {}
	local BBMin = { x = BB.Min.x, y = BB.Min.y, z = BB.Min.z }
	local BBMax = { x = BB.Max.x, y = BB.Max.y, z = BB.Max.z }

	if not toggle then
		BBMin.y = BBMin.y - ConceiledStorageOffset
		BBMax.y = BBMax.y - ConceiledStorageOffset
	end

    for k,v in pairs( getAllObjects() ) do
        if v != self then
            if PointToAABBIntersect( BBMin, BBMax, v.getPosition() ) then
                if toggle then
                    Store( v )
                else
                    Dispense( v )
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Assumes ||min|| < ||max||
function PointToAABBIntersect( min, max, point )
    if IsInRange( point.x, min.x, max.x ) and
       IsInRange( point.y, min.y, max.y ) and
       IsInRange( point.z, min.z, max.z ) then
	   return true
    end

    return false
end

function IsInRange( value, a, b )
	local min = 0
	local max = 0

	if a > b then
		max = a
		min = b
	else
		max = b
		min = a
	end

	if value > min and value < max then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function Store( obj )
	local pos = obj.getPosition()
	local isLocked = obj.getLock()

	obj.setVar( "LockStatus", isLocked )

    obj.interactable = false
    obj.setLock( true )
    obj.setPosition({
        x = pos.x,
        y = pos.y - ConceiledStorageOffset,
        z = pos.z
    })
end

function Dispense( obj )
	local pos = obj.getPosition()
	local originalLockStatus = obj.getVar( "LockStatus" )

    obj.setPosition({
        x = pos.x,
        y = pos.y + ConceiledStorageOffset,
        z = pos.z
    })

    obj.interactable = true

	if originalLockStatus ~= nil and originalLockStatus == true then
		obj.setLock( true )
	else
		obj.setLock( false )
	end
end

2.LuaScript:
--Purple Drawer Open
local ConcealedStorageHeight = 3.0
local ConceiledStorageOffset = 10000.0
local StorageState = 1

local BB = {
	Min = {
		x = -16.0,
		y = 41.99,
		z = -50.0
	},
	Max = {
		x = 16.0,
		y = 41.99,
		z = -32.0
	}
}

function onLoad()
    self.interactable = false;

    self.createButton({
		label = "",
		click_function = "onButtonClick",
		function_owner = self,
		width = 1000,
		height = 750,
		color = {1, 0, 0, 0.0},
		position = {0, 40.7, 50.5},
		rotation = {-90, 0, 0},
		font_size = 200
    })

	if self.getStateId() ~= StorageState then
    Timer.create({
        identifier = ("onAfterLoad" .. self.guid),
        function_name = "onAfterLoad",
        delay = 0.2
    })
	end
end

function onAfterLoad()
	local pos = self.getPosition()
	local bounds = self.getBoundsNormalized()
	local rot = self.getRotation()
	local scale = self.getScale()
	local direction = 1.0

	if rot.y == 0 then
		direction = -1.0
	end

	BB.Min.x = (BB.Min.x * scale.x) + pos.x
	BB.Min.y = (BB.Min.y * scale.y) + pos.y - 1.5
	BB.Min.z = ((BB.Min.z * direction) * scale.z) + pos.z

	BB.Max.x = 	(BB.Max.x * scale.x) + pos.x
	BB.Max.y = 	(BB.Max.y * scale.y) + pos.y + ConcealedStorageHeight + 0.5
	BB.Max.z = ((BB.Max.z * direction) * scale.z) + pos.z

	HideObjectsAbove( false )
end

function onButtonClick()
	local currentState = self.getStateId()
	local nextState = 1 + (currentState % 2)

	if currentState ~= StorageState then
		-- HideObjectsAbove( true )
	end

	self.setState( nextState )
end

function HideObjectsAbove( toggle )
    local objectsAbove = {}
	local BBMin = { x = BB.Min.x, y = BB.Min.y, z = BB.Min.z }
	local BBMax = { x = BB.Max.x, y = BB.Max.y, z = BB.Max.z }

	if not toggle then
		BBMin.y = BBMin.y - ConceiledStorageOffset
		BBMax.y = BBMax.y - ConceiledStorageOffset
	end

    for k,v in pairs( getAllObjects() ) do
        if v != self then
            if PointToAABBIntersect( BBMin, BBMax, v.getPosition() ) then
                if toggle then
                    Store( v )
                else
                    Dispense( v )
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Assumes ||min|| < ||max||
function PointToAABBIntersect( min, max, point )
    if IsInRange( point.x, min.x, max.x ) and
       IsInRange( point.y, min.y, max.y ) and
       IsInRange( point.z, min.z, max.z ) then
	   return true
    end

    return false
end

function IsInRange( value, a, b )
	local min = 0
	local max = 0

	if a > b then
		max = a
		min = b
	else
		max = b
		min = a
	end

	if value > min and value < max then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function Store( obj )
	local pos = obj.getPosition()
	local isLocked = obj.getLock()

	obj.setVar( "LockStatus", isLocked )

    obj.interactable = false
    obj.setLock( true )
    obj.setPosition({
        x = pos.x,
        y = pos.y - ConceiledStorageOffset,
        z = pos.z
    })
end

function Dispense( obj )
	local pos = obj.getPosition()
	local originalLockStatus = obj.getVar( "LockStatus" )

    obj.setPosition({
        x = pos.x,
        y = pos.y + ConceiledStorageOffset,
